sentences.hanzi: 马克说：“还没有。”
sentences.pinyin: ma3 ke4 shuo1 hai2 mei2 you3

sentences.hanzi: 老王说：“早上好！你吃了吗？”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 wang2 shuo1 zao3 shang5 hao3 ni3 chi1 le5 ma5
sentences.english: Old Wang says, “Good morning! Have you eaten?”

sentences.hanzi: 马克说：“没有。”

sentences.hanzi: “她是小七。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shi4 xiao3 qi1
sentences.english: “She's Little Seven.”

sentences.hanzi: “小七？小七是机器人啊！她也是我妈妈！”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 qi1 xiao3 qi1 shi4 ji1 qi4 ren2 a5 ta1 ye3 shi4 wo3 ma1 ma5

sentences.hanzi: 大明看着小八。小八看着大明。

sentences.pinyin: xiao3 ba1 shuo1 ni3 hao3 ge1 ge5
sentences.english: Little Eight says, “Hello, big brother.”

sentences.pinyin: qing3 wen4 zhe4 li3 you3 da4 xiong2 mao1 ma5
sentences.english: “Excuse me, are there pandas here?”

sentences.english: “Yes. Look, that big thing.”

sentences.hanzi: “那是什么？”

sentences.hanzi: “它在做什么？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zai4 zuo4 shen2 me5

sentences.hanzi: “它在睡觉。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zai4 shui4 jiao4

sentences.hanzi: “它一天都做什么？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yi1 tian1 dou1 zuo4 shen2 me5

sentences.hanzi: “吃东西，睡觉。”
sentences.pinyin: chi1 dong1 xi5 shui4 jiao4
sentences.english: “It eats and it sleeps.”

sentences.hanzi: “还有呢？”
sentences.pinyin: hai2 you3 ne5
sentences.english: “And what else?”

sentences.hanzi: “吃东西，睡觉。”
sentences.pinyin: chi1 dong1 xi5 shui4 jiao4
sentences.english: “It eats and it sleeps.”

sentences.hanzi: 小红看着我，说：“像你一样。”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 hong2 kan4 zhe5 wo3 shuo1 xiang4 ni3 yi1 yang4
sentences.english: Xiaohong looks at me and says, “Just like you.”

sentences.hanzi: 两千多年前，中国有一个老师，叫孔子。

sentences.english: More than two thousand years ago, there was a teacher in China called Confucius.

sentences.hanzi: 他有很多学生，但是他想做更大的事。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 you3 hen3 duo1 xue2 sheng5 dan4 shi4 ta1 xiang3 zuo4 geng4 da4 de5 shi4
sentences.english: He had many students, but he wanted to do something bigger.

sentences.hanzi: 他带着学生走了很多地方，找能用他的人。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 dai4 zhe5 xue2 sheng5 zou3 le5 hen3 duo1 di4 fang5 zhao3 neng2 yong4 ta1 de5 ren2
sentences.english: He travelled to many places with his students, looking for someone who would use him.

sentences.hanzi: 很多人听他说，但是没有人用他。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 ren2 ting1 ta1 shuo1 dan4 shi4 mei2 you3 ren2 yong4 ta1
sentences.english: Many people listened to him, but nobody used him.

sentences.hanzi: 他找了很多年，还是没有工作。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zhao3 le5 hen3 duo1 nian2 hai2 shi5 mei2 you3 gong1 zuo4
sentences.english: He looked for many years and still had no job.

sentences.hanzi: 孔子回了家，还是做老师。
sentences.pinyin: kong3 zi3 hui2 le5 jia1 hai2 shi5 zuo4 lao3 shi1
sentences.english: Confucius went home and went on being a teacher.

sentences.hanzi: 都说他有三千个学生。
sentences.pinyin: dou1 shuo1 ta1 you3 san1 qian1 ge4 xue2 sheng5
sentences.english: People say he had three thousand students.

sentences.hanzi: 他告诉学生：“三个人一起走，一定有一个是我的老师。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 gao4 su5 xue2 sheng5 san1 ge4 ren2 yi1 qi3 zou3 yi1 ding4 you3 yi1 ge5 shi4 wo3 de5 lao3 shi1
sentences.english: He told his students, “When three people walk together, one of them is sure to be my teacher.”

sentences.hanzi: 孔子死了，他的学生还在说他说过的这些话。
sentences.pinyin: kong3 zi3 si3 le5 ta1 de5 xue2 sheng1 hai2 zai4 shuo1 ta1 shuo1 guo5 de5 zhe4 xie1 hua4
sentences.english: Confucius died, and his students went on repeating the things he had said.

sentences.hanzi: 那时候，没有人用他。
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi2 hou5 mei2 you3 ren2 yong4 ta1
sentences.english: In those days, nobody used him.

sentences.hanzi: 今天，很多人都在用这些话。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 hen3 duo1 ren2 dou1 zai4 yong4 zhe4 xie1 hua4
sentences.english: Today, many people use those words.

sentences.hanzi: 唐朝的时候，很多人带着东西来长安。
sentences.pinyin: tang2 chao2 de5 shi2 hou5 hen3 duo1 ren2 dai4 zhe5 dong1 xi5 lai2 chang2 an1
sentences.english: In the Tang dynasty, many people came to Chang'an bringing goods.

sentences.pinyin: yi1 tian1 xiao3 an1 kan4 dao4 yi1 ge5 da4 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: One day, Xiao'an saw something big.

sentences.hanzi: “爸爸，那是什么？”
sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 na4 shi4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: “Dad, what's that?”

sentences.hanzi: “那是骆驼。它走了两年才到这里。”
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi4 luo4 tuo2 ta1 zou3 le5 liang3 nian2 cai2 dao4 zhe4 li3
sentences.english: “That's a camel. It walked for two years to get here.”

sentences.hanzi: 一个人带着骆驼走过来。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 ren2 dai4 zhe5 luo4 tuo2 zou3 guo4 lai2
sentences.english: A man came over, leading the camel.

sentences.hanzi: 小安问他：“你叫什么？”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 an1 wen4 ta1 ni3 jiao4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: Xiao'an asked him, “What's your name?”

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“你好！”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 ni3 hao3
sentences.english: He said, “Hello!”

sentences.hanzi: 小安问：“你从什么地方来？”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 an1 wen4 ni3 cong2 shen2 me5 di4 fang5 lai2
sentences.english: Xiao'an asked, “Where do you come from?”

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“你好！”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 ni3 hao3
sentences.english: He said, “Hello!”

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸说：“他只会说这个。”
sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 shuo1 ta1 zhi3 hui4 shuo1 zhe4 ge5
sentences.english: Dad said, “That's all he can say.”

sentences.hanzi: 小安想了想，说：“我是小安。”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 an1 xiang3 le5 xiang3 shuo1 wo3 shi4 xiao3 an1
sentences.english: Xiao'an thought for a moment and said, “I'm Xiao'an.”

sentences.hanzi: 那个人很高兴，说：“我是小安！”
sentences.pinyin: na4 ge5 ren2 hen3 gao1 xing4 shuo1 wo3 shi4 xiao3 an1
sentences.english: The man looked delighted and said, “I'm Xiao'an!”

sentences.hanzi: 小安说：“不！你不是小安，我是小安！”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 an1 shuo1 bu4 ni3 bu4 shi4 xiao3 an1 wo3 shi4 xiao3 an1
sentences.english: Xiao'an said, “No! You're not Xiao'an, I'm Xiao'an!”

sentences.hanzi: 那个人说：“不！你不是小安，我是小安！”
sentences.pinyin: na4 ge5 ren2 shuo1 bu4 ni3 bu4 shi4 xiao3 an1 wo3 shi4 xiao3 an1
sentences.english: The man said, “No! You're not Xiao'an, I'm Xiao'an!”

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸看了看他们，说：“好了，现在长安有两个小安了。”
sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 kan4 le5 kan4 ta1 men5 shuo1 hao3 le5 xian4 zai4 chang2 an1 you3 liang3 ge4 xiao3 an1 le5

sentences.hanzi: 春节到了。马克去朋友小丽家。
sentences.pinyin: chun1 jie2 dao4 le5 ma3 ke4 qu4 peng2 you5 xiao3 li4 jia1
sentences.english: Spring Festival has come. Mark goes to his friend Xiaoli's home.

sentences.pinyin: xiao3 li4 jia1 de5 men2 shang4 you3 yi1 ge5 da4 da4 de5 fu2
sentences.english: On Xiaoli's door there is a big character 福, “good luck”.

sentences.pinyin: ma3 ke4 kan4 le5 kan4 shuo1 xiao3 li4 ni3 men5 jia1 de5 fu2 dao4 le5
sentences.english: Mark takes a look and says, “Xiaoli, your 福 is upside down!”

sentences.hanzi: “我知道。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zhi1 dao4
sentences.english: “I know.”

sentences.hanzi: “我帮你放好吧。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 bang1 ni3 fang4 hao3 ba5
sentences.english: “Let me put it right for you.”

sentences.hanzi: 小丽说：“别！你说什么？再来一次。”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 li4 shuo1 bie2 ni3 shuo1 shen2 me5 zai4 lai2 yi1 ci4
sentences.english: Xiaoli says, “Don't! What did you say? Once more.”

sentences.hanzi: “福倒了。”
sentences.pinyin: fu2 dao4 le5
sentences.english: “福 is upside down.”

sentences.hanzi: “快一点，再来一次！”
sentences.pinyin: kuai4 yi1 dian3 zai4 lai2 yi1 ci4
sentences.english: “Faster, once more!”

sentences.hanzi: “福倒了，福倒了，福到了……”
sentences.pinyin: fu2 dao4 le5 fu2 dao4 le5 fu2 dao4 le5
sentences.english: “Fú dào le, fú dào le, fú dào le…”

sentences.hanzi: 马克看着小丽：“啊！福到了！”
sentences.pinyin: ma3 ke4 kan4 zhe5 xiao3 li4 a5 fu2 dao4 le5
sentences.english: Mark looks at Xiaoli. “Oh! Luck has arrived!”

sentences.hanzi: 小丽说：“对！倒和到，听起来一样。”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 li4 shuo1 dui4 dao4 he2 dao4 ting1 qi3 lai5 yi1 yang4
sentences.english: Xiaoli says, “Right! 倒 and 到 sound the same.”

sentences.hanzi: 马克想了想，问：“那我把钱倒着放，钱也会到吗？”
sentences.pinyin: ma3 ke4 xiang3 le5 xiang3 wen4 na4 wo3 ba3 qian2 dao4 zhe5 fang4 qian2 ye3 hui4 dao4 ma5
sentences.english: Mark thinks for a moment and asks, “So if I keep my money upside down, will money arrive too?”

sentences.hanzi: 小丽说：“别想了。想要钱，还是去工作吧！”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 li4 shuo1 bie2 xiang3 le5 xiang3 yao4 qian2 hai2 shi5 qu4 gong1 zuo4 ba5
sentences.english: Xiaoli says, “Forget it. If you want money, you'd better go to work!”

title: 长城有多长？
titleEnglish: How long is the Great Wall?

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸带我去长城。
sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 dai4 wo3 qu4 chang2 cheng2
sentences.english: Dad took me to the Great Wall.

sentences.hanzi: 我们八点开始走。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 ba1 dian3 kai1 shi3 zou3
sentences.english: We started walking at eight.

sentences.hanzi: 我问爸爸：“长城有多长？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wen4 ba4 ba5 chang2 cheng2 you3 duo1 chang2
sentences.english: I asked Dad, “How long is the Great Wall?”

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸说：“两万多公里。”
sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 shuo1 liang3 wan4 duo1 gong1 li3
sentences.english: Dad said, “More than twenty thousand kilometres.”

sentences.hanzi: “这么长！是谁修的？”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 me5 chang2 shi4 shei2 xiu1 de5
sentences.english: “That long! Who built it?”

sentences.hanzi: “很多很多人。他们修了两千年。”
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 hen3 duo1 ren2 ta1 men5 xiu1 le5 liang3 qian1 nian2
sentences.english: “Lots and lots of people. They built it for two thousand years.”

sentences.hanzi: 我们走啊走，走了三个小时。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 zou3 a5 zou3 zou3 le5 san1 ge4 xiao3 shi2
sentences.english: We walked and walked, for three hours.

sentences.hanzi: “爸爸，我们走了多少？”
sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 wo3 men5 zou3 le5 duo1 shao5
sentences.english: “Dad, how far have we walked?”

sentences.hanzi: “四公里。”
sentences.pinyin: si4 gong1 li3
sentences.english: “Four kilometres.”

sentences.hanzi: “还有多少？”
sentences.pinyin: hai2 you3 duo1 shao5
sentences.english: “How much is left?”

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸想了想，说：“两万多公里。”
sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 xiang3 le5 xiang3 shuo1 liang3 wan4 duo1 gong1 li3
sentences.english: Dad thought for a moment and said, “More than twenty thousand kilometres.”

sentences.hanzi: 我坐了下来。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zuo4 le5 xia4 lai5
sentences.english: I sat down.

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸也坐了下来，说：“别担心。他们修了两千年，我们不要走那么快。”
sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 ye3 zuo4 le5 xia4 lai5 shuo1 bie2 dan1 xin1 ta1 men5 xiu1 le5 liang3 qian1 nian2 wo3 men5 bu4 yao4 zou3 na4 me5 kuai4
sentences.english: Dad sat down too and said, “Don't worry. They took two thousand years to build it. We shouldn't walk so fast.”

title: 月亮上的兔子
titlePinyin: yue4 liang5 shang4 de5 tu4 zi5

sentences.hanzi: 小月七岁的时候，妈妈告诉她：“月亮上有一只兔子。”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 yue4 qi1 sui4 de5 shi2 hou5 ma1 ma5 gao4 su5 ta1 yue4 liang4 shang4 you3 yi1 zhi1 tu4 zi5
sentences.english: When Xiaoyue was seven, her mother told her, “There is a rabbit on the moon.”

sentences.hanzi: 小月问：“真有吗？”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 yue4 wen4 zhen1 you3 ma5
sentences.english: Xiaoyue asked, “Is there really?”

sentences.hanzi: 妈妈说：“真有。”
sentences.pinyin: ma1 ma5 shuo1 zhen1 you3
sentences.english: Her mother said, “There really is.”

sentences.hanzi: 三十年后，小月到了月亮上。
sentences.pinyin: san1 shi2 nian2 hou4 xiao3 yue4 dao4 le5 yue4 liang5 shang4
sentences.english: Thirty years later, Xiaoyue reached the moon.

sentences.hanzi: 她是第一个来这里的中国人。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shi4 di4 yi1 ge4 lai2 zhe4 li3 de5 zhong1 guo2 ren2
sentences.english: She was the first Chinese person to come here.

sentences.hanzi: 这里什么都没有。没有人，也没有兔子。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 li3 shen2 me5 dou1 mei2 you3 mei2 you3 ren2 ye3 mei2 you3 tu4 zi5
sentences.english: There was nothing here. No people, and no rabbit.

sentences.hanzi: 她走了一个小时。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zou3 le5 yi1 ge5 xiao3 shi2
sentences.english: She walked for an hour.

sentences.hanzi: 这时候，她看到前面有一个小东西。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 hou5 ta1 kan4 dao4 qian2 mian4 you3 yi1 ge5 xiao3 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: Then she saw a small thing ahead of her.

sentences.hanzi: 她走过去，看了看。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zou3 guo4 qu4 kan4 le5 kan4
sentences.english: She walked over and took a look.

sentences.hanzi: 它身上写着：玉兔。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shen1 shang5 xie3 zhe5 yu4 tu4
sentences.english: Written on its body was: Jade Rabbit.

sentences.hanzi: 很多年前，中国把这个机器人送到了月亮上。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 nian2 qian2 zhong1 guo2 ba3 zhe4 ge5 ji1 qi4 ren2 song4 dao4 le5 yue4 liang5 shang4
sentences.english: Many years ago, China had sent this robot to the moon.

sentences.hanzi: 它一直站在这里，等人来。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yi1 zhi2 zhan4 zai4 zhe4 li3 deng3 ren2 lai2
sentences.english: It had been standing here all this time, waiting for someone to come.

sentences.hanzi: 小月非常高兴，马上告诉妈妈：
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 yue4 fei1 chang2 gao1 xing4 ma3 shang4 gao4 su5 ma1 ma5
sentences.english: Xiaoyue was overjoyed, and told her mother at once:

sentences.hanzi: “妈妈，你说得对！月亮上真有一只兔子！”
sentences.pinyin: ma1 ma5 ni3 shuo1 de5 dui4 yue4 liang4 shang4 zhen1 you3 yi1 zhi1 tu4 zi5
sentences.english: “Mum, you were right! There really is a rabbit on the moon!”

glossed.meaning: Yutu, Jade Rabbit, China's moon rover

sentences.hanzi: 打了几天，他们没有看到水，却看到了一个头。
sentences.pinyin: da3 le5 ji3 tian1 ta1 men5 mei2 you3 kan4 dao4 shui3 que4 kan4 dao4 le5 yi1 ge5 tou2
sentences.english: After a few days of digging they saw no water, but they did see a head.

sentences.hanzi: 一个人的头！
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 ren2 de5 tou2
sentences.english: A human head!

sentences.hanzi: 大家都看着那个头，不知道怎么办。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 kan4 zhe5 na4 ge4 tou2 bu4 zhi1 dao4 zen3 me5 ban4
sentences.english: Everyone stared at the head, not knowing what to do.

sentences.hanzi: 那不是真人的头，是人做的。
sentences.pinyin: na4 bu4 shi4 zhen1 ren2 de5 tou2 shi4 ren2 zuo4 de5
sentences.english: It wasn't a real head. People had made it.

sentences.hanzi: 很多人来了，他们找到了更多这样的人。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 ren2 lai2 le5 ta1 men5 zhao3 dao4 le5 geng4 duo1 zhe4 yang4 de5 ren2
sentences.english: Many people came, and they found more figures like this.

sentences.hanzi: 今天我们知道，这里可能有八千个这样的人。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 li3 ke3 neng2 you3 ba1 qian1 ge4 zhe4 yang4 de5 ren2
sentences.english: Today we know there may be eight thousand of these figures here.

sentences.hanzi: 人们叫他们兵马俑。
sentences.pinyin: ren2 men5 jiao4 ta1 men5 bing1 ma3 yong3
sentences.english: People call them the Terracotta Warriors.

sentences.hanzi: 两千多年前，秦始皇让人做了这些兵马俑。
sentences.pinyin: liang3 qian1 duo1 nian2 qian2 qin2 shi3 huang2 rang4 ren2 zuo4 le5 zhe4 xie1 bing1 ma3 yong3
sentences.english: More than two thousand years ago, Qin Shi Huang had people make these terracotta warriors.

sentences.hanzi: 秦始皇死了以后，这些兵马俑一直在这里，两千多年没有人看到。
sentences.pinyin: qin2 shi3 huang2 si3 le5 yi3 hou4 zhe4 xie1 bing1 ma3 yong3 yi1 zhi2 zai4 zhe4 li3 liang3 qian1 duo1 nian2 mei2 you3 ren2 kan4 dao4
sentences.english: After Qin Shi Huang died, these warriors stayed here, and for more than two thousand years nobody saw them.

sentences.hanzi: 那几个人没有找到水。
sentences.pinyin: na4 ji3 ge4 ren2 mei2 you3 zhao3 dao4 shui3
sentences.english: Those few men never found water.

sentences.hanzi: 他们找到的，是两千多年前的中国。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 zhao3 dao4 de5 shi4 liang3 qian1 duo1 nian2 qian2 de5 zhong1 guo2
sentences.english: What they found was the China of more than two thousand years ago.

title: 这个老人是谁？

sentences.hanzi: 清朝的时候，上海有了一个新地方，可以照相。

sentences.english: In the Qing dynasty, a new place opened in Shanghai where you could have your photo taken.

sentences.pinyin: nai3 nai5 xiang3 le5 xiang3 shuo1 ye3 dui4

sentences.english: The photographer told her to sit up straight and not move.

sentences.hanzi: 奶奶坐在那里，一点都不敢动。
sentences.pinyin: nai3 nai5 zuo4 zai4 na4 li5 yi1 dian3 dou1 bu4 gan3 dong4
sentences.english: Grandmother sat there and didn't dare move at all.

sentences.hanzi: 三天后，小兰拿着一张照片回来了。

sentences.english: Three days later, Xiaolan came back with a photograph.

sentences.pinyin: nai3 nai5 nin2 kan4

sentences.pinyin: nai3 nai5 kan4 le5 hen3 jiu3 wen4 zhe4 ge5 lao3 ren2 shi4 shei2
sentences.english: Grandmother looked at it for a long time and asked, “Who is this old woman?”

sentences.pinyin: wo3 wo3 zhe4 me5 lao3 ma5

sentences.pinyin: nai3 nai5 kan4 le5 kan4 xiao3 lan2 shuo1 wo3 shuo1 guo5 ba5 zhao4 xiang4 bu4 shi4 hao3 dong1 xi5 ni3 kan4 yi1 zhao4 xiang4 jiu4 lao3 le5 er4 shi2 sui4

sentences.english: This was my first time in China, and I went straight to Guilin.

sentences.english: I sat on a boat, looking out at the mountains and the water.

sentences.english: The mountains here were beautiful.

sentences.hanzi: “没有，这是我第一次来。”
sentences.pinyin: mei2 you3 zhe4 shi4 wo3 di4 yi1 ci4 lai2

sentences.english: “Then where did you see it?”

sentences.hanzi: “我不知道。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 bu4 zhi1 dao4

sentences.english: The old man thought for a moment and asked, “Do you have twenty yuan?”

sentences.pinyin: lao3 ren2 na2 zhe5 qian2 shuo1 ni3 kan4 kan5 shang4 mian4 de5 shan1 he2 shui3

sentences.pinyin: wo3 kan4 kan5 qian2 you4 kan4 kan5 wai4 mian4

sentences.english: The same! The same mountains, the same water!

sentences.pinyin: lao3 ren2 shuo1 dui4 zhe4 jiu4 shi4 li2 jiang1
sentences.english: The old man said, “That's right. This is the Li River.”

sentences.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 tai4 hao3 le5 xie4 xie5 ni3

sentences.english: People in Guangzhou love morning tea: drinking tea, eating, chatting.

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸又在桌子上点了两下。
sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 you4 zai4 zhuo1 zi5 shang4 dian3 le5 liang3 xia4

sentences.pinyin: mei2 you3 a5 ta1 hen3 gao1 xing4
sentences.english: “Not at all. He's very happy.”

sentences.hanzi: “那他为什么这样做？”
sentences.pinyin: na4 ta1 wei4 shen2 me5 zhe4 yang4 zuo4

sentences.pinyin: a1 ming2 shuo1 ta1 zai4 shuo1 xie4 xie5
sentences.english: Ah Ming says, “He's saying thank you.”

sentences.english: “Yes. When your mouth is busy eating, it can't talk, but your fingers can.”

sentences.hanzi: 马克明白了。
sentences.pinyin: ma3 ke4 ming2 bai5 le5
sentences.english: Now Mark understands.

sentences.english: Ah Ming's father pours Mark a cup of tea.

sentences.pinyin: ma3 ke4 xiang3 le5 xiang3 yong4 shou3 zhi3 zai4 zhuo1 zi5 shang4 dian3 le5 shi2 xia4

sentences.pinyin: ma3 ke4 shuo1 zhe4 shi4 fei1 chang2 fei1 chang2 xie4 xie5
sentences.english: Mark says, “That's thank you very, very much!”

sentences.english: This year, her father takes her back to Earth.

sentences.english: Xiaoxing is frightened.

sentences.english: Her father laughs. “Don't be afraid. It's rain.”

sentences.english: “Whose water is this?”

sentences.hanzi: “不是谁的。谁都可以用。”
sentences.pinyin: bu4 shi4 shei2 de5 shei2 dou1 ke3 yi3 yong4
sentences.english: “It's nobody's. Anyone can use it.”

sentences.english: The people outside are all running.

sentences.hanzi: “他们为什么跑？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 wei4 shen2 me5 pao3
sentences.english: “Why are they running?”

sentences.hanzi: “他们不喜欢身上有水。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 bu4 xi3 huan5 shen1 shang5 you3 shui3
sentences.english: “They don't like getting wet.”

sentences.hanzi: 小星觉得这些人太奇怪了。

sentences.english: Xiaoxing thinks these people are very strange.

sentences.english: Her father asks, “What are you doing?”

title: 麒麟喜欢吃花

sentences.english: One day, someone brought a very strange creature on board.

sentences.english: It was much taller than a horse, and its head looked down at everyone from high above.

sentences.english: Nobody knew what it was, and nobody dared look after it.

sentences.english: Back in China, the emperor came to see Gaogao.

sentences.hanzi: 有人说：“这是麒麟！只有好皇帝才能见到麒麟！”
sentences.pinyin: you3 ren2 shuo1 zhe4 shi4 qi2 lin2 zhi3 you3 hao3 huang2 di4 cai2 neng2 jian4 dao4 qi2 lin2
sentences.english: Someone said, “This is a qilin! Only a good emperor can see a qilin!”

sentences.hanzi: 皇帝非常高兴。
sentences.pinyin: huang2 di4 fei1 chang2 gao1 xing4
sentences.english: The emperor was delighted.

sentences.hanzi: 小海想：这不是麒麟，这是高高。可是他不敢说。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 hai3 xiang3 zhe4 bu4 shi4 qi2 lin2 zhe4 shi4 gao1 gao1 ke3 shi4 ta1 bu4 gan3 shuo1
sentences.english: Xiaohai thought: this isn't a qilin, this is Gaogao. But he didn't dare say so.

sentences.hanzi: 人们给麒麟拿来很多好东西，麒麟都不吃。
sentences.pinyin: ren2 men5 gei3 qi2 lin2 na2 lai2 hen3 duo1 hao3 dong1 xi5 qi2 lin2 dou1 bu4 chi1
sentences.english: People brought the qilin many fine things, and it wouldn't eat any of them.

sentences.hanzi: 一天，两天，三天。皇帝很担心。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 tian1 liang3 tian1 san1 tian1 huang2 di4 hen3 dan1 xin1
sentences.english: One day, two days, three days. The emperor was very worried.

sentences.hanzi: 他问：“谁知道麒麟吃什么？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 wen4 shei2 zhi1 dao4 qi2 lin2 chi1 shen2 me5
sentences.english: He asked, “Who knows what a qilin eats?”

sentences.hanzi: 小海说：“我知道。”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 hai3 shuo1 wo3 zhi1 dao4
sentences.english: Xiaohai said, “I do.”

sentences.hanzi: 他跑到外面，拿回来很多花。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 pao3 dao4 wai4 mian4 na2 hui2 lai5 hen3 duo1 hua1
sentences.english: He ran outside and came back with an armful of flowers.

sentences.hanzi: 那是皇帝最喜欢的花。
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi4 huang2 di4 zui4 xi3 huan5 de5 hua1
sentences.english: They were the emperor's favourite flowers.

sentences.hanzi: 麒麟吃得很高兴。
sentences.pinyin: qi2 lin2 chi1 de5 hen3 gao1 xing4
sentences.english: The qilin ate them happily.

sentences.hanzi: 皇帝看了看自己的花，又看了看小海，说：“好。从今天起，你来管麒麟。”
sentences.pinyin: huang2 di4 kan4 le5 kan4 zi4 ji3 de5 hua1 you4 kan4 le5 kan4 xiao3 hai3 shuo1 hao3 cong2 jin1 tian1 qi3 ni3 lai2 guan3 qi2 lin2
sentences.english: The emperor looked at his flowers, then at Xiaohai, and said, “Very well. From today, you will look after the qilin.”

sentences.hanzi: 一千八百多年前，中国有一个很重要的人，叫曹操。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 qian1 ba1 bai3 duo1 nian2 qian2 zhong1 guo2 you3 yi1 ge5 hen3 zhong4 yao4 de5 ren2 jiao4 cao2 cao1
sentences.english: More than eighteen hundred years ago, there was a very important man in China called Cao Cao.

sentences.hanzi: 书上说，有人给他送来一头大象。
sentences.pinyin: shu1 shang4 shuo1 you3 ren2 gei3 ta1 song4 lai2 yi1 tou2 da4 xiang4
sentences.english: The books say someone sent him an elephant.

sentences.hanzi: 曹操想知道：这头大象有多重？
sentences.pinyin: cao2 cao1 xiang3 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 tou2 da4 xiang4 you3 duo1 zhong4
sentences.english: Cao Cao wanted to know: how heavy was this elephant?

sentences.hanzi: 他问身边的人。大家想了很久，都没有办法。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 wen4 shen1 bian1 de5 ren2 da4 jia1 xiang3 le5 hen3 jiu3 dou1 mei2 you3 ban4 fa3
sentences.english: He asked the people around him. They thought for a long time, but nobody had a way.

sentences.hanzi: 这时候，曹操的儿子曹冲走了过来。他只有五六岁。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 hou5 cao2 cao1 de5 er2 zi5 cao2 chong1 zou3 le5 guo4 lai2 ta1 zhi3 you3 wu3 liu4 sui4
sentences.english: Just then, Cao Cao's son Cao Chong came over. He was only five or six.

sentences.hanzi: 曹冲说：“把大象放在大船上，看水到了船的什么地方，记下来。”
sentences.pinyin: cao2 chong1 shuo1 ba3 da4 xiang4 fang4 zai4 da4 chuan2 shang4 kan4 shui3 dao4 le5 chuan2 de5 shen2 me5 di4 fang5 ji4 xia4 lai5
sentences.english: Cao Chong said, “Put the elephant on a big boat, see how far up the boat the water comes, and mark it.”

sentences.hanzi: “再把大象带下来，把别的东西放到船上，让水到一样的地方。”
sentences.pinyin: zai4 ba3 da4 xiang4 dai4 xia4 lai5 ba3 bie2 de5 dong1 xi5 fang4 dao4 chuan2 shang4 rang4 shui3 dao4 yi1 yang4 de5 di4 fang5
sentences.english: “Then take the elephant off and load other things onto the boat until the water reaches the same place.”

sentences.hanzi: “这些东西有多重，大象就有多重。”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 dong1 xi5 you3 duo1 zhong4 da4 xiang4 jiu4 you3 duo1 zhong4
sentences.english: “However heavy those things are, that is how heavy the elephant is.”

sentences.hanzi: 大象太大，很难知道有多重，小东西就容易了。
sentences.pinyin: da4 xiang4 tai4 da4 hen3 nan2 zhi1 dao4 you3 duo1 zhong4 xiao3 dong1 xi5 jiu4 rong2 yi4 le5
sentences.english: The elephant was too big to weigh, but small things were easy.

sentences.hanzi: 曹操听了，非常高兴，马上让人去做。
sentences.pinyin: cao2 cao1 ting1 le5 fei1 chang2 gao1 xing4 ma3 shang4 rang4 ren2 qu4 zuo4
sentences.english: When Cao Cao heard this he was delighted, and at once had it done.

sentences.hanzi: 这么多人想不到的办法，一个孩子想到了。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 me5 duo1 ren2 xiang3 bu4 dao4 de5 ban4 fa3 yi1 ge5 hai2 zi5 xiang3 dao4 le5
sentences.english: A child had thought of what so many others could not.

sentences.hanzi: 这个故事可能不是真的，可是今天，中国的孩子都知道它。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 gu4 shi5 ke3 neng2 bu4 shi4 zhen1 de5 ke3 shi4 jin1 tian1 zhong1 guo2 de5 hai2 zi5 dou1 zhi1 dao4 ta1
sentences.english: This story may not be true, but today, children in China all know it.

sentences.hanzi: 中国很大，从东到西有五千多公里。
sentences.pinyin: zhong1 guo2 hen3 da4 cong2 dong1 dao4 xi1 you3 wu3 qian1 duo1 gong1 li3
sentences.english: China is huge: more than five thousand kilometres from east to west.

sentences.hanzi: 可是中国只有一个时间，就是北京时间。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zhong1 guo2 zhi3 you3 yi1 ge5 shi2 jian1 jiu4 shi4 bei3 jing1 shi2 jian1
sentences.english: But China has only one time, Beijing time.

sentences.hanzi: 那年冬天，我去新疆的喀什看朋友阿依。
sentences.pinyin: na4 nian2 dong1 tian1 wo3 qu4 xin1 jiang1 de5 ka1 shi2 kan4 peng2 you5 a1 yi1
sentences.english: That winter, I went to Kashgar in Xinjiang to see my friend Ayi.

sentences.hanzi: 喀什在中国的西面，离北京很远。
sentences.pinyin: ka1 shi2 zai4 zhong1 guo2 de5 xi1 mian4 li2 bei3 jing1 hen3 yuan3
sentences.english: Kashgar is in the west of China, far from Beijing.

sentences.hanzi: 阿依说：“明天早上八点，我们一起吃早饭。”
sentences.pinyin: a1 yi1 shuo1 ming2 tian1 zao3 shang5 ba1 dian3 wo3 men5 yi1 qi3 chi1 zao3 fan4
sentences.english: Ayi said, “Tomorrow at eight in the morning, let's have breakfast together.”

sentences.hanzi: 早上八点，我到了她家门口。
sentences.pinyin: zao3 shang5 ba1 dian3 wo3 dao4 le5 ta1 jia1 men2 kou3
sentences.english: At eight in the morning, I arrived at her door.

sentences.hanzi: 外面很黑，太阳还没有出来，一个人也没有。
sentences.pinyin: wai4 mian4 hen3 hei1 tai4 yang5 hai2 mei2 you3 chu1 lai2 yi1 ge5 ren2 ye3 mei2 you3
sentences.english: It was dark outside. The sun wasn't up yet, and there wasn't a soul about.

sentences.hanzi: 我给她打电话：“我到了！你在哪里？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 gei3 ta1 da3 dian4 hua4 wo3 dao4 le5 ni3 zai4 na3 li3
sentences.english: I phoned her. “I'm here! Where are you?”

sentences.hanzi: 阿依的声音很小：“你怎么这么早？现在才六点。”
sentences.pinyin: a1 yi1 de5 sheng1 yin1 hen3 xiao3 ni3 zen3 me5 zhe4 me5 zao3 xian4 zai4 cai2 liu4 dian3
sentences.english: Ayi's voice was faint. “Why are you so early? It's only six.”

sentences.hanzi: “六点？现在是八点啊！”
sentences.pinyin: liu4 dian3 xian4 zai4 shi4 ba1 dian3 a5
sentences.english: “Six? It's eight!”

sentences.hanzi: “那是北京时间。在这里，很多人用新疆时间，比北京时间晚两个小时。”
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi4 bei3 jing1 shi2 jian1 zai4 zhe4 li3 hen3 duo1 ren2 yong4 xin1 jiang1 shi2 jian1 bi3 bei3 jing1 shi2 jian1 wan3 liang3 ge4 xiao3 shi2
sentences.english: “That's Beijing time. Here, a lot of people use Xinjiang time, two hours behind Beijing time.”

sentences.hanzi: “为什么？”
sentences.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: “Why?”

sentences.hanzi: “因为我们这里的太阳，比北京的太阳起得晚。”
sentences.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 men5 zhe4 li3 de5 tai4 yang5 bi3 bei3 jing1 de5 tai4 yang5 qi3 de5 wan3
sentences.english: “Because our sun gets up later than Beijing's sun.”

sentences.hanzi: “那我现在做什么？”
sentences.pinyin: na4 wo3 xian4 zai4 zuo4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: “So what do I do now?”

sentences.hanzi: “回去睡觉吧。”
sentences.pinyin: hui2 qu5 shui4 jiao4 ba5
sentences.english: “Go back to bed.”

sentences.hanzi: 那天晚上，吃完东西，阿依说：“明天九点见。”
sentences.pinyin: na4 tian1 wan3 shang5 chi1 wan2 dong1 xi5 a1 yi1 shuo1 ming2 tian1 jiu3 dian3 jian4
sentences.english: That evening, after we had eaten, Ayi said, “See you at nine tomorrow.”

sentences.hanzi: 我马上问：“哪个九点？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 ma3 shang4 wen4 na3 ge5 jiu3 dian3
sentences.english: I immediately asked, “Which nine?”

sentences.hanzi: 阿依说：“你看，你已经会说新疆话了！”
sentences.pinyin: a1 yi1 shuo1 ni3 kan4 ni3 yi3 jing1 hui4 shuo1 xin1 jiang1 hua4 le5
sentences.english: Ayi said, “See? You can already speak Xinjiang!”

glossed.meaning: Xinjiang, in the far west of China

sentences.hanzi: 贵州的山里有一只大“眼睛”，人们叫它天眼。
sentences.pinyin: gui4 zhou1 de5 shan1 li3 you3 yi1 zhi1 da4 yan3 jing5 ren2 men5 jiao4 ta1 tian1 yan3
sentences.english: In the mountains of Guizhou there is a great “eye”, which people call Sky Eye.

sentences.hanzi: 它不看东西，只听天上的声音。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 bu4 kan4 dong1 xi5 zhi3 ting1 tian1 shang4 de5 sheng1 yin1
sentences.english: It doesn't look at things. It only listens to sounds from the sky.

sentences.hanzi: 五十年来，人们每天晚上都向天上发一个消息：
sentences.pinyin: wu3 shi2 nian2 lai2 ren2 men5 mei3 tian1 wan3 shang5 dou1 xiang4 tian1 shang4 fa1 yi1 ge5 xiao1 xi5
sentences.english: For fifty years, every night, people had sent the same message into the sky:

sentences.hanzi: “你好！我们在这里。你们在吗？”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 hao3 wo3 men5 zai4 zhe4 li3 ni3 men5 zai4 ma5
sentences.english: “Hello! We are here. Are you there?”

sentences.hanzi: 没有人回答。
sentences.pinyin: mei2 you3 ren2 hui2 da2
sentences.english: Nobody answered.

sentences.hanzi: 小林在天眼工作了二十年。她每天都在听，什么也没有听到。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 lin2 zai4 tian1 yan3 gong1 zuo4 le5 er4 shi2 nian2 ta1 mei3 tian1 dou1 zai4 ting1 shen2 me5 ye3 mei2 you3 ting1 dao4
sentences.english: Xiaolin had worked at Sky Eye for twenty years. She listened every day, and every day she heard nothing.

sentences.hanzi: 一天晚上，小林听到了一个奇怪的声音。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 tian1 wan3 shang5 xiao3 lin2 ting1 dao4 le5 yi1 ge5 qi2 guai4 de5 sheng1 yin1
sentences.english: One night, Xiaolin heard a strange sound.

sentences.hanzi: 这不是地球上的声音。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 bu4 shi4 di4 qiu2 shang4 de5 sheng1 yin1
sentences.english: It was not a sound from Earth.

sentences.hanzi: 她马上叫来了所有的人。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 ma3 shang4 jiao4 lai2 le5 suo3 you3 de5 ren2
sentences.english: At once she called everyone in.

sentences.hanzi: 大家用了三天，才明白它的意思。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 yong4 le5 san1 tian1 cai2 ming2 bai5 ta1 de5 yi4 si5
sentences.english: It took them three days to work out what it meant.

sentences.hanzi: 那天，世界上所有的人都在看电视。
sentences.pinyin: na4 tian1 shi4 jie4 shang4 suo3 you3 de5 ren2 dou1 zai4 kan4 dian4 shi4
sentences.english: That day, everyone in the world was watching television.

sentences.hanzi: 小林站在大家面前，开始读：
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 lin2 zhan4 zai4 da4 jia1 mian4 qian2 kai1 shi3 du2
sentences.english: Xiaolin stood in front of them all and began to read:

sentences.hanzi: “你好。”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 hao3
sentences.english: “Hello.”

sentences.hanzi: “我们收到了你们的消息。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 shou1 dao4 le5 ni3 men5 de5 xiao1 xi5
sentences.english: “We have received your message.”

sentences.hanzi: “我们也在这里。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 ye3 zai4 zhe4 li3
sentences.english: “We are here too.”

sentences.hanzi: 很多人高兴得跳了起来。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 ren2 gao1 xing4 de5 tiao4 le5 qi3 lai5
sentences.english: Many people jumped for joy.

sentences.hanzi: “还有一件事。”
sentences.pinyin: hai2 you3 yi1 jian4 shi4
sentences.english: “There is one more thing.”

sentences.hanzi: 大家都不说话了。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 bu4 shuo1 hua4 le5
sentences.english: Everyone fell silent.

sentences.hanzi: “请别再发了。你们的声音太大，我们的孩子不能睡觉。”
sentences.pinyin: qing3 bie2 zai4 fa1 le5 ni3 men5 de5 sheng1 yin1 tai4 da4 wo3 men5 de5 hai2 zi5 bu4 neng2 shui4 jiao4
sentences.english: “Please stop sending. You are too loud. Our children cannot sleep.”

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，地球向天上发了一个新的消息：
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 di4 qiu2 xiang4 tian1 shang4 fa1 le5 yi1 ge5 xin1 de5 xiao1 xi5
sentences.english: The next day, Earth sent a new message into the sky:

sentences.hanzi: “对不起。”
sentences.pinyin: dui4 bu5 qi3
sentences.english: “Sorry.”

glossed.meaning: Guizhou, a province in southwest China
Sky Eye, China's giant radio telescope

sentences.hanzi: 马克在中国已经三年了。
sentences.pinyin: ma3 ke4 zai4 zhong1 guo2 yi3 jing1 san1 nian2 le5
sentences.english: Mark has been in China for three years now.

sentences.hanzi: 他的中文不错，可是有一件事，他一直不明白。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 zhong1 wen2 bu4 cuo4 ke3 shi4 you3 yi1 jian4 shi4 ta1 yi1 zhi2 bu4 ming2 bai5
sentences.english: His Chinese is good, but there is one thing he has never understood.

sentences.hanzi: 这天晚上，老王和老李请他吃饭。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 tian1 wan3 shang5 lao3 wang2 he2 lao3 li3 qing3 ta1 chi1 fan4
sentences.english: This evening, Old Wang and Old Li have invited him to dinner.

sentences.hanzi: 吃完了，老王马上站起来，说：“我来！”
sentences.pinyin: chi1 wan2 le5 lao3 wang2 ma3 shang4 zhan4 qi3 lai5 shuo1 wo3 lai2
sentences.english: When they finish, Old Wang jumps up and says, “I've got this!”

sentences.hanzi: 老李也站起来，抓住老王的手，说：“不行！今天我来！”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 li3 ye3 zhan4 qi3 lai5 zhua1 zhu4 lao3 wang2 de5 shou3 shuo1 bu4 xing2 jin1 tian1 wo3 lai2
sentences.english: Old Li stands up too, grabs Old Wang's hand and says, “No way! Today it's on me!”

sentences.hanzi: “你上一次已经付了！”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 shang4 yi1 ci4 yi3 jing1 fu4 le5
sentences.english: “You already paid last time!”

sentences.hanzi: “那是上一次！”
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi4 shang4 yi1 ci4
sentences.english: “That was last time!”

sentences.hanzi: 两个人的声音都很大。
sentences.pinyin: liang3 ge4 ren2 de5 sheng1 yin1 dou1 hen3 da4
sentences.english: Both of them are very loud.

sentences.hanzi: 服务员看看老王，又看看老李，不知道该拿谁的钱。
sentences.pinyin: fu2 wu4 yuan2 kan4 kan5 lao3 wang2 you4 kan4 kan5 lao3 li3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 gai1 na2 shei2 de5 qian2
sentences.english: The waitress looks at Old Wang, then at Old Li, not knowing whose money to take.

sentences.hanzi: 马克非常紧张。他们不是好朋友吗？他们为什么生气了？
sentences.pinyin: ma3 ke4 fei1 chang2 jin3 zhang1 ta1 men5 bu4 shi4 hao3 peng2 you5 ma5 ta1 men5 wei4 shen2 me5 sheng1 qi4 le5
sentences.english: Mark is very nervous. Aren't they good friends? Why are they angry?

sentences.hanzi: 最后，老李赢了。两个人坐了下来，又开始高兴地说话。
sentences.pinyin: zui4 hou4 lao3 li3 ying2 le5 liang3 ge4 ren2 zuo4 le5 xia4 lai5 you4 kai1 shi3 gao1 xing4 de5 shuo1 hua4
sentences.english: In the end, Old Li wins. The two of them sit down and go back to chatting happily.

sentences.hanzi: 马克问：“你们刚才没有生气吗？”
sentences.pinyin: ma3 ke4 wen4 ni3 men5 gang1 cai2 mei2 you3 sheng1 qi4 ma5
sentences.english: Mark asks, “Weren't you angry just now?”

sentences.hanzi: 老王说：“生气？没有啊。好朋友吃饭，都是这样。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 wang2 shuo1 sheng1 qi4 mei2 you3 a5 hao3 peng2 you5 chi1 fan4 dou1 shi4 zhe4 yang4
sentences.english: Old Wang says, “Angry? Not at all. That's how good friends eat together.”

sentences.hanzi: 马克明白了。他想：下一次，我要赢。
sentences.pinyin: ma3 ke4 ming2 bai5 le5 ta1 xiang3 xia4 yi1 ci4 wo3 yao4 ying2
sentences.english: Now Mark understands. He thinks: next time, I'm going to win.

sentences.hanzi: 一个星期后，他们三个人又一起吃饭。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 xing1 qi1 hou4 ta1 men5 san1 ge4 ren2 you4 yi1 qi3 chi1 fan4
sentences.english: A week later, the three of them eat together again.

sentences.hanzi: 吃了一会儿，马克说：“我去一下洗手间。”
sentences.pinyin: chi1 le5 yi1 hui4 er5 ma3 ke4 shuo1 wo3 qu4 yi1 xia4 xi3 shou3 jian1
sentences.english: Partway through the meal, Mark says, “I'm just going to the bathroom.”

sentences.hanzi: 其实，他没有去洗手间。他走到前面，把钱付了。
sentences.pinyin: qi2 shi2 ta1 mei2 you3 qu4 xi3 shou3 jian1 ta1 zou3 dao4 qian2 mian4 ba3 qian2 fu4 le5
sentences.english: In fact, he doesn't go to the bathroom. He goes to the front and pays.

sentences.hanzi: 吃完了，老王马上站起来：“我来！”
sentences.pinyin: chi1 wan2 le5 lao3 wang2 ma3 shang4 zhan4 qi3 lai5 wo3 lai2
sentences.english: When they finish, Old Wang jumps up. “I've got this!”

sentences.hanzi: 老李也站起来：“不行！我来！”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 li3 ye3 zhan4 qi3 lai5 bu4 xing2 wo3 lai2
sentences.english: Old Li stands up too. “No way! It's on me!”

sentences.hanzi: 服务员走过来，说：“不用了，这位先生已经付了。”
sentences.pinyin: fu2 wu4 yuan2 zou3 guo4 lai2 shuo1 bu4 yong4 le5 zhe4 wei4 xian1 sheng5 yi3 jing1 fu4 le5
sentences.english: The waitress comes over and says, “No need. This gentleman has already paid.”

sentences.hanzi: 老王和老李看着马克，看了很久。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 wang2 he2 lao3 li3 kan4 zhe5 ma3 ke4 kan4 le5 hen3 jiu3
sentences.english: Old Wang and Old Li look at Mark for a long time.

sentences.hanzi: 老李说：“马克，你现在真是中国人了。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 li3 shuo1 ma3 ke4 ni3 xian4 zai4 zhen1 shi5 zhong1 guo2 ren2 le5

title: 没有猴子的路

sentences.english: He is a monkey in Journey to the West, who protects a man on the way to India.

sentences.pinyin: yi1 qian1 si4 bai3 nian2 qian2 xuan2 zang4 sheng1 huo2 zai4 tang2 chao2
sentences.english: Fourteen hundred years ago, Xuanzang lived in the Tang dynasty.

sentences.hanzi: 他读了很多佛经，可是有很多地方读不懂。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 du2 le5 hen3 duo1 fo2 jing1 ke3 shi4 you3 hen3 duo1 di4 fang5 du2 bu4 dong3
sentences.english: He read many Buddhist scriptures, but there were many places he couldn't understand.

sentences.hanzi: 他决定去印度，看看真正的佛经。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 jue2 ding4 qu4 yin4 du4 kan4 kan5 zhen1 zheng4 de5 fo2 jing1
sentences.english: He decided to go to India to see the true scriptures.

sentences.hanzi: 可是皇帝不同意他去。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 huang2 di4 bu4 tong2 yi4 ta1 qu4

sentences.hanzi: 玄奘不管，自己走了。
sentences.pinyin: xuan2 zang4 bu4 guan3 zi4 ji3 zou3 le5

sentences.hanzi: 这条路非常难走。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 tiao2 lu4 fei1 chang2 nan2 zou3

sentences.hanzi: 有一次，他走了四五天，一点水也没有，差一点就死了。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 ci4 ta1 zou3 le5 si4 wu3 tian1 yi1 dian3 shui3 ye3 mei2 you3 cha4 yi1 dian3 jiu4 si3 le5
sentences.english: Once he walked for four or five days without a drop of water, and almost died.

sentences.hanzi: 他走了几年才到印度，又在那里读了很多年的书。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zou3 le5 ji3 nian2 cai2 dao4 yin4 du4 you4 zai4 na4 li5 du2 le5 hen3 duo1 nian2 de5 shu1
sentences.english: It took him years to reach India, and he studied there for many more.

sentences.hanzi: 十七年后，他回来了。
sentences.pinyin: shi2 qi1 nian2 hou4 ta1 hui2 lai5 le5
sentences.english: Seventeen years later, he came back.

sentences.hanzi: 他带回来六百多部佛经，很多人都来看他。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 dai4 hui2 lai2 liu4 bai3 duo1 bu4 fo2 jing1 hen3 duo1 ren2 dou1 lai2 kan4 ta1
sentences.english: He brought back more than six hundred Buddhist texts, and crowds came out to see him.

sentences.hanzi: 皇帝想让他留在自己身边，他没有同意。
sentences.pinyin: huang2 di4 xiang3 rang4 ta1 liu2 zai4 zi4 ji3 shen1 bian1 ta1 mei2 you3 tong2 yi4
sentences.english: The emperor wanted him to stay at his side, but he said no.

sentences.hanzi: 他只想做一件事：把这些佛经变成中文。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zhi3 xiang3 zuo4 yi1 jian4 shi4 ba3 zhe4 xie1 fo2 jing1 bian4 cheng2 zhong1 wen2
sentences.english: He wanted to do only one thing: turn these scriptures into Chinese.

sentences.hanzi: 他做了十九年，一直做到死。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 le5 shi2 jiu3 nian2 yi1 zhi2 zuo4 dao4 si3
sentences.english: He did it for nineteen years, right up to his death.

sentences.hanzi: 西游记里，有猴子帮他。
sentences.pinyin: xi1 you2 ji4 li3 you3 hou2 zi5 bang1 ta1
sentences.english: In Journey to the West, a monkey helps him.

sentences.hanzi: 真的玄奘没有猴子。这条路，是他自己走完的。
sentences.pinyin: zhen1 de5 xuan2 zang4 mei2 you3 hou2 zi5 zhe4 tiao2 lu4 shi4 ta1 zi4 ji3 zou3 wan2 de5
sentences.english: The real Xuanzang had no monkey. He walked that road himself.

sentences.english: Atu didn't cry. The next day, he went to work as usual.

sentences.english: These were his father's eyes. This was his father's mouth.

sentences.english: He was afraid of forgetting. He wanted to keep the way his father smiled.

sentences.english: Old Zhang found out. “Atu, a terracotta warrior can't smile. Who is this?”

sentences.pinyin: lao3 zhang1 kan4 le5 na4 zhang1 lian3 hen3 jiu3
sentences.english: Old Zhang looked at the face for a long time.

sentences.hanzi: 他什么也没有说，把它和别的兵马俑放在了一起。

sentences.english: More than two thousand years later, a girl came to Xi'an with her father.

sentences.english: She was looking at the warriors one by one when she suddenly stopped.

sentences.english: Then everyone laughed, until their eyes were red.

sentences.hanzi: 八年的研究，世界上所有的害怕和希望，就是一个打错的电话。
sentences.pinyin: ba1 nian2 de5 yan2 jiu1 shi4 jie4 shang4 suo3 you3 de5 hai4 pa4 he2 xi1 wang4 jiu4 shi4 yi1 ge5 da3 cuo4 de5 dian4 hua4
sentences.english: Eight years of research, all the world's fear and hope, and it was a wrong number.

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，中心决定回答。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 zhong1 xin1 jue2 ding4 hui2 da2
sentences.english: The next day the centre decided to reply.

sentences.hanzi: 该说什么呢？
sentences.pinyin: gai1 shuo1 shen2 me5 ne5
sentences.english: What should they say?

sentences.hanzi: 最后是她写的，只有三个字：“没关系。”
sentences.pinyin: zui4 hou4 shi4 ta1 xie3 de5 zhi3 you3 san1 ge4 zi4 mei2 guan1 xi5
sentences.english: In the end she wrote it, just three characters: "No problem."

sentences.hanzi: 有人问：“这三个字也要走四百年，有什么用？”
sentences.pinyin: you3 ren2 wen4 zhe4 san1 ge4 zi4 ye3 yao4 zou3 si4 bai3 nian2 you3 shen2 me5 yong4
sentences.english: Someone asked, "Those three characters will take four hundred years too. What's the use?"

sentences.hanzi: 她说：“这样，他们就知道，电话这边有人。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 zhe4 yang4 ta1 men5 jiu4 zhi1 dao4 dian4 hua4 zhe4 bian1 you3 ren2
sentences.english: She said, "This way they'll know someone is at this end of the line."

sentences.hanzi: 两千多年前，汉朝有一个大问题：匈奴。
sentences.pinyin: liang3 qian1 duo1 nian2 qian2 han4 chao2 you3 yi1 ge5 da4 wen4 ti2 xiong1 nu2
sentences.english: More than two thousand years ago, the Han dynasty had one big problem: the Xiongnu.

sentences.hanzi: 匈奴人在北边活动，力量很大，经常来打汉朝。
sentences.pinyin: xiong1 nu2 ren2 zai4 bei3 bian1 huo2 dong4 li4 liang5 hen3 da4 jing1 chang2 lai2 da3 han4 chao2
sentences.english: The Xiongnu roamed the north, were very strong, and often attacked the Han.

sentences.hanzi: 皇帝听说，西边很远的地方有一个国家，也恨匈奴。
sentences.pinyin: huang2 di4 ting1 shuo1 xi1 bian1 hen3 yuan3 de5 di4 fang5 you3 yi1 ge5 guo2 jia1 ye3 hen4 xiong1 nu2
sentences.english: The emperor heard that a country far to the west also hated the Xiongnu.

sentences.hanzi: 要是能找到这个国家，两边一起打，就好了。
sentences.pinyin: yao4 shi5 neng2 zhao3 dao4 zhe4 ge5 guo2 jia1 liang3 bian1 yi1 qi3 da3 jiu4 hao3 le5
sentences.english: If it could be found and both sides attacked together, that would be ideal.

sentences.hanzi: 可是路在哪里？没有人知道。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 lu4 zai4 na3 li3 mei2 you3 ren2 zhi1 dao4
sentences.english: But where was the road? Nobody knew.

sentences.hanzi: 皇帝问：“谁愿意去？”
sentences.pinyin: huang2 di4 wen4 shei2 yuan4 yi4 qu4
sentences.english: The emperor asked, "Who is willing to go?"

sentences.hanzi: 一个叫张骞的人站了出来。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 jiao4 zhang1 qian1 de5 ren2 zhan4 le5 chu1 lai2
sentences.english: A man named Zhang Qian stepped forward.

sentences.hanzi: 他带着一百多人，向西走去。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 dai4 zhe5 yi1 bai3 duo1 ren2 xiang4 xi1 zou3 qu4
sentences.english: He led more than a hundred men west.

sentences.hanzi: 路上要经过匈奴的地方，他们很快就被抓住，带走了。
sentences.pinyin: lu4 shang5 yao4 jing1 guo4 xiong1 nu2 de5 di4 fang5 ta1 men5 hen3 kuai4 jiu4 bei4 zhua1 zhu4 dai4 zou3 le5
sentences.english: The way passed through Xiongnu land, and they were soon captured and taken away.

sentences.hanzi: 匈奴人没有杀他，只是不让他走。
sentences.pinyin: xiong1 nu2 ren2 mei2 you3 sha1 ta1 zhi3 shi4 bu4 rang4 ta1 zou3
sentences.english: The Xiongnu did not kill him. They just would not let him leave.

sentences.hanzi: 这一留，就是十年。人生能有几个十年？
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 liu2 jiu4 shi4 shi2 nian2 ren2 sheng1 neng2 you3 ji3 ge4 shi2 nian2
sentences.english: He stayed for ten years. How many ten-year spans does a life have?

sentences.hanzi: 他在那里结婚，有了儿子。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zai4 na4 li5 jie2 hun1 you3 le5 er2 zi5
sentences.english: There he married and had a son.

sentences.hanzi: 很多人以为，他已经习惯了这里的生活，忘了自己的任务。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 ren2 yi3 wei2 ta1 yi3 jing1 xi2 guan4 le5 zhe4 li3 de5 sheng1 huo2 wang4 le5 zi4 ji3 de5 ren4 wu5
sentences.english: Many thought he had grown used to life there and forgotten his mission.

sentences.hanzi: 可是他一直没有忘。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ta1 yi1 zhi2 mei2 you3 wang4
sentences.english: But he never had.

sentences.hanzi: 有一天，他逃了出来，继续往西走。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 ta1 tao2 le5 chu1 lai2 ji4 xu4 wang3 xi1 zou3
sentences.english: One day he escaped and carried on west.

sentences.hanzi: 路上困难很多，食物也不够。
sentences.pinyin: lu4 shang5 kun4 nan5 hen3 duo1 shi2 wu4 ye3 bu4 gou4
sentences.english: The road was hard, and there wasn't enough food.

sentences.hanzi: 他终于找到了那个国家。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zhong1 yu2 zhao3 dao4 le5 na4 ge5 guo2 jia1
sentences.english: At last he found that country.

sentences.hanzi: 可是，那里的人已经住得很舒服，不想再打了。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 na4 li5 de5 ren2 yi3 jing1 zhu4 de5 hen3 shu1 fu5 bu4 xiang3 zai4 da3 le5
sentences.english: But the people there were now living comfortably and didn't want to fight any more.

sentences.hanzi: 这么多年，他只听见一个字：不。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 me5 duo1 nian2 ta1 zhi3 ting1 jian4 yi1 ge5 zi4 bu4
sentences.english: After all those years, he heard just one word: no.

sentences.hanzi: 任务失败了。
sentences.pinyin: ren4 wu5 shi1 bai4 le5
sentences.english: The mission had failed.

sentences.hanzi: 回来的路上，他又被抓住，一年多以后才逃了出来。
sentences.pinyin: hui2 lai5 de5 lu4 shang5 ta1 you4 bei4 zhua1 zhu4 yi1 nian2 duo1 yi3 hou4 cai2 tao2 le5 chu1 lai2
sentences.english: On the way back he was caught again, and he escaped only after more than a year.

sentences.hanzi: 十三年以后，他回到了汉朝。
sentences.pinyin: shi2 san1 nian2 yi3 hou4 ta1 hui2 dao4 le5 han4 chao2
sentences.english: Thirteen years after he left, he returned to the Han.

sentences.hanzi: 走的时候一百多人，跟他回来的只有一个。
sentences.pinyin: zou3 de5 shi2 hou5 yi1 bai3 duo1 ren2 gen1 ta1 hui2 lai5 de5 zhi3 you3 yi1 ge5
sentences.english: More than a hundred had left with him. Only one came back with him.

sentences.hanzi: 恐怕皇帝要生气了吧？
sentences.pinyin: kong3 pa4 huang2 di4 yao4 sheng1 qi4 le5 ba5
sentences.english: Surely the emperor would be angry?

sentences.hanzi: 让人意外的是，皇帝很高兴。
sentences.pinyin: rang4 ren2 yi4 wai4 de5 shi4 huang2 di4 hen3 gao1 xing4
sentences.english: Surprisingly, the emperor was delighted.

sentences.hanzi: 因为关键的不是那个回答，而是张骞看到的世界。
sentences.pinyin: yin1 wei4 guan1 jian4 de5 bu4 shi4 na4 ge5 hui2 da2 er2 shi4 zhang1 qian1 kan4 dao4 de5 shi4 jie4
sentences.english: What mattered was not that answer but the world Zhang Qian had seen.

sentences.hanzi: 他知道了周围有哪些国家，路怎么走。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zhi1 dao4 le5 zhou1 wei2 you3 na3 xie1 guo2 jia1 lu4 zen3 me5 zou3
sentences.english: He knew what countries lay around them and how to reach them.

sentences.hanzi: 后来，很多人走上了这条路，这就是丝绸之路。
sentences.pinyin: hou4 lai2 hen3 duo1 ren2 zou3 shang4 le5 zhe4 tiao2 lu4 zhe4 jiu4 shi4 si1 chou2 zhi1 lu4
sentences.english: Later, many people took this road. It became the Silk Road.

sentences.hanzi: 张骞的任务失败了，可是他打开了一条路。
sentences.pinyin: zhang1 qian1 de5 ren4 wu5 shi1 bai4 le5 ke3 shi4 ta1 da3 kai1 le5 yi1 tiao2 lu4
sentences.english: Zhang Qian's mission failed, but he opened a road.

glossed.meaning: the Xiongnu, a northern nomadic people

sentences.hanzi: 我在敦煌替人写信，写了一生。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zai4 dun1 huang2 ti4 ren2 xie3 xin4 xie3 le5 yi1 sheng1
sentences.english: I have spent my life in Dunhuang, writing letters for people.

sentences.hanzi: 这里是唐朝的西边，离家很远。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 li3 shi4 tang2 chao2 de5 xi1 bian1 li2 jia1 hen3 yuan3
sentences.english: This is the far west of the Tang empire, a long way from home.

sentences.hanzi: 这里的士兵通常没有学过写字，每个月都有人来找我。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 li3 de5 shi4 bing1 tong1 chang2 mei2 you3 xue2 guo5 xie3 zi4 mei3 ge5 yue4 dou1 you3 ren2 lai2 zhao3 wo3
sentences.english: Soldiers here have usually never learned to write, so every month some come to find me.

sentences.hanzi: 他们说的都差不多：“妈，我很好，别担心。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 shuo1 de5 dou1 cha4 bu5 duo1 ma1 wo3 hen3 hao3 bie2 dan1 xin1
sentences.english: They all say much the same thing: "Mother, I'm well, don't worry."

sentences.hanzi: 有一个年轻的士兵叫小五，他每个月都来。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 ge5 nian2 qing1 de5 shi4 bing1 jiao4 xiao3 wu3 ta1 mei3 ge5 yue4 dou1 lai2
sentences.english: One young soldier, Little Five, came every month.

sentences.hanzi: 他总是说：“字写大一点，我妈眼睛不好。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zong3 shi4 shuo1 zi4 xie3 da4 yi1 dian3 wo3 ma1 yan3 jing5 bu4 hao3
sentences.english: He always said, "Write it a bit bigger. My mother's eyes are bad."

sentences.hanzi: 我就写得很大，一张纸只写几句话。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 xie3 de5 hen3 da4 yi1 zhang1 zhi3 zhi3 xie3 ji3 ju4 hua4
sentences.english: So I wrote very large, only a few lines to a sheet.

sentences.hanzi: 那年冬天很冷，他们出发了，向西走。
sentences.pinyin: na4 nian2 dong1 tian1 hen3 leng3 ta1 men5 chu1 fa1 le5 xiang4 xi1 zou3
sentences.english: That winter was very cold. They set out and marched west.

sentences.hanzi: 回来的人还没有一半。
sentences.pinyin: hui2 lai5 de5 ren2 hai2 mei2 you3 yi1 ban4
sentences.english: Fewer than half came back.

sentences.hanzi: 不幸的是，小五没有回来。
sentences.pinyin: bu4 xing4 de5 shi4 xiao3 wu3 mei2 you3 hui2 lai5
sentences.english: Sadly, Little Five did not come back.

sentences.hanzi: 他的朋友来找我，说：“小五死了。他妈只有他一个孩子。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 peng2 you5 lai2 zhao3 wo3 shuo1 xiao3 wu3 si3 le5 ta1 ma1 zhi3 you3 ta1 yi1 ge5 hai2 zi5
sentences.english: His friend came to me and said, "Little Five is dead. He was his mother's only child."

sentences.hanzi: 我拿起那支笔，想告诉她真相，可是写不下去。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 na2 qi3 na4 zhi1 bi3 xiang3 gao4 su5 ta1 zhen1 xiang4 ke3 shi4 xie3 bu4 xia4 qu4
sentences.english: I picked up my brush to tell her the truth, but I couldn't go on.

sentences.hanzi: 我想：要是她知道了，恐怕活不下去。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 yao4 shi5 ta1 zhi1 dao4 le5 kong3 pa4 huo2 bu4 xia4 qu4
sentences.english: I thought: if she finds out, she may not survive it.

sentences.hanzi: 我写了几个字，又把纸烧了。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 xie3 le5 ji3 ge4 zi4 you4 ba3 zhi3 shao1 le5
sentences.english: I wrote a few words, then burned the paper.

sentences.hanzi: 我放下了笔，一夜没有睡。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 fang4 xia4 le5 bi3 yi1 ye4 mei2 you3 shui4
sentences.english: I put down the brush and didn't sleep all night.

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，我写：“妈，我很好，别担心。”
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 wo3 xie3 ma1 wo3 hen3 hao3 bie2 dan1 xin1
sentences.english: The next day I wrote, "Mother, I'm well, don't worry."

sentences.hanzi: 字写得很大。
sentences.pinyin: zi4 xie3 de5 hen3 da4
sentences.english: I wrote the characters very large.

sentences.hanzi: 正好有人要去她家那边，我就把信给了他。
sentences.pinyin: zheng4 hao3 you3 ren2 yao4 qu4 ta1 jia1 na4 bian5 wo3 jiu4 ba3 xin4 gei3 le5 ta1
sentences.english: Someone happened to be going her way, so I gave him the letter.

sentences.hanzi: 从那以后，我每个月都写一次。
sentences.pinyin: cong2 na4 yi3 hou4 wo3 mei3 ge5 yue4 dou1 xie3 yi1 ci4
sentences.english: After that I wrote once every month.

sentences.hanzi: 我绝不告诉任何人。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 jue2 bu4 gao4 su5 ren4 he2 ren2
sentences.english: I would never tell anyone.

sentences.hanzi: 就这样过了三年，我也习惯了，头发也白了。
sentences.pinyin: jiu4 zhe4 yang4 guo4 le5 san1 nian2 wo3 ye3 xi2 guan4 le5 tou2 fa5 ye3 bai2 le5
sentences.english: Three years went by like this. I grew used to it, and my hair turned white.

sentences.hanzi: 有一天，一个从她家那边来的男人在街边找到我，给了我一张纸。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 yi1 ge5 cong2 ta1 jia1 na4 bian5 lai2 de5 nan2 ren2 zai4 jie1 bian1 zhao3 dao4 wo3 gei3 le5 wo3 yi1 zhang1 zhi3
sentences.english: One day a man from her district found me at the roadside and gave me a sheet of paper.

sentences.hanzi: 这是小五的母亲让人写的，上面只有几句话：
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 xiao3 wu3 de5 mu3 qin1 rang4 ren2 xie3 de5 shang4 mian4 zhi3 you3 ji3 ju4 hua4
sentences.english: Little Five's mother had asked someone to write it. There were only a few lines on it.

sentences.hanzi: “先生，小五的朋友回家的时候，已经告诉我了。”
sentences.pinyin: xian1 sheng5 xiao3 wu3 de5 peng2 you5 hui2 jia1 de5 shi2 hou5 yi3 jing1 gao4 su5 wo3 le5
sentences.english: "Sir, when Little Five's friend came home, he told me."

sentences.hanzi: “我知道这些信不是他写的。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 xie1 xin4 bu4 shi4 ta1 xie3 de5
sentences.english: "I know these letters are not from him."

sentences.hanzi: “可是每个月，我都在门前等。”
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 mei3 ge5 yue4 wo3 dou1 zai4 men2 qian2 deng3
sentences.english: "But every month I wait at my door."

sentences.hanzi: “请不要停。”
sentences.pinyin: qing3 bu4 yao4 ting2
sentences.english: "Please don't stop."

sentences.hanzi: 我看了很久，接着拿起笔。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 kan4 le5 hen3 jiu3 jie1 zhe5 na2 qi3 bi3
sentences.english: I looked at it for a long time, and then I picked up my brush.

sentences.hanzi: “妈，我很好，别担心。”
sentences.pinyin: ma1 wo3 hen3 hao3 bie2 dan1 xin1
sentences.english: "Mother, I'm well, don't worry."

sentences.hanzi: 我把字写得很大。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 ba3 zi4 xie3 de5 hen3 da4
sentences.english: I wrote it very large.

title: 手机上的地图
titlePinyin: shou3 ji1 shang4 de5 di4 tu2

sentences.hanzi: 你去过重庆吗？
sentences.pinyin: ni3 qu4 guo5 chong2 qing4 ma5
sentences.english: Have you been to Chongqing?

sentences.hanzi: 在那里，手机上的地图通常没有用。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 na4 li5 shou3 ji1 shang4 de5 di4 tu2 tong1 chang2 mei2 you3 yong4
sentences.english: There, the map on your phone is usually no use.

sentences.hanzi: 重庆在长江边上，到处都是山，很多人也叫它“山城”。
sentences.pinyin: chong2 qing4 zai4 chang2 jiang1 bian1 shang4 dao4 chu4 dou1 shi4 shan1 hen3 duo1 ren2 ye3 jiao4 ta1 shan1 cheng2
sentences.english: Chongqing lies on the Yangtze and has hills everywhere. Many people call it the Mountain City.

sentences.hanzi: 在重庆的中心区，一条街在上面，另一条街在下面，相当难走。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 chong2 qing4 de5 zhong1 xin1 qu1 yi1 tiao2 jie1 zai4 shang4 mian4 ling4 yi1 tiao2 jie1 zai4 xia4 mian4 xiang1 dang1 nan2 zou3
sentences.english: In central Chongqing, one street runs above and another below, which makes it quite hard to get around.

sentences.hanzi: 我第一次去的时候，想找一家小店吃饭。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 di4 yi1 ci4 qu4 de5 shi2 hou5 xiang3 zhao3 yi1 jia1 xiao3 dian4 chi1 fan4
sentences.english: The first time I went, I wanted to find a small restaurant.

sentences.hanzi: 走了二十分钟，地图说：“你已经到了。”
sentences.pinyin: zou3 le5 er4 shi2 fen1 zhong1 di4 tu2 shuo1 ni3 yi3 jing1 dao4 le5
sentences.english: After twenty minutes, the map said, "You have arrived."

sentences.hanzi: 我停下，看看周围，没有店。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 ting2 xia4 kan4 kan5 zhou1 wei2 mei2 you3 dian4
sentences.english: I stopped and looked around. No restaurant.

sentences.hanzi: 我问一位老人：“请问，这家店在哪里？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wen4 yi1 wei4 lao3 ren2 qing3 wen4 zhe4 jia1 dian4 zai4 na3 li3
sentences.english: I asked an old man, "Excuse me, where is this restaurant?"

sentences.hanzi: 老人笑了，指了指我的头上：“就在你上面。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ren2 xiao4 le5 zhi3 le5 zhi3 wo3 de5 tou2 shang4 jiu4 zai4 ni3 shang4 mian4
sentences.english: He smiled and pointed over my head. "It's right above you."

sentences.hanzi: 我往上看，上面还有一条街，街的一边有一家小店。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wang3 shang4 kan4 shang4 mian4 hai2 you3 yi1 tiao2 jie1 jie1 de5 yi1 bian1 you3 yi1 jia1 xiao3 dian4
sentences.english: I looked up. Above me was another street, and on one side of it a small restaurant.

sentences.hanzi: 地图没有说错，只是方向错了：店不在前面，而是在上面。
sentences.pinyin: di4 tu2 mei2 you3 shuo1 cuo4 zhi3 shi4 fang1 xiang4 cuo4 le5 dian4 bu4 zai4 qian2 mian4 er2 shi4 zai4 shang4 mian4
sentences.english: The map hadn't lied. It was just the wrong direction: the restaurant wasn't ahead but above.

sentences.hanzi: 我一步一步走上去，又走了二十分钟，累得不行，才坐下吃饭。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 yi1 bu4 yi1 bu4 zou3 shang4 qu4 you4 zou3 le5 er4 shi2 fen1 zhong1 lei4 de5 bu4 xing2 cai2 zuo4 xia5 chi1 fan4
sentences.english: I climbed up step by step, walked another twenty minutes, and was exhausted by the time I sat down to eat.

sentences.hanzi: 在重庆，这样的事不少。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 chong2 qing4 zhe4 yang4 de5 shi4 bu4 shao3
sentences.english: This sort of thing happens a lot in Chongqing.

sentences.hanzi: 比如洪崖洞，它靠着山，从一楼一直到十一楼。
sentences.pinyin: bi3 ru2 hong2 ya2 dong4 ta1 kao4 zhe5 shan1 cong2 yi1 lou2 yi1 zhi2 dao4 shi2 yi1 lou2
sentences.english: Take Hongyadong. It leans against the hillside and rises from the first floor to the eleventh.

sentences.hanzi: 你从下面的路走进一楼，走到十一楼，出来一看，又是一条街！
sentences.pinyin: ni3 cong2 xia4 mian4 de5 lu4 zou3 jin4 yi1 lou2 zou3 dao4 shi2 yi1 lou2 chu1 lai2 yi1 kan4 you4 shi4 yi1 tiao2 jie1
sentences.english: You walk in from the road below at the first floor, go all the way up to the eleventh, step out, and there's another street!

sentences.hanzi: 还有李子坝，那里的地铁从一座住人的楼里走过。
sentences.pinyin: hai2 you3 li3 zi5 ba4 na4 li5 de5 di4 tie3 cong2 yi1 zuo4 zhu4 ren2 de5 lou2 li3 zou3 guo4
sentences.english: Then there's Liziba, where the metro passes through an apartment block.

sentences.hanzi: 楼里的人已经习惯了，地铁每天从他们家旁边经过。
sentences.pinyin: lou2 li3 de5 ren2 yi3 jing1 xi2 guan4 le5 di4 tie3 mei3 tian1 cong2 ta1 men5 jia1 pang2 bian1 jing1 guo4
sentences.english: The people in the building are used to it. The trains pass their homes every day.

sentences.hanzi: 离开以前，我又见到那位老人。
sentences.pinyin: li2 kai1 yi3 qian2 wo3 you4 jian4 dao4 na4 wei4 lao3 ren2
sentences.english: Before I left, I met that old man again.

sentences.hanzi: 我顺便问：“在重庆，怎么才能不走错路？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shun4 bian4 wen4 zai4 chong2 qing4 zen3 me5 cai2 neng2 bu4 zou3 cuo4 lu4
sentences.english: I took the chance to ask, "How do you avoid getting lost in Chongqing?"

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“别看手机。手机只知道东南西北，不知道上下。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 bie2 kan4 shou3 ji1 shou3 ji1 zhi3 zhi1 dao4 dong1 nan2 xi1 bei3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 shang4 xia4
sentences.english: He said, "Don't look at your phone. A phone knows north, south, east and west, but not up and down."

sentences.hanzi: 小雨生在空间站上。九岁生日那天，她问了妈妈一个问题。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 yu3 sheng1 zai4 kong1 jian1 zhan4 shang4 jiu3 sui4 sheng1 ri4 na4 tian1 ta1 wen4 le5 ma1 ma5 yi1 ge5 wen4 ti2
sentences.english: Little Rain was born on a space station. On her ninth birthday, she asked her mother a question.

sentences.hanzi: “我为什么叫小雨？雨是什么？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wei4 shen2 me5 jiao4 xiao3 yu3 yu3 shi4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: "Why am I called Little Rain? What is rain?"

sentences.hanzi: 妈妈说：“雨就是水，从天上掉下来的水。”
sentences.pinyin: ma1 ma5 shuo1 yu3 jiu4 shi4 shui3 cong2 tian1 shang4 diao4 xia4 lai5 de5 shui3
sentences.english: Her mother said, "Rain is water. Water that falls from the sky."

sentences.hanzi: 小雨不相信。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 yu3 bu4 xiang1 xin4
sentences.english: Little Rain didn't believe it.

sentences.hanzi: 她从来没有去过地球。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 cong2 lai2 mei2 you3 qu4 guo5 di4 qiu2
sentences.english: She had never been to Earth.

sentences.hanzi: 在空间站，水不往下掉，而是一颗一颗地在空中飞。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 kong1 jian1 zhan4 shui3 bu4 wang3 xia4 diao4 er2 shi4 yi1 ke1 yi1 ke1 de5 zai4 kong1 zhong1 fei1
sentences.english: On the space station, water doesn't fall. It flies through the air, drop by drop.

sentences.hanzi: 在这里，水是最重要的东西。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 li3 shui3 shi4 zui4 zhong4 yao4 de5 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: Here, water is the most important thing there is.

sentences.hanzi: 每一杯水都有人记着，用过的水要回到系统里，洗干净，再喝。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 yi1 bei1 shui3 dou1 you3 ren2 ji4 zhe5 yong4 guo5 de5 shui3 yao4 hui2 dao4 xi4 tong3 li3 xi3 gan1 jing4 zai4 he1
sentences.english: Every cup is recorded. Used water goes back into the system, gets cleaned, and is drunk again.

sentences.hanzi: 小雨从小就习惯了：一点水也不能浪费。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 yu3 cong2 xiao3 jiu4 xi2 guan4 le5 yi1 dian3 shui3 ye3 bu4 neng2 lang4 fei4
sentences.english: Little Rain had grown up used to this: you must not waste a drop.

sentences.hanzi: “掉下来以后呢？”她问。
sentences.pinyin: diao4 xia4 lai5 yi3 hou4 ne5 ta1 wen4
sentences.english: "And after it falls?" she asked.

sentences.hanzi: “掉在地面上，没有人管。”
sentences.pinyin: diao4 zai4 di4 mian4 shang4 mei2 you3 ren2 guan3
sentences.english: "It lands on the ground, and nobody bothers about it."

sentences.hanzi: “掉多少？”
sentences.pinyin: diao4 duo1 shao5
sentences.english: "How much falls?"

sentences.hanzi: “有时下得很多，下一天一夜。”
sentences.pinyin: you3 shi2 xia4 de5 hen3 duo1 xia4 yi1 tian1 yi1 ye4
sentences.english: "Sometimes a huge amount, all day and all night."

sentences.hanzi: “没有人记着？”
sentences.pinyin: mei2 you3 ren2 ji4 zhe5
sentences.english: "And nobody records it?"

sentences.hanzi: “没有。”
sentences.pinyin: mei2 you3
sentences.english: "No."

sentences.hanzi: 小雨生气了：“太浪费了！”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 yu3 sheng1 qi4 le5 tai4 lang4 fei4 le5
sentences.english: Little Rain was outraged. "What a waste!"

sentences.hanzi: 妈妈笑了：“等你回到地球，就明白了。”
sentences.pinyin: ma1 ma5 xiao4 le5 deng3 ni3 hui2 dao4 di4 qiu2 jiu4 ming2 bai5 le5
sentences.english: Her mother laughed. "You'll understand when we get back to Earth."

sentences.hanzi: 小雨慢慢长大。十四岁那年，她们终于回到了地球。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 yu3 man4 man4 zhang3 da4 shi2 si4 sui4 na4 nian2 ta1 men5 zhong1 yu2 hui2 dao4 le5 di4 qiu2
sentences.english: Little Rain grew up. The year she turned fourteen, they finally went back to Earth.

sentences.hanzi: 一天下午，她单独在外面走。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 tian1 xia4 wu3 ta1 dan1 du2 zai4 wai4 mian4 zou3
sentences.english: One afternoon she was out walking alone.

sentences.hanzi: 天突然黑了，有东西打在她的脸上。
sentences.pinyin: tian1 tu1 ran2 hei1 le5 you3 dong1 xi5 da3 zai4 ta1 de5 lian3 shang4
sentences.english: The sky suddenly went dark and something hit her face.

sentences.hanzi: 一颗，两颗，接着是许多颗。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ke1 liang3 ke1 jie1 zhe5 shi4 xu3 duo1 ke1
sentences.english: One drop, two drops, then many more.

sentences.hanzi: 周围的人都跑了，躲进了房子里。
sentences.pinyin: zhou1 wei2 de5 ren2 dou1 pao3 le5 duo3 jin4 le5 fang2 zi5 li3
sentences.english: Everyone around her ran and hid indoors.

sentences.hanzi: 小雨没有跑。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 yu3 mei2 you3 pao3
sentences.english: Little Rain didn't run.

sentences.hanzi: 她站在外面，看着天，张开了嘴。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zhan4 zai4 wai4 mian4 kan4 zhe5 tian1 zhang1 kai1 le5 zui3
sentences.english: She stood outside, looked at the sky and opened her mouth.

sentences.hanzi: 水很冷，打在她的头发上、手上、衣服上，又掉到地面上。
sentences.pinyin: shui3 hen3 leng3 da3 zai4 ta1 de5 tou2 fa5 shang4 shou3 shang4 yi1 fu5 shang4 you4 diao4 dao4 di4 mian4 shang4
sentences.english: The water was cold. It hit her hair, her hands, her clothes, and fell to the ground.

sentences.hanzi: 这水没有系统的味道。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shui3 mei2 you3 xi4 tong3 de5 wei4 dao5
sentences.english: This water didn't taste of the system.

sentences.hanzi: 她想起了空间站的每一杯水。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 qi3 le5 kong1 jian1 zhan4 de5 mei3 yi1 bei1 shui3
sentences.english: She remembered every cup of water on the space station.

sentences.hanzi: 这里没有人记，没有人管。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 li3 mei2 you3 ren2 ji4 mei2 you3 ren2 guan3
sentences.english: Here nobody recorded it. Nobody bothered.

sentences.hanzi: “太浪费了！”她叫了起来。
sentences.pinyin: tai4 lang4 fei4 le5 ta1 jiao4 le5 qi3 lai5
sentences.english: "What a waste!" she shouted.

sentences.hanzi: 可是她笑着，很久都没有走。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ta1 xiao4 zhe5 hen3 jiu3 dou1 mei2 you3 zou3
sentences.english: But she was laughing, and it was a long time before she left.

sentences.hanzi: 一千三百年前，世界历史上最大的城市之一是唐朝的长安。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 qian1 san1 bai3 nian2 qian2 shi4 jie4 li4 shi3 shang4 zui4 da4 de5 cheng2 shi4 zhi1 yi1 shi4 tang2 chao2 de5 chang2 an1
sentences.english: Thirteen hundred years ago, one of the largest cities in world history was Tang dynasty Chang'an.

sentences.hanzi: 这里住着差不多一百万人，许多人来自很远的地方。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 li3 zhu4 zhe5 cha4 bu5 duo1 yi1 bai3 wan4 ren2 xu3 duo1 ren2 lai2 zi4 hen3 yuan3 de5 di4 fang5
sentences.english: Close to a million people lived here, many of them from far away.

sentences.hanzi: 这么大的城，夜里路上一定有很多人吧？
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 me5 da4 de5 cheng2 ye4 li3 lu4 shang5 yi1 ding4 you3 hen3 duo1 ren2 ba5
sentences.english: A city this big must have had crowds on the streets at night, surely?

sentences.hanzi: 不。要是夜里你走在长安的大路上，你会被打。
sentences.pinyin: bu4 yao4 shi5 ye4 li3 ni3 zou3 zai4 chang2 an1 de5 da4 lu4 shang4 ni3 hui4 bei4 da3
sentences.english: No. If you walked the main streets of Chang'an at night, you would be beaten.

sentences.hanzi: 这是法律。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 fa3 lu:4
sentences.english: That was the law.

sentences.hanzi: 长安城分成一百多个区，每个区四边都有墙，墙上有门。
sentences.pinyin: chang2 an1 cheng2 fen1 cheng2 yi1 bai3 duo1 ge4 qu1 mei3 ge5 qu1 si4 bian1 dou1 you3 qiang2 qiang2 shang4 you3 men2
sentences.english: The city was divided into over a hundred wards, each walled on four sides, with gates in the walls.

sentences.hanzi: 普通人就住在这些墙里面。
sentences.pinyin: pu3 tong1 ren2 jiu4 zhu4 zai4 zhe4 xie1 qiang2 li3 mian4
sentences.english: Ordinary people lived inside these walls.

sentences.hanzi: 每天晚上，城里开始打鼓。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 tian1 wan3 shang5 cheng2 li3 kai1 shi3 da3 gu3
sentences.english: Every evening, drums began to beat across the city.

sentences.hanzi: 鼓声一停，所有的门都要关。
sentences.pinyin: gu3 sheng1 yi1 ting2 suo3 you3 de5 men2 dou1 yao4 guan1
sentences.english: When the drums stopped, all the gates had to be shut.

sentences.hanzi: 从这个时刻开始，你必须留在自己的区里。
sentences.pinyin: cong2 zhe4 ge5 shi2 ke4 kai1 shi3 ni3 bi4 xu1 liu2 zai4 zi4 ji3 de5 qu1 li3
sentences.english: From that moment on, you had to stay in your own ward.

sentences.hanzi: 在区里面没有关系，你可以吃饭、喝酒、找朋友。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 qu1 li3 mian4 mei2 you3 guan1 xi5 ni3 ke3 yi3 chi1 fan4 he1 jiu3 zhao3 peng2 you5
sentences.english: Inside the ward that was fine. You could eat, drink and visit friends.

sentences.hanzi: 可是你绝不能走上外面的街。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ni3 jue2 bu4 neng2 zou3 shang4 wai4 mian4 de5 jie1
sentences.english: But you must never go out onto the street.

sentences.hanzi: 夜里的长安，大路上空空的，非常安静。
sentences.pinyin: ye4 li3 de5 chang2 an1 da4 lu4 shang4 kong1 kong1 de5 fei1 chang2 an1 jing4
sentences.english: At night in Chang'an, the main streets were empty and very quiet.

sentences.hanzi: 第二天早上，鼓又打起来，门才开。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 zao3 shang5 gu3 you4 da3 qi3 lai5 men2 cai2 kai1
sentences.english: The next morning the drums beat again, and only then did the gates open.

sentences.hanzi: 可是，一年里有三个晚上不一样。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 yi1 nian2 li3 you3 san1 ge4 wan3 shang5 bu4 yi1 yang4
sentences.english: But three nights a year were different.

sentences.hanzi: 那就是元宵节前后。
sentences.pinyin: na4 jiu4 shi4 yuan2 xiao1 jie2 qian2 hou4
sentences.english: Those were the nights around the Lantern Festival.

sentences.hanzi: 这三个晚上，门不关了，人们可以出来看美丽的灯。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 san1 ge4 wan3 shang5 men2 bu4 guan1 le5 ren2 men5 ke3 yi3 chu1 lai2 kan4 mei3 li4 de5 deng1
sentences.english: On these three nights the gates stayed open, and people could come out to see the beautiful lanterns.

sentences.hanzi: 老人、孩子、年轻的姑娘，都走上了街。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ren2 hai2 zi5 nian2 qing1 de5 gu1 niang5 dou1 zou3 shang4 le5 jie1
sentences.english: Old people, children and young women all came out onto the streets.

sentences.hanzi: 他们走了一夜，看了一夜的灯。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 zou3 le5 yi1 ye4 kan4 le5 yi1 ye4 de5 deng1
sentences.english: They walked all night and watched the lanterns all night.

sentences.hanzi: 人们期待了一年，就为了这三个晚上。
sentences.pinyin: ren2 men5 qi1 dai4 le5 yi1 nian2 jiu4 wei4 le5 zhe4 san1 ge4 wan3 shang5
sentences.english: People looked forward all year to these three nights.

sentences.hanzi: 今天，中国人还在元宵节看灯。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 zhong1 guo2 ren2 hai2 zai4 yuan2 xiao1 jie2 kan4 deng1
sentences.english: Today, Chinese people still go to see lanterns at the Lantern Festival.

sentences.hanzi: 可是很少有人想起，一千多年前，那是长安人一年里唯一能在夜里走上街的日子。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 hen3 shao3 you3 ren2 xiang3 qi3 yi1 qian1 duo1 nian2 qian2 na4 shi4 chang2 an1 ren2 yi1 nian2 li3 wei2 yi1 neng2 zai4 ye4 li3 zou3 shang4 jie1 de5 ri4 zi5
sentences.english: But few remember that over a thousand years ago, those were the only nights of the year when the people of Chang'an could walk the streets after dark.

sentences.hanzi: 每一年春节以前，中国都有一件重要的事：回家。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 yi1 nian2 chun1 jie2 yi3 qian2 zhong1 guo2 dou1 you3 yi1 jian4 zhong4 yao4 de5 shi4 hui2 jia1
sentences.english: Every year before Spring Festival, China has one important thing to do: go home.

sentences.hanzi: 春节前后的这四十天，叫“春运”。
sentences.pinyin: chun1 jie2 qian2 hou4 de5 zhe4 si4 shi2 tian1 jiao4 chun1 yun4
sentences.english: The forty days around the festival are called Chunyun.

sentences.hanzi: 很多很多人离开上班的城市，回到老家。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 hen3 duo1 ren2 li2 kai1 shang4 ban1 de5 cheng2 shi4 hui2 dao4 lao3 jia1
sentences.english: A huge number of people leave the cities where they work and return to their home towns.

sentences.hanzi: 我爸爸在广东上班，我们的家在贵州。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 ba4 ba5 zai4 guang3 dong1 shang4 ban1 wo3 men5 de5 jia1 zai4 gui4 zhou1
sentences.english: My father worked in Guangdong. Our home is in Guizhou.

sentences.hanzi: 那时候买火车票，要到车站排队。
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi2 hou5 mai3 huo3 che1 piao4 yao4 dao4 che1 zhan4 pai2 dui4
sentences.english: In those days you had to queue at the station to buy a train ticket.

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸夜里就去，在外面排一夜。
sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 ye4 li3 jiu4 qu4 zai4 wai4 mian4 pai2 yi1 ye4
sentences.english: Father would go the night before and queue outside all night.

sentences.hanzi: 有时排到他，票已经没了。
sentences.pinyin: you3 shi2 pai2 dao4 ta1 piao4 yi3 jing1 mei2 le5
sentences.english: Sometimes, by the time he reached the front, the tickets were gone.

sentences.hanzi: 有一年他没买到票，就和朋友们一起骑摩托车回家。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 nian2 ta1 mei2 mai3 dao4 piao4 jiu4 he2 peng2 you5 men5 yi1 qi3 qi2 mo2 tuo1 che1 hui2 jia1
sentences.english: One year he couldn't get a ticket, so he and some friends rode home on motorbikes.

sentences.hanzi: 路上很冷，他们骑了两天。
sentences.pinyin: lu4 shang5 hen3 leng3 ta1 men5 qi2 le5 liang3 tian1
sentences.english: It was cold on the road, and they rode for two days.

sentences.hanzi: 他到家的时候，我已经睡了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 dao4 jia1 de5 shi2 hou5 wo3 yi3 jing1 shui4 le5
sentences.english: By the time he got home I was already asleep.

sentences.hanzi: 第二天早上，我看见他的手，皮都破了。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 zao3 shang5 wo3 kan4 jian4 ta1 de5 shou3 pi2 dou1 po4 le5
sentences.english: The next morning I saw his hands. The skin was split and raw.

sentences.hanzi: 他只住了七天，又出发了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zhi3 zhu4 le5 qi1 tian1 you4 chu1 fa1 le5
sentences.english: He stayed for only seven days and then set off again.

sentences.hanzi: 走以前，我问他：“这么累，为什么每次都要回来？”
sentences.pinyin: zou3 yi3 qian2 wo3 wen4 ta1 zhe4 me5 lei4 wei4 shen2 me5 mei3 ci4 dou1 yao4 hui2 lai5
sentences.english: Before he left I asked him, "If it's this tiring, why come back every time?"

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸没有回答，只是拿了一块肉给我。
sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 mei2 you3 hui2 da2 zhi3 shi4 na2 le5 yi1 kuai4 rou4 gei3 wo3
sentences.english: Father didn't answer. He just handed me a piece of meat.

sentences.hanzi: 现在不用排队了，手机上就能买票。
sentences.pinyin: xian4 zai4 bu4 yong4 pai2 dui4 le5 shou3 ji1 shang4 jiu4 neng2 mai3 piao4
sentences.english: Now you don't have to queue. You can buy tickets on your phone.

sentences.hanzi: 可是票一出来，几秒就没了。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 piao4 yi1 chu1 lai2 ji3 miao3 jiu4 mei2 le5
sentences.english: But as soon as tickets go on sale, they're gone in seconds.

sentences.hanzi: 我长大了，也离开了贵州，在一个大城市上班。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zhang3 da4 le5 ye3 li2 kai1 le5 gui4 zhou1 zai4 yi1 ge5 da4 cheng2 shi4 shang4 ban1
sentences.english: I've grown up and left Guizhou too, and I work in a big city.

sentences.hanzi: 每一年的这一天，我都坐在电脑前，等待那一秒。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 yi1 nian2 de5 zhe4 yi1 tian1 wo3 dou1 zuo4 zai4 dian4 nao3 qian2 deng3 dai4 na4 yi1 miao3
sentences.english: Every year on this day I sit at my computer and wait for that one second.

sentences.hanzi: 这一年，我买到的票没有地方坐，我站了二十个小时。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 nian2 wo3 mai3 dao4 de5 piao4 mei2 you3 di4 fang5 zuo4 wo3 zhan4 le5 er4 shi2 ge4 xiao3 shi2
sentences.english: This year the ticket I got had no seat, and I stood for twenty hours.

sentences.hanzi: 到家的时候，爸爸已经老了，头发全白了。
sentences.pinyin: dao4 jia1 de5 shi2 hou5 ba4 ba5 yi3 jing1 lao3 le5 tou2 fa5 quan2 bai2 le5
sentences.english: When I got home, Father had grown old, and his hair was completely white.

sentences.hanzi: 他看着我，说：“这么累，为什么每次都要回来？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 zhe5 wo3 shuo1 zhe4 me5 lei4 wei4 shen2 me5 mei3 ci4 dou1 yao4 hui2 lai5
sentences.english: He looked at me and said, "If it's this tiring, why come back every time?"

sentences.hanzi: 我没有回答，只是拿了一块肉给他。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 mei2 you3 hui2 da2 zhi3 shi4 na2 le5 yi1 kuai4 rou4 gei3 ta1
sentences.english: I didn't answer. I just handed him a piece of meat.

glossed.meaning: Chunyun, the Spring Festival travel rush

title: 葡萄的水
titleEnglish: Where the grapes get their water

sentences.hanzi: 中国最热的地方在哪里？
sentences.pinyin: zhong1 guo2 zui4 re4 de5 di4 fang5 zai4 na3 li3
sentences.english: Where is the hottest place in China?

sentences.hanzi: 很多人的答案是新疆的吐鲁番。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 ren2 de5 da2 an4 shi4 xin1 jiang1 de5 tu3 lu3 fan1
sentences.english: Many people would answer Turpan, in Xinjiang.

sentences.hanzi: 这里的七月，经常超过四十度。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 li3 de5 qi1 yue4 jing1 chang2 chao1 guo4 si4 shi2 du4
sentences.english: In July it often goes above forty degrees here.

sentences.hanzi: 一年里很少下雨。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 nian2 li3 hen3 shao3 xia4 yu3
sentences.english: It rarely rains all year.

sentences.hanzi: 可是，吐鲁番的葡萄十分有名，又大又甜。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 tu3 lu3 fan1 de5 pu2 tao2 shi2 fen1 you3 ming2 you4 da4 you4 tian2
sentences.english: And yet Turpan's grapes are famous, big and sweet.

sentences.hanzi: 这就奇怪了：没有水，葡萄怎么长大？
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 qi2 guai4 le5 mei2 you3 shui3 pu2 tao2 zen3 me5 zhang3 da4
sentences.english: That's strange. Without water, how do the grapes grow?

sentences.hanzi: 关键不在天上，而在地下。
sentences.pinyin: guan1 jian4 bu4 zai4 tian1 shang4 er2 zai4 di4 xia4
sentences.english: The key is not in the sky but under the ground.

sentences.hanzi: 吐鲁番的北边是天山，天山上有许多雪。
sentences.pinyin: tu3 lu3 fan1 de5 bei3 bian1 shi4 tian1 shan1 tian1 shan1 shang4 you3 xu3 duo1 xue3
sentences.english: To the north of Turpan are the Tian Shan mountains, where there is a lot of snow.

sentences.hanzi: 春天一到，雪变成水，流了下来。
sentences.pinyin: chun1 tian1 yi1 dao4 xue3 bian4 cheng2 shui3 liu2 le5 xia4 lai5
sentences.english: When spring comes, the snow turns to water and flows down.

sentences.hanzi: 可是吐鲁番的地面太热了。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 tu3 lu3 fan1 de5 di4 mian4 tai4 re4 le5
sentences.english: But the ground at Turpan is far too hot.

sentences.hanzi: 水走不到一半，就没了。
sentences.pinyin: shui3 zou3 bu4 dao4 yi1 ban4 jiu4 mei2 le5
sentences.english: The water would vanish before it got halfway.

sentences.hanzi: 怎么办？
sentences.pinyin: zen3 me5 ban4
sentences.english: What could be done?

sentences.hanzi: 很久以前，这里的人想到一个办法：不让水经过地面。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 jiu3 yi3 qian2 zhe4 li3 de5 ren2 xiang3 dao4 yi1 ge5 ban4 fa3 bu4 rang4 shui3 jing1 guo4 di4 mian4
sentences.english: Long ago, people here came up with a way: keep the water off the surface.

sentences.hanzi: 于是，他们在地下开出一条长长的水道，让水慢慢流过来。
sentences.pinyin: yu2 shi4 ta1 men5 zai4 di4 xia4 kai1 chu1 yi1 tiao2 chang2 chang2 de5 shui3 dao4 rang4 shui3 man4 man4 liu2 guo4 lai2
sentences.english: So they dug long channels underground and let the water slowly flow in.

sentences.hanzi: 每走一段，就在上面开一个口。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 zou3 yi1 duan4 jiu4 zai4 shang4 mian4 kai1 yi1 ge5 kou3
sentences.english: Every so often they opened a shaft to the surface.

sentences.hanzi: 人从口里下去，一点一点向前开。
sentences.pinyin: ren2 cong2 kou3 li3 xia4 qu4 yi1 dian3 yi1 dian3 xiang4 qian2 kai1
sentences.english: Workers went down through the shaft and dug forward bit by bit.

sentences.hanzi: 地下又黑又冷，这是十分危险的工作。
sentences.pinyin: di4 xia4 you4 hei1 you4 leng3 zhe4 shi4 shi2 fen1 wei1 xian3 de5 gong1 zuo4
sentences.english: It was dark and cold down there, and it was very dangerous work.

sentences.hanzi: 这样的水道，就叫坎儿井。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 de5 shui3 dao4 jiu4 jiao4 kan3 er2 jing3
sentences.english: These channels are called karez.

sentences.hanzi: 吐鲁番差不多有一千条。从飞机上往下看，这些口一个一个排在地面上。
sentences.pinyin: tu3 lu3 fan1 cha4 bu5 duo1 you3 yi1 qian1 tiao2 cong2 fei1 ji1 shang4 wang3 xia4 kan4 zhe4 xie1 kou3 yi1 ge5 yi1 ge5 pai2 zai4 di4 mian4 shang4
sentences.english: Turpan has about a thousand of them. From a plane you can see the shafts lined up across the ground.

sentences.hanzi: 今天，还有差不多两百条有水，人们还在用。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 hai2 you3 cha4 bu5 duo1 liang3 bai3 tiao2 you3 shui3 ren2 men5 hai2 zai4 yong4
sentences.english: Today about two hundred still carry water, and people still use them.

sentences.hanzi: 地面热得像火，地下的水却又冷又干净。
sentences.pinyin: di4 mian4 re4 de5 xiang4 huo3 di4 xia4 de5 shui3 que4 you4 leng3 you4 gan1 jing4
sentences.english: The surface is hot as fire, but the water underground is cold and clean.

sentences.hanzi: 所以，下次在吐鲁番吃葡萄，你可以想一想。
sentences.pinyin: suo3 yi3 xia4 ci4 zai4 tu3 lu3 fan1 chi1 pu2 tao2 ni3 ke3 yi3 xiang3 yi1 xiang3
sentences.english: So the next time you eat grapes in Turpan, think about this.

sentences.hanzi: 这么甜的味道，是天山上的雪，走了很长很长的路，从地下来到了这里。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 me5 tian2 de5 wei4 dao5 shi4 tian1 shan1 shang4 de5 xue3 zou3 le5 hen3 chang2 hen3 chang2 de5 lu4 cong2 di4 xia4 lai2 dao4 le5 zhe4 li3
sentences.english: That sweet taste is snow from the Tian Shan, which has travelled a very long way underground to get here.

glossed.meaning: Turpan, an oasis city in Xinjiang

sentences.hanzi: 老周在船上过了一生。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 zhou1 zai4 chuan2 shang4 guo4 le5 yi1 sheng1
sentences.english: Old Zhou had spent his life on boats.

sentences.hanzi: 那是明朝，北京人吃的米，很多是从南边用船送来的。
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi4 ming2 chao2 bei3 jing1 ren2 chi1 de5 mi3 hen3 duo1 shi4 cong2 nan2 bian1 yong4 chuan2 song4 lai2 de5
sentences.english: This was the Ming dynasty, when much of the rice eaten in Beijing was shipped from the south.

sentences.hanzi: 老周的船从杭州出发，走大运河，一直向北。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 zhou1 de5 chuan2 cong2 hang2 zhou1 chu1 fa1 zou3 da4 yun4 he2 yi1 zhi2 xiang4 bei3
sentences.english: Old Zhou's boat set out from Hangzhou and went north along the Grand Canal.

sentences.hanzi: 走一趟，要好几个月。
sentences.pinyin: zou3 yi1 tang4 yao4 hao3 ji3 ge4 yue4
sentences.english: One trip took several months.

sentences.hanzi: 大运河上的每一段水，老周都认识。
sentences.pinyin: da4 yun4 he2 shang4 de5 mei3 yi1 duan4 shui3 lao3 zhou1 dou1 ren4 shi5
sentences.english: Old Zhou knew every stretch of the canal.

sentences.hanzi: 他知道哪里水深，哪里风大，哪里晚上不能停船。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zhi1 dao4 na3 li3 shui3 shen1 na3 li3 feng1 da4 na3 li3 wan3 shang5 bu4 neng2 ting2 chuan2
sentences.english: He knew where the water was deep, where the wind was strong, and where you must not moor at night.

sentences.hanzi: 这一年，一个新人来到船上，叫小七，才十几岁。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 nian2 yi1 ge5 xin1 ren2 lai2 dao4 chuan2 shang4 jiao4 xiao3 qi1 cai2 shi2 ji3 sui4
sentences.english: That year a newcomer called Little Seven joined the boat. He was still in his teens.

sentences.hanzi: 小七第一次去北京，十分兴奋。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 qi1 di4 yi1 ci4 qu4 bei3 jing1 shi2 fen1 xing1 fen4
sentences.english: It was his first trip to Beijing, and he was very excited.

sentences.hanzi: 他问：“老周，北京是什么样子？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 wen4 lao3 zhou1 bei3 jing1 shi4 shen2 me5 yang4 zi5
sentences.english: He asked, "Old Zhou, what's Beijing like?"

sentences.hanzi: 老周看着水，没有说话。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 zhou1 kan4 zhe5 shui3 mei2 you3 shuo1 hua4
sentences.english: Old Zhou looked at the water and said nothing.

sentences.hanzi: 小七又问：“皇帝住的地方，真的那么大吗？”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 qi1 you4 wen4 huang2 di4 zhu4 de5 di4 fang5 zhen1 de5 na4 me5 da4 ma5
sentences.english: Little Seven asked again, "Is the place where the emperor lives really that big?"

sentences.hanzi: 老周说：“不知道。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 zhou1 shuo1 bu4 zhi1 dao4
sentences.english: Old Zhou said, "I don't know."

sentences.hanzi: 小七笑了：“你走了四十年，怎么会不知道？”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 qi1 xiao4 le5 ni3 zou3 le5 si4 shi2 nian2 zen3 me5 hui4 bu4 zhi1 dao4
sentences.english: Little Seven laughed. "Forty years on this route, and you don't know?"

sentences.hanzi: 老周说：“船到了通州就停了。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 zhou1 shuo1 chuan2 dao4 le5 tong1 zhou1 jiu4 ting2 le5
sentences.english: Old Zhou said, "The boats stop at Tongzhou."

sentences.hanzi: 通州在北京东边，米从这里上车，送进城里。
sentences.pinyin: tong1 zhou1 zai4 bei3 jing1 dong1 bian1 mi3 cong2 zhe4 li3 shang4 che1 song4 jin4 cheng2 li3
sentences.english: Tongzhou was just east of Beijing. There the rice went onto carts and into the city.

sentences.hanzi: 四十年了，老周每次都在这里等，然后把船开回南边。
sentences.pinyin: si4 shi2 nian2 le5 lao3 zhou1 mei3 ci4 dou1 zai4 zhe4 li3 deng3 ran2 hou4 ba3 chuan2 kai1 hui2 nan2 bian1
sentences.english: For forty years Old Zhou had waited here each time, then taken his boat back south.

sentences.hanzi: “你从来没有进过城？”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 cong2 lai2 mei2 you3 jin4 guo5 cheng2
sentences.english: "You've never been into the city?"

sentences.hanzi: “没有。船上总有事。”
sentences.pinyin: mei2 you3 chuan2 shang4 zong3 you3 shi4
sentences.english: "No. There's always something to do on the boat."
