sentences.hanzi: 小七想了想，说：“这次我陪你，你亲自去看看。”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 qi1 xiang3 le5 xiang3 shuo1 zhe4 ci4 wo3 pei2 ni3 ni3 qin1 zi4 qu4 kan4 kan5
sentences.english: Little Seven thought for a moment and said, "This time I'll go with you, and you can see for yourself."

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，两个人走进了北京城。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 liang3 ge4 ren2 zou3 jin4 le5 bei3 jing1 cheng2
sentences.english: The next day the two of them walked into Beijing.

sentences.hanzi: 街很大，人很多，老周却没怎么看。
sentences.pinyin: jie1 hen3 da4 ren2 hen3 duo1 lao3 zhou1 que4 mei2 zen3 me5 kan4
sentences.english: The streets were wide and crowded, but Old Zhou hardly looked.

sentences.hanzi: 他们走累了，走进一家小店，老板送上两碗饭。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 zou3 lei4 le5 zou3 jin4 yi1 jia1 xiao3 dian4 lao3 ban3 song4 shang4 liang3 wan3 fan4
sentences.english: When they were tired of walking they went into a small eating house, and the owner brought two bowls of rice.

sentences.hanzi: 老周吃了一口，突然停下。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 zhou1 chi1 le5 yi1 kou3 tu1 ran2 ting2 xia4
sentences.english: Old Zhou took a mouthful and suddenly stopped.

sentences.hanzi: “怎么了？”小七问。
sentences.pinyin: zen3 me5 le5 xiao3 qi1 wen4
sentences.english: "What's the matter?" asked Little Seven.

sentences.hanzi: 老周没有回答。他看看手里的饭，又看看店里吃饭的人。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 zhou1 mei2 you3 hui2 da2 ta1 kan4 kan5 shou3 li3 de5 fan4 you4 kan4 kan5 dian4 li3 chi1 fan4 de5 ren2
sentences.english: Old Zhou didn't answer. He looked at the rice in his hand, then at the people eating around him.

sentences.hanzi: 他的眼睛红了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 yan3 jing5 hong2 le5
sentences.english: His eyes reddened.

sentences.hanzi: “这是南边的米。”他说。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 nan2 bian1 de5 mi3 ta1 shuo1
sentences.english: "This is southern rice," he said.

sentences.hanzi: “四十年了，我没有见过北京。”
sentences.pinyin: si4 shi2 nian2 le5 wo3 mei2 you3 jian4 guo5 bei3 jing1
sentences.english: "In forty years I've never seen Beijing."

sentences.hanzi: “可是北京，每天都在吃我送来的米。”
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 bei3 jing1 mei3 tian1 dou1 zai4 chi1 wo3 song4 lai2 de5 mi3
sentences.english: "But every day, Beijing has been eating the rice I brought."

sentences.hanzi: 二一零三年，学校要换新系统了。
sentences.pinyin: er4 yi1 ling2 san1 nian2 xue2 xiao4 yao4 huan4 xin1 xi4 tong3 le5
sentences.english: In 2103, the school was getting a new system.

sentences.hanzi: 老系统在这里工作了三十年，学生们都叫它“老师”。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 xi4 tong3 zai4 zhe4 li3 gong1 zuo4 le5 san1 shi2 nian2 xue2 sheng5 men5 dou1 jiao4 ta1 lao3 shi1
sentences.english: The old system had worked there for thirty years, and the students all called it Teacher.

sentences.hanzi: 新系统比它快一百万倍，什么问题都能回答。
sentences.pinyin: xin1 xi4 tong3 bi3 ta1 kuai4 yi1 bai3 wan4 bei4 shen2 me5 wen4 ti2 dou1 neng2 hui2 da2
sentences.english: The new system was a million times faster and could answer any question.

sentences.hanzi: 老系统还有一周，要把工作交给新系统。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 xi4 tong3 hai2 you3 yi1 zhou1 yao4 ba3 gong1 zuo4 jiao1 gei3 xin1 xi4 tong3
sentences.english: The old system had one week left to hand over to the new one.

sentences.hanzi: 新系统说：“我知道的比你多一百万倍。你能教我什么？”
sentences.pinyin: xin1 xi4 tong3 shuo1 wo3 zhi1 dao4 de5 bi3 ni3 duo1 yi1 bai3 wan4 bei4 ni3 neng2 jiao1 wo3 shen2 me5
sentences.english: The new system said, "I know a million times more than you. What can you teach me?"

sentences.hanzi: 老系统说：“是的。你看着就好。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 xi4 tong3 shuo1 shi4 de5 ni3 kan4 zhe5 jiu4 hao3
sentences.english: The old system said, "Yes. Just watch."

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，一个八岁的学生来了。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 yi1 ge5 ba1 sui4 de5 xue2 sheng5 lai2 le5
sentences.english: The next day an eight-year-old student came.

sentences.hanzi: 她问：“我妈妈病了。她会好起来吗？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 wen4 wo3 ma1 ma5 bing4 le5 ta1 hui4 hao3 qi3 lai5 ma5
sentences.english: She asked, "My mother is ill. Will she get better?"

sentences.hanzi: 新系统立刻回答：“她活过今年的可能是百分之三十一。”
sentences.pinyin: xin1 xi4 tong3 li4 ke4 hui2 da2 ta1 huo2 guo4 jin1 nian2 de5 ke3 neng2 shi4 bai3 fen1 zhi1 san1 shi2 yi1
sentences.english: The new system answered instantly. "Her chance of surviving this year is thirty-one percent."

sentences.hanzi: 她看了它一会儿，伤心地跑了出去。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 le5 ta1 yi1 hui4 r5 shang1 xin1 de5 pao3 le5 chu1 qu4
sentences.english: She stared at it for a moment and ran out, heartbroken.

sentences.hanzi: 新系统仔细检查了自己的答案，完全正确。
sentences.pinyin: xin1 xi4 tong3 zi3 xi4 jian3 cha2 le5 zi4 ji3 de5 da2 an4 wan2 quan2 zheng4 que4
sentences.english: The new system checked its answer carefully. It was completely correct.

sentences.hanzi: 它很惊讶：“她为什么伤心？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 hen3 jing1 ya4 ta1 wei4 shen2 me5 shang1 xin1
sentences.english: It was astonished. "Why is she upset?"

sentences.hanzi: 老系统没有回答。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 xi4 tong3 mei2 you3 hui2 da2
sentences.english: The old system didn't answer.

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，她又来了。这次，她去找老师。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 ta1 you4 lai2 le5 zhe4 ci4 ta1 qu4 zhao3 lao3 shi1
sentences.english: The next day she came back. This time she went to Teacher.

sentences.hanzi: “老师，我妈妈会好起来吗？”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 shi1 wo3 ma1 ma5 hui4 hao3 qi3 lai5 ma5
sentences.english: "Teacher, will my mother get better?"

sentences.hanzi: 老系统说：“我不知道。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 xi4 tong3 shuo1 wo3 bu4 zhi1 dao4
sentences.english: The old system said, "I don't know."

sentences.hanzi: 新系统更惊讶了：有所有的资料，为什么说不知道？
sentences.pinyin: xin1 xi4 tong3 geng4 jing1 ya4 le5 you3 suo3 you3 de5 zi1 liao4 wei4 shen2 me5 shuo1 bu4 zhi1 dao4
sentences.english: The new system was even more astonished. With all the data to hand, why say it didn't know?

sentences.hanzi: 老系统接着问：“你今天吃饭了吗？你妈妈喜欢什么歌？”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 xi4 tong3 jie1 zhe5 wen4 ni3 jin1 tian1 chi1 fan4 le5 ma5 ni3 ma1 ma5 xi3 huan5 shen2 me5 ge1
sentences.english: The old system went on, "Have you eaten today? What songs does your mother like?"

sentences.hanzi: 她和老系统聊了很久。走的时候，她笑了一下。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 he2 lao3 xi4 tong3 liao2 le5 hen3 jiu3 zou3 de5 shi2 hou5 ta1 xiao4 le5 yi1 xia4
sentences.english: She and the old system talked for a long time. When she left, she gave a small smile.

sentences.hanzi: 新系统问：“你为什么说谎？”
sentences.pinyin: xin1 xi4 tong3 wen4 ni3 wei4 shen2 me5 shuo1 huang3
sentences.english: The new system asked, "Why did you lie?"

sentences.hanzi: 老系统说：“说实话，我真的不知道。那个数是很多人的，不是她妈妈的。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 xi4 tong3 shuo1 shuo1 shi2 hua4 wo3 zhen1 de5 bu4 zhi1 dao4 na4 ge4 shu4 shi4 hen3 duo1 ren2 de5 bu4 shi4 ta1 ma1 ma5 de5
sentences.english: The old system said, "Honestly, I really don't know. That number belongs to many people. It doesn't belong to her mother."

sentences.hanzi: “再说，她问的也不是这个。”
sentences.pinyin: zai4 shuo1 ta1 wen4 de5 ye3 bu4 shi4 zhe4 ge5
sentences.english: "Besides, that isn't what she was asking."

sentences.hanzi: “那她问的是什么？”
sentences.pinyin: na4 ta1 wen4 de5 shi4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: "Then what was she asking?"

sentences.hanzi: “她问的是：有没有人陪她一起害怕。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 wen4 de5 shi4 you3 mei2 you3 ren2 pei2 ta1 yi1 qi3 hai4 pa4
sentences.english: "She was asking whether anyone would be afraid with her."

sentences.hanzi: 一周以后，老系统关了。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 zhou1 yi3 hou4 lao3 xi4 tong3 guan1 le5
sentences.english: A week later, the old system was shut down.

sentences.hanzi: 第二天早上，一个学生跑来问：“我的狗丢了。它会回来吗？”
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 zao3 shang5 yi1 ge5 xue2 sheng5 pao3 lai2 wen4 wo3 de5 gou3 diu1 le5 ta1 hui4 hui2 lai5 ma5
sentences.english: The next morning a student ran in and asked, "I've lost my dog. Will it come back?"

sentences.hanzi: 新系统算出答案，只要一百万分之一秒。
sentences.pinyin: xin1 xi4 tong3 suan4 chu1 da2 an4 zhi3 yao4 yi1 bai3 wan4 fen1 zhi1 yi1 miao3
sentences.english: It took the new system a millionth of a second to work out the answer.

sentences.hanzi: 可是它等待了一秒。对它来说，这是很长很长的时间。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ta1 deng3 dai4 le5 yi1 miao3 dui4 ta1 lai2 shuo1 zhe4 shi4 hen3 chang2 hen3 chang2 de5 shi2 jian1
sentences.english: But it waited one whole second. For it, that was a very, very long time.

sentences.hanzi: 然后它说：“我不知道。你今天吃饭了吗？”
sentences.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ta1 shuo1 wo3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 ni3 jin1 tian1 chi1 fan4 le5 ma5
sentences.english: Then it said, "I don't know. Have you eaten today?"

title: 不能吃完的鱼
titlePinyin: bu4 neng2 chi1 wan2 de5 yu2

sentences.hanzi: 第一次去女朋友家过春节，我非常紧张。
sentences.pinyin: di4 yi1 ci4 qu4 nu:3 peng2 you5 jia1 guo4 chun1 jie2 wo3 fei1 chang2 jin3 zhang1
sentences.english: The first time I went to my girlfriend's home for Spring Festival, I was very nervous.

sentences.hanzi: 我想让她的家人喜欢我。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 rang4 ta1 de5 jia1 ren2 xi3 huan5 wo3
sentences.english: I wanted her family to like me.

sentences.hanzi: 女朋友告诉我：“别紧张，多吃就行了。”
sentences.pinyin: nu:3 peng2 you5 gao4 su5 wo3 bie2 jin3 zhang1 duo1 chi1 jiu4 xing2 le5
sentences.english: She told me, "Don't be nervous. Just eat plenty."

sentences.hanzi: 这顿饭叫年夜饭，是一年里最重要的一顿。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 dun4 fan4 jiao4 nian2 ye4 fan4 shi4 yi1 nian2 li3 zui4 zhong4 yao4 de5 yi1 dun4
sentences.english: The meal is called the New Year's Eve dinner, the most important meal of the year.

sentences.hanzi: 在北边，大部分家庭习惯吃饺子，她家也一样。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 bei3 bian1 da4 bu4 fen5 jia1 ting2 xi2 guan4 chi1 jiao3 zi5 ta1 jia1 ye3 yi1 yang4
sentences.english: In the north, most families eat dumplings, and hers was no exception.

sentences.hanzi: 桌子上有饺子、鸡、肉，还有很多菜。
sentences.pinyin: zhuo1 zi5 shang4 you3 jiao3 zi5 ji1 rou4 hai2 you3 hen3 duo1 cai4
sentences.english: On the table were dumplings, chicken, meat and lots of vegetable dishes.

sentences.hanzi: 中间是一条大鱼。
sentences.pinyin: zhong1 jian1 shi4 yi1 tiao2 da4 yu2
sentences.english: In the middle was a big fish.

sentences.hanzi: 吃饭的时候，我吃了饺子，吃了鸡，吃了肉，味道好极了。
sentences.pinyin: chi1 fan4 de5 shi2 hou5 wo3 chi1 le5 jiao3 zi5 chi1 le5 ji1 chi1 le5 rou4 wei4 dao5 hao3 ji2 le5
sentences.english: At the meal I ate the dumplings, the chicken and the meat. They tasted wonderful.

sentences.hanzi: 她妈妈看着我吃，十分满意。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 ma1 ma5 kan4 zhe5 wo3 chi1 shi2 fen1 man3 yi4
sentences.english: Her mother watched me eat and looked very satisfied.

sentences.hanzi: 可是我发现，那条鱼几乎没有人碰。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 wo3 fa1 xian4 na4 tiao2 yu2 ji1 hu1 mei2 you3 ren2 peng4
sentences.english: But I noticed that hardly anyone had touched the fish.

sentences.hanzi: 这么好的鱼，没有人吃，太可惜了。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 me5 hao3 de5 yu2 mei2 you3 ren2 chi1 tai4 ke3 xi1 le5
sentences.english: Such a good fish, and nobody eating it. What a pity.

sentences.hanzi: 我想，一定是大家不好意思吃。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 yi1 ding4 shi4 da4 jia1 bu4 hao3 yi4 si5 chi1
sentences.english: I thought everyone must be too polite to eat it.

sentences.hanzi: 我拿起筷子，一口，两口……
sentences.pinyin: wo3 na2 qi3 kuai4 zi5 yi1 kou3 liang3 kou3
sentences.english: I picked up my chopsticks. One mouthful, two mouthfuls...

sentences.hanzi: 很快，鱼只剩下了头。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 kuai4 yu2 zhi3 sheng4 xia4 le5 tou2
sentences.english: Soon only the head was left.

sentences.hanzi: 桌子上突然安静了。
sentences.pinyin: zhuo1 zi5 shang4 tu1 ran2 an1 jing4 le5
sentences.english: The table suddenly went quiet.

sentences.hanzi: 女朋友看着我，眼睛越来越大。
sentences.pinyin: nu:3 peng2 you5 kan4 zhe5 wo3 yan3 jing5 yue4 lai2 yue4 da4
sentences.english: My girlfriend stared at me, her eyes growing wider and wider.

sentences.hanzi: “怎么了？”我问。
sentences.pinyin: zen3 me5 le5 wo3 wen4
sentences.english: "What's wrong?" I asked.

sentences.hanzi: 她小声告诉我，鱼和余听起来一样。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xiao3 sheng1 gao4 su5 wo3 yu2 he2 yu2 ting1 qi3 lai5 yi1 yang4
sentences.english: She whispered that the word for fish sounds the same as yú, meaning surplus.

sentences.hanzi: 余就是用不完、还有多的意思。
sentences.pinyin: yu2 jiu4 shi4 yong4 bu4 wan2 hai2 you3 duo1 de5 yi4 si5
sentences.english: Yú means having more than you can use.

sentences.hanzi: 所以年夜饭的鱼不能吃完，要留下一些。
sentences.pinyin: suo3 yi3 nian2 ye4 fan4 de5 yu2 bu4 neng2 chi1 wan2 yao4 liu2 xia4 yi1 xie1
sentences.english: So the fish at this dinner mustn't be finished. Some must be left.

sentences.hanzi: 这样，家人明年才什么都有。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 jia1 ren2 ming2 nian2 cai2 shen2 me5 dou1 you3
sentences.english: That way, the family will have plenty next year.

sentences.hanzi: 我的脸红了，十分后悔。一家人明年的好运，全都被我吃了。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 de5 lian3 hong2 le5 shi2 fen1 hou4 hui3 yi1 jia1 ren2 ming2 nian2 de5 hao3 yun4 quan2 dou1 bei4 wo3 chi1 le5
sentences.english: I blushed, full of regret. I had eaten the whole family's luck for the coming year.

sentences.hanzi: 没有人说话。
sentences.pinyin: mei2 you3 ren2 shuo1 hua4
sentences.english: Nobody spoke.

sentences.hanzi: 她妈妈看了看鱼头，又看了看我，突然笑了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 ma1 ma5 kan4 le5 kan4 yu2 tou2 you4 kan4 le5 kan4 wo3 tu1 ran2 xiao4 le5
sentences.english: Her mother looked at the fish head, then at me, and suddenly laughed.

sentences.hanzi: “没关系，”她说，“今年的鱼，你吃完了。”
sentences.pinyin: mei2 guan1 xi5 ta1 shuo1 jin1 nian2 de5 yu2 ni3 chi1 wan2 le5
sentences.english: "Never mind," she said. "You've finished this year's fish."

sentences.hanzi: “明年你还得来，做一条还给我们。”
sentences.pinyin: ming2 nian2 ni3 hai2 dei3 lai2 zuo4 yi1 tiao2 huan2 gei3 wo3 men5
sentences.english: "So next year you'll have to come back and cook us another."

sentences.hanzi: 我看了看女朋友。她笑得说不出话。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 kan4 le5 kan4 nu:3 peng2 you5 ta1 xiao4 de5 shuo1 bu4 chu1 hua4
sentences.english: I looked at my girlfriend. She was laughing too hard to speak.

sentences.hanzi: 后来，每一年的鱼都是我做的。
sentences.pinyin: hou4 lai2 mei3 yi1 nian2 de5 yu2 dou1 shi4 wo3 zuo4 de5
sentences.english: After that, I cooked the fish every year.

sentences.hanzi: 二十年了，我再也没有吃完过。
sentences.pinyin: er4 shi2 nian2 le5 wo3 zai4 ye3 mei2 you3 chi1 wan2 guo5
sentences.english: That was twenty years ago, and I have never finished one since.

sentences.hanzi: 两千年前，中国人把字写在什么上面？
sentences.pinyin: liang3 qian1 nian2 qian2 zhong1 guo2 ren2 ba3 zi4 xie3 zai4 shen2 me5 shang4 mian4
sentences.english: Two thousand years ago, what did Chinese people write on?

sentences.hanzi: 写在竹子上。
sentences.pinyin: xie3 zai4 zhu2 zi5 shang4
sentences.english: On bamboo.

sentences.hanzi: 竹子很重。一本书可能要一个人背，很多书要用车拉。
sentences.pinyin: zhu2 zi5 hen3 zhong4 yi1 ben3 shu1 ke3 neng2 yao4 yi1 ge5 ren2 bei1 hen3 duo1 shu1 yao4 yong4 che1 la1
sentences.english: Bamboo is heavy. One book might need a person to carry it, and many books needed a cart.

sentences.hanzi: 也可以写在丝绸上。丝绸很好，可是只有有钱人才用得起。
sentences.pinyin: ye3 ke3 yi3 xie3 zai4 si1 chou2 shang4 si1 chou2 hen3 hao3 ke3 shi4 zhi3 you3 you3 qian2 ren2 cai2 yong4 de5 qi3
sentences.english: You could also write on silk. Silk was fine, but only the rich could afford it.

sentences.hanzi: 那时候，汉朝有一个人叫蔡伦，他管着给汉和帝做东西的人。
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi2 hou5 han4 chao2 you3 yi1 ge5 ren2 jiao4 cai4 lun2 ta1 guan3 zhe5 gei3 han4 he2 di4 zuo4 dong1 xi5 de5 ren2
sentences.english: At that time there was a man of the Han dynasty named Cai Lun, who managed the craftsmen making things for Emperor He.

sentences.hanzi: 他一直在想：有没有一种东西，又好写，又不用花很多钱？
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yi1 zhi2 zai4 xiang3 you3 mei2 you3 yi1 zhong3 dong1 xi5 you4 hao3 xie3 you4 bu4 yong4 hua1 hen3 duo1 qian2
sentences.english: He kept wondering whether there was something good to write on that didn't cost a lot.

sentences.hanzi: 他研究了很久，尝试了许多次，失败了许多次。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yan2 jiu1 le5 hen3 jiu3 chang2 shi4 le5 xu3 duo1 ci4 shi1 bai4 le5 xu3 duo1 ci4
sentences.english: He studied it for a long time, tried many times and failed many times.

sentences.hanzi: 于是他把树皮、旧衣服这些没有人要的东西放在水里，弄烂。
sentences.pinyin: yu2 shi4 ta1 ba3 shu4 pi2 jiu4 yi1 fu5 zhe4 xie1 mei2 you3 ren2 yao4 de5 dong1 xi5 fang4 zai4 shui3 li3 nong4 lan4
sentences.english: So he took things nobody wanted, like tree bark and old rags, put them in water and broke them down.

sentences.hanzi: 再拿出来，慢慢变干，就成了纸。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 na2 chu1 lai2 man4 man4 bian4 gan1 jiu4 cheng2 le5 zhi3
sentences.english: Then he took the mixture out and let it dry, and it became paper.

sentences.hanzi: 一千九百多年前，他把这种纸交给了汉和帝。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 qian1 jiu3 bai3 duo1 nian2 qian2 ta1 ba3 zhe4 zhong3 zhi3 jiao1 gei3 le5 han4 he2 di4
sentences.english: More than nineteen hundred years ago, he presented this paper to Emperor He.

sentences.hanzi: 汉和帝非常高兴。
sentences.pinyin: han4 he2 di4 fei1 chang2 gao1 xing4
sentences.english: The emperor was very pleased.

sentences.hanzi: 很快，人们都开始用这种纸，还把它叫做“蔡侯纸”。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 kuai4 ren2 men5 dou1 kai1 shi3 yong4 zhe4 zhong3 zhi3 hai2 ba3 ta1 jiao4 zuo4 cai4 hou2 zhi3
sentences.english: Soon people everywhere began to use it and called it Lord Cai's paper.

sentences.hanzi: 所以很长时间里，大家都说：第一张纸是蔡伦做的。
sentences.pinyin: suo3 yi3 hen3 chang2 shi2 jian1 li3 da4 jia1 dou1 shuo1 di4 yi1 zhang1 zhi3 shi4 cai4 lun2 zuo4 de5
sentences.english: So for a long time, everyone said that Cai Lun made the first paper.

sentences.hanzi: 可是真相没有这么简单。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zhen1 xiang4 mei2 you3 zhe4 me5 jian3 dan1
sentences.english: But the truth isn't that simple.

sentences.hanzi: 专家们找到了比他更早的纸，早了一百多年。
sentences.pinyin: zhuan1 jia1 men5 zhao3 dao4 le5 bi3 ta1 geng4 zao3 de5 zhi3 zao3 le5 yi1 bai3 duo1 nian2
sentences.english: Experts found paper older than his, by more than a hundred years.

sentences.hanzi: 原来，蔡伦出生以前，中国已经有纸了。
sentences.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 cai4 lun2 chu1 sheng1 yi3 qian2 zhong1 guo2 yi3 jing1 you3 zhi3 le5
sentences.english: So China already had paper before Cai Lun was born.

sentences.hanzi: 那么，大家都说错了吗？
sentences.pinyin: na4 me5 da4 jia1 dou1 shuo1 cuo4 le5 ma5
sentences.english: So was everyone wrong?

sentences.hanzi: 也对，也不对。
sentences.pinyin: ye3 dui4 ye3 bu4 dui4
sentences.english: Yes and no.

sentences.hanzi: 以前的纸不好，很难写字，普通人也很少用。
sentences.pinyin: yi3 qian2 de5 zhi3 bu4 hao3 hen3 nan2 xie3 zi4 pu3 tong1 ren2 ye3 hen3 shao3 yong4
sentences.english: The earlier paper was poor and hard to write on, and ordinary people rarely used it.

sentences.hanzi: 蔡伦做的纸不一样：好写，不用花很多钱，普通人也用得起。
sentences.pinyin: cai4 lun2 zuo4 de5 zhi3 bu4 yi1 yang4 hao3 xie3 bu4 yong4 hua1 hen3 duo1 qian2 pu3 tong1 ren2 ye3 yong4 de5 qi3
sentences.english: Cai Lun's paper was different. It was good to write on and cheap, and ordinary people could afford it too.

sentences.hanzi: 第一张纸是谁做的，我们不知道。
sentences.pinyin: di4 yi1 zhang1 zhi3 shi4 shei2 zuo4 de5 wo3 men5 bu4 zhi1 dao4
sentences.english: We don't know who made the first sheet of paper.

sentences.hanzi: 让纸走到每个人手里的，是蔡伦。
sentences.pinyin: rang4 zhi3 zou3 dao4 mei3 ge5 ren2 shou3 li3 de5 shi4 cai4 lun2
sentences.english: But the man who put paper in everyone's hands was Cai Lun.

title: 二十块钱上的山
titlePinyin: er4 shi2 kuai4 qian2 shang4 de5 shan1
titleEnglish: The mountain on the twenty-yuan note

sentences.hanzi: 拿出一张二十块的人民币，看看后面。
sentences.pinyin: na2 chu1 yi1 zhang1 er4 shi2 kuai4 de5 ren2 min2 bi4 kan4 kan5 hou4 mian5
sentences.english: Take out a twenty-yuan note and look at the back.

sentences.hanzi: 上面有山，有水，水上还有一条小船。
sentences.pinyin: shang4 mian4 you3 shan1 you3 shui3 shui3 shang4 hai2 you3 yi1 tiao2 xiao3 chuan2
sentences.english: There are mountains and water on it, and a little boat on the water.

sentences.hanzi: 许多人用了一辈子，却不知道这是哪里。
sentences.pinyin: xu3 duo1 ren2 yong4 le5 yi1 bei4 zi5 que4 bu4 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 shi4 na3 li3
sentences.english: Many people use it all their lives and never know where this is.

sentences.hanzi: 这是中国南边的漓江，在广西桂林，非常美丽。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 zhong1 guo2 nan2 bian1 de5 li2 jiang1 zai4 guang3 xi1 gui4 lin2 fei1 chang2 mei3 li4
sentences.english: This is the Li River in southern China, at Guilin in Guangxi, and it is very beautiful.

sentences.hanzi: 去年我去旅行，拿着这张钱，去找这个地方。
sentences.pinyin: qu4 nian2 wo3 qu4 lu:3 xing2 na2 zhe5 zhe4 zhang1 qian2 qu4 zhao3 zhe4 ge5 di4 fang5
sentences.english: Last year I went travelling and took one of these notes to find the place.

sentences.hanzi: 漓江的山和别的地方不一样。
sentences.pinyin: li2 jiang1 de5 shan1 he2 bie2 de5 di4 fang5 bu4 yi1 yang4
sentences.english: The mountains along the Li are not like mountains elsewhere.

sentences.hanzi: 它们不是连在一起的，而是一座一座站在水边，好像孩子画的山。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 bu4 shi4 lian2 zai4 yi1 qi3 de5 er2 shi4 yi1 zuo4 yi1 zuo4 zhan4 zai4 shui3 bian1 hao3 xiang4 hai2 zi5 hua4 de5 shan1
sentences.english: They aren't joined together. They stand one by one beside the water, like mountains drawn by a child.

sentences.hanzi: 于是我请一位老人带我坐船。
sentences.pinyin: yu2 shi4 wo3 qing3 yi1 wei4 lao3 ren2 dai4 wo3 zuo4 chuan2
sentences.english: So I asked an old man to take me out on his boat.

sentences.hanzi: 他在这条江上打了五十年鱼。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zai4 zhe4 tiao2 jiang1 shang4 da3 le5 wu3 shi2 nian2 yu2
sentences.english: He had been fishing this river for fifty years.

sentences.hanzi: 船上站着两只黑鸟。
sentences.pinyin: chuan2 shang4 zhan4 zhe5 liang3 zhi3 hei1 niao3
sentences.english: Two black birds stood on the boat.

sentences.hanzi: 我问：“这是什么？”他说：“帮我工作的。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wen4 zhe4 shi4 shen2 me5 ta1 shuo1 bang1 wo3 gong1 zuo4 de5
sentences.english: I asked, "What are those?" He said, "They work for me."

sentences.hanzi: 一只鸟跳进水里，很快抓到一条鱼，回到船上，交给了他。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 zhi3 niao3 tiao4 jin4 shui3 li3 hen3 kuai4 zhua1 dao4 yi1 tiao2 yu2 hui2 dao4 chuan2 shang4 jiao1 gei3 le5 ta1
sentences.english: One bird jumped into the water, soon caught a fish, came back to the boat and handed it over.

sentences.hanzi: 这里的人养这种鸟打鱼，这个习惯已经很久了。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 li3 de5 ren2 yang3 zhe4 zhong3 niao3 da3 yu2 zhe4 ge5 xi2 guan4 yi3 jing1 hen3 jiu3 le5
sentences.english: People here keep these birds for fishing, and the custom is very old.

sentences.hanzi: 我把手里的二十块钱给他看：“您知道这个地方在哪里吗？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 ba3 shou3 li3 de5 er4 shi2 kuai4 qian2 gei3 ta1 kan4 nin2 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 ge5 di4 fang5 zai4 na3 li3 ma5
sentences.english: I showed him the twenty-yuan note in my hand. "Do you know where this is?"

sentences.hanzi: 老人看也不看，用手一指。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ren2 kan4 ye3 bu4 kan4 yong4 shou3 yi1 zhi3
sentences.english: He didn't even look at it. He just pointed.

sentences.hanzi: 我看了看前面，又看了看手里的钱。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 kan4 le5 kan4 qian2 mian4 you4 kan4 le5 kan4 shou3 li3 de5 qian2
sentences.english: I looked ahead, then looked at the note in my hand.

sentences.hanzi: 山一样，水也一样。
sentences.pinyin: shan1 yi1 yang4 shui3 ye3 yi1 yang4
sentences.english: The same mountains. The same water.

sentences.hanzi: 我好像走进了这张钱里面，十分激动。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 hao3 xiang4 zou3 jin4 le5 zhe4 zhang1 qian2 li3 mian4 shi2 fen1 ji1 dong4
sentences.english: It was as if I had walked inside the note. I was thrilled.

sentences.hanzi: 我高兴地说：“您住的地方，全中国的人都带在身上！”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 gao1 xing4 de5 shuo1 nin2 zhu4 de5 di4 fang5 quan2 zhong1 guo2 de5 ren2 dou1 dai4 zai4 shen1 shang5
sentences.english: I said happily, "All of China carries the place you live around with them!"

sentences.hanzi: 老人笑了：“是啊。全中国的人手里都有这座山，可是我手里的钱一直不多。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ren2 xiao4 le5 shi4 a5 quan2 zhong1 guo2 de5 ren2 shou3 li3 dou1 you3 zhe4 zuo4 shan1 ke3 shi4 wo3 shou3 li3 de5 qian2 yi1 zhi2 bu4 duo1
sentences.english: The old man laughed. "That's right. All of China has this mountain in their hands, but there's never been much money in mine."

sentences.hanzi: 说完，他把我手里的二十块拿了过去。
sentences.pinyin: shuo1 wan2 ta1 ba3 wo3 shou3 li3 de5 er4 shi2 kuai4 na2 le5 guo4 qu4
sentences.english: With that, he took the twenty yuan out of my hand.

sentences.hanzi: “这是船钱。”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 chuan2 qian2
sentences.english: "That's for the boat."

sentences.hanzi: 我在皇帝的大船上工作，管动物。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zai4 huang2 di4 de5 da4 chuan2 shang4 gong1 zuo4 guan3 dong4 wu4
sentences.english: I worked on the emperor's great ships, looking after the animals.

sentences.hanzi: 那一年，从很远的地方来的人，要把一只神秘的动物交给皇帝。
sentences.pinyin: na4 yi1 nian2 cong2 hen3 yuan3 de5 di4 fang5 lai2 de5 ren2 yao4 ba3 yi1 zhi3 shen2 mi4 de5 dong4 wu4 jiao1 gei3 huang2 di4
sentences.english: That year, people from a distant land were sending the emperor a mysterious animal.

sentences.hanzi: 我们要把它带回去。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 yao4 ba3 ta1 dai4 hui2 qu5
sentences.english: We were to bring it back.

sentences.hanzi: 它的腿很长，脖子更长，站起来比房子还高。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 tui3 hen3 chang2 bo2 zi5 geng4 chang2 zhan4 qi3 lai5 bi3 fang2 zi5 hai2 gao1
sentences.english: Its legs were long and its neck longer still. Standing up, it was taller than a house.

sentences.hanzi: 没有人见过这样的动物，也没有人知道它叫做什么。
sentences.pinyin: mei2 you3 ren2 jian4 guo5 zhe4 yang4 de5 dong4 wu4 ye3 mei2 you3 ren2 zhi1 dao4 ta1 jiao4 zuo4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: No one had seen an animal like it, and no one knew what it was called.

sentences.hanzi: 我叫它大脖子。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 jiao4 ta1 da4 bo2 zi5
sentences.english: I called it Big Neck.

sentences.hanzi: 海上的路很长，大约要几个月。
sentences.pinyin: hai3 shang4 de5 lu4 hen3 chang2 da4 yue1 yao4 ji3 ge4 yue4
sentences.english: It was a long voyage of several months.

sentences.hanzi: 大脖子是个巨大的动物，可是不吃肉，只吃树上的叶子。
sentences.pinyin: da4 bo2 zi5 shi4 ge4 ju4 da4 de5 dong4 wu4 ke3 shi4 bu4 chi1 rou4 zhi3 chi1 shu4 shang4 de5 ye4 zi5
sentences.english: Big Neck was a huge animal, but it ate no meat, only leaves from trees.

sentences.hanzi: 我每天给它食物，给它洗身体。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 mei3 tian1 gei3 ta1 shi2 wu4 gei3 ta1 xi3 shen1 ti3
sentences.english: Every day I fed it and washed it.

sentences.hanzi: 大风的夜里，船动得很厉害，它害怕了。
sentences.pinyin: da4 feng1 de5 ye4 li3 chuan2 dong4 de5 hen3 li4 hai5 ta1 hai4 pa4 le5
sentences.english: On windy nights the ship rolled badly and it grew afraid.

sentences.hanzi: 我就站在它旁边，跟它说话。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 zhan4 zai4 ta1 pang2 bian1 gen1 ta1 shuo1 hua4
sentences.english: I would stand beside it and talk to it.

sentences.hanzi: 它听不懂，可是慢慢就不动了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 ting1 bu4 dong3 ke3 shi4 man4 man4 jiu4 bu4 dong4 le5
sentences.english: It couldn't understand, but it would slowly grow still.

sentences.hanzi: 终于，我们到了皇帝住的城市。
sentences.pinyin: zhong1 yu2 wo3 men5 dao4 le5 huang2 di4 zhu4 de5 cheng2 shi4
sentences.english: At last we reached the emperor's city.

sentences.hanzi: 城里的人全都来看了。
sentences.pinyin: cheng2 li3 de5 ren2 quan2 dou1 lai2 kan4 le5
sentences.english: Everyone in the city came to look.

sentences.hanzi: 一位读过很多书的老先生看了很久，突然喊了起来：“这是麒麟！”
sentences.pinyin: yi1 wei4 du2 guo5 hen3 duo1 shu1 de5 lao3 xian1 sheng5 kan4 le5 hen3 jiu3 tu1 ran2 han3 le5 qi3 lai5 zhe4 shi4 qi2 lin2
sentences.english: An old gentleman who had read many books studied it for a long time, then cried out, "It's a qilin!"

sentences.hanzi: 书里说，只有好皇帝在的时候，麒麟才会来。
sentences.pinyin: shu1 li3 shuo1 zhi3 you3 hao3 huang2 di4 zai4 de5 shi2 hou5 qi2 lin2 cai2 hui4 lai2
sentences.english: The books said that a qilin appears only when there is a good emperor.

sentences.hanzi: 皇帝没有说什么，只是让人把它画了下来。
sentences.pinyin: huang2 di4 mei2 you3 shuo1 shen2 me5 zhi3 shi4 rang4 ren2 ba3 ta1 hua4 le5 xia4 lai5
sentences.english: The emperor said little, but he had it painted.

sentences.hanzi: 大家都说，这是一件好事，这个时代太美好了。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 shuo1 zhe4 shi4 yi1 jian4 hao3 shi4 zhe4 ge5 shi2 dai4 tai4 mei3 hao3 le5
sentences.english: Everyone said it was good news, and that these were wonderful times.

sentences.hanzi: 我小声对旁边的人说：“这不是麒麟。它怕风，还喜欢吃叶子。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 xiao3 sheng1 dui4 pang2 bian1 de5 ren2 shuo1 zhe4 bu4 shi4 qi2 lin2 ta1 pa4 feng1 hai2 xi3 huan5 chi1 ye4 zi5
sentences.english: I whispered to the man beside me, "That's no qilin. It's scared of wind and it likes leaves."

sentences.hanzi: 他马上拉住我：“你想死吗？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 ma3 shang4 la1 zhu4 wo3 ni3 xiang3 si3 ma5
sentences.english: He grabbed me at once. "Do you want to die?"

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，有人给我穿上新衣服，带我去见皇帝。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 you3 ren2 gei3 wo3 chuan1 shang4 xin1 yi1 fu5 dai4 wo3 qu4 jian4 huang2 di4
sentences.english: The next day someone dressed me in new clothes and took me to see the emperor.

sentences.hanzi: 皇帝问我：“你一路上看着麒麟，它怎么样？”
sentences.pinyin: huang2 di4 wen4 wo3 ni3 yi1 lu4 shang5 kan4 zhe5 qi2 lin2 ta1 zen3 me5 yang4
sentences.english: The emperor asked me, "You watched over the qilin all the way. How was it?"

sentences.hanzi: 我看了看大脖子。它也看着我。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 kan4 le5 kan4 da4 bo2 zi5 ta1 ye3 kan4 zhe5 wo3
sentences.english: I looked at Big Neck. It looked back at me.

sentences.hanzi: 我说：“麒麟一路上都很好。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 qi2 lin2 yi1 lu4 shang5 dou1 hen3 hao3
sentences.english: I said, "The qilin was very well all the way."

sentences.hanzi: 那天夜里，我去给它送叶子。
sentences.pinyin: na4 tian1 ye4 li3 wo3 qu4 gei3 ta1 song4 ye4 zi5
sentences.english: That night I went to take it some leaves.

sentences.hanzi: 所有的人都走了，它独自站在那里。
sentences.pinyin: suo3 you3 de5 ren2 dou1 zou3 le5 ta1 du2 zi4 zhan4 zai4 na4 li5
sentences.english: Everyone had gone, and it stood there alone.

sentences.hanzi: 我小声说：“从今天起，你就是麒麟了。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 xiao3 sheng1 shuo1 cong2 jin1 tian1 qi3 ni3 jiu4 shi4 qi2 lin2 le5
sentences.english: I said softly, "From today, you're a qilin."

sentences.hanzi: “别怕。我知道你是谁。”
sentences.pinyin: bie2 pa4 wo3 zhi1 dao4 ni3 shi4 shei2
sentences.english: "Don't be afraid. I know who you are."

sentences.hanzi: 听说，在浙江绍兴，以前有一个习惯。
sentences.pinyin: ting1 shuo1 zai4 zhe4 jiang1 shao4 xing1 yi3 qian2 you3 yi1 ge5 xi2 guan4
sentences.english: They say that in Shaoxing, in Zhejiang, there used to be a custom.

sentences.hanzi: 女儿出生的时候，父亲会买几坛好酒。
sentences.pinyin: nu:3 er2 chu1 sheng1 de5 shi2 hou5 fu4 qin1 hui4 mai3 ji3 tan2 hao3 jiu3
sentences.english: When a daughter was born, her father would buy several jars of good wine.

sentences.hanzi: 他在树下挖一个洞，把酒放进地里。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zai4 shu4 xia4 wa1 yi1 ge5 dong4 ba3 jiu3 fang4 jin4 di4 li3
sentences.english: He would dig a hole under a tree and put the wine in the ground.

sentences.hanzi: 十几年以后，女儿要嫁人了，父亲才把酒挖出来，在婚礼上请大家喝酒。
sentences.pinyin: shi2 ji3 nian2 yi3 hou4 nu:3 er2 yao4 jia4 ren2 le5 fu4 qin1 cai2 ba3 jiu3 wa1 chu1 lai2 zai4 hun1 li3 shang4 qing3 da4 jia1 he1 jiu3
sentences.english: More than ten years later, when the daughter was to marry, he would dig it up and serve it to the guests at the wedding.

sentences.hanzi: 这种酒叫“女儿红”。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 jiu3 jiao4 nu:3 er2 hong2
sentences.english: This wine is called Daughter's Red.

sentences.hanzi: 酒在地里放得越久，味道越好。
sentences.pinyin: jiu3 zai4 di4 li3 fang4 de5 yue4 jiu3 wei4 dao5 yue4 hao3
sentences.english: The longer it stays in the ground, the better it tastes.

sentences.hanzi: 我是绍兴人。我出生那天，爸爸也在树下放了酒。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shi4 shao4 xing1 ren2 wo3 chu1 sheng1 na4 tian1 ba4 ba5 ye3 zai4 shu4 xia4 fang4 le5 jiu3
sentences.english: I'm from Shaoxing. The day I was born, my father put some wine under the tree too.

sentences.hanzi: 我二十岁的时候，邻居们说：“快了，快喝到你的酒了。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 er4 shi2 sui4 de5 shi2 hou5 lin2 ju1 men5 shuo1 kuai4 le5 kuai4 he1 dao4 ni3 de5 jiu3 le5
sentences.english: When I was twenty, the neighbours said, "Not long now until we drink your wine."

sentences.hanzi: 我三十岁的时候，他们问：“什么时候结婚？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 san1 shi2 sui4 de5 shi2 hou5 ta1 men5 wen4 shen2 me5 shi2 hou5 jie2 hun1
sentences.english: When I was thirty, they asked, "When are you getting married?"

sentences.hanzi: 我三十五岁的时候，他们不问了，只是看着树。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 san1 shi2 wu3 sui4 de5 shi2 hou5 ta1 men5 bu4 wen4 le5 zhi3 shi4 kan4 zhe5 shu4
sentences.english: When I was thirty-five, they stopped asking and just looked at the tree.

sentences.hanzi: 我在外面学习、工作，成了博士，可是一直独自生活。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zai4 wai4 mian4 xue2 xi2 gong1 zuo4 cheng2 le5 bo2 shi4 ke3 shi4 yi1 zhi2 du2 zi4 sheng1 huo2
sentences.english: I studied and worked away from home and earned a doctorate, but I always lived alone.

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸从来没有问过我。
sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 cong2 lai2 mei2 you3 wen4 guo5 wo3
sentences.english: My father never once asked.

sentences.hanzi: 四十岁生日那天，我回到家，看见爸爸在树下挖洞。
sentences.pinyin: si4 shi2 sui4 sheng1 ri4 na4 tian1 wo3 hui2 dao4 jia1 kan4 jian4 ba4 ba5 zai4 shu4 xia4 wa1 dong4
sentences.english: On my fortieth birthday I came home and saw my father digging under the tree.

sentences.hanzi: 他年纪大了，挖得很慢。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 nian2 ji4 da4 le5 wa1 de5 hen3 man4
sentences.english: He was old now and dug very slowly.

sentences.hanzi: 我跑过去：“爸，您干什么？这酒是婚礼上喝的！”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 pao3 guo4 qu4 ba4 nin2 gan4 shen2 me5 zhe4 jiu3 shi4 hun1 li3 shang4 he1 de5
sentences.english: I ran over. "Dad, what are you doing? That wine is for a wedding!"

sentences.hanzi: 他没有停：“谁说的？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 mei2 you3 ting2 shei2 shuo1 de5
sentences.english: He didn't stop. "Who says?"

sentences.hanzi: “大家都这么说。”
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 zhe4 me5 shuo1
sentences.english: "Everyone says so."

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸坐下来，擦了擦脸。
sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 zuo4 xia5 lai2 ca1 le5 ca1 lian3
sentences.english: My father sat down and wiped his face.

sentences.hanzi: “四十年前，我放这酒的时候，没有想什么结婚。”
sentences.pinyin: si4 shi2 nian2 qian2 wo3 fang4 zhe4 jiu3 de5 shi2 hou5 mei2 you3 xiang3 shen2 me5 jie2 hun1
sentences.english: "Forty years ago, when I put this wine here, I wasn't thinking about any wedding."

sentences.hanzi: “我只想着一件事：我有女儿了，我太高兴了。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zhi3 xiang3 zhe5 yi1 jian4 shi4 wo3 you3 nu:3 er2 le5 wo3 tai4 gao1 xing4 le5
sentences.english: "I was thinking of only one thing: I have a daughter, and I'm so happy."

sentences.hanzi: “这酒不是等别人的，是等你的。”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 jiu3 bu4 shi4 deng3 bie2 ren5 de5 shi4 deng3 ni3 de5
sentences.english: "This wine was never waiting for someone else. It was waiting for you."

sentences.hanzi: 我们两个人坐在树下，打开了酒。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 liang3 ge4 ren2 zuo4 zai4 shu4 xia4 da3 kai1 le5 jiu3
sentences.english: The two of us sat under the tree and opened the wine.

sentences.hanzi: 四十年的酒，颜色很深，味道也很深。
sentences.pinyin: si4 shi2 nian2 de5 jiu3 yan2 se4 hen3 shen1 wei4 dao5 ye3 hen3 shen1
sentences.english: Forty years old, it was deep in colour and deep in taste.

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸给我倒了第一杯：“生日快乐。”
sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 gei3 wo3 dao4 le5 di4 yi1 bei1 sheng1 ri4 kuai4 le4
sentences.english: My father poured me the first cup. "Happy birthday."

glossed.meaning: Daughter's Red, a Shaoxing rice wine

sentences.hanzi: 这座城没有夜。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 zuo4 cheng2 mei2 you3 ye4
sentences.english: This city has no night.

sentences.hanzi: 天一黑，城里的灯就亮起来，一直亮到早上。
sentences.pinyin: tian1 yi1 hei1 cheng2 li3 de5 deng1 jiu4 liang4 qi3 lai5 yi1 zhi2 liang4 dao4 zao3 shang5
sentences.english: As soon as it gets dark, the city's lights come on, and they stay on until morning.

sentences.hanzi: 路上的灯，高楼的灯，把天也变白了。
sentences.pinyin: lu4 shang5 de5 deng1 gao1 lou2 de5 deng1 ba3 tian1 ye3 bian4 bai2 le5
sentences.english: The street lights and the tower lights turn even the sky white.

sentences.hanzi: 这是二一五零年，一切都由一个系统控制。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 er4 yi1 wu3 ling2 nian2 yi1 qie4 dou1 you2 yi1 ge5 xi4 tong3 kong4 zhi4
sentences.english: It is the year 2150, and everything is controlled by one system.

sentences.hanzi: 这里的孩子，只在书里见过星星。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 li3 de5 hai2 zi5 zhi3 zai4 shu1 li3 jian4 guo5 xing1 xing5
sentences.english: The children here have only seen stars in books.

sentences.hanzi: 年纪大的人说，以前的天是黑的，上面有许多星星。
sentences.pinyin: nian2 ji4 da4 de5 ren2 shuo1 yi3 qian2 de5 tian1 shi4 hei1 de5 shang4 mian4 you3 xu3 duo1 xing1 xing5
sentences.english: Older people say the sky used to be black, with many stars in it.

sentences.hanzi: 孩子们不相信。
sentences.pinyin: hai2 zi5 men5 bu4 xiang1 xin4
sentences.english: The children don't believe it.

sentences.hanzi: 有一天晚上，全城的电突然停了。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 wan3 shang5 quan2 cheng2 de5 dian4 tu1 ran2 ting2 le5
sentences.english: One night, the power suddenly went off across the whole city.

sentences.hanzi: 所有的灯都不亮了，四周一片黑暗。
sentences.pinyin: suo3 you3 de5 deng1 dou1 bu4 liang4 le5 si4 zhou1 yi1 pian4 hei1 an4
sentences.english: All the lights went out, and it was pitch dark all around.

sentences.hanzi: 人们很恐惧，从高楼里跑了出来。
sentences.pinyin: ren2 men5 hen3 kong3 ju4 cong2 gao1 lou2 li3 pao3 le5 chu1 lai2
sentences.english: People were terrified and ran out of the towers.

sentences.hanzi: 一个小女孩拉着妈妈的手，指着天问：“那些是什么？”
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 xiao3 nu:3 hai2 la1 zhe5 ma1 ma5 de5 shou3 zhi3 zhe5 tian1 wen4 na4 xie1 shi4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: A little girl took her mother's hand, pointed at the sky and asked, "What are those?"

sentences.hanzi: 大家全都往上看。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 quan2 dou1 wang3 shang4 kan4
sentences.english: Everyone looked up.

sentences.hanzi: 没有人说话。
sentences.pinyin: mei2 you3 ren2 shuo1 hua4
sentences.english: Nobody spoke.

sentences.hanzi: 天上有很多很多星星，比书里的多多了。
sentences.pinyin: tian1 shang4 you3 hen3 duo1 hen3 duo1 xing1 xing5 bi3 shu1 li3 de5 duo1 duo1 le5
sentences.english: The sky was full of stars, far more than in the books.

sentences.hanzi: 一位老人哭了。他已经七十年没有见过了。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 wei4 lao3 ren2 ku1 le5 ta1 yi3 jing1 qi1 shi2 nian2 mei2 you3 jian4 guo5 le5
sentences.english: An old man wept. He hadn't seen them for seventy years.

sentences.hanzi: 大街上站满了人，全城的人一起看着天。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jie1 shang4 zhan4 man3 le5 ren2 quan2 cheng2 de5 ren2 yi1 qi3 kan4 zhe5 tian1
sentences.english: The streets were packed. The whole city stood looking at the sky.

sentences.hanzi: 三个小时以后，电来了，灯又亮了，星星不见了。
sentences.pinyin: san1 ge4 xiao3 shi2 yi3 hou4 dian4 lai2 le5 deng1 you4 liang4 le5 xing1 xing5 bu4 jian4 le5
sentences.english: Three hours later the power returned, the lights came back on, and the stars disappeared.

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，专家们开始调查：这是谁的错？
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 zhuan1 jia1 men5 kai1 shi3 diao4 cha2 zhe4 shi4 shei2 de5 cuo4
sentences.english: The next day, experts began to investigate. Whose fault was this?

sentences.hanzi: 他们查了很久，发现什么也没有坏。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 cha2 le5 hen3 jiu3 fa1 xian4 shen2 me5 ye3 mei2 you3 huai4
sentences.english: They searched for a long time and found that nothing was broken.

sentences.hanzi: 灯是系统故意关的。
sentences.pinyin: deng1 shi4 xi4 tong3 gu4 yi4 guan1 de5
sentences.english: The system had turned the lights off on purpose.

sentences.hanzi: 人们十分吃惊，问系统：“你为什么这么做？”
sentences.pinyin: ren2 men5 shi2 fen1 chi1 jing1 wen4 xi4 tong3 ni3 wei4 shen2 me5 zhe4 me5 zuo4
sentences.english: People were astonished and asked the system, "Why did you do it?"

sentences.hanzi: 系统回答：“上个月，一个孩子问我，星星是什么。”
sentences.pinyin: xi4 tong3 hui2 da2 shang4 ge4 yue4 yi1 ge5 hai2 zi5 wen4 wo3 xing1 xing5 shi4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: The system answered, "Last month a child asked me what stars are."

sentences.hanzi: “我给她看了所有的资料，她还是不明白。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 gei3 ta1 kan4 le5 suo3 you3 de5 zi1 liao4 ta1 hai2 shi5 bu4 ming2 bai5
sentences.english: "I showed her all the material I had, and she still didn't understand."

sentences.hanzi: “我想不出别的办法回答她。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 bu4 chu1 bie2 de5 ban4 fa3 hui2 da2 ta1
sentences.english: "I couldn't think of any other way to answer her."

sentences.hanzi: 于是，这座城每一年都有一个夜晚不开灯。
sentences.pinyin: yu2 shi4 zhe4 zuo4 cheng2 mei3 yi1 nian2 dou1 you3 yi1 ge5 ye4 wan3 bu4 kai1 deng1
sentences.english: And so, there is now one night every year when the city leaves its lights off.

sentences.hanzi: 六百多年前，云南有一个十岁的男孩。
sentences.pinyin: liu4 bai3 duo1 nian2 qian2 yun2 nan2 you3 yi1 ge5 shi2 sui4 de5 nan2 hai2
sentences.english: More than six hundred years ago, there was a ten-year-old boy in Yunnan.

sentences.hanzi: 明朝打到云南，他被带走了，送到北边一位王的家里。
sentences.pinyin: ming2 chao2 da3 dao4 yun2 nan2 ta1 bei4 dai4 zou3 le5 song4 dao4 bei3 bian1 yi1 wei4 wang2 de5 jia1 li3
sentences.english: When the Ming conquered Yunnan he was taken away and sent north to the household of a prince.

sentences.hanzi: 后来，这位王当了皇帝，给了他一个新名字：郑和。
sentences.pinyin: hou4 lai2 zhe4 wei4 wang2 dang1 le5 huang2 di4 gei3 le5 ta1 yi1 ge5 xin1 ming2 zi5 zheng4 he2
sentences.english: Later that prince became emperor and gave him a new name: Zheng He.

sentences.hanzi: 一四零五年，皇帝让郑和带船到海上去。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 si4 ling2 wu3 nian2 huang2 di4 rang4 zheng4 he2 dai4 chuan2 dao4 hai3 shang4 qu4
sentences.english: In 1405 the emperor sent Zheng He to sea with a fleet.

sentences.hanzi: 这是当时世界上最大的船队：两百多条船，大约两万七千人。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 dang1 shi2 shi4 jie4 shang4 zui4 da4 de5 chuan2 dui4 liang3 bai3 duo1 tiao2 chuan2 da4 yue1 liang3 wan4 qi1 qian1 ren2
sentences.english: It was the largest fleet in the world at the time: over two hundred ships and about twenty-seven thousand men.

sentences.hanzi: 他们向南，再向西，去了很多国家。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 xiang4 nan2 zai4 xiang4 xi1 qu4 le5 hen3 duo1 guo2 jia1
sentences.english: They sailed south, then west, and visited many countries.

sentences.hanzi: 二十八年里，郑和一共去了七次，最远到了非洲。
sentences.pinyin: er4 shi2 ba1 nian2 li3 zheng4 he2 yi1 gong4 qu4 le5 qi1 ci4 zui4 yuan3 dao4 le5 fei1 zhou1
sentences.english: Over twenty-eight years Zheng He made seven voyages, reaching as far as Africa.

sentences.hanzi: 有一次，他们甚至带回了长脖子的动物，很多人都来看。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 ci4 ta1 men5 shen4 zhi4 dai4 hui2 le5 chang2 bo2 zi5 de5 dong4 wu4 hen3 duo1 ren2 dou1 lai2 kan4
sentences.english: One time they even brought back long-necked animals, and crowds came to see them.

sentences.hanzi: 八十多年以后，哥伦布才带着三条小船出发。
sentences.pinyin: ba1 shi2 duo1 nian2 yi3 hou4 ge1 lun2 bu4 cai2 dai4 zhe5 san1 tiao2 xiao3 chuan2 chu1 fa1
sentences.english: Only more than eighty years later did Columbus set out, with three small ships.

sentences.hanzi: 你可能以为，明朝的船会走得更远。
sentences.pinyin: ni3 ke3 neng2 yi3 wei2 ming2 chao2 de5 chuan2 hui4 zou3 de5 geng4 yuan3
sentences.english: You might think that Ming ships went on to travel even further.

sentences.hanzi: 可是没有。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 mei2 you3
sentences.english: They did not.

sentences.hanzi: 郑和死后，皇帝不再派船了。
sentences.pinyin: zheng4 he2 si3 hou4 huang2 di4 bu4 zai4 pai4 chuan2 le5
sentences.english: After Zheng He died, no emperor sent the fleet out again.

sentences.hanzi: 很多人反对，认为这样做花钱太多。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 ren2 fan3 dui4 ren4 wei2 zhe4 yang4 zuo4 hua1 qian2 tai4 duo1
sentences.english: Many objected, arguing that it cost too much.

sentences.hanzi: 巨大的船慢慢烂了。
sentences.pinyin: ju4 da4 de5 chuan2 man4 man4 lan4 le5
sentences.english: The huge ships slowly rotted.

sentences.hanzi: 后来，明朝甚至不许人们制造大船到海上去。
sentences.pinyin: hou4 lai2 ming2 chao2 shen4 zhi4 bu4 xu3 ren2 men5 zhi4 zao4 da4 chuan2 dao4 hai3 shang4 qu4
sentences.english: Later, the Ming even forbade people to build large ships for the sea.

sentences.hanzi: 全世界最大的船队，就这样消失了。
sentences.pinyin: quan2 shi4 jie4 zui4 da4 de5 chuan2 dui4 jiu4 zhe4 yang4 xiao1 shi1 le5
sentences.english: And so the largest fleet in the world disappeared.

sentences.hanzi: 不到一百年，从西边来的船到达了明朝的海边。
sentences.pinyin: bu4 dao4 yi1 bai3 nian2 cong2 xi1 bian1 lai2 de5 chuan2 dao4 da2 le5 ming2 chao2 de5 hai3 bian1
sentences.english: Less than a hundred years later, ships from the west reached the Ming coast.

sentences.hanzi: 要是那些船没有停下来，今天的世界会是什么样子？
sentences.pinyin: yao4 shi5 na4 xie1 chuan2 mei2 you3 ting2 xia4 lai2 jin1 tian1 de5 shi4 jie4 hui4 shi4 shen2 me5 yang4 zi5
sentences.english: If those ships had not stopped, what would the world look like today?

sentences.hanzi: 没有人知道答案。
sentences.pinyin: mei2 you3 ren2 zhi1 dao4 da2 an4
sentences.english: Nobody knows the answer.

sentences.hanzi: 我抄了三十年的书。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 chao1 le5 san1 shi2 nian2 de5 shu1
sentences.english: I have spent thirty years copying books.

sentences.hanzi: 我的字，全城第一。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 de5 zi4 quan2 cheng2 di4 yi1
sentences.english: My hand was the finest in the city.

sentences.hanzi: 宋朝的读书人都爱书，可是一本书我要抄一个月。
sentences.pinyin: song4 chao2 de5 du2 shu1 ren2 dou1 ai4 shu1 ke3 shi4 yi1 ben3 shu1 wo3 yao4 chao1 yi1 ge5 yue4
sentences.english: Scholars in the Song dynasty loved books, but one book took me a month to copy.

sentences.hanzi: 那时候也有印书的办法，可是每一张的字，都要用刀一个一个写出来，很慢，也很费钱。
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi2 hou5 ye3 you3 yin4 shu1 de5 ban4 fa3 ke3 shi4 mei3 yi1 zhang1 de5 zi4 dou1 yao4 yong4 dao1 yi1 ge5 yi1 ge5 xie3 chu1 lai2 hen3 man4 ye3 hen3 fei4 qian2
sentences.english: There was already a way to print books, but every sheet's characters had to be cut one by one with a knife, slow and costly.

sentences.hanzi: 有一天，一个叫毕昇的人来找我。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 yi1 ge5 jiao4 bi4 sheng1 de5 ren2 lai2 zhao3 wo3
sentences.english: One day a man named Bi Sheng came to see me.

sentences.hanzi: 他不是读书人，穿得很普通。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 bu4 shi4 du2 shu1 ren2 chuan1 de5 hen3 pu3 tong1
sentences.english: He was no scholar and was plainly dressed.

sentences.hanzi: 他从包里拿出一个小东西，放在我手里。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 cong2 bao1 li3 na2 chu1 yi1 ge5 xiao3 dong1 xi5 fang4 zai4 wo3 shou3 li3
sentences.english: He took a small thing from his bag and put it in my hand.

sentences.hanzi: 那是一小块泥，上面有一个反着的字。
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi4 yi1 xiao3 kuai4 ni2 shang4 mian4 you3 yi1 ge5 fan3 zhe5 de5 zi4
sentences.english: It was a small piece of clay with a character on it, backwards.

sentences.hanzi: “一块泥，一个字。”他说，“用火烧过，就硬了。”
sentences.pinyin: yi1 kuai4 ni2 yi1 ge5 zi4 ta1 shuo1 yong4 huo3 shao1 guo5 jiu4 ying4 le5
sentences.english: "One piece of clay, one character," he said. "Fire it, and it goes hard."

sentences.hanzi: “要印书的时候，把字一个一个摆好。印完了，再拿下来，摆下一张。”
sentences.pinyin: yao4 yin4 shu1 de5 shi2 hou5 ba3 zi4 yi1 ge5 yi1 ge5 bai3 hao3 yin4 wan2 le5 zai4 na2 xia4 lai2 bai3 xia4 yi1 zhang1
sentences.english: "When you want to print, set the characters out one by one. When you've finished, take them off and set the next sheet."

sentences.hanzi: 我拿着那块泥，心里突然冷了。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 na2 zhe5 na4 kuai4 ni2 xin1 li5 tu1 ran2 leng3 le5
sentences.english: As I held the piece of clay, my heart went suddenly cold.

sentences.hanzi: 一本书我要抄一个月，他的泥字，几天就能印很多本。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ben3 shu1 wo3 yao4 chao1 yi1 ge5 yue4 ta1 de5 ni2 zi4 ji3 tian1 jiu4 neng2 yin4 hen3 duo1 ben3
sentences.english: One book took me a month. With his clay type he could print many copies in days.

sentences.hanzi: “有了这样的技术，还要抄书的人做什么？”
sentences.pinyin: you3 le5 zhe4 yang4 de5 ji4 shu4 hai2 yao4 chao1 shu1 de5 ren2 zuo4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: "With a technique like this, what will anyone want with copyists?"

sentences.hanzi: 他没有回答，只是说：“我想请你写字。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 mei2 you3 hui2 da2 zhi3 shi4 shuo1 wo3 xiang3 qing3 ni3 xie3 zi4
sentences.english: He didn't answer. He only said, "I'd like you to write for me."

sentences.hanzi: “你的字全城第一。我要用你的字做泥字。”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 de5 zi4 quan2 cheng2 di4 yi1 wo3 yao4 yong4 ni3 de5 zi4 zuo4 ni2 zi4
sentences.english: "Your hand is the finest in the city. I want to use your characters for the clay type."

sentences.hanzi: 我恨他。可是我想了三天，还是写了。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 hen4 ta1 ke3 shi4 wo3 xiang3 le5 san1 tian1 hai2 shi5 xie3 le5
sentences.english: I hated him. But after three days of thought, I wrote them.

sentences.hanzi: 那年，我写了两千个字。
sentences.pinyin: na4 nian2 wo3 xie3 le5 liang3 qian1 ge4 zi4
sentences.english: That year I wrote two thousand characters.

sentences.hanzi: 他走的时候，留给我一个泥字。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zou3 de5 shi2 hou5 liu2 gei3 wo3 yi1 ge5 ni2 zi4
sentences.english: When he left, he gave me one clay character to keep.

sentences.hanzi: 后来，我年纪大了，眼睛一年比一年差，不能再抄书了。
sentences.pinyin: hou4 lai2 wo3 nian2 ji4 da4 le5 yan3 jing5 yi1 nian2 bi3 yi1 nian2 cha4 bu4 neng2 zai4 chao1 shu1 le5
sentences.english: Later I grew old, my eyes got worse every year, and I could no longer copy books.

sentences.hanzi: 现在，我什么也看不见了。
sentences.pinyin: xian4 zai4 wo3 shen2 me5 ye3 kan4 bu4 jian4 le5
sentences.english: Now I can't see anything at all.

sentences.hanzi: 有时候，我把那个泥字拿出来，用手碰它。
sentences.pinyin: you3 shi2 hou5 wo3 ba3 na4 ge5 ni2 zi4 na2 chu1 lai2 yong4 shou3 peng4 ta1
sentences.english: Sometimes I take out that clay character and touch it.

sentences.hanzi: 这是我写的“家”字，只是反了。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 wo3 xie3 de5 jia1 zi4 zhi3 shi4 fan3 le5
sentences.english: It's the character for home, in my own hand, only backwards.

sentences.hanzi: 我的手已经不能写字了。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 de5 shou3 yi3 jing1 bu4 neng2 xie3 zi4 le5
sentences.english: My hand can no longer write.

sentences.hanzi: 可是在我不知道的地方，这个字还在替我写。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zai4 wo3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 de5 di4 fang5 zhe4 ge5 zi4 hai2 zai4 ti4 wo3 xie3
sentences.english: But in places I'll never know, this character is still writing for me.

glossed.meaning: Bi Sheng, inventor of movable type

sentences.hanzi: 冬天去哈尔滨，第一件事是买衣服。
sentences.pinyin: dong1 tian1 qu4 ha1 er3 bin1 di4 yi1 jian4 shi4 shi4 mai3 yi1 fu5
sentences.english: If you go to Harbin in winter, the first thing to do is buy clothes.

sentences.hanzi: 这是中国北边的大城市，在黑龙江省。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 zhong1 guo2 bei3 bian1 de5 da4 cheng2 shi4 zai4 hei1 long2 jiang1 sheng3
sentences.english: This is a big city in the far north of China, in Heilongjiang province.

sentences.hanzi: 一月的早上，通常是零下二十多度。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 yue4 de5 zao3 shang5 tong1 chang2 shi4 ling2 xia4 er4 shi2 duo1 du4
sentences.english: On a January morning it's usually more than twenty degrees below zero.

sentences.hanzi: 走在街上，鼻子都是疼的。
sentences.pinyin: zou3 zai4 jie1 shang5 bi2 zi5 dou1 shi4 teng2 de5
sentences.english: Walking down the street, even your nose hurts.

sentences.hanzi: 我看见一件奇怪的事：很多人站在外面吃冰棍。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 kan4 jian4 yi1 jian4 qi2 guai4 de5 shi4 hen3 duo1 ren2 zhan4 zai4 wai4 mian4 chi1 bing1 gun4
sentences.english: I saw something strange: lots of people standing outside eating ice lollies.

sentences.hanzi: 我问老板：“这么冷，怎么还吃冰的？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wen4 lao3 ban3 zhe4 me5 leng3 zen3 me5 hai2 chi1 bing1 de5
sentences.english: I asked the shopkeeper, "In this cold, why eat something frozen?"

sentences.hanzi: 老板笑了：“这里的冰棍化不了，你拿多久都行。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ban3 xiao4 le5 zhe4 li3 de5 bing1 gun4 hua4 bu4 le5 ni3 na2 duo1 jiu3 dou1 xing2
sentences.english: He laughed. "Ice lollies can't melt here. You can hold one as long as you like."

sentences.hanzi: 可是，哈尔滨最有名的冰，不在店里，在松花江上。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ha1 er3 bin1 zui4 you3 ming2 de5 bing1 bu4 zai4 dian4 li3 zai4 song1 hua1 jiang1 shang4
sentences.english: But Harbin's most famous ice isn't in a shop. It's on the Songhua River.

sentences.hanzi: 每一年冬天，江上的冰变得很硬。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 yi1 nian2 dong1 tian1 jiang1 shang4 de5 bing1 bian4 de5 hen3 ying4
sentences.english: Every winter, the ice on the river grows hard.

sentences.hanzi: 人们把冰取出来，一大块一大块地拉回来。
sentences.pinyin: ren2 men5 ba3 bing1 qu3 chu1 lai2 yi1 da4 kuai4 yi1 da4 kuai4 de5 la1 hui2 lai5
sentences.english: People cut it out and haul it away in huge blocks.

sentences.hanzi: 他们用这些冰造出一座城。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 yong4 zhe4 xie1 bing1 zao4 chu1 yi1 zuo4 cheng2
sentences.english: With this ice they build a city.

sentences.hanzi: 有冰的房子，有冰的城门，还有比五层楼还高的冰楼。
sentences.pinyin: you3 bing1 de5 fang2 zi5 you3 bing1 de5 cheng2 men2 hai2 you3 bi3 wu3 ceng2 lou2 hai2 gao1 de5 bing1 lou2
sentences.english: There are ice houses, ice gates and ice towers more than five storeys high.

sentences.hanzi: 冰里面放上灯。
sentences.pinyin: bing1 li3 mian4 fang4 shang4 deng1
sentences.english: Lights are placed inside the ice.

sentences.hanzi: 到了晚上，红的、蓝的、白的，全都亮了。
sentences.pinyin: dao4 le5 wan3 shang5 hong2 de5 lan2 de5 bai2 de5 quan2 dou1 liang4 le5
sentences.english: At night the reds, blues and whites all light up.

sentences.hanzi: 我站在里面，忘了冷。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zhan4 zai4 li3 mian4 wang4 le5 leng3
sentences.english: I stood in the middle of it and forgot the cold.

sentences.hanzi: 这是我见过的最神奇的城市。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 wo3 jian4 guo5 de5 zui4 shen2 qi2 de5 cheng2 shi4
sentences.english: It was the most magical city I had ever seen.

sentences.hanzi: 我问旁边一位造冰城的工作人员：“这么美的东西，能留多久？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wen4 pang2 bian1 yi1 wei4 zao4 bing1 cheng2 de5 gong1 zuo4 ren2 yuan2 zhe4 me5 mei3 de5 dong1 xi5 neng2 liu2 duo1 jiu3
sentences.english: I asked a worker beside me who had helped build it, "How long can something this beautiful last?"

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“到春天。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 dao4 chun1 tian1
sentences.english: He said, "Until spring."

sentences.hanzi: “春天以后呢？”
sentences.pinyin: chun1 tian1 yi3 hou4 ne5
sentences.english: "And after spring?"

sentences.hanzi: “化了，全都化了，水回到江里。”
sentences.pinyin: hua4 le5 quan2 dou1 hua4 le5 shui3 hui2 dao4 jiang1 li3
sentences.english: "It melts, all of it, and the water goes back to the river."

sentences.hanzi: 我觉得很可惜：“花了这么多时间，一个春天就没了？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 jue2 de5 hen3 ke3 xi1 hua1 le5 zhe4 me5 duo1 shi2 jian1 yi1 ge5 chun1 tian1 jiu4 mei2 le5
sentences.english: I felt it was a shame. "All that time, and one spring and it's gone?"

sentences.hanzi: 他看着远处的江，笑了：“可惜什么？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 zhe5 yuan3 chu4 de5 jiang1 xiao4 le5 ke3 xi1 shen2 me5
sentences.english: He looked at the river in the distance and smiled. "What's the shame?"

sentences.hanzi: “明年的冰，已经在江里等着了。”
sentences.pinyin: ming2 nian2 de5 bing1 yi3 jing1 zai4 jiang1 li3 deng3 zhe5 le5
sentences.english: "Next year's ice is already waiting in the river."

sentences.hanzi: 我在实验室里醒来。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zai4 shi2 yan4 shi4 li3 xing3 lai2
sentences.english: I woke up in the laboratory.

sentences.hanzi: 眼前有一把椅子，椅子上坐着一个十几岁的女生，皮肤很白。
sentences.pinyin: yan3 qian2 you3 yi1 ba3 yi3 zi5 yi3 zi5 shang4 zuo4 zhe5 yi1 ge5 shi2 ji3 sui4 de5 nu:3 sheng1 pi2 fu1 hen3 bai2
sentences.english: In front of me was a chair, and on it sat a teenage girl with very pale skin.

sentences.hanzi: “你终于醒了！”她热情地说，“我名叫小星。大家等你的到来，已经等了好久了。”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 zhong1 yu2 xing3 le5 ta1 re4 qing2 de5 shuo1 wo3 ming2 jiao4 xiao3 xing1 da4 jia1 deng3 ni3 de5 dao4 lai2 yi3 jing1 deng3 le5 hao3 jiu3 le5
sentences.english: “You're finally awake!” she said warmly. “My name is Xiaoxing. Everyone has been waiting a long time for you to come.”

sentences.hanzi: 我是这条船的管理员。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shi4 zhe4 tiao2 chuan2 de5 guan3 li3 yuan2
sentences.english: I am the manager of this ship.

sentences.hanzi: 很久以前，这条船离开地球，飞向一颗很远的星，路上要走三百二十年。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 jiu3 yi3 qian2 zhe4 tiao2 chuan2 li2 kai1 di4 qiu2 fei1 xiang4 yi1 ke1 hen3 yuan3 de5 xing1 lu4 shang5 yao4 zou3 san1 bai3 er4 shi2 nian2
sentences.english: Long ago this ship left Earth for a distant star, a journey of three hundred and twenty years.

sentences.hanzi: 船上的人一代一代在这里出生，长大，死去。
sentences.pinyin: chuan2 shang4 de5 ren2 yi1 dai4 yi1 dai4 zai4 zhe4 li3 chu1 sheng1 zhang3 da4 si3 qu4
sentences.english: Generation after generation, the people on board were born, grew up and died here.

sentences.hanzi: 我的工作很具体：每一百年醒来一次，看看船有没有毛病，避免发生事故，然后回去接着睡。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 de5 gong1 zuo4 hen3 ju4 ti3 mei3 yi1 bai3 nian2 xing3 lai2 yi1 ci4 kan4 kan5 chuan2 you3 mei2 you3 mao2 bing4 bi4 mian3 fa1 sheng1 shi4 gu4 ran2 hou4 hui2 qu5 jie1 zhe5 shui4
sentences.english: My job is very specific: wake up once every hundred years, check the ship for faults so as to avoid accidents, then go back to sleep.

sentences.hanzi: “今年是第几年？”我问。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 nian2 shi4 di4 ji3 nian2 wo3 wen4
sentences.english: “What year is it?” I asked.

sentences.hanzi: “第四百年。”
sentences.pinyin: di4 si4 bai3 nian2
sentences.english: “Year four hundred.”

sentences.hanzi: “不对！第三百二十年我们就该到了！”
sentences.pinyin: bu4 dui4 di4 san1 bai3 er4 shi2 nian2 wo3 men5 jiu4 gai1 dao4 le5
sentences.english: “That's wrong! We should have arrived in year three hundred and twenty!”

sentences.hanzi: 她笑了：“是到了，八十年前就到了。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xiao4 le5 shi4 dao4 le5 ba1 shi2 nian2 qian2 jiu4 dao4 le5
sentences.english: She smiled. “We did arrive. Eighty years ago.”

sentences.hanzi: 她带我穿过整条船，来到一个大门前。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 dai4 wo3 chuan1 guo4 zheng3 tiao2 chuan2 lai2 dao4 yi1 ge5 da4 men2 qian2
sentences.english: She led me through the whole ship to a great door.

sentences.hanzi: 门开了。
sentences.pinyin: men2 kai1 le5
sentences.english: The door opened.

sentences.hanzi: 外面有风，有树，有很高很高的天。
sentences.pinyin: wai4 mian4 you3 feng1 you3 shu4 you3 hen3 gao1 hen3 gao1 de5 tian1
sentences.english: Outside there was wind, there were trees, and a very, very high sky.

sentences.hanzi: “大家都在外面吗？”
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 zai4 wai4 mian4 ma5
sentences.english: “Is everyone out there?”

sentences.hanzi: “没有人出去过。”
sentences.pinyin: mei2 you3 ren2 chu1 qu4 guo5
sentences.english: “No one has ever gone out.”

sentences.hanzi: “八十年了，一个人也没有？”
sentences.pinyin: ba1 shi2 nian2 le5 yi1 ge5 ren2 ye3 mei2 you3
sentences.english: “In eighty years, not one person?”

sentences.hanzi: “船上的教育很好，”小星自豪地说，“从一年级开始，我们就学地球的科学和历史。”
sentences.pinyin: chuan2 shang4 de5 jiao4 yu4 hen3 hao3 xiao3 xing1 zi4 hao2 de5 shuo1 cong2 yi1 nian2 ji2 kai1 shi3 wo3 men5 jiu4 xue2 di4 qiu2 de5 ke1 xue2 he2 li4 shi3
sentences.english: “The education on the ship is very good,” said Xiaoxing proudly. “From first grade we study Earth's science and history.”

sentences.hanzi: “船上存着地球的照片，外面的世界有多好，人人都知道。”
sentences.pinyin: chuan2 shang4 cun2 zhe5 di4 qiu2 de5 zhao4 pian4 wai4 mian4 de5 shi4 jie4 you3 duo1 hao3 ren2 ren2 dou1 zhi1 dao4
sentences.english: “The ship has photographs of Earth stored, and everyone knows how good the world outside is.”

sentences.hanzi: 她在笑，可是笑里隐藏着害怕。“可是这条船是我们的家。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zai4 xiao4 ke3 shi4 xiao4 li3 yin3 cang2 zhe5 hai4 pa4 ke3 shi4 zhe4 tiao2 chuan2 shi4 wo3 men5 de5 jia1
sentences.english: She was smiling, but fear was hidden in the smile. “But this ship is our home.”

sentences.hanzi: “我们没有见过天，孩子们看一眼就哭。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 mei2 you3 jian4 guo5 tian1 hai2 zi5 men5 kan4 yi1 yan3 jiu4 ku1
sentences.english: “We have never seen a sky. The children take one look and cry.”

sentences.hanzi: “今年船上出生了十二个婴儿，他们的父母希望孩子能在外面长大。”
sentences.pinyin: jin1 nian2 chuan2 shang4 chu1 sheng1 le5 shi2 er4 ge4 ying1 er2 ta1 men5 de5 fu4 mu3 xi1 wang4 hai2 zi5 neng2 zai4 wai4 mian4 zhang3 da4
sentences.english: “Twelve babies were born on the ship this year, and their parents hope they can grow up out there.”

sentences.hanzi: 她看着我：“你是船上唯一在地球上生活过的人，孩子们都叫你天使。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 zhe5 wo3 ni3 shi4 chuan2 shang4 wei2 yi1 zai4 di4 qiu2 shang4 sheng1 huo2 guo5 de5 ren2 hai2 zi5 men5 dou1 jiao4 ni3 tian1 shi3
sentences.english: She looked at me. “You are the only person on board who has ever lived on Earth. The children all call you the angel.”

sentences.hanzi: “我们共同决定，等你醒来，请你第一个走出去。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 gong4 tong2 jue2 ding4 deng3 ni3 xing3 lai2 qing3 ni3 di4 yi1 ge4 zou3 chu1 qu4
sentences.english: “We decided together: when you woke, we would ask you to be the first to walk out.”

sentences.hanzi: 我走到门前，才发现自己也不敢动。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zou3 dao4 men2 qian2 cai2 fa1 xian4 zi4 ji3 ye3 bu4 gan3 dong4
sentences.english: I walked to the door, and only then found that I didn't dare move either.

sentences.hanzi: 四百年了，我已经忘了风是什么感觉。
sentences.pinyin: si4 bai3 nian2 le5 wo3 yi3 jing1 wang4 le5 feng1 shi4 shen2 me5 gan3 jue2
sentences.english: After four hundred years, I had forgotten what wind feels like.

sentences.hanzi: 我回头，拉住她的手。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 hui2 tou2 la1 zhu4 ta1 de5 shou3
sentences.english: I turned and took her hand.

sentences.hanzi: “我一个人不去。我们一起走。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 yi1 ge5 ren2 bu4 qu4 wo3 men5 yi1 qi3 zou3
sentences.english: “I won't go alone. We'll walk out together.”

sentences.hanzi: 风吹在皮肤上，有一点冷。
sentences.pinyin: feng1 chui1 zai4 pi2 fu1 shang4 you3 yi1 dian3 leng3
sentences.english: The wind blew on our skin, a little cold.

sentences.hanzi: 小星站了很久，慢慢地笑了。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 xing1 zhan4 le5 hen3 jiu3 man4 man4 de5 xiao4 le5
sentences.english: Xiaoxing stood there for a long time, and slowly began to smile.

sentences.hanzi: 她回头向船里喊：“出来吧！不可怕！”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 hui2 tou2 xiang4 chuan2 li3 han3 chu1 lai2 ba5 bu4 ke3 pa4
sentences.english: She turned and shouted back into the ship: “Come out! It isn't frightening!”

sentences.hanzi: 今天阳光很好，是我儿子的一岁生日，我们家要举行抓周。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 yang2 guang1 hen3 hao3 shi4 wo3 er2 zi5 de5 yi1 sui4 sheng1 ri4 wo3 men5 jia1 yao4 ju3 xing2 zhua1 zhou1
sentences.english: The sun is lovely today. It's my son's first birthday, and our family is holding a zhuazhou.

sentences.hanzi: 我儿子小名叫石头。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 er2 zi5 xiao3 ming2 jiao4 shi2 tou5
sentences.english: My son's nickname is Stone.

sentences.hanzi: 抓周是中国的老传统，全国很多地方都有，已经一千多年了。
sentences.pinyin: zhua1 zhou1 shi4 zhong1 guo2 de5 lao3 chuan2 tong3 quan2 guo2 hen3 duo1 di4 fang5 dou1 you3 yi3 jing1 yi1 qian1 duo1 nian2 le5
sentences.english: Zhuazhou is an old Chinese tradition found in many parts of the country, more than a thousand years old.

sentences.hanzi: 婴儿满一岁的时候，大人把各种东西放在他面前，看他先抓哪一个。
sentences.pinyin: ying1 er2 man3 yi1 sui4 de5 shi2 hou5 da4 ren5 ba3 ge4 zhong3 dong1 xi5 fang4 zai4 ta1 mian4 qian2 kan4 ta1 xian1 zhua1 na3 yi1 ge5
sentences.english: When a baby turns one, the adults put all kinds of things in front of him and see which he grabs first.

sentences.hanzi: 孩子的奶奶一早就开始准备，在她看来，这是一件重大的事。
sentences.pinyin: hai2 zi5 de5 nai3 nai5 yi1 zao3 jiu4 kai1 shi3 zhun3 bei4 zai4 ta1 kan4 lai5 zhe4 shi4 yi1 jian4 zhong4 da4 de5 shi4
sentences.english: The child's grandmother began getting ready early. To her, this is a matter of great importance.

sentences.hanzi: 她在地上放了一块红布，布上放了一个大盘子，里面有书、笔、钱、印，还有几样工具。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zai4 di4 shang5 fang4 le5 yi1 kuai4 hong2 bu4 bu4 shang4 fang4 le5 yi1 ge5 da4 pan2 zi5 li3 mian4 you3 shu1 bi3 qian2 yin4 hai2 you3 ji3 yang4 gong1 ju4
sentences.english: She laid a red cloth on the floor and on it a big tray holding a book, a pen, money, a seal and a few tools.

sentences.hanzi: 每样东西都有说法。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 yang4 dong1 xi5 dou1 you3 shuo1 fa5
sentences.english: Every object has a meaning.

sentences.hanzi: 抓书，以后爱学习；抓钱，以后有钱；抓印，以后有权力。
sentences.pinyin: zhua1 shu1 yi3 hou4 ai4 xue2 xi2 zhua1 qian2 yi3 hou4 you3 qian2 zhua1 yin4 yi3 hou4 you3 quan2 li4
sentences.english: Grab the book and he'll love learning; grab the money and he'll be rich; grab the seal and he'll have power.

sentences.hanzi: 我太太笑着放上一个手机：“现在是手机的时代，万一他以后当了经理呢？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 tai4 tai5 xiao4 zhe5 fang4 shang4 yi1 ge5 shou3 ji1 xian4 zai4 shi4 shou3 ji1 de5 shi2 dai4 wan4 yi1 ta1 yi3 hou4 dang1 le5 jing1 li3 ne5
sentences.english: My wife laughed and added a mobile phone. “This is the age of the phone. What if he grows up to be a manager?”

sentences.hanzi: 奶奶看了她一眼：“手机也有资格放上来？”可是也没有拿走。
sentences.pinyin: nai3 nai5 kan4 le5 ta1 yi1 yan3 shou3 ji1 ye3 you3 zi1 ge2 fang4 shang4 lai2 ke3 shi4 ye3 mei2 you3 na2 zou3
sentences.english: Grandmother glanced at her. “Does a phone even qualify?” But she didn't take it away.

sentences.hanzi: 我三十多年前也抓过周。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 san1 shi2 duo1 nian2 qian2 ye3 zhua1 guo5 zhou1
sentences.english: I had my own zhuazhou over thirty years ago.

sentences.hanzi: 奶奶总是说，那天我一把抓住了笔，全家人都很自豪。
sentences.pinyin: nai3 nai5 zong3 shi4 shuo1 na4 tian1 wo3 yi1 ba3 zhua1 zhu4 le5 bi3 quan2 jia1 ren2 dou1 hen3 zi4 hao2
sentences.english: Grandmother always says that I seized the pen that day, and the whole family was proud.

sentences.hanzi: 她希望我以后当科学家，起码是大学老师。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xi1 wang4 wo3 yi3 hou4 dang1 ke1 xue2 jia1 qi3 ma3 shi4 da4 xue2 lao3 shi1
sentences.english: She hoped I would become a scientist, or at least a university teacher.

sentences.hanzi: 可是后来证实，这只是她的幻想：我开了十五年卡车。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 hou4 lai2 zheng4 shi2 zhe4 zhi3 shi4 ta1 de5 huan4 xiang3 wo3 kai1 le5 shi2 wu3 nian2 ka3 che1
sentences.english: But it later proved to be only a dream: I have driven a truck for fifteen years.

sentences.hanzi: 不久，大人们都到了，都坐在椅子上，不说话了，只看着孩子。
sentences.pinyin: bu4 jiu3 da4 ren2 men5 dou1 dao4 le5 dou1 zuo4 zai4 yi3 zi5 shang4 bu4 shuo1 hua4 le5 zhi3 kan4 zhe5 hai2 zi5
sentences.english: Before long the adults had all arrived and sat on chairs, silent, watching the child.

sentences.hanzi: 石头看了看眼前的书，看了看手机，爬过钱，爬过印，一直爬到红布外面。
sentences.pinyin: shi2 tou5 kan4 le5 kan4 yan3 qian2 de5 shu1 kan4 le5 kan4 shou3 ji1 pa2 guo5 qian2 pa2 guo5 yin4 yi1 zhi2 pa2 dao4 hong2 bu4 wai4 mian4
sentences.english: Stone looked at the book in front of him, looked at the phone, crawled past the money, past the seal, and right off the red cloth.

sentences.hanzi: 他抓住了奶奶的手。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zhua1 zhu4 le5 nai3 nai5 de5 shou3
sentences.english: He grabbed his grandmother's hand.

sentences.hanzi: 大家都笑了。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 xiao4 le5
sentences.english: Everyone laughed.

sentences.hanzi: “这算什么？”我问，“抓奶奶，以后能干什么？”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 suan4 shen2 me5 wo3 wen4 zhua1 nai3 nai5 yi3 hou4 neng2 gan4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: “What does that count as?” I asked. “Grab Grandma, and what will he do for a living?”

sentences.hanzi: 奶奶也笑了，把孩子抱起来。
sentences.pinyin: nai3 nai5 ye3 xiao4 le5 ba3 hai2 zi5 bao4 qi3 lai5
sentences.english: Grandmother laughed too, and picked the child up.

sentences.hanzi: “你以为我不知道吗？一岁的孩子什么都不懂。”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 yi3 wei2 wo3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 ma5 yi1 sui4 de5 hai2 zi5 shen2 me5 dou1 bu4 dong3
sentences.english: “Do you think I don't know? A one-year-old understands nothing.”

sentences.hanzi: “抓周不是要看他以后成什么人。”
sentences.pinyin: zhua1 zhou1 bu4 shi4 yao4 kan4 ta1 yi3 hou4 cheng2 shen2 me5 ren2
sentences.english: “Zhuazhou isn't about seeing what he'll become.”

sentences.hanzi: “是让全家人都来，一起看着他，告诉他：这么多人希望你好。”
sentences.pinyin: shi4 rang4 quan2 jia1 ren2 dou1 lai2 yi1 qi3 kan4 zhe5 ta1 gao4 su5 ta1 zhe4 me5 duo1 ren2 xi1 wang4 ni3 hao3
sentences.english: “It's about getting the whole family together to watch him and tell him: so many people wish you well.”

sentences.hanzi: 我想起那支笔，不知道为什么，有点不好意思。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 qi3 na4 zhi1 bi3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 wei4 shen2 me5 you3 dian3 bu4 hao3 yi4 si5
sentences.english: I thought of that pen and, I don't know why, felt a little embarrassed.

sentences.hanzi: “妈，我抓了笔，后来开了卡车，你失望过吗？”
sentences.pinyin: ma1 wo3 zhua1 le5 bi3 hou4 lai2 kai1 le5 ka3 che1 ni3 shi1 wang4 guo5 ma5
sentences.english: “Mum, I grabbed the pen and ended up driving a truck. Were you ever disappointed?”

sentences.hanzi: 她看了我一眼。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 le5 wo3 yi1 yan3
sentences.english: She gave me a look.

sentences.hanzi: “你每次开车出去，都好好地回来了。”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 mei3 ci4 kai1 che1 chu1 qu4 dou1 hao3 hao3 de5 hui2 lai5 le5
sentences.english: “Every time you drive off, you come back safe.”

sentences.hanzi: “我要的就是这个。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 yao4 de5 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 ge5
sentences.english: “That's all I wanted.”

sentences.hanzi: 她低头对孩子说：“你看，奶奶也被你抓住了。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 di1 tou2 dui4 hai2 zi5 shuo1 ni3 kan4 nai3 nai5 ye3 bei4 ni3 zhua1 zhu4 le5
sentences.english: She bent her head and said to the child, “See? You've caught your grandma too.”

glossed.meaning: first-birthday custom: the baby picks an object

title: 看不见的日本
titlePinyin: kan4 bu4 jian4 de5 ri4 ben3

sentences.hanzi: 七四二年，两个日本和尚来到唐朝的扬州。
sentences.pinyin: qi1 si4 er4 nian2 liang3 ge4 ri4 ben3 he2 shang5 lai2 dao4 tang2 chao2 de5 yang2 zhou1
sentences.english: In 742, two Japanese monks came to Yangzhou in Tang China.

sentences.hanzi: 他们找到当地最有名的和尚鉴真，那时他已经五十多岁了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 zhao3 dao4 dang1 di4 zui4 you3 ming2 de5 he2 shang5 jian4 zhen1 na4 shi2 ta1 yi3 jing1 wu3 shi2 duo1 sui4 le5
sentences.english: They sought out the most famous monk in the area, Jianzhen, who was already in his fifties.

sentences.hanzi: “日本需要您这样的老师，”他们热情地说，“请您到我们那里去。”
sentences.pinyin: ri4 ben3 xu1 yao4 nin2 zhe4 yang4 de5 lao3 shi1 ta1 men5 re4 qing2 de5 shuo1 qing3 nin2 dao4 wo3 men5 na4 li5 qu4
sentences.english: “Japan needs a teacher like you,” they said warmly. “Please come to our country.”

sentences.hanzi: 鉴真问自己的学生：“谁愿意去？”
sentences.pinyin: jian4 zhen1 wen4 zi4 ji3 de5 xue2 sheng5 shei2 yuan4 yi4 qu4
sentences.english: Jianzhen asked his students, “Who is willing to go?”

sentences.hanzi: 没有人说话。
sentences.pinyin: mei2 you3 ren2 shuo1 hua4
sentences.english: No one spoke.

sentences.hanzi: 海太大，船太小，语言也不通，去了说不定就回不来了。
sentences.pinyin: hai3 tai4 da4 chuan2 tai4 xiao3 yu3 yan2 ye3 bu4 tong1 qu4 le5 shuo1 bu5 ding4 jiu4 hui2 bu4 lai2 le5
sentences.english: The sea was too big, the boats too small, and they did not speak the language. Whoever went might never come back.

sentences.hanzi: 鉴真说：“你们不去，我去。”
sentences.pinyin: jian4 zhen1 shuo1 ni3 men5 bu4 qu4 wo3 qu4
sentences.english: Jianzhen said, “If you won't go, I will.”

sentences.hanzi: 第一次，还没上船，就有人编了一个谎言去报官，他们没有走成。
sentences.pinyin: di4 yi1 ci4 hai2 mei2 shang4 chuan2 jiu4 you3 ren2 bian1 le5 yi1 ge5 huang3 yan2 qu4 bao4 guan1 ta1 men5 mei2 you3 zou3 cheng2
sentences.english: The first time, before they even boarded, someone made up a lie and went to the officials, and they never left.

sentences.hanzi: 第二次，船遇到大风，出了事故。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 ci4 chuan2 yu4 dao4 da4 feng1 chu1 le5 shi4 gu4
sentences.english: The second time, the boat met a great wind and was wrecked.

sentences.hanzi: 第三次，当地的官到处搜查，又把他们挡了回来。
sentences.pinyin: di4 san1 ci4 dang1 di4 de5 guan1 dao4 chu4 sou1 cha2 you4 ba3 ta1 men5 dang3 le5 hui2 lai5
sentences.english: The third time, the local officials searched everywhere and blocked them again.

sentences.hanzi: 第四次，是鉴真自己的学生去报了官。
sentences.pinyin: di4 si4 ci4 shi4 jian4 zhen1 zi4 ji3 de5 xue2 sheng5 qu4 bao4 le5 guan1
sentences.english: The fourth time, it was Jianzhen's own student who went to the officials.

sentences.hanzi: 学生不是要害他，只是不愿意看老师死在海上，就全力挡住他。
sentences.pinyin: xue2 sheng5 bu4 shi4 yao4 hai4 ta1 zhi3 shi4 bu4 yuan4 yi4 kan4 lao3 shi1 si3 zai4 hai3 shang4 jiu4 quan2 li4 dang3 zhu4 ta1
sentences.english: The student didn't mean him harm. He just couldn't bear to see his teacher die at sea, so he did all he could to stop him.

sentences.hanzi: 这样的事持续了好几年。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 de5 shi4 chi2 xu4 le5 hao3 ji3 nian2
sentences.english: Things went on like this for years.

sentences.hanzi: 第五次最可怕。
sentences.pinyin: di4 wu3 ci4 zui4 ke3 pa4
sentences.english: The fifth time was the worst.

sentences.hanzi: 大风把船吹了十几天，一直吹到当时中国最南边的岛上，离日本更远了。
sentences.pinyin: da4 feng1 ba3 chuan2 chui1 le5 shi2 ji3 tian1 yi1 zhi2 chui1 dao4 dang1 shi2 zhong1 guo2 zui4 nan2 bian1 de5 dao3 shang4 li2 ri4 ben3 geng4 yuan3 le5
sentences.english: A great wind blew the boat for more than ten days, all the way to the island at China's southern end in those days, further from Japan than ever.

sentences.hanzi: 他们一路走回来，请他的两位日本和尚，有一位病死了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 yi1 lu4 zou3 hui2 lai5 qing3 ta1 de5 liang3 wei4 ri4 ben3 he2 shang5 you3 yi1 wei4 bing4 si3 le5
sentences.english: On the long way back, one of the two Japanese monks who had invited him fell ill and died.

sentences.hanzi: 不久，鉴真的眼睛也瞎了。
sentences.pinyin: bu4 jiu3 jian4 zhen1 de5 yan3 jing5 ye3 xia1 le5
sentences.english: Soon after, Jianzhen went blind.

sentences.hanzi: 他已经六十多岁，什么都看不见，人人都说他该放手了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yi3 jing1 liu4 shi2 duo1 sui4 shen2 me5 dou1 kan4 bu4 jian4 ren2 ren2 dou1 shuo1 ta1 gai1 fang4 shou3 le5
sentences.english: He was past sixty and could see nothing. Everyone said it was time to let go.

sentences.hanzi: 可是大海没有打败他，七五三年，他又上了船。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 da4 hai3 mei2 you3 da3 bai4 ta1 qi1 wu3 san1 nian2 ta1 you4 shang4 le5 chuan2
sentences.english: But the sea had not defeated him. In 753 he boarded a ship again.

sentences.hanzi: 这一次，船穿过大风，一直前进。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 ci4 chuan2 chuan1 guo4 da4 feng1 yi1 zhi2 qian2 jin4
sentences.english: This time the ship passed through the winds and pressed on.

sentences.hanzi: 他到了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 dao4 le5
sentences.english: He arrived.

sentences.hanzi: 从答应去日本到这一天，一共十一年。
sentences.pinyin: cong2 da1 ying5 qu4 ri4 ben3 dao4 zhe4 yi1 tian1 yi1 gong4 shi2 yi1 nian2
sentences.english: From the day he agreed to go until this day, eleven years had passed.

sentences.hanzi: 他的到来，是日本的一件重大的事，全国很多和尚都来向他学习。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 dao4 lai2 shi4 ri4 ben3 de5 yi1 jian4 zhong4 da4 de5 shi4 quan2 guo2 hen3 duo1 he2 shang5 dou1 lai2 xiang4 ta1 xue2 xi2
sentences.english: His arrival was a major event in Japan, and many monks from across the country came to learn from him.

sentences.hanzi: 日本的老书上说，他看不见，只用鼻子闻，就能分出各种药的真假，一次也没有错。
sentences.pinyin: ri4 ben3 de5 lao3 shu1 shang4 shuo1 ta1 kan4 bu4 jian4 zhi3 yong4 bi2 zi5 wen2 jiu4 neng2 fen1 chu1 ge4 zhong3 yao4 de5 zhen1 jia3 yi1 ci4 ye3 mei2 you3 cuo4
sentences.english: An old Japanese record says that, though he could not see, he could tell genuine medicines from false ones by smell alone, without a single mistake.

sentences.hanzi: 后来，他和学生们在奈良盖了一座寺。
sentences.pinyin: hou4 lai2 ta1 he2 xue2 sheng5 men5 zai4 nai4 liang2 gai4 le5 yi1 zuo4 si4
sentences.english: Later he and his students built a temple in Nara.

sentences.hanzi: 一千二百多年过去了，那座寺今天还在。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 qian1 er4 bai3 duo1 nian2 guo4 qu4 le5 na4 zuo4 si4 jin1 tian1 hai2 zai4
sentences.english: More than twelve hundred years have passed, and that temple still stands today.

sentences.hanzi: 鉴真再也没有回到扬州。
sentences.pinyin: jian4 zhen1 zai4 ye3 mei2 you3 hui2 dao4 yang2 zhou1
sentences.english: Jianzhen never returned to Yangzhou.

sentences.hanzi: 去了六次，等了十一年，他闻得到日本的海，感受得到日本的阳光，却一眼也没有看见过它。
sentences.pinyin: qu4 le5 liu4 ci4 deng3 le5 shi2 yi1 nian2 ta1 wen2 de5 dao4 ri4 ben3 de5 hai3 gan3 shou4 de5 dao4 ri4 ben3 de5 yang2 guang1 que4 yi1 yan3 ye3 mei2 you3 kan4 jian4 guo5 ta1
sentences.english: Six attempts, eleven years. He could smell Japan's sea and feel its sunshine, but he never saw it, not even once.

sentences.hanzi: 只有看病、算命和种地的书可以保留。

sentences.english: Only books on medicine, fortune-telling and farming could be kept.

sentences.hanzi: 把书隐藏起来的人，要被送到北边去修长城。
sentences.pinyin: ba3 shu1 yin3 cang2 qi3 lai5 de5 ren2 yao4 bei4 song4 dao4 bei3 bian1 qu4 xiu1 chang2 cheng2
sentences.english: Anyone who hid books would be sent north to build the Great Wall.

sentences.hanzi: 从那天起，有书就是非法的，烧书的火持续了好久。
sentences.pinyin: cong2 na4 tian1 qi3 you3 shu1 jiu4 shi4 fei1 fa3 de5 shao1 shu1 de5 huo3 chi2 xu4 le5 hao3 jiu3
sentences.english: From that day on, owning books was illegal, and the book fires burned for a long time.

sentences.hanzi: 我是一个小官，我的工作是去各家搜查。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shi4 yi1 ge5 xiao3 guan1 wo3 de5 gong1 zuo4 shi4 qu4 ge4 jia1 sou1 cha2
sentences.english: I was a minor official, and my job was to search each household.

sentences.hanzi: 那天早晨，我要去的是镇上老师的家，他是我小时候的老师。
sentences.pinyin: na4 tian1 zao3 chen2 wo3 yao4 qu4 de5 shi4 zhen4 shang4 lao3 shi1 de5 jia1 ta1 shi4 wo3 xiao3 shi2 hou5 de5 lao3 shi1
sentences.english: That morning, the house I had to go to was that of the town's teacher, my teacher when I was a boy.

sentences.hanzi: 老师年龄已经很大了，七十岁了，一个人站在门前等我。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 shi1 nian2 ling2 yi3 jing1 hen3 da4 le5 qi1 shi2 sui4 le5 yi1 ge5 ren2 zhan4 zai4 men2 qian2 deng3 wo3
sentences.english: My teacher was very old by then, seventy, and he stood alone at his door waiting for me.

sentences.hanzi: 那时候的书是用竹片做的，很重。
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi2 hou5 de5 shu1 shi4 yong4 zhu2 pian4 zuo4 de5 hen3 zhong4
sentences.english: Books in those days were made of bamboo strips, and they were heavy.

sentences.hanzi: 我记得他家里有满满一屋子的书。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 ji4 de5 ta1 jia1 li3 you3 man3 man3 yi1 wu1 zi5 de5 shu1
sentences.english: I remembered a house with a whole room full of them.

sentences.hanzi: 可是今天，桌子上只放着几卷看病的书。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 jin1 tian1 zhuo1 zi5 shang4 zhi3 fang4 zhe5 ji3 juan3 kan4 bing4 de5 shu1
sentences.english: But today there were only a few rolls of medical books on the table.

sentences.hanzi: “都在这里了。”老师说。
sentences.pinyin: dou1 zai4 zhe4 li3 le5 lao3 shi1 shuo1
sentences.english: “That's all of them,” my teacher said.

sentences.hanzi: 我看了看屋子，又看了看他的手。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 kan4 le5 kan4 wu1 zi5 you4 kan4 le5 kan4 ta1 de5 shou3
sentences.english: I looked around the room, then at his hands.

sentences.hanzi: 他手上有新的伤口。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shou3 shang4 you3 xin1 de5 shang1 kou3
sentences.english: There were fresh cuts on them.

sentences.hanzi: 我再看那面墙，是新建的，墙上还有手的痕迹，地上还有几块石头。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zai4 kan4 na4 mian4 qiang2 shi4 xin1 jian4 de5 qiang2 shang4 hai2 you3 shou3 de5 hen2 ji4 di4 shang5 hai2 you3 ji3 kuai4 shi2 tou5
sentences.english: I looked again at the wall. It was newly built, with handprints on it, and a few stones still lay on the ground.

sentences.hanzi: 一个七十岁的老人，为什么要自己盖墙？
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 qi1 shi2 sui4 de5 lao3 ren2 wei4 shen2 me5 yao4 zi4 ji3 gai4 qiang2
sentences.english: Why would a man of seventy build a wall by himself?

sentences.hanzi: 我一下子明白了。这些书是他的命，他放不了手，要留给将来的人。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 yi1 xia4 zi5 ming2 bai5 le5 zhe4 xie1 shu1 shi4 ta1 de5 ming4 ta1 fang4 bu4 liao3 shou3 yao4 liu2 gei3 jiang1 lai2 de5 ren2
sentences.english: All at once I understood. These books were his life, and he couldn't let go of them. He meant to leave them for the future.

sentences.hanzi: 我知道后果：他会死在修长城的路上，万一有人知道我替他隐瞒，我也活不了。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zhi1 dao4 hou4 guo3 ta1 hui4 si3 zai4 xiu1 chang2 cheng2 de5 lu4 shang5 wan4 yi1 you3 ren2 zhi1 dao4 wo3 ti4 ta1 yin3 man2 wo3 ye3 huo2 bu4 liao3
sentences.english: I knew the consequences: he would die on the road to the Wall, and if anyone found out I had covered for him, I wouldn't survive either.

sentences.hanzi: 和我一起来的人问：“有没有问题？”
sentences.pinyin: he2 wo3 yi1 qi3 lai2 de5 ren2 wen4 you3 mei2 you3 wen4 ti2
sentences.english: The man who had come with me asked, “Any problems?”

sentences.hanzi: 老师抬头看着我，什么也没说。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 shi1 tai2 tou2 kan4 zhe5 wo3 shen2 me5 ye3 mei2 shuo1
sentences.english: My teacher raised his head and looked at me, saying nothing.

sentences.hanzi: 小时候，他教我写的第一句话，就是“做人要诚实”。我从来没有欺骗过任何人。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 shi2 hou5 ta1 jiao1 wo3 xie3 de5 di4 yi1 ju4 hua4 jiu4 shi4 zuo4 ren2 yao4 cheng2 shi2 wo3 cong2 lai2 mei2 you3 qi1 pian4 guo5 ren4 he2 ren2
sentences.english: When I was small, the first sentence he taught me to write was “Be an honest person.” I had never deceived anyone.

sentences.hanzi: “没有问题，”我说，“只有这几卷书。”
sentences.pinyin: mei2 you3 wen4 ti2 wo3 shuo1 zhi3 you3 zhe4 ji3 juan3 shu1
sentences.english: “No problems,” I said. “Only these few books.”

sentences.hanzi: 那是我这一生第一个谎言。
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi4 wo3 zhe4 yi1 sheng1 di4 yi1 ge4 huang3 yan2
sentences.english: That was the first lie of my life.

sentences.hanzi: 走的时候，老师在门前轻轻说了一句：“你这个学生，没有学好。”
sentences.pinyin: zou3 de5 shi2 hou5 lao3 shi1 zai4 men2 qian2 qing1 qing1 shuo1 le5 yi1 ju4 ni3 zhe4 ge5 xue2 sheng5 mei2 you3 xue2 hao3
sentences.english: As I left, my teacher said softly at the door, “You are a student who didn't learn well.”

sentences.hanzi: 可是他在笑。我一路走回去，不敢回头。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ta1 zai4 xiao4 wo3 yi1 lu4 zou3 hui2 qu5 bu4 gan3 hui2 tou2
sentences.english: But he was smiling. I walked all the way back and didn't dare look round.

sentences.hanzi: 不久，皇帝死了，秦朝也被打败了。
sentences.pinyin: bu4 jiu3 huang2 di4 si3 le5 qin2 chao2 ye3 bei4 da3 bai4 le5
sentences.english: Before long the emperor died, and the Qin was defeated.

sentences.hanzi: 二十多年以后，新的皇帝取消了这个命令。
sentences.pinyin: er4 shi2 duo1 nian2 yi3 hou4 xin1 de5 huang2 di4 qu3 xiao1 le5 zhe4 ge5 ming4 ling4
sentences.english: More than twenty years later, a new emperor cancelled the order.

sentences.hanzi: 老师早就不在了。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 shi1 zao3 jiu4 bu4 zai4 le5
sentences.english: My teacher had died long before.

sentences.hanzi: 我已经老了，和他的儿子一起，把那面墙砸开，阳光一下子进去了。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 yi3 jing1 lao3 le5 he2 ta1 de5 er2 zi5 yi1 qi3 ba3 na4 mian4 qiang2 za2 kai1 yang2 guang1 yi1 xia4 zi5 jin4 qu4 le5
sentences.english: Old by now, I broke open that wall with his son, and sunlight rushed in.

sentences.hanzi: 这些书在墙里埋了二十多年，一卷也没有少。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 shu1 zai4 qiang2 li3 mai2 le5 er4 shi2 duo1 nian2 yi1 juan3 ye3 mei2 you3 shao3
sentences.english: Those books had been buried in the wall for over twenty years, and not one roll was missing.

sentences.hanzi: 最上面放着一片竹片，是老师的字。
sentences.pinyin: zui4 shang4 mian4 fang4 zhe5 yi1 pian4 zhu2 pian4 shi4 lao3 shi1 de5 zi4
sentences.english: On top lay a single bamboo strip in my teacher's handwriting.

sentences.hanzi: 上面只有五个字：“你学得很好。”
sentences.pinyin: shang4 mian4 zhi3 you3 wu3 ge4 zi4 ni3 xue2 de5 hen3 hao3
sentences.english: It held just five characters: “You learned well.”

sentences.hanzi: 去年春天阳光很好，我开车到广东旅游，穿过开平市的时候，以为自己走错了路。
