sentences.pinyin: qu4 nian2 chun1 tian1 yang2 guang1 hen3 hao3 wo3 kai1 che1 dao4 guang3 dong1 lu:3 you2 chuan1 guo4 kai1 ping2 shi4 de5 shi2 hou5 yi3 wei2 zi4 ji3 zou3 cuo4 le5 lu4
sentences.english: Last spring, in lovely sunshine, I drove around Guangdong, and passing through the city of Kaiping I thought I had taken a wrong turn.

sentences.hanzi: 这里只是一些小村子，房子都很低。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 li3 zhi3 shi4 yi1 xie1 xiao3 cun1 zi5 fang2 zi5 dou1 hen3 di1
sentences.english: There were only small villages here, with low houses.

sentences.hanzi: 可是地里突然站起来一栋高楼。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 di4 li3 tu1 ran2 zhan4 qi3 lai5 yi1 dong4 gao1 lou2
sentences.english: But suddenly a tall tower rose out of the fields.

sentences.hanzi: 楼有五六层，墙又高又直，顶上却像美国的老房子。
sentences.pinyin: lou2 you3 wu3 liu4 ceng2 qiang2 you4 gao1 you4 zhi2 ding3 shang4 que4 xiang4 mei3 guo2 de5 lao3 fang2 zi5
sentences.english: It had five or six floors and high, straight walls, yet the top looked like an old American building.

sentences.hanzi: 一个小村子里，为什么有这样的楼？
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 xiao3 cun1 zi5 li3 wei4 shen2 me5 you3 zhe4 yang4 de5 lou2
sentences.english: Why was there a building like that in a small village?

sentences.hanzi: 而且不是一栋。往前开，又是一栋；再往前，是十几栋。
sentences.pinyin: er2 qie3 bu4 shi4 yi1 dong4 wang3 qian2 kai1 you4 shi4 yi1 dong4 zai4 wang3 qian2 shi4 shi2 ji3 dong4
sentences.english: And it wasn't just one. Further on there was another, and further still, a dozen more.

sentences.hanzi: 当地人叫它碉楼，开平现在还有一千八百多栋，全国没有别的地方有这么多。
sentences.pinyin: dang1 di4 ren2 jiao4 ta1 diao1 lou2 kai1 ping2 xian4 zai4 hai2 you3 yi1 qian1 ba1 bai3 duo1 dong4 quan2 guo2 mei2 you3 bie2 de5 di4 fang5 you3 zhe4 me5 duo1
sentences.english: The locals call them diaolou. Kaiping still has more than eighteen hundred, more than anywhere else in the country.

sentences.hanzi: 一位老人看我站着不走，就招呼我过去。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 wei4 lao3 ren2 kan4 wo3 zhan4 zhe5 bu4 zou3 jiu4 zhao1 hu5 wo3 guo4 qu4
sentences.english: An old man saw me standing there and called me over.

sentences.hanzi: “这是我奶奶的父亲建的，”他自豪地说，“上来看看吧。”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 wo3 nai3 nai5 de5 fu4 qin1 jian4 de5 ta1 zi4 hao2 de5 shuo1 shang4 lai2 kan4 kan5 ba5
sentences.english: “My grandmother's father built this one,” he said proudly. “Come up and take a look.”

sentences.hanzi: 楼里的窗户很小，门很重。
sentences.pinyin: lou2 li3 de5 chuang1 hu5 hen3 xiao3 men2 hen3 zhong4
sentences.english: Inside, the windows were small and the doors heavy.

sentences.hanzi: 老人告诉我，一百多年前，人们在这里很难生存。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ren2 gao4 su5 wo3 yi1 bai3 duo1 nian2 qian2 ren2 men5 zai4 zhe4 li3 hen3 nan2 sheng1 cun2
sentences.english: The old man told me that over a hundred years ago, it was very hard to survive here.

sentences.hanzi: 很多男人坐船去了美国，挖金子，修路，运石头，一干就是几十年。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 nan2 ren2 zuo4 chuan2 qu4 le5 mei3 guo2 wa1 jin1 zi5 xiu1 lu4 yun4 shi2 tou5 yi1 gan4 jiu4 shi4 ji3 shi2 nian2
sentences.english: Many men took ships to America, digging for gold, building roads and hauling stone for decades.

sentences.hanzi: 他们省下每一块钱，寄回家，期望将来能回来。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 sheng3 xia4 mei3 yi1 kuai4 qian2 ji4 hui2 jia1 qi1 wang4 jiang1 lai2 neng2 hui2 lai5
sentences.english: They saved every dollar and sent it home, hoping to return some day.

sentences.hanzi: 有钱的人家开始盖房子。不久，麻烦也来了，因为有钱这件事没法隐藏。
sentences.pinyin: you3 qian2 de5 ren2 jia5 kai1 shi3 gai4 fang2 zi5 bu4 jiu3 ma2 fan5 ye3 lai2 le5 yin1 wei4 you3 qian2 zhe4 jian4 shi4 mei2 fa3 yin3 cang2
sentences.english: Families with money began building houses. Before long trouble came too, because there's no way to hide having money.

sentences.hanzi: 那时候路上很不太平，抢劫的人越来越多。
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi2 hou5 lu4 shang5 hen3 bu4 tai4 ping2 qiang3 jie2 de5 ren2 yue4 lai2 yue4 duo1
sentences.english: The roads were unsafe in those days, and there were more and more robbers.

sentences.hanzi: 他们知道哪家有人在美国，半夜就进村来抢。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 zhi1 dao4 na3 jia1 you3 ren2 zai4 mei3 guo2 ban4 ye4 jiu4 jin4 cun1 lai2 qiang3
sentences.english: They knew which families had someone in America, and came into the villages at night to rob them.

sentences.hanzi: 于是大家拿出在美国赚的钱，盖了这种楼。盖一栋很贵，可是大家都愿意。
sentences.pinyin: yu2 shi4 da4 jia1 na2 chu1 zai4 mei3 guo2 zhuan4 de5 qian2 gai4 le5 zhe4 zhong3 lou2 gai4 yi1 dong4 hen3 gui4 ke3 shi4 da4 jia1 dou1 yuan4 yi4
sentences.english: So people took the money they had earned in America and built these towers. They cost a lot, but everyone was willing.

sentences.hanzi: 抢劫的人一来，全村的人都跑进楼里，把他们挡在外面。
sentences.pinyin: qiang3 jie2 de5 ren2 yi1 lai2 quan2 cun1 de5 ren2 dou1 pao3 jin4 lou2 li3 ba3 ta1 men5 dang3 zai4 wai4 mian4
sentences.english: When robbers came, the whole village ran inside and shut them out.

sentences.hanzi: 他们在美国见过各种房子，回来就照着样子盖。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 zai4 mei3 guo2 jian4 guo5 ge4 zhong3 fang2 zi5 hui2 lai5 jiu4 zhao4 zhe5 yang4 zi5 gai4
sentences.english: They had seen all sorts of buildings in America, and they copied them back home.

sentences.hanzi: 所以这些楼又古怪又迷人：一半是美国，一半是中国。
sentences.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 xie1 lou2 you4 gu3 guai4 you4 mi2 ren2 yi1 ban4 shi4 mei3 guo2 yi1 ban4 shi4 zhong1 guo2
sentences.english: That is why these towers are so strange and so charming: half America, half China.

sentences.hanzi: 到了楼顶，老人打开一个盒子，里面保留着一些旧信。
sentences.pinyin: dao4 le5 lou2 ding3 lao3 ren2 da3 kai1 yi1 ge5 he2 zi5 li3 mian4 bao3 liu2 zhe5 yi1 xie1 jiu4 xin4
sentences.english: On the roof, the old man opened a box in which he had kept some old letters.

sentences.hanzi: “他在美国写信回来，总是问：楼建好了吗？家里人都住进去了吗？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zai4 mei3 guo2 xie3 xin4 hui2 lai5 zong3 shi4 wen4 lou2 jian4 hao3 le5 ma5 jia1 li3 ren2 dou1 zhu4 jin4 qu4 le5 ma5
sentences.english: “He wrote from America, always asking: Is the tower built? Has the family moved in?”

sentences.hanzi: “楼建好了，他说再干几年就回来。”
sentences.pinyin: lou2 jian4 hao3 le5 ta1 shuo1 zai4 gan4 ji3 nian2 jiu4 hui2 lai5
sentences.english: “When it was built, he said he'd work a few more years and then come home.”

sentences.hanzi: “可是他又干了十五年，死在了那边。”
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ta1 you4 gan4 le5 shi2 wu3 nian2 si3 zai4 le5 na4 bian5
sentences.english: “But he worked another fifteen years and died over there.”

sentences.hanzi: “这栋楼，他一天也没有住过。”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 dong4 lou2 ta1 yi1 tian1 ye3 mei2 you3 zhu4 guo5
sentences.english: “He never spent a single day in this tower.”

sentences.hanzi: 我从楼顶往外看，一栋一栋的碉楼站在地里。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 cong2 lou2 ding3 wang3 wai4 kan4 yi1 dong4 yi1 dong4 de5 diao1 lou2 zhan4 zai4 di4 li3
sentences.english: I looked out from the roof at tower after tower standing in the fields.

sentences.hanzi: 它们很像一群站得高高的人，在等家里人从海上回来。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 hen3 xiang4 yi1 qun2 zhan4 de5 gao1 gao1 de5 ren2 zai4 deng3 jia1 li3 ren2 cong2 hai3 shang4 hui2 lai5
sentences.english: They looked like a crowd of people standing tall, waiting for their families to come home across the sea.

glossed.meaning: Guangdong, a province in southern China

sentences.hanzi: 这个城市有一个记忆市场。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 cheng2 shi4 you3 yi1 ge5 ji4 yi4 shi4 chang3
sentences.english: This city has a memory market.

sentences.hanzi: 痛苦的记忆可以卖掉，幸福的记忆可以买来。
sentences.pinyin: tong4 ku3 de5 ji4 yi4 ke3 yi3 mai4 diao4 xing4 fu2 de5 ji4 yi4 ke3 yi3 mai3 lai2
sentences.english: Painful memories can be sold; happy memories can be bought.

sentences.hanzi: 我三十五岁，从来没有进去过。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 san1 shi2 wu3 sui4 cong2 lai2 mei2 you3 jin4 qu4 guo5
sentences.english: I was thirty-five and had never set foot in it.

sentences.hanzi: 我七岁那年出了事故，醒来以后，以前的事全忘了。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 qi1 sui4 na4 nian2 chu1 le5 shi4 gu4 xing3 lai2 yi3 hou4 yi3 qian2 de5 shi4 quan2 wang4 le5
sentences.english: When I was seven I had an accident, and when I woke up I had forgotten everything before it.

sentences.hanzi: 奶奶把我养大。我问爸爸去了哪里，她只说：“他走了。”
sentences.pinyin: nai3 nai5 ba3 wo3 yang3 da4 wo3 wen4 ba4 ba5 qu4 le5 na3 li3 ta1 zhi3 shuo1 ta1 zou3 le5
sentences.english: My grandmother raised me. When I asked where my father had gone, she only said, “He left.”

sentences.hanzi: 去年奶奶去世了。我突然很渴望知道，有爸爸是什么感觉。
sentences.pinyin: qu4 nian2 nai3 nai5 qu4 shi4 le5 wo3 tu1 ran2 hen3 ke3 wang4 zhi1 dao4 you3 ba4 ba5 shi4 shen2 me5 gan3 jue2
sentences.english: Last year she died, and suddenly I longed to know what it felt like to have a father.

sentences.hanzi: 于是我走进市场，买了一段记忆。
sentences.pinyin: yu2 shi4 wo3 zou3 jin4 shi4 chang3 mai3 le5 yi1 duan4 ji4 yi4
sentences.english: So I walked into the market and bought a memory.

sentences.hanzi: “这一段是二十八年前存进来的，”店里的人说，“很贵，一直没有人买。”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 duan4 shi4 er4 shi2 ba1 nian2 qian2 cun2 jin4 lai2 de5 dian4 li3 de5 ren2 shuo1 hen3 gui4 yi1 zhi2 mei2 you3 ren2 mai3
sentences.english: “This one was stored twenty-eight years ago,” said the man in the shop. “It's expensive. No one has ever bought it.”

sentences.hanzi: 那天的阳光很好。
sentences.pinyin: na4 tian1 de5 yang2 guang1 hen3 hao3
sentences.english: The sunshine was lovely that day.

sentences.hanzi: 我在学骑车，一个男人在后面拉着车，说：“别怕，爸爸在后面。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zai4 xue2 qi2 che1 yi1 ge5 nan2 ren2 zai4 hou4 mian5 la1 zhe5 che1 shuo1 bie2 pa4 ba4 ba5 zai4 hou4 mian5
sentences.english: I was learning to ride a bike. A man held on behind me and said, “Don't be afraid. Daddy's right behind you.”

sentences.hanzi: 我骑了很远，回头一看，他早就放手了，站在门口对我笑。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 qi2 le5 hen3 yuan3 hui2 tou2 yi1 kan4 ta1 zao3 jiu4 fang4 shou3 le5 zhan4 zai4 men2 kou3 dui4 wo3 xiao4
sentences.english: I rode a long way, looked back, and saw he had let go long ago and was standing by the door, smiling at me.

sentences.hanzi: 我知道这是别人的记忆，只是一场幻想，可是每天晚上，我都要回去看一次。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 shi4 bie2 ren5 de5 ji4 yi4 zhi3 shi4 yi1 chang3 huan4 xiang3 ke3 shi4 mei3 tian1 wan3 shang5 wo3 dou1 yao4 hui2 qu5 kan4 yi1 ci4
sentences.english: I knew it was someone else's memory, only a fantasy, but every night I went back to see it.

sentences.hanzi: 一个月以后，我整理奶奶的东西，在楼下看到一辆红色的小车子。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 yue4 yi3 hou4 wo3 zheng3 li3 nai3 nai5 de5 dong1 xi5 zai4 lou2 xia4 kan4 dao4 yi1 liang4 hong2 se4 de5 xiao3 che1 zi5
sentences.english: A month later, sorting through my grandmother's things, I found a little red bike downstairs.

sentences.hanzi: 毫无疑问，它和记忆里的那辆车是同一辆。
sentences.pinyin: hao2 wu2 yi2 wen4 ta1 he2 ji4 yi4 li3 de5 na4 liang4 che1 shi4 tong2 yi1 liang4
sentences.english: There was no doubt about it: this was the same bike as the one in the memory.

sentences.hanzi: 过了二十八年，它依然是红色的。
sentences.pinyin: guo4 le5 er4 shi2 ba1 nian2 ta1 yi1 ran2 shi4 hong2 se4 de5
sentences.english: After twenty-eight years, it was still red.

sentences.hanzi: 我回到市场，查出了卖记忆的人的名字。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 hui2 dao4 shi4 chang3 cha2 chu1 le5 mai4 ji4 yi4 de5 ren2 de5 ming2 zi5
sentences.english: I went back to the market and found out the name of the person who had sold it.

sentences.hanzi: 那是我爸爸的名字。奶奶对我隐瞒了二十八年。
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi4 wo3 ba4 ba5 de5 ming2 zi5 nai3 nai5 dui4 wo3 yin3 man2 le5 er4 shi2 ba1 nian2
sentences.english: It was my father's name. My grandmother had hidden it from me for twenty-eight years.

sentences.hanzi: 他还活着，住在城西的一家小医院。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 hai2 huo2 zhe5 zhu4 zai4 cheng2 xi1 de5 yi1 jia1 xiao3 yi1 yuan4
sentences.english: He was still alive, living in a small hospital in the west of the city.

sentences.hanzi: 我找到他的时候，他一个人坐在门口的阳光里。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zhao3 dao4 ta1 de5 shi2 hou5 ta1 yi1 ge5 ren2 zuo4 zai4 men2 kou3 de5 yang2 guang1 li3
sentences.english: When I found him, he was sitting alone in the sunshine by the door.

sentences.hanzi: “您好。”我说。
sentences.pinyin: nin2 hao3 wo3 shuo1
sentences.english: “Hello,” I said.

sentences.hanzi: 他抬起头，眼神很平静，像看一个陌生人：“你是新来的医生吗？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 tai2 qi3 tou2 yan3 shen2 hen3 ping2 jing4 xiang4 kan4 yi1 ge5 mo4 sheng1 ren2 ni3 shi4 xin1 lai2 de5 yi1 sheng1 ma5
sentences.english: He looked up with a calm gaze, as one looks at a stranger. “Are you the new doctor?”

sentences.hanzi: 他没有认出我。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 mei2 you3 ren4 chu1 wo3
sentences.english: He didn't recognise me.

sentences.hanzi: 一位护士把我拉到一边。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 wei4 hu4 shi5 ba3 wo3 la1 dao4 yi1 bian1
sentences.english: A nurse drew me aside.

sentences.hanzi: “二十八年前，他的孩子出了重大事故，看病要很多钱。他卖了房子，还不够，别无选择，就来卖记忆。”
sentences.pinyin: er4 shi2 ba1 nian2 qian2 ta1 de5 hai2 zi5 chu1 le5 zhong4 da4 shi4 gu4 kan4 bing4 yao4 hen3 duo1 qian2 ta1 mai4 le5 fang2 zi5 hai2 bu4 gou4 bie2 wu2 xuan3 ze2 jiu4 lai2 mai4 ji4 yi4
sentences.english: “Twenty-eight years ago his child had a serious accident, and the treatment cost a great deal of money. He sold his house and it still wasn't enough. With no other choice, he came to sell memories.”

sentences.hanzi: “有孩子的记忆最贵。他把跟孩子有关的，全都卖了。”
sentences.pinyin: you3 hai2 zi5 de5 ji4 yi4 zui4 gui4 ta1 ba3 gen1 hai2 zi5 you3 guan1 de5 quan2 dou1 mai4 le5
sentences.english: “Memories with a child in them are worth the most. He sold everything to do with his child.”

sentences.hanzi: “病看好了，可是他再也不记得自己有过孩子。”
sentences.pinyin: bing4 kan4 hao3 le5 ke3 shi4 ta1 zai4 ye3 bu4 ji4 de5 zi4 ji3 you3 guo5 hai2 zi5
sentences.english: “The illness was cured, but he no longer remembers that he ever had a child.”

sentences.hanzi: 我在他旁边坐下。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zai4 ta1 pang2 bian1 zuo4 xia5
sentences.english: I sat down beside him.

sentences.hanzi: “我给您讲一个故事，好吗？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 gei3 nin2 jiang3 yi1 ge5 gu4 shi5 hao3 ma5
sentences.english: “May I tell you a story?”

sentences.hanzi: 我讲了那天的阳光，那辆红色的车，那个放了手的男人。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 jiang3 le5 na4 tian1 de5 yang2 guang1 na4 liang4 hong2 se4 de5 che1 na4 ge5 fang4 le5 shou3 de5 nan2 ren2
sentences.english: I told him about the sunshine that day, the red bike, the man who let go.

sentences.hanzi: 他听得很认真。听完，他微笑了，就是记忆里的那个微笑。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 ting1 de5 hen3 ren4 zhen1 ting1 wan2 ta1 wei1 xiao4 le5 jiu4 shi4 ji4 yi4 li3 de5 na4 ge5 wei1 xiao4
sentences.english: He listened very closely. When I finished he smiled. It was the smile from the memory.

sentences.hanzi: “这个孩子的爸爸，”他说，“一定很爱他吧。”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 hai2 zi5 de5 ba4 ba5 ta1 shuo1 yi1 ding4 hen3 ai4 ta1 ba5
sentences.english: “That child's father,” he said, “must have loved him very much.”

sentences.hanzi: “是的。”我说。
sentences.pinyin: shi4 de5 wo3 shuo1
sentences.english: “Yes,” I said.

sentences.hanzi: 一五一九年，五条船离开西班牙，一直向西前进。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 wu3 yi1 jiu3 nian2 wu3 tiao2 chuan2 li2 kai1 xi1 ban1 ya2 yi1 zhi2 xiang4 xi1 qian2 jin4
sentences.english: In 1519, five ships left Spain and pressed on westward.

sentences.hanzi: 带队的人叫麦哲伦，他想证实一件事：向西走，也能到东方。
sentences.pinyin: dai4 dui4 de5 ren2 jiao4 mai4 zhe2 lun2 ta1 xiang3 zheng4 shi2 yi1 jian4 shi4 xiang4 xi1 zou3 ye3 neng2 dao4 dong1 fang1
sentences.english: Their leader was Magellan, who wanted to prove one thing: you can reach the East by going west.

sentences.hanzi: 风险很大，可是船上还是聚了二百多人，其中有一个意大利年轻人，名叫皮加费塔。
sentences.pinyin: feng1 xian3 hen3 da4 ke3 shi4 chuan2 shang4 hai2 shi5 ju4 le5 er4 bai3 duo1 ren2 qi2 zhong1 you3 yi1 ge5 yi4 da4 li4 nian2 qing1 ren2 ming2 jiao4 pi2 jia1 fei4 ta3
sentences.english: The risk was great, but over two hundred men gathered on the ships, among them a young Italian named Pigafetta.

sentences.hanzi: 他上船的动机很简单：好奇。他专门做一件事：写日记。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shang4 chuan2 de5 dong4 ji1 hen3 jian3 dan1 hao4 qi2 ta1 zhuan1 men2 zuo4 yi1 jian4 shi4 xie3 ri4 ji4
sentences.english: His motive for coming aboard was simple: curiosity. He devoted himself to one thing: keeping a diary.

sentences.hanzi: 每天，他都把风、星星、食物、陌生人的样子具体地写下来，一页也不少。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 tian1 ta1 dou1 ba3 feng1 xing1 xing5 shi2 wu4 mo4 sheng1 ren2 de5 yang4 zi5 ju4 ti3 de5 xie3 xia4 lai5 yi1 ye4 ye3 bu4 shao3
sentences.english: Every day he wrote down the wind, the stars, the food and the faces of strangers in detail, without missing a page.

sentences.hanzi: 他们在南美搜索了好几个月，才找到路穿过去，进入了一片大海。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 zai4 nan2 mei3 sou1 suo3 le5 hao3 ji3 ge4 yue4 cai2 zhao3 dao4 lu4 chuan1 guo4 qu4 jin4 ru4 le5 yi1 pian4 da4 hai3
sentences.english: They searched along South America for months before they found a way through and entered a vast ocean.

sentences.hanzi: 这片海很平静，麦哲伦叫它太平洋。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 pian4 hai3 hen3 ping2 jing4 mai4 zhe2 lun2 jiao4 ta1 tai4 ping2 yang2
sentences.english: The sea was calm, and Magellan named it the Pacific.

sentences.hanzi: 然而，太平洋比所有人想的都大。
sentences.pinyin: ran2 er2 tai4 ping2 yang2 bi3 suo3 you3 ren2 xiang3 de5 dou1 da4
sentences.english: However, the Pacific was bigger than anyone had imagined.

sentences.hanzi: 三个多月，他们吃不到新鲜的东西，水也臭了。
sentences.pinyin: san1 ge4 duo1 yue4 ta1 men5 chi1 bu4 dao4 xin1 xian1 de5 dong1 xi5 shui3 ye3 chou4 le5
sentences.english: For over three months they had nothing fresh to eat, and the water went bad.

sentences.hanzi: 人们饿得吃船上的皮，大量的人生病，死者一天比一天多。
sentences.pinyin: ren2 men5 e4 de5 chi1 chuan2 shang4 de5 pi2 da4 liang4 de5 ren2 sheng1 bing4 si3 zhe3 yi1 tian1 bi3 yi1 tian1 duo1
sentences.english: Starving men ate the leather on the ship. Great numbers fell ill, and the dead grew day by day.

sentences.hanzi: 皮加费塔依然每天写。
sentences.pinyin: pi2 jia1 fei4 ta3 yi1 ran2 mei3 tian1 xie3
sentences.english: Pigafetta still wrote every day.

sentences.hanzi: 一五二一年，他们到了菲律宾。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 wu3 er4 yi1 nian2 ta1 men5 dao4 le5 fei1 lu:4 bin1
sentences.english: In 1521 they reached the Philippines.

sentences.hanzi: 麦哲伦和当地人发生战斗，死在了那里。
sentences.pinyin: mai4 zhe2 lun2 he2 dang1 di4 ren2 fa1 sheng1 zhan4 dou4 si3 zai4 le5 na4 li5
sentences.english: Magellan died there in a battle with local people.

sentences.hanzi: 剩下的人没有回头，还是一路向西。
sentences.pinyin: sheng4 xia4 de5 ren2 mei2 you3 hui2 tou2 hai2 shi5 yi1 lu4 xiang4 xi1
sentences.english: The rest did not turn back but carried on west.

sentences.hanzi: 船一条一条地没有了。
sentences.pinyin: chuan2 yi1 tiao2 yi1 tiao2 de5 mei2 you3 le5
sentences.english: One by one the ships were lost.

sentences.hanzi: 一五二二年，快要到家的时候，只剩下一条船了。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 wu3 er4 er4 nian2 kuai4 yao4 dao4 jia1 de5 shi2 hou5 zhi3 sheng4 xia4 yi1 tiao2 chuan2 le5
sentences.english: In 1522, when they were nearly home, only one ship was left.

sentences.hanzi: 船上没有吃的了，他们立即停在一个岛上。
sentences.pinyin: chuan2 shang4 mei2 you3 chi1 de5 le5 ta1 men5 li4 ji2 ting2 zai4 yi1 ge5 dao3 shang4
sentences.english: There was no food left on board, so they stopped at once at an island.

sentences.hanzi: 皮加费塔的日记上写的是星期三。
sentences.pinyin: pi2 jia1 fei4 ta3 de5 ri4 ji4 shang4 xie3 de5 shi4 xing1 qi1 san1
sentences.english: Pigafetta's diary said it was Wednesday.

sentences.hanzi: 可是岛上的人说：“今天是星期四。”
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 dao3 shang4 de5 ren2 shuo1 jin1 tian1 shi4 xing1 qi1 si4
sentences.english: But the people on the island said, “Today is Thursday.”

sentences.hanzi: 他吓了一跳，把日记查了一遍又一遍。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xia4 le5 yi1 tiao4 ba3 ri4 ji4 cha2 le5 yi1 bian4 you4 yi1 bian4
sentences.english: He was shocked, and checked his diary again and again.

sentences.hanzi: 三年了，他每天都写，一天也没有少。
sentences.pinyin: san1 nian2 le5 ta1 mei3 tian1 dou1 xie3 yi1 tian1 ye3 mei2 you3 shao3
sentences.english: For three years he had written every day and not missed one.

sentences.hanzi: 大家的判断都一样：今天是星期三。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 de5 pan4 duan4 dou1 yi1 yang4 jin1 tian1 shi4 xing1 qi1 san1
sentences.english: Everyone came to the same judgement: today was Wednesday.

sentences.hanzi: 一天去哪里了？它是何时丢的？
sentences.pinyin: yi1 tian1 qu4 na3 li3 le5 ta1 shi4 he2 shi2 diu1 de5
sentences.english: Where had the day gone? When had it been lost?

sentences.hanzi: 那年九月，船回到西班牙，船上生存下来的只有十八个人。
sentences.pinyin: na4 nian2 jiu3 yue4 chuan2 hui2 dao4 xi1 ban1 ya2 chuan2 shang4 sheng1 cun2 xia4 lai5 de5 zhi3 you3 shi2 ba1 ge4 ren2
sentences.english: That September the ship returned to Spain with just eighteen survivors on board.

sentences.hanzi: 这是人类史上第一次绕地球走了一圈。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 ren2 lei4 shi3 shang4 di4 yi1 ci4 rao4 di4 qiu2 zou3 le5 yi1 quan1
sentences.english: It was the first time in human history that anyone had gone all the way around the Earth.

sentences.hanzi: 后来人们才明白：他们一直向西走，一直追着太阳，每一天都比家里的人长一点点。
sentences.pinyin: hou4 lai2 ren2 men5 cai2 ming2 bai5 ta1 men5 yi1 zhi2 xiang4 xi1 zou3 yi1 zhi2 zhui1 zhe5 tai4 yang5 mei3 yi1 tian1 dou1 bi3 jia1 li3 de5 ren2 chang2 yi1 dian3 dian3
sentences.english: Only later did people understand: sailing west, chasing the sun, each of their days had been a tiny bit longer than a day at home.

sentences.hanzi: 绕地球一圈，这些一点点加起来，正好是一天。
sentences.pinyin: rao4 di4 qiu2 yi1 quan1 zhe4 xie1 yi1 dian3 dian3 jia1 qi3 lai5 zheng4 hao3 shi4 yi1 tian1
sentences.english: Over one trip around the Earth, those tiny bits added up to exactly one day.

sentences.hanzi: 皮加费塔的日记没有错。
sentences.pinyin: pi2 jia1 fei4 ta3 de5 ri4 ji4 mei2 you3 cuo4
sentences.english: Pigafetta's diary was not wrong.

sentences.hanzi: 错的是大家都以为，世界上每个地方的“今天”都是一样的。
sentences.pinyin: cuo4 de5 shi4 da4 jia1 dou1 yi3 wei2 shi4 jie4 shang4 mei3 ge5 di4 fang5 de5 jin1 tian1 dou1 shi4 yi1 yang4 de5
sentences.english: What was wrong was the belief that “today” is the same everywhere in the world.

sentences.hanzi: 我刚到中国那年，在大学教英语，差点因为一顿饭报警。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 gang1 dao4 zhong1 guo2 na4 nian2 zai4 da4 xue2 jiao1 ying1 yu3 cha4 dian3 yin1 wei4 yi1 dun4 fan4 bao4 jing3
sentences.english: In my first year in China, teaching English at a university, a meal nearly made me call the police.

sentences.hanzi: 那天下班以后，我和同事老王去饭店吃饭，旁边桌子上的两位老人突然站了起来。
sentences.pinyin: na4 tian1 xia4 ban1 yi3 hou4 wo3 he2 tong2 shi4 lao3 wang2 qu4 fan4 dian4 chi1 fan4 pang2 bian1 zhuo1 zi5 shang4 de5 liang3 wei4 lao3 ren2 tu1 ran2 zhan4 le5 qi3 lai5
sentences.english: That day after work I went to a restaurant with my colleague Lao Wang, and two old men at the next table suddenly stood up.

sentences.hanzi: 他们的声音越来越大，像在吵架。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 de5 sheng1 yin1 yue4 lai2 yue4 da4 xiang4 zai4 chao3 jia4
sentences.english: Their voices got louder and louder, as if they were quarrelling.

sentences.hanzi: 胖的那位抓住另一位的手，另一位用力推他。
sentences.pinyin: pang4 de5 na4 wei4 zhua1 zhu4 ling4 yi1 wei4 de5 shou3 ling4 yi1 wei4 yong4 li4 tui1 ta1
sentences.english: The fat one grabbed the other's hand, and the other shoved him hard.

sentences.hanzi: 毫无疑问，他们要打架了。我马上拿出了手机。
sentences.pinyin: hao2 wu2 yi2 wen4 ta1 men5 yao4 da3 jia4 le5 wo3 ma3 shang4 na2 chu1 le5 shou3 ji1
sentences.english: There was no doubt they were about to fight. I took out my phone at once.

sentences.hanzi: 老王按住我的手，笑了：“别急，胖的那位是老张，我认识。人家在抢着买单。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 wang2 an4 zhu4 wo3 de5 shou3 xiao4 le5 bie2 ji2 pang4 de5 na4 wei4 shi4 lao3 zhang1 wo3 ren4 shi5 ren2 jia5 zai4 qiang3 zhe5 mai3 dan1
sentences.english: Lao Wang pressed down my hand and laughed. “Relax. The fat one is Lao Zhang, I know him. They're fighting to pay the bill.”

sentences.hanzi: “抢着买单？”
sentences.pinyin: qiang3 zhe5 mai3 dan1
sentences.english: “Fighting to pay?”

sentences.hanzi: 我看了半天才看懂。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 kan4 le5 ban4 tian1 cai2 kan4 dong3
sentences.english: It took me a long while to understand what I was watching.

sentences.hanzi: 胖的那位拿出钱包，把钱塞给服务员，另一位把钱拿回来，塞进他的口袋。
sentences.pinyin: pang4 de5 na4 wei4 na2 chu1 qian2 bao1 ba3 qian2 sai1 gei3 fu2 wu4 yuan2 ling4 yi1 wei4 ba3 qian2 na2 hui2 lai5 sai1 jin4 ta1 de5 kou3 dai4
sentences.english: The fat one took out his wallet and stuffed money at the waiter; the other took it back and stuffed it into his friend's pocket.

sentences.hanzi: 这样持续了好久。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 chi2 xu4 le5 hao3 jiu3
sentences.english: This went on for a long time.

sentences.hanzi: 最后，老张趁朋友去洗手间，跑到前面把钱付了。
sentences.pinyin: zui4 hou4 lao3 zhang1 chen4 peng2 you5 qu4 xi3 shou3 jian1 pao3 dao4 qian2 mian4 ba3 qian2 fu4 le5
sentences.english: In the end Lao Zhang waited until his friend went to the toilet, then ran to the front and paid.

sentences.hanzi: 朋友回来，很生气：“你这个人！下次不许这样！”
sentences.pinyin: peng2 you5 hui2 lai5 hen3 sheng1 qi4 ni3 zhe4 ge5 ren2 xia4 ci4 bu4 xu3 zhe4 yang4
sentences.english: His friend came back furious. “You! Don't you ever do that again!”

sentences.hanzi: 可是两个人都在笑。老王向他们打了个招呼。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 liang3 ge4 ren2 dou1 zai4 xiao4 lao3 wang2 xiang4 ta1 men5 da3 le5 ge4 zhao1 hu5
sentences.english: But both of them were laughing. Lao Wang gave them a wave.

sentences.hanzi: “这家饭店这么便宜，抢什么？这也算礼貌？”我问。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 jia1 fan4 dian4 zhe4 me5 pian2 yi5 qiang3 shen2 me5 zhe4 ye3 suan4 li3 mao4 wo3 wen4
sentences.english: “This place is so cheap. What's to fight over? Is this supposed to be good manners?” I asked.

sentences.hanzi: “当然，全国很多地方都这样。”老王说。
sentences.pinyin: dang1 ran2 quan2 guo2 hen3 duo1 di4 fang5 dou1 zhe4 yang4 lao3 wang2 shuo1
sentences.english: “Of course. You see it in a lot of places around the country,” said Lao Wang.

sentences.hanzi: “在我家那边，朋友吃饭一般各付各的，”我说，“这样多合理。”
sentences.pinyin: zai4 wo3 jia1 na4 bian5 peng2 you5 chi1 fan4 yi1 ban1 ge4 fu4 ge4 de5 wo3 shuo1 zhe4 yang4 duo1 he2 li3
sentences.english: “Where I'm from, friends usually pay for themselves,” I said. “Isn't that more reasonable?”

sentences.hanzi: 老王说：“算清楚了，两个人就谁也不欠谁了。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 wang2 shuo1 suan4 qing1 chu5 le5 liang3 ge4 ren2 jiu4 shei2 ye3 bu4 qian4 shei2 le5
sentences.english: Lao Wang said, “Once it's all settled, neither owes the other anything.”

sentences.hanzi: “今天他付了，下次就该你请他。”
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 ta1 fu4 le5 xia4 ci4 jiu4 gai1 ni3 qing3 ta1
sentences.english: “He pays today, so next time it's your turn to treat him.”

sentences.hanzi: “欠一顿饭，就还有下一顿。”
sentences.pinyin: qian4 yi1 dun4 fan4 jiu4 hai2 you3 xia4 yi1 dun4
sentences.english: “If you owe a meal, there's always another meal.”

sentences.hanzi: “所以抢着买单，不是为了钱？”
sentences.pinyin: suo3 yi3 qiang3 zhe5 mai3 dan1 bu4 shi4 wei4 le5 qian2
sentences.english: “So fighting over the bill isn't about money?”

sentences.hanzi: “是为了下一次再聚。”
sentences.pinyin: shi4 wei4 le5 xia4 yi1 ci4 zai4 ju4
sentences.english: “It's about getting together again next time.”

sentences.hanzi: 后来我也常去那家饭店，总能看到这两位老朋友。
sentences.pinyin: hou4 lai2 wo3 ye3 chang2 qu4 na4 jia1 fan4 dian4 zong3 neng2 kan4 dao4 zhe4 liang3 wei4 lao3 peng2 you5
sentences.english: After that I often went to the restaurant and always saw the two old friends.

sentences.hanzi: 他们每个月都聚一次，下雨也来，每次都抢，已经抢了四十年。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 mei3 ge5 yue4 dou1 ju4 yi1 ci4 xia4 yu3 ye3 lai2 mei3 ci4 dou1 qiang3 yi3 jing1 qiang3 le5 si4 shi2 nian2
sentences.english: They got together every month, even in the rain, and fought every time, and had been doing it for forty years.

sentences.hanzi: 第二年春天，老张不再来了。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 nian2 chun1 tian1 lao3 zhang1 bu4 zai4 lai2 le5
sentences.english: The next spring, Lao Zhang stopped coming.

sentences.hanzi: 老王告诉我，他生病去世了，葬礼就在上个星期。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 wang2 gao4 su5 wo3 ta1 sheng1 bing4 qu4 shi4 le5 zang4 li3 jiu4 zai4 shang4 ge4 xing1 qi1
sentences.english: Lao Wang told me he had fallen ill and died. The funeral was the week before.

sentences.hanzi: 不久，我看见他的朋友依然坐在那张桌子旁边，只有他一个人。
sentences.pinyin: bu4 jiu3 wo3 kan4 jian4 ta1 de5 peng2 you5 yi1 ran2 zuo4 zai4 na4 zhang1 zhuo1 zi5 pang2 bian1 zhi3 you3 ta1 yi1 ge5 ren2
sentences.english: Not long after, I saw his friend sitting at that table as usual, all alone.

sentences.hanzi: 他点了两个人的菜，桌子上放着两杯茶。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 dian3 le5 liang3 ge4 ren2 de5 cai4 zhuo1 zi5 shang4 fang4 zhe5 liang3 bei1 cha2
sentences.english: He had ordered food for two, and two cups of tea stood on the table.

sentences.hanzi: 吃完了，他站起来，慢慢走到前面，拿出了钱包。
sentences.pinyin: chi1 wan2 le5 ta1 zhan4 qi3 lai5 man4 man4 zou3 dao4 qian2 mian4 na2 chu1 le5 qian2 bao1
sentences.english: When he finished, he stood up, walked slowly to the front and took out his wallet.

sentences.hanzi: 服务员很同情他，说：“今天没有人跟您抢了。”
sentences.pinyin: fu2 wu4 yuan2 hen3 tong2 qing2 ta1 shuo1 jin1 tian1 mei2 you3 ren2 gen1 nin2 qiang3 le5
sentences.english: The waiter, feeling for him, said, “No one's fighting you for it today.”

sentences.hanzi: 老人平静地笑了笑，把钱放下。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ren2 ping2 jing4 de5 xiao4 le5 xiao4 ba3 qian2 fang4 xia4
sentences.english: The old man smiled calmly and put the money down.

sentences.hanzi: “上次是他抢到的，”他说，“这顿该我请他。”
sentences.pinyin: shang4 ci4 shi4 ta1 qiang3 dao4 de5 ta1 shuo1 zhe4 dun4 gai1 wo3 qing3 ta1
sentences.english: “He won last time,” he said. “This one is on me.”

sentences.hanzi: 一四一四年，我十六岁，是明朝大船上的士兵，专门养马。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 si4 yi1 si4 nian2 wo3 shi2 liu4 sui4 shi4 ming2 chao2 da4 chuan2 shang4 de5 shi4 bing1 zhuan1 men2 yang3 ma3
sentences.english: In 1414 I was sixteen, a soldier on one of the great Ming ships, assigned to look after the horses.

sentences.hanzi: 那一年，船从孟加拉回来，上面多了一个怪物。
sentences.pinyin: na4 yi1 nian2 chuan2 cong2 meng4 jia1 la1 hui2 lai5 shang4 mian4 duo1 le5 yi1 ge5 guai4 wu5
sentences.english: That year, the ship came back from Bengal with a monster on board.

sentences.hanzi: 它看起来比房子还高，脖子特别长，皮肤上都是一块一块的花。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 qi3 lai5 bi3 fang2 zi5 hai2 gao1 bo2 zi5 te4 bie2 chang2 pi2 fu1 shang4 dou1 shi4 yi1 kuai4 yi1 kuai4 de5 hua1
sentences.english: It looked taller than a house, with an extremely long neck and patches all over its skin.

sentences.hanzi: 孟加拉当地人说，它是从很远很远的非洲来的。
sentences.pinyin: meng4 jia1 la1 dang1 di4 ren2 shuo1 ta1 shi4 cong2 hen3 yuan3 hen3 yuan3 de5 fei1 zhou1 lai2 de5
sentences.english: The people of Bengal said it had come from far, far away in Africa.

sentences.hanzi: 它是什么？没有人知道。吃什么？也没有人知道。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shi4 shen2 me5 mei2 you3 ren2 zhi1 dao4 chi1 shen2 me5 ye3 mei2 you3 ren2 zhi1 dao4
sentences.english: What was it? No one knew. What did it eat? No one knew that either.

sentences.hanzi: 船上的官说：“你会养马，就交给你了。”
sentences.pinyin: chuan2 shang4 de5 guan1 shuo1 ni3 hui4 yang3 ma3 jiu4 jiao1 gei3 ni3 le5
sentences.english: The officer on board said, “You can handle horses, so it's yours.”

sentences.hanzi: 一路上，我整整陪了它两个多月。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 lu4 shang4 wo3 zheng3 zheng3 pei2 le5 ta1 liang3 ge4 duo1 yue4
sentences.english: All the way, for two whole months and more, I stayed with it.

sentences.hanzi: 大风的晚上，它害怕得睡不着，我就站在它旁边安慰它。
sentences.pinyin: da4 feng1 de5 wan3 shang5 ta1 hai4 pa4 de5 shui4 bu4 zhao2 wo3 jiu4 zhan4 zai4 ta1 pang2 bian1 an1 wei4 ta1
sentences.english: On windy nights it was too frightened to sleep, and I would stand next to it and comfort it.

sentences.hanzi: 它会低下头，用脸碰碰我的手。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 hui4 di1 xia4 tou2 yong4 lian3 peng4 peng4 wo3 de5 shou3
sentences.english: It would lower its head and touch my hand with its face.

sentences.hanzi: 我给它起了个名字，叫高高。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 gei3 ta1 qi3 le5 ge4 ming2 zi5 jiao4 gao1 gao1
sentences.english: I gave it a name: Gaogao, “Tall-Tall”.

sentences.hanzi: 到了京城，全城的人都挤来看它，一位大官也来了。
sentences.pinyin: dao4 le5 jing1 cheng2 quan2 cheng2 de5 ren2 dou1 ji3 lai2 kan4 ta1 yi1 wei4 da4 guan1 ye3 lai2 le5
sentences.english: When we reached the capital, the whole city crowded in to see it, and a high official came too.

sentences.hanzi: 他看了很久，突然大声说：“麒麟！这是麒麟！”全城都震惊了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 le5 hen3 jiu3 tu1 ran2 da4 sheng1 shuo1 qi2 lin2 zhe4 shi4 qi2 lin2 quan2 cheng2 dou1 zhen4 jing1 le5
sentences.english: He stared for a long time, then suddenly cried out, “A qilin! This is a qilin!” The whole city was stunned.

sentences.hanzi: 麒麟不是一般的动物，老人们说，只有好皇帝在的时候，它才会出现。
sentences.pinyin: qi2 lin2 bu4 shi4 yi1 ban1 de5 dong4 wu4 lao3 ren2 men5 shuo1 zhi3 you3 hao3 huang2 di4 zai4 de5 shi2 hou5 ta1 cai2 hui4 chu1 xian4
sentences.english: The qilin is no ordinary animal. Old people say it appears only when there is a good emperor.

sentences.hanzi: 我忍不住说：“大人，它是动物。它也会生病，听见大风也怕。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 ren3 bu4 zhu4 shuo1 da4 ren5 ta1 shi4 dong4 wu4 ta1 ye3 hui4 sheng1 bing4 ting1 jian4 da4 feng1 ye3 pa4
sentences.english: I couldn't help saying, “Sir, it's an animal. It gets sick too, and it's scared of strong winds.”

sentences.hanzi: 大官看着我：“你今年多大？”
sentences.pinyin: da4 guan1 kan4 zhe5 wo3 ni3 jin1 nian2 duo1 da4
sentences.english: The official looked at me. “How old are you?”

sentences.hanzi: “十六。”
sentences.pinyin: shi2 liu4
sentences.english: “Sixteen.”

sentences.hanzi: “想活到十七吗？”
sentences.pinyin: xiang3 huo2 dao4 shi2 qi1 ma5
sentences.english: “Would you like to live to seventeen?”

sentences.hanzi: 我知道说真话的后果。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zhi1 dao4 shuo1 zhen1 hua4 de5 hou4 guo3
sentences.english: I understood the consequences of telling the truth.

sentences.hanzi: 那天晚上，我坐在高高旁边，心中很不平静。
sentences.pinyin: na4 tian1 wan3 shang5 wo3 zuo4 zai4 gao1 gao1 pang2 bian1 xin1 zhong1 hen3 bu4 ping2 jing4
sentences.english: That night I sat beside Gaogao, my mind in turmoil.

sentences.hanzi: 我母亲教过我，做人要诚实。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 mu3 qin1 jiao1 guo5 wo3 zuo4 ren2 yao4 cheng2 shi2
sentences.english: My mother had taught me to be honest.

sentences.hanzi: 它明明只是动物，这是一个谎言。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 ming2 ming2 zhi3 shi4 dong4 wu4 zhe4 shi4 yi1 ge5 huang3 yan2
sentences.english: It was obviously just an animal. This was a lie.

sentences.hanzi: 可是如果它只是一个奇怪的动物，皇帝看两眼就忘了，生病了谁给它治？
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ru2 guo3 ta1 zhi3 shi4 yi1 ge5 qi2 guai4 de5 dong4 wu4 huang2 di4 kan4 liang3 yan3 jiu4 wang4 le5 sheng1 bing4 le5 shei2 gei3 ta1 zhi4
sentences.english: But if it was only a strange animal, the emperor would look twice and forget it. Then if it fell ill, who would treat it?

sentences.hanzi: 如果它是麒麟，人人都会保护它，全国没有人敢打它，饿它。
sentences.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ta1 shi4 qi2 lin2 ren2 ren2 dou1 hui4 bao3 hu4 ta1 quan2 guo2 mei2 you3 ren2 gan3 da3 ta1 e4 ta1
sentences.english: If it was a qilin, everyone would protect it, and no one in the country would dare to beat it or starve it.

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，皇帝想见它，他的人问我：“这是什么？”
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 huang2 di4 xiang3 jian4 ta1 ta1 de5 ren2 wen4 wo3 zhe4 shi4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: The next day the emperor wished to see it, and his man asked me, “What is this?”

sentences.hanzi: 高高低下头看着我。
sentences.pinyin: gao1 gao1 di1 xia4 tou2 kan4 zhe5 wo3
sentences.english: Gaogao lowered its head and looked at me.

sentences.hanzi: “是麒麟，”我大声说，“而且只有我知道怎么养它。”
sentences.pinyin: shi4 qi2 lin2 wo3 da4 sheng1 shuo1 er2 qie3 zhi3 you3 wo3 zhi1 dao4 zen3 me5 yang3 ta1
sentences.english: “It's a qilin,” I said loudly. “And I'm the only one who knows how to care for it.”

sentences.hanzi: 于是我一直留在它身边。
sentences.pinyin: yu2 shi4 wo3 yi1 zhi2 liu2 zai4 ta1 shen1 bian1
sentences.english: And so I stayed by its side.

sentences.hanzi: 后来，皇帝让人把它画了下来。
sentences.pinyin: hou4 lai2 huang2 di4 rang4 ren2 ba3 ta1 hua4 le5 xia4 lai5
sentences.english: Later the emperor had it painted.

sentences.hanzi: 画上，它的旁边有一个很小的人，手里拉着它。
sentences.pinyin: hua4 shang4 ta1 de5 pang2 bian1 you3 yi1 ge5 hen3 xiao3 de5 ren2 shou3 li3 la1 zhe5 ta1
sentences.english: In the painting, beside it, is a very small person holding its rope.

sentences.hanzi: 那个人就是我。
sentences.pinyin: na4 ge5 ren2 jiu4 shi4 wo3
sentences.english: That person is me.

sentences.hanzi: 我骗了皇帝，可是我从来没有骗过它。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 pian4 le5 huang2 di4 ke3 shi4 wo3 cong2 lai2 mei2 you3 pian4 guo5 ta1
sentences.english: I deceived the emperor, but I never once deceived Gaogao.

glossed.meaning: qilin, a sacred beast of Chinese legend

title: 山里的一扇门
titlePinyin: shan1 li3 de5 yi1 shan4 men2

sentences.hanzi: 我从挪威坐飞机一直向北，来到离北极很近的一个岛上。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 cong2 nuo2 wei1 zuo4 fei1 ji1 yi1 zhi2 xiang4 bei3 lai2 dao4 li2 bei3 ji2 hen3 jin4 de5 yi1 ge5 dao3 shang4
sentences.english: I flew north from Norway to an island close to the North Pole.

sentences.hanzi: 这里冬天有几个月看不见太阳，夏天也很冷，山里的地一年到头都是冰。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 li3 dong1 tian1 you3 ji3 ge4 yue4 kan4 bu4 jian4 tai4 yang5 xia4 tian1 ye3 hen3 leng3 shan1 li3 de5 di4 yi1 nian2 dao4 tou2 dou1 shi4 bing1
sentences.english: In winter the sun isn't seen for months here, summer is cold too, and the ground inside the mountains stays frozen all year.

sentences.hanzi: 放下行李，我就往山上走。我走了这么远，只是为了亲眼看一扇门。
sentences.pinyin: fang4 xia4 xing2 li5 wo3 jiu4 wang3 shan1 shang4 zou3 wo3 zou3 le5 zhe4 me5 yuan3 zhi3 shi4 wei4 le5 qin1 yan3 kan4 yi1 shan4 men2
sentences.english: As soon as I put down my bags, I headed up the mountain. I had come all this way just to see a door with my own eyes.

sentences.hanzi: 门开在山上，是铁的，不大，平常都关闭着，每年只开几次。
sentences.pinyin: men2 kai1 zai4 shan1 shang4 shi4 tie3 de5 bu4 da4 ping2 chang2 dou1 guan1 bi4 zhe5 mei3 nian2 zhi3 kai1 ji3 ci4
sentences.english: It opens in the side of a mountain: iron, not large, usually shut, and opened only a few times a year.

sentences.hanzi: 可是门后面有一条一百多米长的路，一直通到山的深处。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 men2 hou4 mian5 you3 yi1 tiao2 yi1 bai3 duo1 mi3 chang2 de5 lu4 yi1 zhi2 tong1 dao4 shan1 de5 shen1 chu4
sentences.english: But behind it a passage more than a hundred metres long runs deep into the mountain.

sentences.hanzi: 路的尽头有三间屋子，里面存着大量的种子，一共一百多万份。
sentences.pinyin: lu4 de5 jin4 tou2 you3 san1 jian1 wu1 zi5 li3 mian4 cun2 zhe5 da4 liang4 de5 zhong3 zi5 yi1 gong4 yi1 bai3 duo1 wan4 fen4
sentences.english: At the end are three rooms holding vast numbers of seeds, over a million samples in all.

sentences.hanzi: 这些种子是从世界各地收集来的，这是一个国际项目。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 zhong3 zi5 shi4 cong2 shi4 jie4 ge4 di4 shou1 ji2 lai2 de5 zhe4 shi4 yi1 ge5 guo2 ji4 xiang4 mu4
sentences.english: These seeds were collected from all over the world. It is an international project.

sentences.hanzi: 为什么要存这些种子？
sentences.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 yao4 cun2 zhe4 xie1 zhong3 zi5
sentences.english: Why store these seeds?

sentences.hanzi: 因为这个星球上常常发生灾难。
sentences.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zhe4 ge5 xing1 qiu2 shang4 chang2 chang2 fa1 sheng1 zai1 nan4
sentences.english: Because disasters often happen on this planet.

sentences.hanzi: 战争、大火、大水，都可能让一种食物永远消失。
sentences.pinyin: zhan4 zheng1 da4 huo3 da4 shui3 dou1 ke3 neng2 rang4 yi1 zhong3 shi2 wu4 yong3 yuan3 xiao1 shi1
sentences.english: War, fire or flood could make a food crop disappear forever.

sentences.hanzi: 那时候，人们可以来这里，把种子拿回去。
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi2 hou5 ren2 men5 ke3 yi3 lai2 zhe4 li3 ba3 zhong3 zi5 na2 hui2 qu5
sentences.english: If that happens, people can come here and take the seeds back.

sentences.hanzi: 这里的地是冰的，就算设备坏了，种子也能在山里保留很多年。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 li3 de5 di4 shi4 bing1 de5 jiu4 suan4 she4 bei4 huai4 le5 zhong3 zi5 ye3 neng2 zai4 shan1 li3 bao3 liu2 hen3 duo1 nian2
sentences.english: The ground here is frozen, so even if the equipment fails, the seeds can keep in the mountain for many years.

sentences.hanzi: 这里的管理很严格，每个箱子只有送来的人才能打开。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 li3 de5 guan3 li3 hen3 yan2 ge2 mei3 ge5 xiang1 zi5 zhi3 you3 song4 lai2 de5 ren2 cai2 neng2 da3 kai1
sentences.english: Management here is strict: each box can only be opened by those who sent it.

sentences.hanzi: 两个国家的关系不管多坏，它们的箱子都在山里和平地放在一起。
sentences.pinyin: liang3 ge4 guo2 jia1 de5 guan1 xi5 bu4 guan3 duo1 huai4 ta1 men5 de5 xiang1 zi5 dou1 zai4 shan1 li3 he2 ping2 de5 fang4 zai4 yi1 qi3
sentences.english: However bad relations between two countries may be, their boxes sit peacefully together in the mountain.

sentences.hanzi: 我问当地的一位女士：“这里的种子真的用过吗？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wen4 dang1 di4 de5 yi1 wei4 nu:3 shi4 zhe4 li3 de5 zhong3 zi5 zhen1 de5 yong4 guo5 ma5
sentences.english: I asked a local woman, “Have the seeds here ever really been used?”

sentences.hanzi: “用过。”她说。
sentences.pinyin: yong4 guo5 ta1 shuo1
sentences.english: “They have,” she said.

sentences.hanzi: 一个研究机构因为战争离开了自己的城市，种子都带不走。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 yan2 jiu1 ji1 gou4 yin1 wei4 zhan4 zheng1 li2 kai1 le5 zi4 ji3 de5 cheng2 shi4 zhong3 zi5 dou1 dai4 bu4 zou3
sentences.english: A research institute forced from its city by war could not take its seeds along.

sentences.hanzi: 二零一五年，他们第一次从这里取回了自己的箱子，种子依然是活的。
sentences.pinyin: er4 ling2 yi1 wu3 nian2 ta1 men5 di4 yi1 ci4 cong2 zhe4 li3 qu3 hui2 le5 zi4 ji3 de5 xiang1 zi5 zhong3 zi5 yi1 ran2 shi4 huo2 de5
sentences.english: In 2015, for the first time, they took their own boxes back from here. The seeds were still alive.

sentences.hanzi: 他们把种子带到新的地方种下去，几年后，又把新长出来的种子送了回来。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 ba3 zhong3 zi5 dai4 dao4 xin1 de5 di4 fang5 zhong4 xia4 qu4 ji3 nian2 hou4 you4 ba3 xin1 zhang3 chu1 lai2 de5 zhong3 zi5 song4 le5 hui2 lai5
sentences.english: They took the seeds to a new place and planted them, and a few years later sent newly grown seeds back.

sentences.hanzi: 借了，就要还。
sentences.pinyin: jie4 le5 jiu4 yao4 huan2
sentences.english: What you borrow, you return.

sentences.hanzi: 公众不能进去，我只能站在门口的冷风里。
sentences.pinyin: gong1 zhong4 bu4 neng2 jin4 qu4 wo3 zhi3 neng2 zhan4 zai4 men2 kou3 de5 leng3 feng1 li3
sentences.english: The public can't go inside, so I could only stand at the door in the cold wind.

sentences.hanzi: 人类盖了很多高大的建筑，都是给自己看的。
sentences.pinyin: ren2 lei4 gai4 le5 hen3 duo1 gao1 da4 de5 jian4 zhu4 dou1 shi4 gei3 zi4 ji3 kan4 de5
sentences.english: Humans have put up many towering buildings, all for themselves to look at.

sentences.hanzi: 这扇小门后面的东西，却是给还没有出生的人留的。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shan4 xiao3 men2 hou4 mian5 de5 dong1 xi5 que4 shi4 gei3 hai2 mei2 you3 chu1 sheng1 de5 ren2 liu2 de5
sentences.english: What lies behind this small door is kept for people who haven't been born.

sentences.hanzi: 建它的人最大的希望，是以后再也不用打开那些箱子。
sentences.pinyin: jian4 ta1 de5 ren2 zui4 da4 de5 xi1 wang4 shi4 yi3 hou4 zai4 ye3 bu4 yong4 da3 kai1 na4 xie1 xiang1 zi5
sentences.english: The greatest hope of those who built it is that those boxes will never need to be opened again.

sentences.hanzi: 二一零零年，人类向一颗星发了一封信。
sentences.pinyin: er4 yi1 ling2 ling2 nian2 ren2 lei4 xiang4 yi1 ke1 xing1 fa1 le5 yi1 feng1 xin4
sentences.english: In the year 2100, humanity sent a letter to a star.

sentences.hanzi: 那颗星离地球五十光年，信走到那里要整整五十年。
sentences.pinyin: na4 ke1 xing1 li2 di4 qiu2 wu3 shi2 guang1 nian2 xin4 zou3 dao4 na4 li5 yao4 zheng3 zheng3 wu3 shi2 nian2
sentences.english: The star was fifty light years from Earth, so the letter would take a full fifty years to get there.

sentences.hanzi: 如果有人回信，最早也要一百年以后才能收到。
sentences.pinyin: ru2 guo3 you3 ren2 hui2 xin4 zui4 zao3 ye3 yao4 yi1 bai3 nian2 yi3 hou4 cai2 neng2 shou1 dao4
sentences.english: If anyone replied, it would be a hundred years at the very earliest.

sentences.hanzi: 发信的是王教授，我是她的助手。
sentences.pinyin: fa1 xin4 de5 shi4 wang2 jiao4 shou4 wo3 shi4 ta1 de5 zhu4 shou3
sentences.english: The sender was Professor Wang, and I was her assistant.

sentences.hanzi: 信很简单：一段音乐，几句话，还有一张图，图上画着地球。
sentences.pinyin: xin4 hen3 jian3 dan1 yi1 duan4 yin1 yue4 ji3 ju4 hua4 hai2 you3 yi1 zhang1 tu2 tu2 shang4 hua4 zhe5 di4 qiu2
sentences.english: The letter was simple: some music, a few sentences, and a picture of the Earth.

sentences.hanzi: “我们收不到回信了，”她微笑着说，“这封信是写给将来的人的。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 shou1 bu4 dao4 hui2 xin4 le5 ta1 wei1 xiao4 zhe5 shuo1 zhe4 feng1 xin4 shi4 xie3 gei3 jiang1 lai2 de5 ren2 de5
sentences.english: “We won't see a reply,” she said with a smile. “This letter is for the people of the future.”

sentences.hanzi: 发完信，世界很快就把这件事忘了。
sentences.pinyin: fa1 wan2 xin4 shi4 jie4 hen3 kuai4 jiu4 ba3 zhe4 jian4 shi4 wang4 le5
sentences.english: Once it was sent, the world soon forgot all about it.

sentences.hanzi: 我在实验室的工作是每天看数据，看了八十多天，没有一点迹象。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zai4 shi2 yan4 shi4 de5 gong1 zuo4 shi4 mei3 tian1 kan4 shu4 ju4 kan4 le5 ba1 shi2 duo1 tian1 mei2 you3 yi1 dian3 ji4 xiang4
sentences.english: My job in the lab was to check the data each day, and for over eighty days there was no sign of anything.

sentences.hanzi: 第八十七天的半夜，我快要睡着了，警报响了。
sentences.pinyin: di4 ba1 shi2 qi1 tian1 de5 ban4 ye4 wo3 kuai4 yao4 shui4 zhao2 le5 jing3 bao4 xiang3 le5
sentences.english: In the middle of the night on the eighty-seventh day, as I was falling asleep, the alarm went off.

sentences.hanzi: 信号很强，从太空里来。
sentences.pinyin: xin4 hao4 hen3 qiang2 cong2 tai4 kong1 li3 lai2
sentences.english: The signal was strong, and it came from space.

sentences.hanzi: 我打开一看，以为设备坏了。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 da3 kai1 yi1 kan4 yi3 wei2 she4 bei4 huai4 le5
sentences.english: I opened it and thought the equipment must be broken.

sentences.hanzi: 一段音乐，几句话，一张地球的图。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 duan4 yin1 yue4 ji3 ju4 hua4 yi1 zhang1 di4 qiu2 de5 tu2
sentences.english: Some music, a few sentences, a picture of the Earth.

sentences.hanzi: 毫无疑问，这是我们自己的信。
sentences.pinyin: hao2 wu2 yi2 wen4 zhe4 shi4 wo3 men5 zi4 ji3 de5 xin4
sentences.english: There was no doubt: it was our own letter.

sentences.hanzi: 只是图变了：地球旁边，多了一个小小的点。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 tu2 bian4 le5 di4 qiu2 pang2 bian1 duo1 le5 yi1 ge5 xiao3 xiao3 de5 dian3
sentences.english: Only the picture had changed: next to the Earth there was a tiny dot.

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，消息发表了，全世界都震惊了。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 xiao1 xi5 fa1 biao3 le5 quan2 shi4 jie4 dou1 zhen4 jing1 le5
sentences.english: The next day the news was published, and the whole world was stunned.

sentences.hanzi: 人们走到街上，又唱又跳。媒体说：人类不再孤独了！
sentences.pinyin: ren2 men5 zou3 dao4 jie1 shang5 you4 chang4 you4 tiao4 mei2 ti3 shuo1 ren2 lei4 bu4 zai4 gu1 du2 le5
sentences.english: People poured into the streets, singing and dancing. The media said humanity was no longer alone.

sentences.hanzi: 只有王教授一个人坐在办公室里，脸色很不好。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 you3 wang2 jiao4 shou4 yi1 ge5 ren2 zuo4 zai4 ban4 gong1 shi4 li3 lian3 se4 hen3 bu4 hao3
sentences.english: Only Professor Wang sat alone in her office, looking pale.

sentences.hanzi: “你算过了吗？”她问我，眼神很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: ni3 suan4 guo5 le5 ma5 ta1 wen4 wo3 yan3 shen2 hen3 qi2 guai4
sentences.english: “Have you done the sums?” she asked me, with a strange look in her eyes.

sentences.hanzi: “算什么？”
sentences.pinyin: suan4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: “What sums?”

sentences.hanzi: “时间。”
sentences.pinyin: shi2 jian1
sentences.english: “The time.”

sentences.hanzi: 我站在那里，突然明白了，全身都冷了。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zhan4 zai4 na4 li5 tu1 ran2 ming2 bai5 le5 quan2 shen1 dou1 leng3 le5
sentences.english: I stood there, and suddenly understood. I went cold all over.

sentences.hanzi: 光走到那颗星要五十年，可是这封信只走了八十七天就回来了。
sentences.pinyin: guang1 zou3 dao4 na4 ke1 xing1 yao4 wu3 shi2 nian2 ke3 shi4 zhe4 feng1 xin4 zhi3 zou3 le5 ba1 shi2 qi1 tian1 jiu4 hui2 lai5 le5
sentences.english: Light takes fifty years to reach that star, yet the letter was back in eighty-seven days.

sentences.hanzi: 去四十多天，回来四十多天。
sentences.pinyin: qu4 si4 shi2 duo1 tian1 hui2 lai5 si4 shi2 duo1 tian1
sentences.english: Forty-odd days out, forty-odd days back.

sentences.hanzi: 他们不在那颗星上。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 bu4 zai4 na4 ke1 xing1 shang4
sentences.english: They were not on that star.

sentences.hanzi: 相反，他们离我们最多只有四十多天的路。
sentences.pinyin: xiang1 fan3 ta1 men5 li2 wo3 men5 zui4 duo1 zhi3 you3 si4 shi2 duo1 tian1 de5 lu4
sentences.english: On the contrary, they were at most forty-odd days away from us.

sentences.hanzi: “我们的信还在路上，就被他们收到了。”她说，“说不定，他们早就在看着我们。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 de5 xin4 hai2 zai4 lu4 shang5 jiu4 bei4 ta1 men5 shou1 dao4 le5 ta1 shuo1 shuo1 bu5 ding4 ta1 men5 zao3 jiu4 zai4 kan4 zhe5 wo3 men5
sentences.english: “Our letter was picked up while it was still on its way,” she said. “Perhaps they've been watching us for a long time.”

sentences.hanzi: 她把手指放在图上的那个小点上。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 ba3 shou3 zhi3 fang4 zai4 tu2 shang4 de5 na4 ge5 xiao3 dian3 shang4
sentences.english: She put her finger on the little dot in the picture.

sentences.hanzi: “大家都以为它在说：你好，我们也在。”
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 yi3 wei2 ta1 zai4 shuo1 ni3 hao3 wo3 men5 ye3 zai4
sentences.english: “Everyone thinks it says: Hello, we exist too.”

sentences.hanzi: “可是它说的是：我们就在你们旁边。”
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ta1 shuo1 de5 shi4 wo3 men5 jiu4 zai4 ni3 men5 pang2 bian1
sentences.english: “But what it says is: We're right next to you.”

sentences.hanzi: 外面，人们依然在唱歌。
sentences.pinyin: wai4 mian4 ren2 men5 yi1 ran2 zai4 chang4 ge1
sentences.english: Outside, people were still singing.

sentences.hanzi: 那天晚上，我抬头看天。天很暗，星星和平常一样，很安静。
sentences.pinyin: na4 tian1 wan3 shang5 wo3 tai2 tou2 kan4 tian1 tian1 hen3 an4 xing1 xing5 he2 ping2 chang2 yi1 yang4 hen3 an1 jing4
sentences.english: That night I looked up at the sky. It was dark, and the stars were quiet, the same as ever.

sentences.hanzi: 可是我第一次觉得，有谁也正在看着我。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 wo3 di4 yi1 ci4 jue2 de5 you3 shei2 ye3 zheng4 zai4 kan4 zhe5 wo3
sentences.english: But for the first time, I felt that someone was looking back.

sentences.hanzi: 明朝的最后一个皇帝叫崇祯，他当上皇帝的时候才十几岁。
sentences.pinyin: ming2 chao2 de5 zui4 hou4 yi1 ge5 huang2 di4 jiao4 chong2 zhen1 ta1 dang1 shang4 huang2 di4 de5 shi2 hou5 cai2 shi2 ji3 sui4
sentences.english: The last Ming emperor was Chongzhen, who came to the throne in his teens.

sentences.hanzi: 他不是一个坏皇帝。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 bu4 shi4 yi1 ge5 huai4 huang2 di4
sentences.english: He was not a bad emperor.

sentences.hanzi: 他每天工作到半夜，非常辛苦，从不放松。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 mei3 tian1 gong1 zuo4 dao4 ban4 ye4 fei1 chang2 xin1 ku3 cong2 bu4 fang4 song1
sentences.english: He worked into the night every day, toiling hard and never relaxing.

sentences.hanzi: 然而明朝已经两百多年了，到处都是问题。
sentences.pinyin: ran2 er2 ming2 chao2 yi3 jing1 liang3 bai3 duo1 nian2 le5 dao4 chu4 dou1 shi4 wen4 ti2
sentences.english: However, the Ming was over two hundred years old, and there were problems everywhere.

sentences.hanzi: 北方下雨越来越少，这样持续了很多年，大量的人饿死了，全国都陷入了灾难。
sentences.pinyin: bei3 fang1 xia4 yu3 yue4 lai2 yue4 shao3 zhe4 yang4 chi2 xu4 le5 hen3 duo1 nian2 da4 liang4 de5 ren2 e4 si3 le5 quan2 guo2 dou1 xian4 ru4 le5 zai1 nan4
sentences.english: In the north the rain grew scarcer year after year, huge numbers of people starved, and the whole country fell into disaster.

sentences.hanzi: 东北有清朝的士兵，西边有李自成的队伍，崇祯的士兵常常被打败。
sentences.pinyin: dong1 bei3 you3 qing1 chao2 de5 shi4 bing1 xi1 bian1 you3 li3 zi4 cheng2 de5 dui4 wu3 chong2 zhen1 de5 shi4 bing1 chang2 chang2 bei4 da3 bai4
sentences.english: In the northeast were Qing soldiers, in the west the forces of Li Zicheng, and Chongzhen's own soldiers were often beaten.

sentences.hanzi: 崇祯越来越不相信手下的人。
sentences.pinyin: chong2 zhen1 yue4 lai2 yue4 bu4 xiang1 xin4 shou3 xia4 de5 ren2
sentences.english: Chongzhen trusted his subordinates less and less.

sentences.hanzi: 大臣换了一个又一个，有的被他杀了，其中还有最能打的人。
sentences.pinyin: da4 chen2 huan4 le5 yi1 ge5 you4 yi1 ge5 you3 de5 bei4 ta1 sha1 le5 qi2 zhong1 hai2 you3 zui4 neng2 da3 de5 ren2
sentences.english: He replaced one minister after another and had some killed, even his best commander.

sentences.hanzi: 一六四四年春天，李自成的队伍到了北京城外。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 liu4 si4 si4 nian2 chun1 tian1 li3 zi4 cheng2 de5 dui4 wu3 dao4 le5 bei3 jing1 cheng2 wai4
sentences.english: In the spring of 1644, Li Zicheng's forces reached the outskirts of Beijing.

sentences.hanzi: 半夜，崇祯亲自敲钟，叫大臣们都来。
sentences.pinyin: ban4 ye4 chong2 zhen1 qin1 zi4 qiao1 zhong1 jiao4 da4 chen2 men5 dou1 lai2
sentences.english: In the middle of the night, Chongzhen rang the bell himself to summon his ministers.

sentences.hanzi: 钟声响了很久。
sentences.pinyin: zhong1 sheng1 xiang3 le5 hen3 jiu3
sentences.english: The bell rang for a long time.

sentences.hanzi: 一个人也没有来。有的已经逃走了，有的在等新的主人。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 ren2 ye3 mei2 you3 lai2 you3 de5 yi3 jing1 tao2 zou3 le5 you3 de5 zai4 deng3 xin1 de5 zhu3 ren2
sentences.english: Not one person came. Some had already fled, and some were waiting for a new master.

sentences.hanzi: 他绝望了。天快亮的时候，他走上皇宫后面的一座小山。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 jue2 wang4 le5 tian1 kuai4 liang4 de5 shi2 hou5 ta1 zou3 shang4 huang2 gong1 hou4 mian5 de5 yi1 zuo4 xiao3 shan1
sentences.english: He was in despair. Just before dawn, he climbed a small hill behind the palace.

sentences.hanzi: 身边只有一个人跟着他。
sentences.pinyin: shen1 bian1 zhi3 you3 yi1 ge5 ren2 gen1 zhe5 ta1
sentences.english: Only one person went with him.

sentences.hanzi: 他在树上结束了自己的生命，那年他三十三岁。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zai4 shu4 shang4 jie2 shu4 le5 zi4 ji3 de5 sheng1 ming4 na4 nian2 ta1 san1 shi2 san1 sui4
sentences.english: He ended his own life on a tree. He was thirty-three.

sentences.hanzi: 明朝就这样结束了，一共二百七十六年。
sentences.pinyin: ming2 chao2 jiu4 zhe4 yang4 jie2 shu4 le5 yi1 gong4 er4 bai3 qi1 shi2 liu4 nian2
sentences.english: So the Ming ended, after two hundred and seventy-six years.

sentences.hanzi: 李自成进了皇宫，以为全国都是他的了。
sentences.pinyin: li3 zi4 cheng2 jin4 le5 huang2 gong1 yi3 wei2 quan2 guo2 dou1 shi4 ta1 de5 le5
sentences.english: Li Zicheng entered the palace and believed the whole country was his.

sentences.hanzi: 可是长城最东边的大门，还在一个明朝官员手里。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 chang2 cheng2 zui4 dong1 bian1 de5 da4 men2 hai2 zai4 yi1 ge5 ming2 chao2 guan1 yuan2 shou3 li3
sentences.english: But the easternmost gate of the Great Wall was still in the hands of a Ming officer.

sentences.hanzi: 门外就是清朝的士兵。
sentences.pinyin: men2 wai4 jiu4 shi4 qing1 chao2 de5 shi4 bing1
sentences.english: Right outside the gate were the Qing soldiers.

sentences.hanzi: 这个人想了想，打开了大门。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ren2 xiang3 le5 xiang3 da3 kai1 le5 da4 men2
sentences.english: The man thought it over, and opened the gate.

sentences.hanzi: 清朝的士兵一路打进北京。
sentences.pinyin: qing1 chao2 de5 shi4 bing1 yi1 lu4 da3 jin4 bei3 jing1
sentences.english: The Qing soldiers fought their way to Beijing.

sentences.hanzi: 李自成在北京只待了四十多天，也逃走了。
sentences.pinyin: li3 zi4 cheng2 zai4 bei3 jing1 zhi3 dai1 le5 si4 shi2 duo1 tian1 ye3 tao2 zou3 le5
sentences.english: Li Zicheng stayed in Beijing only some forty days before he too fled.

sentences.hanzi: 新的主人进了皇宫，一住就是二百六十多年。
sentences.pinyin: xin1 de5 zhu3 ren2 jin4 le5 huang2 gong1 yi1 zhu4 jiu4 shi4 er4 bai3 liu4 shi2 duo1 nian2
sentences.english: New masters moved into the palace and stayed more than two hundred and sixty years.

sentences.hanzi: 后来的人说起这一年，总爱问：如果那天大臣们来了呢？如果那扇门没有开呢？
sentences.pinyin: hou4 lai2 de5 ren2 shuo1 qi3 zhe4 yi1 nian2 zong3 ai4 wen4 ru2 guo3 na4 tian1 da4 chen2 men5 lai2 le5 ne5 ru2 guo3 na4 shan4 men2 mei2 you3 kai1 ne5
sentences.english: People who talk of that year always ask: what if the ministers had come? What if the gate had stayed shut?

sentences.hanzi: 历史没有如果。
sentences.pinyin: li4 shi3 mei2 you3 ru2 guo3
sentences.english: History has no ifs.

sentences.hanzi: 那座小山今天是一个公园。
sentences.pinyin: na4 zuo4 xiao3 shan1 jin1 tian1 shi4 yi1 ge5 gong1 yuan2
sentences.english: That hill is a park today.

sentences.hanzi: 每天早晨，老人们在山上的阳光里唱歌，很少有人想起那天半夜的钟声。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 tian1 zao3 chen2 lao3 ren2 men5 zai4 shan1 shang4 de5 yang2 guang1 li3 chang4 ge1 hen3 shao3 you3 ren2 xiang3 qi3 na4 tian1 ban4 ye4 de5 zhong1 sheng1
sentences.english: Every morning old people sing there in the sunshine, and few think of the bell that rang that night.

sentences.hanzi: 我在墨西哥工作的第二年，朋友玛丽亚请我去她家过亡灵节。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zai4 mo4 xi1 ge1 gong1 zuo4 de5 di4 er4 nian2 peng2 you5 ma3 li4 ya4 qing3 wo3 qu4 ta1 jia1 guo4 wang2 ling2 jie2
sentences.english: In my second year working in Mexico, my friend Maria invited me home for the Day of the Dead.

sentences.hanzi: 每年十一月一日和二日，是很多墨西哥人纪念死者的日子。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 nian2 shi2 yi1 yue4 yi1 ri4 he2 er4 ri4 shi4 hen3 duo1 mo4 xi1 ge1 ren2 ji4 nian4 si3 zhe3 de5 ri4 zi5
sentences.english: Every year on the first and second of November, many Mexicans remember their dead.

sentences.hanzi: 我以为这是一种严肃的仪式，大家都穿着黑衣服，很安静。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 yi3 wei2 zhe4 shi4 yi1 zhong3 yan2 su4 de5 yi2 shi4 da4 jia1 dou1 chuan1 zhe5 hei1 yi1 fu5 hen3 an1 jing4
sentences.english: I assumed it was a solemn ceremony, with everyone in black and very quiet.

sentences.hanzi: 在中国，我们家清明节去看死去的家人，有点像葬礼。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 zhong1 guo2 wo3 men5 jia1 qing1 ming2 jie2 qu4 kan4 si3 qu4 de5 jia1 ren2 you3 dian3 xiang4 zang4 li3
sentences.english: Back in China, when my family visits our dead relatives at Qingming, it's a little like a funeral.

sentences.hanzi: 可是一进门，我吓了一跳。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 yi1 jin4 men2 wo3 xia4 le5 yi1 tiao4
sentences.english: But when I walked in I got a shock.

sentences.hanzi: 屋里到处是黄色的花，桌子上放满了吃的。
sentences.pinyin: wu1 li3 dao4 chu4 shi4 huang2 se4 de5 hua1 zhuo1 zi5 shang4 fang4 man3 le5 chi1 de5
sentences.english: There were yellow flowers everywhere and the table was covered with food.

sentences.hanzi: 还有一些骨头样子的小人，打扮得很漂亮，笑得很开心。
sentences.pinyin: hai2 you3 yi1 xie1 gu3 tou5 yang4 zi5 de5 xiao3 ren2 da3 ban5 de5 hen3 piao4 liang5 xiao4 de5 hen3 kai1 xin1
sentences.english: There were also little skeleton figures, dressed up beautifully and grinning happily.

sentences.hanzi: 桌子中间放着几张照片。
sentences.pinyin: zhuo1 zi5 zhong1 jian1 fang4 zhe5 ji3 zhang1 zhao4 pian4
sentences.english: In the middle of the table stood several photographs.

sentences.hanzi: “这是我爷爷，这是我妈妈。”玛丽亚说，“今天晚上，他们回家来拜访我们。”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 wo3 ye2 ye5 zhe4 shi4 wo3 ma1 ma5 ma3 li4 ya4 shuo1 jin1 tian1 wan3 shang5 ta1 men5 hui2 jia1 lai2 bai4 fang3 wo3 men5
sentences.english: “This is my grandfather, and this is my mother,” Maria said. “Tonight they come home to visit us.”

sentences.hanzi: “爷爷爱喝酒，所以放了酒。妈妈爱吃巧克力，所以放了巧克力。”
sentences.pinyin: ye2 ye5 ai4 he1 jiu3 suo3 yi3 fang4 le5 jiu3 ma1 ma5 ai4 chi1 qiao3 ke4 li4 suo3 yi3 fang4 le5 qiao3 ke4 li4
sentences.english: “Grandpa loved a drink, so there's alcohol. Mum loved chocolate, so there's chocolate.”

sentences.hanzi: 我突然想起来，清明节的时候，我们也给死去的人敬酒，带他们爱吃的菜。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 tu1 ran2 xiang3 qi3 lai5 qing1 ming2 jie2 de5 shi2 hou5 wo3 men5 ye3 gei3 si3 qu4 de5 ren2 jing4 jiu3 dai4 ta1 men5 ai4 chi1 de5 cai4
sentences.english: It suddenly struck me that at Qingming we too offer the dead a drink and bring the dishes they liked.

sentences.hanzi: 只是我们家的人都低着头，很悲伤，很少有人笑。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 wo3 men5 jia1 de5 ren2 dou1 di1 zhe5 tou2 hen3 bei1 shang1 hen3 shao3 you3 ren2 xiao4
sentences.english: Only in my family we keep our heads bowed, full of sorrow, and few of us smile.

sentences.hanzi: 看着这些照片，我有点不安。我爸爸去世三年了。
sentences.pinyin: kan4 zhe5 zhe4 xie1 zhao4 pian4 wo3 you3 dian3 bu4 an1 wo3 ba4 ba5 qu4 shi4 san1 nian2 le5
sentences.english: Looking at the photographs, I felt uneasy. My father has been dead for three years.

sentences.hanzi: 今年清明节，我在墨西哥，没有回去。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 nian2 qing1 ming2 jie2 wo3 zai4 mo4 xi1 ge1 mei2 you3 hui2 qu5
sentences.english: This year at Qingming I was in Mexico and didn't go back.

sentences.hanzi: 玛丽亚的奶奶看我不说话，拉起我的手：“你有家人走了吗？”
sentences.pinyin: ma3 li4 ya4 de5 nai3 nai5 kan4 wo3 bu4 shuo1 hua4 la1 qi3 wo3 de5 shou3 ni3 you3 jia1 ren2 zou3 le5 ma5
sentences.english: Seeing me silent, Maria's grandmother took my hand. “Have you lost someone?”

sentences.hanzi: 我点点头，说起了我爸爸。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 dian3 dian3 tou2 shuo1 qi3 le5 wo3 ba4 ba5
sentences.english: I nodded and began to talk about my father.

sentences.hanzi: 老人没有安慰我，只让我把他的照片放到桌子上。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ren2 mei2 you3 an1 wei4 wo3 zhi3 rang4 wo3 ba3 ta1 de5 zhao4 pian4 fang4 dao4 zhuo1 zi5 shang4
sentences.english: She didn't try to comfort me. She only told me to put his photograph on the table.

sentences.hanzi: 我手机里有他的照片，玛丽亚马上拿去印了出来。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shou3 ji1 li3 you3 ta1 de5 zhao4 pian4 ma3 li4 ya4 ma3 shang4 na2 qu4 yin4 le5 chu1 lai2
sentences.english: I had his picture on my phone, and Maria took it right away and printed it.

sentences.hanzi: “他喜欢吃什么？”老人微笑着问。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xi3 huan5 chi1 shen2 me5 lao3 ren2 wei1 xiao4 zhe5 wen4
sentences.english: “What did he like to eat?” the old woman asked with a smile.

sentences.hanzi: “他喜欢喝茶。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xi3 huan5 he1 cha2
sentences.english: “He liked to drink tea.”

sentences.hanzi: 于是桌子上多了一杯热茶。
sentences.pinyin: yu2 shi4 zhuo1 zi5 shang4 duo1 le5 yi1 bei1 re4 cha2
sentences.english: So a cup of hot tea joined the table.

sentences.hanzi: 晚上，大家把黄色的花从门口一路撒到桌子前。
sentences.pinyin: wan3 shang5 da4 jia1 ba3 huang2 se4 de5 hua1 cong2 men2 kou3 yi1 lu4 sa1 dao4 zhuo1 zi5 qian2
sentences.english: That evening everyone scattered yellow flowers in a trail from the door to the table.

sentences.hanzi: 玛丽亚说，死者看到花，闻到香味，就知道回家的路。
sentences.pinyin: ma3 li4 ya4 shuo1 si3 zhe3 kan4 dao4 hua1 wen2 dao4 xiang1 wei4 jiu4 zhi1 dao4 hui2 jia1 de5 lu4
sentences.english: Maria said the dead see the flowers and smell their scent, and so know the way home.

sentences.hanzi: 老人撒完了花，想了想，又抓了一大把，走到外面的街上。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ren2 sa1 wan2 le5 hua1 xiang3 le5 xiang3 you4 zhua1 le5 yi1 da4 ba3 zou3 dao4 wai4 mian4 de5 jie1 shang5
sentences.english: When the old woman had finished, she thought for a moment, grabbed another big handful and walked out to the street.

sentences.hanzi: “您去哪里？”我问。
sentences.pinyin: nin2 qu4 na3 li3 wo3 wen4
sentences.english: “Where are you going?” I asked.

sentences.hanzi: 她一边撒花，一边回头对我说：
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yi1 bian1 sa1 hua1 yi1 bian1 hui2 tou2 dui4 wo3 shuo1
sentences.english: Scattering flowers as she went, she turned back and said,

sentences.hanzi: “你爸爸是第一次来墨西哥，路不熟。”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 ba4 ba5 shi4 di4 yi1 ci4 lai2 mo4 xi1 ge1 lu4 bu4 shu2
sentences.english: “It's your father's first time in Mexico. He doesn't know the way.”

sentences.hanzi: “要多放一点。”
sentences.pinyin: yao4 duo1 fang4 yi1 dian3
sentences.english: “We need to put down a few more.”

title: 一千年后的人
titlePinyin: yi1 qian1 nian2 hou4 de5 ren2
titleEnglish: The People of a Thousand Years Later

sentences.hanzi: 我十五岁那年，来到敦煌，做了和尚。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shi2 wu3 sui4 na4 nian2 lai2 dao4 dun1 huang2 zuo4 le5 he2 shang5
sentences.english: When I was fifteen I came to Dunhuang and became a monk.

sentences.hanzi: 敦煌的山上有几百个洞，洞里画满了佛像。
sentences.pinyin: dun1 huang2 de5 shan1 shang4 you3 ji3 bai3 ge4 dong4 dong4 li3 hua4 man3 le5 fo2 xiang4
sentences.english: In the cliffs at Dunhuang there are hundreds of caves, painted all over with Buddhas.

sentences.hanzi: 我的工作是跟着老和尚整理书。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 de5 gong1 zuo4 shi4 gen1 zhe5 lao3 he2 shang5 zheng3 li3 shu1
sentences.english: My job was to help the old monk look after the books.

sentences.hanzi: 那年春天，从西边来的人说，一座大城的士兵被打败了，城被摧毁，书都被烧了。
sentences.pinyin: na4 nian2 chun1 tian1 cong2 xi1 bian1 lai2 de5 ren2 shuo1 yi1 zuo4 da4 cheng2 de5 shi4 bing1 bei4 da3 bai4 le5 cheng2 bei4 cui1 hui3 shu1 dou1 bei4 shao1 le5
sentences.english: That spring, travellers from the west said a great city's soldiers had been defeated, the city destroyed and its books burned.

sentences.hanzi: 说不定，战争很快就会来到敦煌，士兵会四处搜查。大家都很不安。
sentences.pinyin: shuo1 bu5 ding4 zhan4 zheng1 hen3 kuai4 jiu4 hui4 lai2 dao4 dun1 huang2 shi4 bing1 hui4 si4 chu4 sou1 cha2 da4 jia1 dou1 hen3 bu4 an1
sentences.english: Perhaps war would soon reach Dunhuang, and soldiers would search everywhere. Everyone was uneasy.

sentences.hanzi: 一天凌晨，老和尚把我和一个画画的朋友叫到一个小洞里。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 tian1 ling2 chen2 lao3 he2 shang5 ba3 wo3 he2 yi1 ge5 hua4 hua4 de5 peng2 you5 jiao4 dao4 yi1 ge5 xiao3 dong4 li3
sentences.english: One day before dawn, the old monk called me and a painter friend into a small cave.

sentences.hanzi: “今晚开始，把书都运进来，隐藏起来。”他说。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 wan3 kai1 shi3 ba3 shu1 dou1 yun4 jin4 lai2 yin3 cang2 qi3 lai5 ta1 shuo1
sentences.english: “Starting tonight, bring all the books in here and hide them,” he said.

sentences.hanzi: 我们怀里抱着书，运了整整三夜，运进去好几万卷。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 huai2 li3 bao4 zhe5 shu1 yun4 le5 zheng3 zheng3 san1 ye4 yun4 jin4 qu4 hao3 ji3 wan4 juan3
sentences.english: With our arms full of books we carried for three whole nights, tens of thousands of scrolls.

sentences.hanzi: 里面不只有佛经，还有人们的信，买卖的记录，甚至儿童练字的纸。
sentences.pinyin: li3 mian4 bu4 zhi3 you3 fo2 jing1 hai2 you3 ren2 men5 de5 xin4 mai3 mai4 de5 ji4 lu4 shen4 zhi4 er2 tong2 lian4 zi4 de5 zhi3
sentences.english: There weren't only sutras but letters, business records, even sheets where children practised writing.

sentences.hanzi: 我拿起一张孩子写的纸，问：“这个也要保留吗？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 na2 qi3 yi1 zhang1 hai2 zi5 xie3 de5 zhi3 wen4 zhe4 ge5 ye3 yao4 bao3 liu2 ma5
sentences.english: I picked up a sheet written by a child and asked, “Do we keep this too?”

sentences.hanzi: 老和尚说：“今天的人写过的字，一张也不能丢。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 he2 shang5 shuo1 jin1 tian1 de5 ren2 xie3 guo5 de5 zi4 yi1 zhang1 ye3 bu4 neng2 diu1
sentences.english: The old monk said, “Of everything written by people today, not one sheet may be lost.”

sentences.hanzi: “不然，一千年后的人怎么知道我们活过？”
sentences.pinyin: bu4 ran2 yi1 qian1 nian2 hou4 de5 ren2 zen3 me5 zhi1 dao4 wo3 men5 huo2 guo5
sentences.english: “Otherwise, how will the people of a thousand years from now know we lived?”

sentences.hanzi: 运完了，我们建了一面墙，把门封上。
sentences.pinyin: yun4 wan2 le5 wo3 men5 jian4 le5 yi1 mian4 qiang2 ba3 men2 feng1 shang4
sentences.english: When we had finished, we built a wall and sealed the entrance.

sentences.hanzi: 朋友在新墙上画了佛像，看不出一点痕迹。
sentences.pinyin: peng2 you5 zai4 xin1 qiang2 shang4 hua4 le5 fo2 xiang4 kan4 bu4 chu1 yi1 dian3 hen2 ji4
sentences.english: My friend painted Buddhas on the new wall, and not a trace could be seen.

sentences.hanzi: “等战争过去，再打开。”老和尚说，“这件事只有我们三个人知道。”
sentences.pinyin: deng3 zhan4 zheng1 guo4 qu4 zai4 da3 kai1 lao3 he2 shang5 shuo1 zhe4 jian4 shi4 zhi3 you3 wo3 men5 san1 ge4 ren2 zhi1 dao4
sentences.english: “Open it when the war has passed,” said the old monk. “Only the three of us know about this.”

sentences.hanzi: 很多年过去了。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 nian2 guo4 qu4 le5
sentences.english: Many years went by.

sentences.hanzi: 老和尚去世了，画画的朋友也走了。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 he2 shang5 qu4 shi4 le5 hua4 hua4 de5 peng2 you5 ye3 zou3 le5
sentences.english: The old monk died, and my painter friend passed on too.

sentences.hanzi: 敦煌来了新的主人，说着新的语言。
sentences.pinyin: dun1 huang2 lai2 le5 xin1 de5 zhu3 ren2 shuo1 zhe5 xin1 de5 yu3 yan2
sentences.english: Dunhuang got new masters, who spoke a new language.

sentences.hanzi: 现在我老了，知道这面墙的人，只剩下我一个。
sentences.pinyin: xian4 zai4 wo3 lao3 le5 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 mian4 qiang2 de5 ren2 zhi3 sheng4 xia4 wo3 yi1 ge5
sentences.english: Now I am old, and I alone remain who knows about this wall.

sentences.hanzi: 平时常有人问我：“以前这里的书都去哪里了？”
sentences.pinyin: ping2 shi2 chang2 you3 ren2 wen4 wo3 yi3 qian2 zhe4 li3 de5 shu1 dou1 qu4 na3 li3 le5
sentences.english: People often ask me, “Where did all the old books here go?”

sentences.hanzi: 我可以说出来。那样，书也许有人读，也许被人烧。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 ke3 yi3 shuo1 chu1 lai2 na4 yang4 shu1 ye3 xu3 you3 ren2 du2 ye3 xu3 bei4 ren2 shao1
sentences.english: I could tell them. Then the books might be read, or might be burned.

sentences.hanzi: 我也可以沉默。那样，我死了以后，它们就没有人知道了。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 ye3 ke3 yi3 chen2 mo4 na4 yang4 wo3 si3 le5 yi3 hou4 ta1 men5 jiu4 mei2 you3 ren2 zhi1 dao4 le5
sentences.english: Or I could stay silent. Then, once I died, no one would know of them.

sentences.hanzi: 两种后果，我都怕。
sentences.pinyin: liang3 zhong3 hou4 guo3 wo3 dou1 pa4
sentences.english: I feared both outcomes.

sentences.hanzi: 我一个人走到那面墙前，站了很久。朋友画的佛像依然在微笑。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 yi1 ge5 ren2 zou3 dao4 na4 mian4 qiang2 qian2 zhan4 le5 hen3 jiu3 peng2 you5 hua4 de5 fo2 xiang4 yi1 ran2 zai4 wei1 xiao4
sentences.english: I went to that wall alone, and stood for a long time. The Buddhas my friend painted were still smiling.

sentences.hanzi: 我想起那张孩子写的纸。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 qi3 na4 zhang1 hai2 zi5 xie3 de5 zhi3
sentences.english: I thought of the sheet written by that child.

sentences.hanzi: 如果今天打开，它只是一张没用的纸。
sentences.pinyin: ru2 guo3 jin1 tian1 da3 kai1 ta1 zhi3 shi4 yi1 zhang1 mei2 yong4 de5 zhi3
sentences.english: Opened today, it is a useless piece of paper.

sentences.hanzi: 如果一千年后打开，它就是一个孩子活过的证据。我这才懂得了老和尚的话。
sentences.pinyin: ru2 guo3 yi1 qian1 nian2 hou4 da3 kai1 ta1 jiu4 shi4 yi1 ge5 hai2 zi5 huo2 guo5 de5 zheng4 ju4 wo3 zhe4 cai2 dong3 de5 le5 lao3 he2 shang5 de5 hua4
sentences.english: Opened a thousand years from now, it is proof that a child once lived. Only then did I understand the old monk's words.

sentences.hanzi: 我什么也没有说。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shen2 me5 ye3 mei2 you3 shuo1
sentences.english: I said nothing.

sentences.hanzi: 将近九百年以后，一九零零年，有人在清理这些洞的时候，发现墙后面是空的。
sentences.pinyin: jiang1 jin4 jiu3 bai3 nian2 yi3 hou4 yi1 jiu3 ling2 ling2 nian2 you3 ren2 zai4 qing1 li3 zhe4 xie1 dong4 de5 shi2 hou5 fa1 xian4 qiang2 hou4 mian5 shi4 kong1 de5
sentences.english: Nearly nine hundred years later, in 1900, someone clearing out the caves discovered the wall was hollow.

sentences.hanzi: 门打开了，五万多件东西出现在眼前。
sentences.pinyin: men2 da3 kai1 le5 wu3 wan4 duo1 jian4 dong1 xi5 chu1 xian4 zai4 yan3 qian2
sentences.english: It was opened, and more than fifty thousand items came to light.

sentences.hanzi: 今天，没有人知道是谁封了这个洞，也没有人知道为什么。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 mei2 you3 ren2 zhi1 dao4 shi4 shei2 feng1 le5 zhe4 ge5 dong4 ye3 mei2 you3 ren2 zhi1 dao4 wei4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: Today no one knows who sealed the cave, or why.

sentences.hanzi: 里面有很多孩子练字的纸，一张也没有丢。
sentences.pinyin: li3 mian4 you3 hen3 duo1 hai2 zi5 lian4 zi4 de5 zhi3 yi1 zhang1 ye3 mei2 you3 diu1
sentences.english: Inside were many sheets of children's writing practice. Not one had been lost.

glossed.meaning: Dunhuang, an oasis town on the Silk Road

title: 看不懂的纸
titleEnglish: The Paper No One Could Read

sentences.hanzi: 我坐火车到山西的平遥，一下车就看见了高高的城墙。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zuo4 huo3 che1 dao4 shan1 xi1 de5 ping2 yao2 yi1 xia4 che1 jiu4 kan4 jian4 le5 gao1 gao1 de5 cheng2 qiang2
sentences.english: I took the train to Pingyao in Shanxi, and as soon as I got off I saw its high city walls.

sentences.hanzi: 这座城的墙是六百多年前建的，还很完整。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 zuo4 cheng2 de5 qiang2 shi4 liu4 bai3 duo1 nian2 qian2 jian4 de5 hai2 hen3 wan2 zheng3
sentences.english: The walls were built over six hundred years ago and are still complete.

sentences.hanzi: 城里有一条大街，街上有一个很小的门，上面写着“日升昌”三个字。
sentences.pinyin: cheng2 li3 you3 yi1 tiao2 da4 jie1 jie1 shang5 you3 yi1 ge5 hen3 xiao3 de5 men2 shang4 mian4 xie3 zhe5 ri4 sheng1 chang1 san1 ge4 zi4
sentences.english: On a main street in town is a small gateway with three characters above it: Rishengchang.

sentences.hanzi: 我差点从门口走过去，可是当地的朋友拉住了我。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 cha4 dian3 cong2 men2 kou3 zou3 guo4 qu4 ke3 shi4 dang1 di4 de5 peng2 you5 la1 zhu4 le5 wo3
sentences.english: I nearly walked past the door, but my local friend held me back.

sentences.hanzi: “别小看这个门，”她说，“中国的银行是从这里开始的。”
sentences.pinyin: bie2 xiao3 kan4 zhe4 ge5 men2 ta1 shuo1 zhong1 guo2 de5 yin2 hang2 shi4 cong2 zhe4 li3 kai1 shi3 de5
sentences.english: “Don't underestimate this door,” she said. “Chinese banking started here.”

sentences.hanzi: 两百多年前，山西的生意人走遍全国，赚了大量的钱。
sentences.pinyin: liang3 bai3 duo1 nian2 qian2 shan1 xi1 de5 sheng1 yi5 ren2 zou3 bian4 quan2 guo2 zhuan4 le5 da4 liang4 de5 qian2
sentences.english: Over two hundred years ago, Shanxi merchants travelled the whole country and made huge amounts of money.

sentences.hanzi: 可是他们有一个大麻烦：钱。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ta1 men5 you3 yi1 ge5 da4 ma2 fan5 qian2
sentences.english: But they had one big problem: money.

sentences.hanzi: 那时候的钱又重又多，要用马车运，请人保护又很贵。
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi2 hou5 de5 qian2 you4 zhong4 you4 duo1 yao4 yong4 ma3 che1 yun4 qing3 ren2 bao3 hu4 you4 hen3 gui4
sentences.english: Money was heavy and bulky then. It had to go by horse cart, and hiring guards was expensive.

sentences.hanzi: 路上抢劫的人很多，风险太大，一车钱常常就这样没了。
sentences.pinyin: lu4 shang5 qiang3 jie2 de5 ren2 hen3 duo1 feng1 xian3 tai4 da4 yi1 che1 qian2 chang2 chang2 jiu4 zhe4 yang4 mei2 le5
sentences.english: There were many robbers on the road, and with the risk so great, a cartload of money could easily vanish.

sentences.hanzi: 一个叫雷履泰的人想：为什么要让钱走路呢？
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 jiao4 lei2 lu:3 tai4 de5 ren2 xiang3 wei4 shen2 me5 yao4 rang4 qian2 zou3 lu4 ne5
sentences.english: A man called Lei Lütai thought: why should money have to travel?

sentences.hanzi: 你在平遥把钱交给我，我给你一张纸。
sentences.pinyin: ni3 zai4 ping2 yao2 ba3 qian2 jiao1 gei3 wo3 wo3 gei3 ni3 yi1 zhang1 zhi3
sentences.english: You give me money in Pingyao, and I give you a piece of paper.

sentences.hanzi: 你带着这张纸到北京，我的人就把钱给你。
sentences.pinyin: ni3 dai4 zhe5 zhe4 zhang1 zhi3 dao4 bei3 jing1 wo3 de5 ren2 jiu4 ba3 qian2 gei3 ni3
sentences.english: You take that paper to Beijing, and my people hand you the money.

sentences.hanzi: 这张纸就等于钱。钱不用走路，一张纸就能穿过大半个中国。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 zhang1 zhi3 jiu4 deng3 yu2 qian2 qian2 bu4 yong4 zou3 lu4 yi1 zhang1 zhi3 jiu4 neng2 chuan1 guo4 da4 ban4 ge4 zhong1 guo2
sentences.english: The paper equals money. The money doesn't need to travel: one sheet of paper can cross half of China.

sentences.hanzi: 一八二三年，日升昌开门了。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ba1 er4 san1 nian2 ri4 sheng1 chang1 kai1 men2 le5
sentences.english: In 1823, Rishengchang opened its doors.

sentences.hanzi: 不久，这样的店开遍了全国，人们叫它票号。
sentences.pinyin: bu4 jiu3 zhe4 yang4 de5 dian4 kai1 bian4 le5 quan2 guo2 ren2 men5 jiao4 ta1 piao4 hao4
sentences.english: Soon shops like it had spread across the country, and people called them piaohao.

sentences.hanzi: 可是问题又来了：纸可以写假的，总有人想欺骗他们。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 wen4 ti2 you4 lai2 le5 zhi3 ke3 yi3 xie3 jia3 de5 zong3 you3 ren2 xiang3 qi1 pian4 ta1 men5
sentences.english: But a new problem appeared: paper can be forged, and there were always people trying to cheat them.

sentences.hanzi: 骗子只要写一张假票，就能把钱拿走。
sentences.pinyin: pian4 zi5 zhi3 yao4 xie3 yi1 zhang1 jia3 piao4 jiu4 neng2 ba3 qian2 na2 zou3
sentences.english: A swindler need only write a fake draft to walk off with the money.

sentences.hanzi: 于是，他们发明了密码。
sentences.pinyin: yu2 shi4 ta1 men5 fa1 ming2 le5 mi4 ma3
sentences.english: So they invented a code.

sentences.hanzi: 表面上，每张票上只有几个普通的字，其实它们代表日子和钱数。
sentences.pinyin: biao3 mian4 shang4 mei3 zhang1 piao4 shang4 zhi3 you3 ji3 ge4 pu3 tong1 de5 zi4 qi2 shi2 ta1 men5 dai4 biao3 ri4 zi5 he2 qian2 shu4
sentences.english: On the surface, each draft carried a few ordinary characters, but in fact they stood for the date and the amount.

sentences.hanzi: 管理很严格，这些字是从几句话里选出来的，只有内部的人知道，而且常常换。
sentences.pinyin: guan3 li3 hen3 yan2 ge2 zhe4 xie1 zi4 shi4 cong2 ji3 ju4 hua4 li3 xuan3 chu1 lai2 de5 zhi3 you3 nei4 bu4 de5 ren2 zhi1 dao4 er2 qie3 chang2 chang2 huan4
sentences.english: Management was strict: the characters were chosen from a few lines known only to insiders, and they were changed often.

sentences.hanzi: 写票的人也只有那么几个，各地的店都认识他们的字，可以证实票是真的。
sentences.pinyin: xie3 piao4 de5 ren2 ye3 zhi3 you3 na4 me5 ji3 ge4 ge4 di4 de5 dian4 dou1 ren4 shi5 ta1 men5 de5 zi4 ke3 yi3 zheng4 shi2 piao4 shi4 zhen1 de5
sentences.english: Only a few people wrote the drafts, too, and branches everywhere knew their handwriting and could confirm a draft was real.

sentences.hanzi: 所以大家都觉得票号很可靠。
sentences.pinyin: suo3 yi3 da4 jia1 dou1 jue2 de5 piao4 hao4 hen3 ke3 kao4
sentences.english: So everyone felt the piaohao were reliable.

sentences.hanzi: 后来，随着新银行的到来，票号慢慢消失，日升昌也在一九三二年关了门。
sentences.pinyin: hou4 lai2 sui2 zhe5 xin1 yin2 hang2 de5 dao4 lai2 piao4 hao4 man4 man4 xiao1 shi1 ri4 sheng1 chang1 ye3 zai4 yi1 jiu3 san1 er4 nian2 guan1 le5 men2
sentences.english: Later, with the arrival of modern banks, the piaohao slowly disappeared, and Rishengchang closed in 1932.

sentences.hanzi: 今天，屋子里还保留着当年的老票。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wu1 zi5 li3 hai2 bao3 liu2 zhe5 dang1 nian2 de5 lao3 piao4
sentences.english: Today the old drafts are still preserved in its rooms.

sentences.hanzi: 朋友指着一张问我：“这张是几月几日的？写了多少钱？”
sentences.pinyin: peng2 you5 zhi3 zhe5 yi1 zhang1 wen4 wo3 zhe4 zhang1 shi4 ji3 yue4 ji3 ri4 de5 xie3 le5 duo1 shao5 qian2
sentences.english: My friend pointed to one and asked, “What date is this? How much money is it for?”

sentences.hanzi: 我看了半天。每个字我都认识，可是依然看不懂。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 kan4 le5 ban4 tian1 mei3 ge5 zi4 wo3 dou1 ren4 shi5 ke3 shi4 yi1 ran2 kan4 bu4 dong3
sentences.english: I looked for a long time. I knew every character, but I still couldn't make sense of it.

sentences.hanzi: 我拿出手机想查一下，手机却要我先输密码。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 na2 chu1 shou3 ji1 xiang3 cha2 yi1 xia4 shou3 ji1 que4 yao4 wo3 xian1 shu1 mi4 ma3
sentences.english: I took out my phone to look it up, but first it wanted my passcode.

sentences.hanzi: 朋友笑了：“看不懂就对了。两百年前的骗子也看不懂。”
sentences.pinyin: peng2 you5 xiao4 le5 kan4 bu4 dong3 jiu4 dui4 le5 liang3 bai3 nian2 qian2 de5 pian4 zi5 ye3 kan4 bu4 dong3
sentences.english: My friend laughed. “You're supposed to be baffled. The swindlers of two hundred years ago were too.”

Pingyao, an old walled town in Shanxi

sentences.hanzi: 每个人一生只有一次机会，向过去的自己发一句话。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 ge5 ren2 yi1 sheng1 zhi3 you3 yi1 ci4 ji1 hui4 xiang4 guo4 qu4 de5 zi4 ji3 fa1 yi1 ju4 hua4
sentences.english: Everyone gets one chance in life to send one sentence to their past self.

sentences.hanzi: 规定很严格：只能发一句，不能超过十个字。
sentences.pinyin: gui1 ding4 hen3 yan2 ge2 zhi3 neng2 fa1 yi1 ju4 bu4 neng2 chao1 guo4 shi2 ge4 zi4
sentences.english: The rules are strict: one sentence only, ten characters at most.

sentences.hanzi: 刚开始的时候，大家都高兴得发疯。
sentences.pinyin: gang1 kai1 shi3 de5 shi2 hou5 da4 jia1 dou1 gao1 xing4 de5 fa1 feng1
sentences.english: At first everyone went mad with joy.

sentences.hanzi: 有人告诉自己别结婚，有人告诉自己去买房子。
sentences.pinyin: you3 ren2 gao4 su5 zi4 ji3 bie2 jie2 hun1 you3 ren2 gao4 su5 zi4 ji3 qu4 mai3 fang2 zi5
sentences.english: Some told themselves not to marry, some told themselves to buy a house.

sentences.hanzi: 奇怪的是，世界一点也没有变。
sentences.pinyin: qi2 guai4 de5 shi4 shi4 jie4 yi1 dian3 ye3 mei2 you3 bian4
sentences.english: Strangely, the world did not change at all.

sentences.hanzi: 后来，科学家的实验证实：你要发的那句话，你早就收到过了。
sentences.pinyin: hou4 lai2 ke1 xue2 jia1 de5 shi2 yan4 zheng4 shi2 ni3 yao4 fa1 de5 na4 ju4 hua4 ni3 zao3 jiu4 shou1 dao4 guo5 le5
sentences.english: Later, the scientists' experiments proved it: the sentence you are going to send, you have already received.

sentences.hanzi: 一切都是注定的，谁也改变不了。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 qie4 dou1 shi4 zhu4 ding4 de5 shei2 ye3 gai3 bian4 bu4 liao3
sentences.english: It was all fated, and no one could change it.

sentences.hanzi: 我今年四十岁，还没用过这个机会。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 jin1 nian2 si4 shi2 sui4 hai2 mei2 yong4 guo5 zhe4 ge5 ji1 hui4
sentences.english: I am forty and have not yet used my chance.

sentences.hanzi: 我知道自己要发什么，因为我十二岁那年收到过。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zhi1 dao4 zi4 ji3 yao4 fa1 shen2 me5 yin1 wei4 wo3 shi2 er4 sui4 na4 nian2 shou1 dao4 guo5
sentences.english: I know what I'll send, because I received it when I was twelve.

sentences.hanzi: 那天早上，我的手机上出现了五个字：今天陪爸爸。
sentences.pinyin: na4 tian1 zao3 shang5 wo3 de5 shou3 ji1 shang4 chu1 xian4 le5 wu3 ge4 zi4 jin1 tian1 pei2 ba4 ba5
sentences.english: That morning, five characters appeared on my phone: Stay with Dad today.

sentences.hanzi: 我以为是同学开玩笑，可是不知道为什么，那天我没有出门。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 yi3 wei2 shi4 tong2 xue2 kai1 wan2 xiao4 ke3 shi4 bu4 zhi1 dao4 wei4 shen2 me5 na4 tian1 wo3 mei2 you3 chu1 men2
sentences.english: I thought a classmate was joking, but somehow I didn't go out that day.

sentences.hanzi: 我陪爸爸修那辆旧车，给他拿工具，修了一下午。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 pei2 ba4 ba5 xiu1 na4 liang4 jiu4 che1 gei3 ta1 na2 gong1 ju4 xiu1 le5 yi1 xia4 wu3
sentences.english: I helped Dad fix his old car, passing him his tools, all afternoon.

sentences.hanzi: 阳光很好，他一点也不着急，胳膊上都是黑油，偶尔抬头看看我，讲个笑话。
sentences.pinyin: yang2 guang1 hen3 hao3 ta1 yi1 dian3 ye3 bu4 zhao2 ji2 ge1 bo5 shang4 dou1 shi4 hei1 you2 ou3 er3 tai2 tou2 kan4 kan5 wo3 jiang3 ge4 xiao4 hua5
sentences.english: The sun was lovely. He was in no hurry at all. His arms were covered in black oil, and now and then he looked up at me and told a joke.

sentences.hanzi: 第二天早上，他开车去上班，出了车祸，再也没有回来。葬礼那天下着雨。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 zao3 shang5 ta1 kai1 che1 qu4 shang4 ban1 chu1 le5 che1 huo4 zai4 ye3 mei2 you3 hui2 lai5 zang4 li3 na4 tian1 xia4 zhe5 yu3
sentences.english: The next morning he drove to work, had a crash, and never came home. It rained on the day of the funeral.

sentences.hanzi: 这二十八年，我一直恨发这句话的人。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 er4 shi2 ba1 nian2 wo3 yi1 zhi2 hen4 fa1 zhe4 ju4 hua4 de5 ren2
sentences.english: For twenty-eight years I have hated the person who sent that sentence.

sentences.hanzi: 那个人就是我自己。
sentences.pinyin: na4 ge5 ren2 jiu4 shi4 wo3 zi4 ji3
sentences.english: That person is me.

sentences.hanzi: 我常常想：她明明什么都知道，为什么不告诉我，别让爸爸开车？
