sentences.english: Last of all, he called his mother, seven years ago.

sentences.hanzi: 妈妈说：“快回来吧，我给你做饭。”
sentences.pinyin: ma1 ma5 shuo1 kuai4 hui2 lai5 ba5 wo3 gei3 ni3 zuo4 fan4
sentences.english: She said, "Come home soon. I'll cook for you."

sentences.hanzi: 老李没有说话，只是一直听。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 li3 mei2 you3 shuo1 hua4 zhi3 shi4 yi1 zhi2 ting1
sentences.english: Old Li said nothing. He just kept listening.

title: 从长安到印度
titlePinyin: cong2 chang2 an1 dao4 yin4 du4

sentences.hanzi: 玄奘是唐朝人，他想去印度。
sentences.pinyin: xuan2 zang4 shi4 tang2 chao2 ren2 ta1 xiang3 qu4 yin4 du4
sentences.english: Xuanzang lived in the Tang dynasty, and he wanted to go to India.

sentences.hanzi: 从长安到印度非常远。
sentences.pinyin: cong2 chang2 an1 dao4 yin4 du4 fei1 chang2 yuan3
sentences.english: It was very far from Chang'an to India.

sentences.hanzi: 从早到晚，他一直走。
sentences.pinyin: cong2 zao3 dao4 wan3 ta1 yi1 zhi2 zou3
sentences.english: From morning to night, he kept walking.

sentences.hanzi: 从离开长安到回来，他用了十七年。
sentences.pinyin: cong2 li2 kai1 chang2 an1 dao4 hui2 lai5 ta1 yong4 le5 shi2 qi1 nian2
sentences.english: From leaving Chang'an to coming back, it took him seventeen years.

sentences.hanzi: 从唐朝到现在，中国人都记得他的名字。
sentences.pinyin: cong2 tang2 chao2 dao4 xian4 zai4 zhong1 guo2 ren2 dou1 ji4 de5 ta1 de5 ming2 zi5
sentences.english: From the Tang dynasty to today, Chinese people have remembered his name.

sentences.hanzi: 我在新疆坐车去喀什。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zai4 xin1 jiang1 zuo4 che1 qu4 ka1 shi2
sentences.english: I was going to Kashgar by road, in Xinjiang.

sentences.hanzi: 我问一位老人：“请问，这里离喀什远吗？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wen4 yi1 wei4 lao3 ren2 qing3 wen4 zhe4 li3 li2 ka1 shi2 yuan3 ma5
sentences.english: I asked an old man, "Excuse me, is it far from here to Kashgar?"

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“不远，很近。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 bu4 yuan3 hen3 jin4
sentences.english: He said, "Not far. Very close."

sentences.hanzi: 我坐了七个小时的车，还没到。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zuo4 le5 qi1 ge4 xiao3 shi2 de5 che1 hai2 mei2 dao4
sentences.english: I rode for seven hours and still hadn't arrived.

sentences.hanzi: 我又问一个人：“这里离喀什还远吗？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 you4 wen4 yi1 ge5 ren2 zhe4 li3 li2 ka1 shi2 hai2 yuan3 ma5
sentences.english: I asked someone else, "Is it still far from here to Kashgar?"

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“不远了，喀什离这里很近。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 bu4 yuan3 le5 ka1 shi2 li2 zhe4 li3 hen3 jin4
sentences.english: He said, "Not far now. Kashgar is very close to here."

sentences.hanzi: 又过了三个小时，我到了。
sentences.pinyin: you4 guo4 le5 san1 ge4 xiao3 shi2 wo3 dao4 le5
sentences.english: Three hours later, I arrived.

sentences.hanzi: 喀什的朋友说：“我家离这里很近，只要九个小时！”
sentences.pinyin: ka1 shi2 de5 peng2 you5 shuo1 wo3 jia1 li2 zhe4 li3 hen3 jin4 zhi3 yao4 jiu3 ge4 xiao3 shi2
sentences.english: My friend in Kashgar said, "My home is very close to here, just nine hours!"

sentences.hanzi: 在北京，我问一位老人：“请问，故宫怎么走？”
sentences.pinyin: zai4 bei3 jing1 wo3 wen4 yi1 wei4 lao3 ren2 qing3 wen4 gu4 gong1 zen3 me5 zou3
sentences.english: In Beijing I asked an old man, "Excuse me, how do I get to the Forbidden City?"

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“往北走，到了前面，再往东走。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 wang3 bei3 zou3 dao4 le5 qian2 mian4 zai4 wang3 dong1 zou3
sentences.english: He said, "Go north, and when you get up ahead, go east."

sentences.hanzi: 我说：“对不起，往北是往左走，还是往右走？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 dui4 bu5 qi3 wang3 bei3 shi4 wang3 zuo3 zou3 hai2 shi5 wang3 you4 zou3
sentences.english: I said, "Sorry, is north to the left or to the right?"

sentences.hanzi: 老人想了想，说：“这个我不知道。在北京，我们只知道东南西北。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ren2 xiang3 le5 xiang3 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 wo3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 zai4 bei3 jing1 wo3 men5 zhi3 zhi1 dao4 dong1 nan2 xi1 bei3
sentences.english: The old man thought and said, "That I don't know. In Beijing we only know north, south, east and west."

title: 他们对什么感兴趣
titlePinyin: ta1 men5 dui4 shen2 me5 gan3 xing4 qu4

sentences.hanzi: 外星人到了地球。
sentences.pinyin: wai4 xing1 ren2 dao4 le5 di4 qiu2
sentences.english: Aliens arrived on Earth.

sentences.hanzi: 大家问：“你们对什么感兴趣？”
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 wen4 ni3 men5 dui4 shen2 me5 gan3 xing4 qu4
sentences.english: Everyone asked, "What are you interested in?"

sentences.hanzi: 他们对我们的车不感兴趣。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 dui4 wo3 men5 de5 che1 bu4 gan3 xing4 qu4
sentences.english: They weren't interested in our cars.

sentences.hanzi: 他们对我们的钱也不感兴趣。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 dui4 wo3 men5 de5 qian2 ye3 bu4 gan3 xing4 qu4
sentences.english: They weren't interested in our money either.

sentences.hanzi: 最后，一个小外星人吃了一个饺子。
sentences.pinyin: zui4 hou4 yi1 ge5 xiao3 wai4 xing1 ren2 chi1 le5 yi1 ge5 jiao3 zi5
sentences.english: At last a small alien ate a dumpling.

sentences.hanzi: 它看了看大家，说：“我们对这个很感兴趣。你们还有多少？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 le5 kan4 da4 jia1 shuo1 wo3 men5 dui4 zhe4 ge5 hen3 gan3 xing4 qu4 ni3 men5 hai2 you3 duo1 shao5
sentences.english: It looked round at everyone and said, "We're very interested in this. How many more do you have?"

sentences.hanzi: 苏武是汉朝人。
sentences.pinyin: su1 wu3 shi4 han4 chao2 ren2
sentences.english: Su Wu lived in the Han dynasty.

sentences.hanzi: 他去了匈奴，可是匈奴人不让他回家。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 qu4 le5 xiong1 nu2 ke3 shi4 xiong1 nu2 ren2 bu4 rang4 ta1 hui2 jia1
sentences.english: He went to the Xiongnu, but they wouldn't let him go home.

sentences.hanzi: 他们说：“别走了，我们给你钱。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 shuo1 bie2 zou3 le5 wo3 men5 gei3 ni3 qian2
sentences.english: They said, "Don't leave, and we'll give you money."

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“不。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 bu4
sentences.english: He said, "No."

sentences.hanzi: 他们就让他去北方放羊。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 jiu4 rang4 ta1 qu4 bei3 fang1 fang4 yang2
sentences.english: So they sent him north to herd sheep.

sentences.hanzi: 他在那里住了十九年。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zai4 na4 li5 zhu4 le5 shi2 jiu3 nian2
sentences.english: He lived there for nineteen years.

sentences.hanzi: 他放了十九年羊，等了十九年，也想了十九年家。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 fang4 le5 shi2 jiu3 nian2 yang2 deng3 le5 shi2 jiu3 nian2 ye3 xiang3 le5 shi2 jiu3 nian2 jia1
sentences.english: He herded sheep for nineteen years, waited for nineteen years, and missed home for nineteen years.

sentences.hanzi: 回家的时候，他已经老了。
sentences.pinyin: hui2 jia1 de5 shi2 hou5 ta1 yi3 jing1 lao3 le5
sentences.english: By the time he came home, he was old.

sentences.hanzi: 今天我七点起来，八点吃东西。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 qi1 dian3 qi3 lai5 ba1 dian3 chi1 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: Today I got up at seven and ate at eight.

sentences.hanzi: 九点我坐上时间机器，去了两千年前。
sentences.pinyin: jiu3 dian3 wo3 zuo4 shang4 shi2 jian1 ji1 qi4 qu4 le5 liang3 qian1 nian2 qian2
sentences.english: At nine I got into the time machine and went back two thousand years.

sentences.hanzi: 两点我在长城上看人工作。
sentences.pinyin: liang3 dian3 wo3 zai4 chang2 cheng2 shang4 kan4 ren2 gong1 zuo4
sentences.english: At two I was on the Great Wall, watching people work.

sentences.hanzi: 三点我在那里跟他们一起吃东西。
sentences.pinyin: san1 dian3 wo3 zai4 na4 li5 gen1 ta1 men5 yi1 qi3 chi1 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: At three I ate with them there.

sentences.hanzi: 七点我回来了。
sentences.pinyin: qi1 dian3 wo3 hui2 lai5 le5
sentences.english: At seven I came back.

sentences.hanzi: 但是，这是早上七点，我家有一个人刚起来。
sentences.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zhe4 shi4 zao3 shang5 qi1 dian3 wo3 jia1 you3 yi1 ge5 ren2 gang1 qi3 lai5
sentences.english: But it was seven in the morning, and someone at my home had just got up.

sentences.hanzi: 那个人是我！
sentences.pinyin: na4 ge5 ren2 shi4 wo3
sentences.english: That person was me!

sentences.hanzi: 我只会说三句中文。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zhi3 hui4 shuo1 san1 ju4 zhong1 wen2
sentences.english: I can only say three sentences of Chinese.

sentences.hanzi: 在北京，我对一位老人说：“你好！”
sentences.pinyin: zai4 bei3 jing1 wo3 dui4 yi1 wei4 lao3 ren2 shuo1 ni3 hao3
sentences.english: In Beijing I said to an old man, "Hello!"

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“你说中文说得真好！”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 ni3 shuo1 zhong1 wen2 shuo1 de5 zhen1 hao3
sentences.english: He said, "You speak Chinese really well!"

sentences.hanzi: 我说：“谢谢！”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 xie4 xie5
sentences.english: I said, "Thank you!"

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“你说得非常清楚！你说得比我还好！”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 ni3 shuo1 de5 fei1 chang2 qing1 chu5 ni3 shuo1 de5 bi3 wo3 hai2 hao3
sentences.english: He said, "You speak so clearly! You speak better than I do!"

sentences.hanzi: 我说：“再见！”然后我跑了，跑得很快。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 zai4 jian4 ran2 hou4 wo3 pao3 le5 pao3 de5 hen3 kuai4
sentences.english: I said, "Goodbye!" Then I ran off, very fast.

sentences.hanzi: 因为我的中文已经说完了。
sentences.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 de5 zhong1 wen2 yi3 jing1 shuo1 wan2 le5
sentences.english: Because I had run out of Chinese.

title: 门外的老人

sentences.english: In Xi'an I stayed in a very old place.

sentences.hanzi: 我开了门，看见一位老人。

sentences.english: I opened the door and saw an old man.

sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 le5 hen3 duo1 ke3 shi4 wo3 mei2 ting1 dong3

sentences.hanzi: 他说完就走了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 wan2 jiu4 zou3 le5
sentences.english: When he had finished, he left.

sentences.english: The next day I found a friend and repeated what I had heard.

sentences.pinyin: peng2 you5 ting1 wan2 shuo1 zhe4 shi4 tang2 chao2 de5 han4 yu3
sentences.english: When he had heard it, my friend said, "This is Tang dynasty Chinese!"

sentences.hanzi: 我和老张找到一个古墓。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 he2 lao3 zhang1 zhao3 dao4 yi1 ge5 gu3 mu4
sentences.english: Old Zhang and I found an ancient tomb.

sentences.hanzi: 老张进去了，我站在外面。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 zhang1 jin4 qu4 le5 wo3 zhan4 zai4 wai4 mian4
sentences.english: Old Zhang went in. I stood outside.

sentences.pinyin: lao3 zhang1 zai4 li3 mian4 shuo1 kuai4 jin4 lai2 zhe4 li3 you3 hao3 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: Old Zhang called from inside, "Come in, quick! There's good stuff here!"

sentences.hanzi: 我说：“我不进去，你出来吧！”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 wo3 bu4 jin4 qu4 ni3 chu1 lai2 ba5
sentences.english: I said, "I'm not going in. You come out!"

sentences.hanzi: 他走出来了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zou3 chu1 lai2 le5
sentences.english: He walked out.

sentences.hanzi: 这时候，里面有人说：“回来！”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 hou5 li3 mian4 you3 ren2 shuo1 hui2 lai5
sentences.english: Just then, someone inside said, "Come back!"

sentences.hanzi: 我去四川的朋友家。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 qu4 si4 chuan1 de5 peng2 you5 jia1
sentences.english: I went to my friend's home in Sichuan.

sentences.hanzi: 朋友的妈妈说话，我听不懂。
sentences.pinyin: peng2 you5 de5 ma1 ma5 shuo1 hua4 wo3 ting1 bu4 dong3
sentences.english: When my friend's mother spoke, I couldn't understand.

sentences.hanzi: 我说中文，她也听不懂。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 zhong1 wen2 ta1 ye3 ting1 bu4 dong3
sentences.english: When I spoke Chinese, she couldn't understand either.

sentences.hanzi: 可是，她给了我很多吃的。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ta1 gei3 le5 wo3 hen3 duo1 chi1 de5
sentences.english: But she gave me lots to eat.

sentences.hanzi: 我说：“太多了，我吃不完！”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 tai4 duo1 le5 wo3 chi1 bu4 wan2
sentences.english: I said, "It's too much, I can't finish it!"

sentences.hanzi: 她又给了我一点。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 you4 gei3 le5 wo3 yi1 dian3
sentences.english: She gave me a bit more.

sentences.hanzi: 朋友说：“我妈说，你吃得完。”
sentences.pinyin: peng2 you5 shuo1 wo3 ma1 shuo1 ni3 chi1 de5 wan2
sentences.english: My friend said, "My mum says you can finish it."

sentences.hanzi: 最后，我吃完了，可是站不起来了。
sentences.pinyin: zui4 hou4 wo3 chi1 wan2 le5 ke3 shi4 zhan4 bu4 qi3 lai5 le5
sentences.english: In the end I finished it, but I couldn't stand up.

sentences.english: Old people say there was once a man called Wang Zhi.

sentences.pinyin: ta1 shang4 shan1 kan4 dao4 liang3 ge4 hai2 zi5 zai4 xia4 qi2
sentences.english: He went up a mountain and saw two children playing chess.

sentences.hanzi: 他想：“我看一下就走。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 wo3 kan4 yi1 xia4 jiu4 zou3
sentences.english: He thought, "I'll just have a quick look and go."

sentences.pinyin: hai2 zi5 shuo1 ni3 zuo4 yi1 xia4 ba5 zai4 kan4 yi1 xia4
sentences.english: The children said, "Sit for a bit, watch a little longer."

sentences.hanzi: 他就坐在那里，看了看。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 zuo4 zai4 na4 li5 kan4 le5 kan4
sentences.english: So he sat there and watched for a little.

sentences.hanzi: 孩子说：“你可以走了。”
sentences.pinyin: hai2 zi5 shuo1 ni3 ke3 yi3 zou3 le5
sentences.english: The children said, "You can go now."

sentences.hanzi: 他下山一看，家没有了，朋友也没有了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xia4 shan1 yi1 kan4 jia1 mei2 you3 le5 peng2 you5 ye3 mei2 you3 le5
sentences.english: He came down the mountain and looked: his home was gone, and so were his friends.

sentences.pinyin: ta1 wen4 le5 yi1 xia4 bie2 ren5
sentences.english: He asked around a little.

sentences.pinyin: bie2 ren5 shuo1 wang2 zhi4 na4 shi4 yi1 bai3 nian2 qian2 de5 ren2
sentences.english: People said, "Wang Zhi? He lived a hundred years ago."

sentences.hanzi: “这件衣服有点儿大，有小一点儿的吗？”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 jian4 yi1 fu5 you3 dian3 r5 da4 you3 xiao3 yi1 dian3 r5 de5 ma5
sentences.english: "This jacket is a bit big. Do you have a slightly smaller one?"

sentences.hanzi: “您看这件。”
sentences.pinyin: nin2 kan4 zhe4 jian4
sentences.english: "Have a look at this one."

sentences.hanzi: “这件有点儿小，有大一点儿的吗？”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 jian4 you3 dian3 r5 xiao3 you3 da4 yi1 dian3 r5 de5 ma5
sentences.english: "This one is a bit small. Do you have a slightly bigger one?"

sentences.hanzi: “您再看这件。”
sentences.pinyin: nin2 zai4 kan4 zhe4 jian4
sentences.english: "Try this one, then."

sentences.hanzi: “太好了！这件不大不小。”
sentences.pinyin: tai4 hao3 le5 zhe4 jian4 bu4 da4 bu4 xiao3
sentences.english: "Wonderful! This one is just right."

sentences.hanzi: 她看了看我，说：“先生，这就是第一件。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 le5 kan4 wo3 shuo1 xian1 sheng5 zhe4 jiu4 shi4 di4 yi1 jian4
sentences.english: She looked at me and said, "Sir, this is the first one."

sentences.hanzi: 二一五零年，我想离开地球。
sentences.pinyin: er4 yi1 wu3 ling2 nian2 wo3 xiang3 li2 kai1 di4 qiu2
sentences.english: In 2150, I wanted to leave Earth.

sentences.hanzi: 一位女士问我：“您去月球还是火星？”
sentences.pinyin: yi1 wei4 nu:3 shi4 wen4 wo3 nin2 qu4 yue4 qiu2 hai2 shi5 huo3 xing1
sentences.english: A lady asked me, "Are you going to the Moon or Mars?"

sentences.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 yue4 qiu2 huo4 zhe3 huo3 xing1 dou1 xing2
sentences.english: I said, "The Moon or Mars, either is fine."

sentences.hanzi: “您今天走还是明天走？”
sentences.pinyin: nin2 jin1 tian1 zou3 hai2 shi5 ming2 tian1 zou3
sentences.english: "Are you leaving today or tomorrow?"

sentences.hanzi: “今天或者明天都行。”
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 huo4 zhe3 ming2 tian1 dou1 xing2
sentences.english: "Today or tomorrow, either is fine."

sentences.hanzi: “您一个人去，还是和妈妈一起去？”
sentences.pinyin: nin2 yi1 ge5 ren2 qu4 hai2 shi5 he2 ma1 ma5 yi1 qi3 qu4
sentences.english: "Are you going alone, or with your mother?"

sentences.hanzi: 我马上说：“一个人！一定是一个人！”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 ma3 shang4 shuo1 yi1 ge5 ren2 yi1 ding4 shi4 yi1 ge5 ren2
sentences.english: I said at once, "Alone! Definitely alone!"

title: 火星上的孩子

sentences.hanzi: 孩子问：“火星上有几个人？”
sentences.pinyin: hai2 zi5 wen4 huo3 xing1 shang4 you3 ji3 ge4 ren2
sentences.english: The child asked, "How many people are on Mars?"

sentences.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 qi1 ge4
sentences.english: I said, "Seven."

sentences.hanzi: “有几个孩子？”
sentences.pinyin: you3 ji3 ge4 hai2 zi5
sentences.english: "How many children?"

sentences.hanzi: “就你一个。”
sentences.pinyin: jiu4 ni3 yi1 ge5
sentences.english: "Only you."

sentences.hanzi: “地球上有多少人？”
sentences.pinyin: di4 qiu2 shang4 you3 duo1 shao5 ren2
sentences.english: "How many people are on Earth?"

sentences.hanzi: “八十亿。”
sentences.pinyin: ba1 shi2 yi4
sentences.english: "Eight billion."

sentences.hanzi: “有多少孩子？”
sentences.pinyin: you3 duo1 shao5 hai2 zi5
sentences.english: "How many children?"

sentences.hanzi: “二十亿。”
sentences.pinyin: er4 shi2 yi4
sentences.english: "Two billion."

sentences.pinyin: bu4 zhi1 dao4 xian4 zai4 shi4 shen2 me5 shi2 hou5
sentences.english: "No idea. What time is it now?"

sentences.hanzi: “不知道。我们为什么在这里？”
sentences.pinyin: bu4 zhi1 dao4 wo3 men5 wei4 shen2 me5 zai4 zhe4 li3
sentences.english: "No idea. Why are we here?"

sentences.hanzi: 这时，又来了一个人。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 you4 lai2 le5 yi1 ge5 ren2
sentences.english: Just then, another person came along.

sentences.hanzi: 他看了看我们，问：“请问，我是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 le5 kan4 wo3 men5 wen4 qing3 wen4 wo3 shi4 shei2
sentences.english: He looked at us and asked, "Excuse me, who am I?"

title: 吃东西的时候
titlePinyin: chi1 dong1 xi5 de5 shi2 hou5

sentences.hanzi: 我小的时候，妈妈总是说：“吃东西的时候别玩！”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 xiao3 de5 shi2 hou5 ma1 ma5 zong3 shi4 shuo1 chi1 dong1 xi5 de5 shi2 hou5 bie2 wan2
sentences.english: When I was little, Mum always said, "Don't play while you're eating!"

sentences.hanzi: 她还说：“走的时候别忘了东西。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 hai2 shuo1 zou3 de5 shi2 hou5 bie2 wang4 le5 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: She also said, "Don't forget your things when you leave."

sentences.hanzi: “过年的时候别说错话。”
sentences.pinyin: guo4 nian2 de5 shi2 hou5 bie2 shuo1 cuo4 hua4
sentences.english: "Don't say the wrong thing at New Year."

sentences.hanzi: 我不喜欢听。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 bu4 xi3 huan5 ting1
sentences.english: I didn't like hearing it.

sentences.hanzi: 现在我有孩子了。
sentences.pinyin: xian4 zai4 wo3 you3 hai2 zi5 le5
sentences.english: Now I have children.

sentences.hanzi: 今天吃东西的时候，我听到有人说：“吃东西的时候别玩！”
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 chi1 dong1 xi5 de5 shi2 hou5 wo3 ting1 dao4 you3 ren2 shuo1 chi1 dong1 xi5 de5 shi2 hou5 bie2 wan2
sentences.english: While we were eating today, I heard someone say, "Don't play while you're eating!"

sentences.hanzi: 说话的人是我。
sentences.pinyin: shuo1 hua4 de5 ren2 shi4 wo3
sentences.english: The person speaking was me.

sentences.hanzi: 叶公说他最爱龙。
sentences.pinyin: ye4 gong1 shuo1 ta1 zui4 ai4 long2
sentences.english: Lord Ye said he loved dragons more than anything.

sentences.hanzi: 他一说话，就说龙。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yi1 shuo1 hua4 jiu4 shuo1 long2
sentences.english: As soon as he spoke, he spoke of dragons.

sentences.hanzi: 他一有时间，就画龙。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yi1 you3 shi2 jian1 jiu4 hua4 long2
sentences.english: As soon as he had time, he drew dragons.

sentences.hanzi: 天上的真龙听说了，很高兴，就来看他。
sentences.pinyin: tian1 shang4 de5 zhen1 long2 ting1 shuo1 le5 hen3 gao1 xing4 jiu4 lai2 kan4 ta1
sentences.english: A real dragon in the sky heard of this, was delighted, and came to see him.

sentences.hanzi: 叶公一回家，就看见了它。
sentences.pinyin: ye4 gong1 yi1 hui2 jia1 jiu4 kan4 jian4 le5 ta1
sentences.english: As soon as Lord Ye got home, he saw it.

sentences.hanzi: 他一看见真龙，就跑了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yi1 kan4 jian4 zhen1 long2 jiu4 pao3 le5
sentences.english: As soon as he saw the real dragon, he ran away.

title: 你怎么才来
titleEnglish: Why are you only here now

sentences.hanzi: 中国只用一个时间。
sentences.pinyin: zhong1 guo2 zhi3 yong4 yi1 ge5 shi2 jian1
sentences.english: All of China uses one time.

sentences.hanzi: 冬天，北京七点多天就亮了，喀什九点多才亮。
sentences.pinyin: dong1 tian1 bei3 jing1 qi1 dian3 duo1 tian1 jiu4 liang4 le5 ka1 shi2 jiu3 dian3 duo1 cai2 liang4
sentences.english: In winter it's light in Beijing soon after seven. In Kashgar it isn't light until after nine.

sentences.hanzi: 朋友请我在喀什吃晚饭，我七点就到了。
sentences.pinyin: peng2 you5 qing3 wo3 zai4 ka1 shi2 chi1 wan3 fan4 wo3 qi1 dian3 jiu4 dao4 le5
sentences.english: A friend invited me to dinner in Kashgar. I was there by seven.

sentences.hanzi: 他九点才来。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 jiu3 dian3 cai2 lai2
sentences.english: He didn't come until nine.

sentences.hanzi: 我问：“你怎么现在才来？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wen4 ni3 zen3 me5 xian4 zai4 cai2 lai2
sentences.english: I asked, "Why have you only come now?"

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“这里九点才吃晚饭，你怎么七点就来了？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 zhe4 li3 jiu3 dian3 cai2 chi1 wan3 fan4 ni3 zen3 me5 qi1 dian3 jiu4 lai2 le5
sentences.english: He said, "People here don't eat dinner until nine. Why did you come at seven?"

sentences.hanzi: 我在桂林问一位老人：“这里除了山以外，还有什么？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zai4 gui4 lin2 wen4 yi1 wei4 lao3 ren2 zhe4 li3 chu2 le5 shan1 yi3 wai4 hai2 you3 shen2 me5
sentences.english: In Guilin I asked an old man, "Besides the mountains, what else is there here?"

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“除了山以外，还有水。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 chu2 le5 shan1 yi3 wai4 hai2 you3 shui3
sentences.english: He said, "Besides the mountains, there's also water."

sentences.hanzi: “除了水以外呢？”
sentences.pinyin: chu2 le5 shui3 yi3 wai4 ne5
sentences.english: "And besides the water?"

sentences.hanzi: “除了水以外，什么都没有了。”
sentences.pinyin: chu2 le5 shui3 yi3 wai4 shen2 me5 dou1 mei2 you3 le5
sentences.english: "Apart from the water, there's nothing."

sentences.hanzi: 我问：“那您为什么不离开这里？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wen4 na4 nin2 wei4 shen2 me5 bu4 li2 kai1 zhe4 li3
sentences.english: I asked, "Then why don't you leave?"

sentences.hanzi: 他看了看山，说：“除了这里以外，别的地方我都不喜欢。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 le5 kan4 shan1 shuo1 chu2 le5 zhe4 li3 yi3 wai4 bie2 de5 di4 fang5 wo3 dou1 bu4 xi3 huan5
sentences.english: He looked at the mountains and said, "Apart from here, I don't like anywhere else."

title: 这位先生是谁
titlePinyin: zhe4 wei4 xian1 sheng5 shi4 shei2

sentences.hanzi: 老王在上海工作，太忙了。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 wang2 zai4 shang4 hai3 gong1 zuo4 tai4 mang2 le5
sentences.english: Old Wang worked in Shanghai and was far too busy.

sentences.hanzi: 他连吃东西的时间都没有。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 lian2 chi1 dong1 xi5 de5 shi2 jian1 dou1 mei2 you3
sentences.english: He didn't even have time to eat.

sentences.hanzi: 他连过年也不回家。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 lian2 guo4 nian2 ye3 bu4 hui2 jia1
sentences.english: He didn't even go home for New Year.

sentences.hanzi: 八年以后，他回家了。
sentences.pinyin: ba1 nian2 yi3 hou4 ta1 hui2 jia1 le5
sentences.english: Eight years later, he went home.

sentences.hanzi: 连家里的狗都不认识他了。
sentences.pinyin: lian2 jia1 li3 de5 gou3 dou1 bu4 ren4 shi5 ta1 le5
sentences.english: Even the family dog didn't recognize him.

sentences.hanzi: 连他的孩子也问妈妈：“这位先生是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: lian2 ta1 de5 hai2 zi5 ye3 wen4 ma1 ma5 zhe4 wei4 xian1 sheng5 shi4 shei2
sentences.english: Even his child asked their mother, "Who is this gentleman?"

sentences.hanzi: 一个老人走过来，对我说：“今天别坐车。”
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 lao3 ren2 zou3 guo4 lai2 dui4 wo3 shuo1 jin1 tian1 bie2 zuo4 che1
sentences.english: An old man came over and said to me, "Don't take the bus today."

sentences.hanzi: 我问：“你是谁？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wen4 ni3 shi4 shei2
sentences.english: I asked, "Who are you?"

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“别问了。也不要去那个地方。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 bie2 wen4 le5 ye3 bu4 yao4 qu4 na4 ge5 di4 fang5
sentences.english: He said, "Stop asking. And don't go to that place."

sentences.hanzi: “你怎么知道？”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 zen3 me5 zhi1 dao4
sentences.english: "How do you know?"

sentences.hanzi: “别担心。我是三十年后的你。”
sentences.pinyin: bie2 dan1 xin1 wo3 shi4 san1 shi2 nian2 hou4 de5 ni3
sentences.english: "Don't worry. I'm you, thirty years from now."

sentences.hanzi: 我很高兴，问：“太好了！三十年后，我有钱吗？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 hen3 gao1 xing4 wen4 tai4 hao3 le5 san1 shi2 nian2 hou4 wo3 you3 qian2 ma5
sentences.english: I was delighted and asked, "Great! In thirty years, will I be rich?"

sentences.hanzi: 他看了看我，说：“这个……别问了。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 le5 kan4 wo3 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 bie2 wen4 le5
sentences.english: He looked at me and said, "That... stop asking."

sentences.hanzi: 小东十岁那年，奶奶给他打了一件毛衣。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 dong1 shi2 sui4 na4 nian2 nai3 nai5 gei3 ta1 da3 le5 yi1 jian4 mao2 yi1
sentences.english: The year Xiaodong turned ten, his grandma knitted him a sweater.

sentences.hanzi: 毛衣是红色的，很好看，可是太大了。
sentences.pinyin: mao2 yi1 shi4 hong2 se4 de5 hen3 hao3 kan4 ke3 shi4 tai4 da4 le5
sentences.english: The sweater was red and nice-looking, but it was far too big.

sentences.hanzi: 小东穿上，手都看不见了。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 dong1 chuan1 shang4 shou3 dou1 kan4 bu4 jian4 le5
sentences.english: When Xiaodong put it on, you couldn't even see his hands.

sentences.hanzi: 妈妈说：“妈，你打得太大了。”
sentences.pinyin: ma1 ma5 shuo1 ma1 ni3 da3 de5 tai4 da4 le5
sentences.english: His mum said: "Mum, you've made it too big."

sentences.hanzi: 奶奶说：“他会长高的。明年就合适了。”
sentences.pinyin: nai3 nai5 shuo1 ta1 hui4 zhang3 gao1 de5 ming2 nian2 jiu4 he2 shi4 le5
sentences.english: Grandma said: "He'll grow. Next year it'll fit."

sentences.hanzi: 第二年，小东长高了，毛衣就合适了。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 nian2 xiao3 dong1 zhang3 gao1 le5 mao2 yi1 jiu4 he2 shi4 le5
sentences.english: The next year Xiaodong had grown, and the sweater fitted.

sentences.hanzi: 可是奶奶又打了一件新的，是蓝色的，又太大了。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 nai3 nai5 you4 da3 le5 yi1 jian4 xin1 de5 shi4 lan2 se4 de5 you4 tai4 da4 le5
sentences.english: But Grandma knitted another new one, a blue one, and it was too big again.

sentences.hanzi: 一年又一年，都是这样。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 nian2 you4 yi1 nian2 dou1 shi4 zhe4 yang4
sentences.english: Year after year, it was always like this.

sentences.hanzi: 奶奶的毛衣，总是比小东大一点。
sentences.pinyin: nai3 nai5 de5 mao2 yi1 zong3 shi4 bi3 xiao3 dong1 da4 yi1 dian3
sentences.english: Grandma's sweaters were always a little bigger than Xiaodong.

sentences.hanzi: 小东总是要等一年，才能穿上。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 dong1 zong3 shi4 yao4 deng3 yi1 nian2 cai2 neng2 chuan1 shang4
sentences.english: Xiaodong always had to wait a year before he could wear them.

sentences.hanzi: 过了很多年，小东的个子比爸爸还高了。
sentences.pinyin: guo4 le5 hen3 duo1 nian2 xiao3 dong1 de5 ge4 zi5 bi3 ba4 ba5 hai2 gao1 le5
sentences.english: Many years later, Xiaodong was taller than his dad.

sentences.hanzi: 奶奶老了，可是她还在打毛衣。
sentences.pinyin: nai3 nai5 lao3 le5 ke3 shi4 ta1 hai2 zai4 da3 mao2 yi1
sentences.english: Grandma grew old, but she was still knitting sweaters.

sentences.hanzi: 小东三十岁那年，奶奶给了他一个包。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 dong1 san1 shi2 sui4 na4 nian2 nai3 nai5 gei3 le5 ta1 yi1 ge5 bao1
sentences.english: The year Xiaodong turned thirty, Grandma gave him a bag.

sentences.hanzi: 他一看，包里是一件很小很小的毛衣。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yi1 kan4 bao1 li3 shi4 yi1 jian4 hen3 xiao3 hen3 xiao3 de5 mao2 yi1
sentences.english: He looked inside: in the bag was a tiny little sweater.

sentences.hanzi: 白色的，只有他的手那么大。
sentences.pinyin: bai2 se4 de5 zhi3 you3 ta1 de5 shou3 na4 me5 da4
sentences.english: A white one, only as big as his hand.

sentences.hanzi: 小东说：“奶奶，这件太小了，我穿不了。”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 dong1 shuo1 nai3 nai5 zhe4 jian4 tai4 xiao3 le5 wo3 chuan1 bu4 liao3
sentences.english: Xiaodong said: "Grandma, this one's too small. I can't wear it."

sentences.hanzi: 奶奶说：“不是给你的。”
sentences.pinyin: nai3 nai5 shuo1 bu4 shi4 gei3 ni3 de5
sentences.english: Grandma said: "It's not for you."

sentences.hanzi: 她看了看小东的妻子，又说：“这一件，不大也不小。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 le5 kan4 xiao3 dong1 de5 qi1 zi5 you4 shuo1 zhe4 yi1 jian4 bu4 da4 ye3 bu4 xiao3
sentences.english: She glanced at Xiaodong's wife and added: "This one is neither too big nor too small."

sentences.hanzi: 马克在北京工作两年了。
sentences.pinyin: ma3 ke4 zai4 bei3 jing1 gong1 zuo4 liang3 nian2 le5
sentences.english: Mark had been working in Beijing for two years.

sentences.hanzi: 春节快到了，朋友们送了他很多东西。

sentences.english: Spring Festival was coming, and his friends gave him lots of things.

sentences.english: One friend gave him a red scarf.

sentences.english: Another friend gave him a red sweater and a red hat.

sentences.pinyin: ma3 ke4 bu4 ming2 bai5 wei4 shen2 me5 dou1 shi4 yi1 ge5 yan2 se4
sentences.english: Mark didn't understand: "Why is everything the same colour?"

sentences.hanzi: 小王问他：“你多大了？”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 wang2 wen4 ta1 ni3 duo1 da4 le5
sentences.english: Xiao Wang asked him: "How old are you?"

sentences.hanzi: “三十六。”
sentences.pinyin: san1 shi2 liu4
sentences.english: "Thirty-six."

sentences.hanzi: “那就对了！三十六岁，是你的本命年。”
sentences.pinyin: na4 jiu4 dui4 le5 san1 shi2 liu4 sui4 shi4 ni3 de5 ben3 ming4 nian2
sentences.english: "That explains it! Thirty-six is your benming nian."

sentences.hanzi: “每十二年，就有一个本命年：十二岁，二十四岁，三十六岁……”
sentences.pinyin: mei3 shi2 er4 nian2 jiu4 you3 yi1 ge5 ben3 ming4 nian2 shi2 er4 sui4 er4 shi2 si4 sui4 san1 shi2 liu4 sui4
sentences.english: "Every twelve years you have a benming nian: at twelve, twenty-four, thirty-six..."

sentences.hanzi: “很多人说，本命年会有坏事。”
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 ren2 shuo1 ben3 ming4 nian2 hui4 you3 huai4 shi4
sentences.english: "Lots of people say bad things can happen in your benming nian."

sentences.hanzi: “所以要穿红色的衣服。红色可以帮你。”
sentences.pinyin: suo3 yi3 yao4 chuan1 hong2 se4 de5 yi1 fu5 hong2 se4 ke3 yi3 bang1 ni3
sentences.english: "So you wear red clothes. Red can protect you."

sentences.hanzi: 马克问：“你们相信吗？”
sentences.pinyin: ma3 ke4 wen4 ni3 men5 xiang1 xin4 ma5
sentences.english: Mark asked: "Do you believe that?"

sentences.hanzi: 小王想了想，说：“我也不知道。可是穿上，也没有问题。”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 wang2 xiang3 le5 xiang3 shuo1 wo3 ye3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 ke3 shi4 chuan1 shang4 ye3 mei2 you3 wen4 ti2
sentences.english: Xiao Wang thought for a moment and said: "I'm not sure. But wearing it can't hurt."

sentences.hanzi: 那一年，马克一直穿红色的袜子。
sentences.pinyin: na4 yi1 nian2 ma3 ke4 yi1 zhi2 chuan1 hong2 se4 de5 wa4 zi5
sentences.english: All that year, Mark wore red socks.

sentences.hanzi: 到了十二月，他还戴上了红色的围巾和帽子。
sentences.pinyin: dao4 le5 shi2 er4 yue4 ta1 hai2 dai4 shang4 le5 hong2 se4 de5 wei2 jin1 he2 mao4 zi5
sentences.english: When December came, he put on the red scarf and hat as well.

sentences.hanzi: 一年过去了，什么坏事都没有发生。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 nian2 guo4 qu4 le5 shen2 me5 huai4 shi4 dou1 mei2 you3 fa1 sheng1
sentences.english: The year went by, and nothing bad happened at all.

sentences.hanzi: 马克说：“红色真行！”
sentences.pinyin: ma3 ke4 shuo1 hong2 se4 zhen1 xing2
sentences.english: Mark said: "Red really works!"

sentences.hanzi: 第二年春节以前，他也买了红色的袜子，送小王。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 nian2 chun1 jie2 yi3 qian2 ta1 ye3 mai3 le5 hong2 se4 de5 wa4 zi5 song4 xiao3 wang2
sentences.english: Before the next Spring Festival, he bought red socks too, for Xiao Wang.

sentences.hanzi: 小王问：“这是做什么？”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 wang2 wen4 zhe4 shi4 zuo4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: Xiao Wang asked: "What's this for?"

sentences.hanzi: 马克说：“你不是二十三岁吗？明年就二十四了。”
sentences.pinyin: ma3 ke4 shuo1 ni3 bu4 shi4 er4 shi2 san1 sui4 ma5 ming2 nian2 jiu4 er4 shi2 si4 le5
sentences.english: Mark said: "Aren't you twenty-three? Next year you'll be twenty-four."

sentences.hanzi: 很久以前，中国有一种很美的衣服。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 jiu3 yi3 qian2 zhong1 guo2 you3 yi1 zhong3 hen3 mei3 de5 yi1 fu5
sentences.english: Long ago, China had a very beautiful kind of cloth for clothes.

sentences.hanzi: 很多地方的人都想要，可是只有中国人会做。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 di4 fang5 de5 ren2 dou1 xiang3 yao4 ke3 shi4 zhi3 you3 zhong1 guo2 ren2 hui4 zuo4
sentences.english: People in many places wanted it, but only the Chinese knew how to make it.

sentences.hanzi: 这种衣服，是用蚕做的。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 yi1 fu5 shi4 yong4 can2 zuo4 de5
sentences.english: It was made with the help of silkworms.

sentences.hanzi: 有人说，那时候中国不让蚕种离开。出去的人，包都要被看一看。
sentences.pinyin: you3 ren2 shuo1 na4 shi2 hou5 zhong1 guo2 bu4 rang4 can2 zhong3 li2 kai1 chu1 qu4 de5 ren2 bao1 dou1 yao4 bei4 kan4 yi1 kan4
sentences.english: Some say China didn't let silkworm eggs leave in those days. Anyone going out had their bags checked.

sentences.hanzi: 从中国向西走很远很远，有一个地方叫于阗。

sentences.english: A long, long way west of China was a place called Khotan.

sentences.hanzi: 于阗的人也想做这种衣服，可是他们没有蚕。
sentences.pinyin: yu2 tian2 de5 ren2 ye3 xiang3 zuo4 zhe4 zhong3 yi1 fu5 ke3 shi4 ta1 men5 mei2 you3 can2
sentences.english: The people of Khotan wanted to make this cloth too, but they had no silkworms.

sentences.english: They came up with a plan: they asked for a princess to come to Khotan. Many people say she was a Chinese princess.

sentences.pinyin: gong1 zhu3 yao4 zou3 le5 yu2 tian2 de5 ren2 gao4 su5 ta1
sentences.english: The princess was about to leave. The people of Khotan told her:

sentences.hanzi: “我们那里没有蚕。如果你想一直穿这么美的衣服，就带一些蚕种来吧。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 na4 li5 mei2 you3 can2 ru2 guo3 ni3 xiang3 yi1 zhi2 chuan1 zhe4 me5 mei3 de5 yi1 fu5 jiu4 dai4 yi1 xie1 can2 zhong3 lai2 ba5
sentences.english: "We have no silkworms. If you want to keep wearing such beautiful clothes, bring some silkworm eggs."

sentences.hanzi: 走的时候，她头上戴着一个很高的帽子。
sentences.pinyin: zou3 de5 shi2 hou5 ta1 tou2 shang4 dai4 zhe5 yi1 ge5 hen3 gao1 de5 mao4 zi5
sentences.english: When she left, she wore a very tall hat on her head.

sentences.hanzi: 快离开的时候，有人要看她的东西。
sentences.pinyin: kuai4 li2 kai1 de5 shi2 hou5 you3 ren2 yao4 kan4 ta1 de5 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: Just as she was about to leave, people wanted to check her things.

sentences.hanzi: 他们看了她所有的包，什么都没有发现。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 kan4 le5 ta1 suo3 you3 de5 bao1 shen2 me5 dou1 mei2 you3 fa1 xian4
sentences.english: They checked all her bags and found nothing.

sentences.hanzi: 只有她的帽子，谁也不敢看。那是公主的帽子啊！
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 you3 ta1 de5 mao4 zi5 shei2 ye3 bu4 gan3 kan4 na4 shi4 gong1 zhu3 de5 mao4 zi5 a5
sentences.english: Only her hat—nobody dared look at that. It was a princess's hat!

sentences.hanzi: 公主到了于阗，才把帽子拿下来。
sentences.pinyin: gong1 zhu3 dao4 le5 yu2 tian2 cai2 ba3 mao4 zi5 na2 xia4 lai2
sentences.english: Only when the princess reached Khotan did she take the hat off.

sentences.hanzi: 帽子里面，都是很小很小的蚕种。
sentences.pinyin: mao4 zi5 li3 mian4 dou1 shi4 hen3 xiao3 hen3 xiao3 de5 can2 zhong3
sentences.english: Inside the hat were lots of tiny silkworm eggs.

sentences.hanzi: 从那以后，于阗也有了这么漂亮的衣服。
sentences.pinyin: cong2 na4 yi3 hou4 yu2 tian2 ye3 you3 le5 zhe4 me5 piao4 liang5 de5 yi1 fu5
sentences.english: From then on, Khotan had beautiful clothes like these too.

sentences.hanzi: 这件事，是一千多年前玄奘在于阗听说的。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 jian4 shi4 shi4 yi1 qian1 duo1 nian2 qian2 xuan2 zang4 zai4 yu2 tian2 ting1 shuo1 de5
sentences.english: Xuanzang heard this story in Khotan more than a thousand years ago.

sentences.hanzi: 真有这件事吗？没有人知道。
sentences.pinyin: zhen1 you3 zhe4 jian4 shi4 ma5 mei2 you3 ren2 zhi1 dao4
sentences.english: Did it really happen? Nobody knows.

sentences.hanzi: 可是今天，那里的人还在用蚕做衣服。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 jin1 tian1 na4 li5 de5 ren2 hai2 zai4 yong4 can2 zuo4 yi1 fu5
sentences.english: But today, people there still make cloth with silkworms.

glossed.meaning: Khotan, an old kingdom in today's Xinjiang, now Hotan

sentences.hanzi: 唐朝的时候，长安的春天特别美。
sentences.pinyin: tang2 chao2 de5 shi2 hou5 chang2 an1 de5 chun1 tian1 te4 bie2 mei3
sentences.english: In the Tang dynasty, spring in Chang'an was especially beautiful.

sentences.hanzi: 春天一到，很多人都要骑马出去玩。
sentences.pinyin: chun1 tian1 yi1 dao4 hen3 duo1 ren2 dou1 yao4 qi2 ma3 chu1 qu4 wan2
sentences.english: As soon as spring came, lots of people rode out on horseback to enjoy themselves.

sentences.hanzi: 十六岁的阿青也想去。
sentences.pinyin: shi2 liu4 sui4 de5 a1 qing1 ye3 xiang3 qu4
sentences.english: Sixteen-year-old A-Qing wanted to go too.

sentences.hanzi: 可是爸爸说：“女孩不要骑马。你别去了。”
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ba4 ba5 shuo1 nu:3 hai2 bu4 yao4 qi2 ma3 ni3 bie2 qu4 le5
sentences.english: But her father said: "Girls shouldn't ride horses. Don't go."

sentences.hanzi: 阿青没有说话。
sentences.pinyin: a1 qing1 mei2 you3 shuo1 hua4
sentences.english: A-Qing said nothing.

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，她穿上了哥哥的衣服。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 ta1 chuan1 shang4 le5 ge1 ge5 de5 yi1 fu5
sentences.english: The next day, she put on her brother's clothes.

sentences.hanzi: 衣服有点长，裤子也有点大。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 fu5 you3 dian3 chang2 ku4 zi5 ye3 you3 dian3 da4
sentences.english: The clothes were a bit long, and the trousers a bit big.

sentences.hanzi: 她把头发放进帽子里，戴上帽子，看了看自己。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 ba3 tou2 fa5 fang4 jin4 mao4 zi5 li3 dai4 shang4 mao4 zi5 kan4 le5 kan4 zi4 ji3
sentences.english: She tucked her hair into a hat, put the hat on, and looked at herself.

sentences.hanzi: 真帅！
sentences.pinyin: zhen1 shuai4
sentences.english: So handsome!

sentences.hanzi: 她骑上哥哥的马，出了门。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 qi2 shang4 ge1 ge5 de5 ma3 chu1 le5 men2
sentences.english: She got on her brother's horse and rode out.

sentences.hanzi: 出去玩的人很多。她不敢看别人。
sentences.pinyin: chu1 qu4 wan2 de5 ren2 hen3 duo1 ta1 bu4 gan3 kan4 bie2 ren5
sentences.english: Lots of people were out enjoying themselves. She didn't dare look at anyone.

sentences.hanzi: 可是走着走着，她看到了一件奇怪的事。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zou3 zhe5 zou3 zhe5 ta1 kan4 dao4 le5 yi1 jian4 qi2 guai4 de5 shi4
sentences.english: But as she rode on, she saw something strange.

sentences.hanzi: 前面骑马的几个“男人”，个子都很矮，样子也很漂亮。
sentences.pinyin: qian2 mian4 qi2 ma3 de5 ji3 ge4 nan2 ren2 ge4 zi5 dou1 hen3 ai3 yang4 zi5 ye3 hen3 piao4 liang5
sentences.english: The few "men" riding ahead were all short, and very pretty too.

sentences.hanzi: 一个“男人”看了看她，说：“你的帽子戴错了。”
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 nan2 ren2 kan4 le5 kan4 ta1 shuo1 ni3 de5 mao4 zi5 dai4 cuo4 le5
sentences.english: One of the "men" looked her over and said: "You've got your hat on wrong."

sentences.hanzi: 这是女孩在说话！
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 nu:3 hai2 zai4 shuo1 hua4
sentences.english: That was a girl talking!

sentences.hanzi: 阿青这才知道，长安很多女孩都这样打扮。
sentences.pinyin: a1 qing1 zhe4 cai2 zhi1 dao4 chang2 an1 hen3 duo1 nu:3 hai2 dou1 zhe4 yang4 da3 ban5
sentences.english: Only then did A-Qing realise that lots of girls in Chang'an dressed this way.

sentences.hanzi: 穿男人的衣服骑马，是那时候最流行的样子。
sentences.pinyin: chuan1 nan2 ren2 de5 yi1 fu5 qi2 ma3 shi4 na4 shi2 hou5 zui4 liu2 xing2 de5 yang4 zi5
sentences.english: Riding out in men's clothes was the most fashionable look at the time.

sentences.hanzi: 晚上，阿青回家的时候，爸爸正在等她。
sentences.pinyin: wan3 shang5 a1 qing1 hui2 jia1 de5 shi2 hou5 ba4 ba5 zheng4 zai4 deng3 ta1
sentences.english: That evening, when A-Qing came home, her father was waiting for her.

sentences.hanzi: 她想：这下完了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 zhe4 xia4 wan2 le5
sentences.english: She thought: now I'm in for it.

sentences.hanzi: 可是爸爸只问了一句：“马跑得快吗？”
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ba4 ba5 zhi3 wen4 le5 yi1 ju4 ma3 pao3 de5 kuai4 ma5
sentences.english: But her father asked only one thing: "Was the horse fast?"

sentences.hanzi: 妈妈站在旁边，手上拿着一件很旧的男人衣服。
sentences.pinyin: ma1 ma5 zhan4 zai4 pang2 bian1 shou3 shang4 na2 zhe5 yi1 jian4 hen3 jiu4 de5 nan2 ren2 yi1 fu5
sentences.english: Her mother stood beside him, holding a very old set of men's clothes.

sentences.hanzi: 妈妈说：“这是我十六岁的时候穿的。”
sentences.pinyin: ma1 ma5 shuo1 zhe4 shi4 wo3 shi2 liu4 sui4 de5 shi2 hou5 chuan1 de5
sentences.english: Her mother said: "I wore these when I was sixteen."

title: 有洞的牛仔裤
titlePinyin: you3 dong4 de5 niu2 zai3 ku4

sentences.hanzi: 二零八零年，人们已经不买衣服了。
sentences.pinyin: er4 ling2 ba1 ling2 nian2 ren2 men5 yi3 jing1 bu4 mai3 yi1 fu5 le5
sentences.english: By 2080, people no longer bought clothes.

sentences.hanzi: 人们自己打印衣服，一天一件新的。
sentences.pinyin: ren2 men5 zi4 ji3 da3 yin4 yi1 fu5 yi1 tian1 yi1 jian4 xin1 de5
sentences.english: People printed their own clothes: a new one every day.

sentences.hanzi: 你想要什么颜色，什么样子，说一句话就行。
sentences.pinyin: ni3 xiang3 yao4 shen2 me5 yan2 se4 shen2 me5 yang4 zi5 shuo1 yi1 ju4 hua4 jiu4 xing2
sentences.english: Whatever colour you want, whatever style, you just say the word.

sentences.hanzi: 所以，没有人穿旧衣服。
sentences.pinyin: suo3 yi3 mei2 you3 ren2 chuan1 jiu4 yi1 fu5
sentences.english: So nobody wore old clothes.

sentences.hanzi: 有一天，小雨在爷爷的房间里找到一个很旧的包。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 xiao3 yu3 zai4 ye2 ye5 de5 fang2 jian1 li3 zhao3 dao4 yi1 ge5 hen3 jiu4 de5 bao1
sentences.english: One day, Xiaoyu found a very old bag in Grandpa's room.

sentences.hanzi: 包里有一条牛仔裤，上面有好几个洞。
sentences.pinyin: bao1 li3 you3 yi1 tiao2 niu2 zai3 ku4 shang4 mian4 you3 hao3 ji3 ge4 dong4
sentences.english: In the bag was a pair of jeans with several holes in them.

sentences.hanzi: “爷爷，这条裤子怎么有这么多洞？”
sentences.pinyin: ye2 ye5 zhe4 tiao2 ku4 zi5 zen3 me5 you3 zhe4 me5 duo1 dong4
sentences.english: "Grandpa, why have these trousers got so many holes?"

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷说：“这是我二十岁的时候穿的。”
sentences.pinyin: ye2 ye5 shuo1 zhe4 shi4 wo3 er4 shi2 sui4 de5 shi2 hou5 chuan1 de5
sentences.english: Grandpa said: "I wore those when I was twenty."

sentences.hanzi: 小雨很喜欢。第二天，她穿上这条牛仔裤，去见朋友。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 yu3 hen3 xi3 huan5 di4 er4 tian1 ta1 chuan1 shang4 zhe4 tiao2 niu2 zai3 ku4 qu4 jian4 peng2 you5
sentences.english: Xiaoyu loved them. The next day she put on the jeans and went to see her friends.

sentences.hanzi: 外面很多人都看她。
sentences.pinyin: wai4 mian4 hen3 duo1 ren2 dou1 kan4 ta1
sentences.english: Lots of people outside stared at her.

sentences.hanzi: 一个老人说：“孩子，你的裤子上有洞，快回家换吧！”
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 lao3 ren2 shuo1 hai2 zi5 ni3 de5 ku4 zi5 shang4 you3 dong4 kuai4 hui2 jia1 huan4 ba5
sentences.english: An old man said: "Child, there are holes in your trousers. Hurry home and change!"

sentences.hanzi: 可是她的朋友们都说：“太好看了！在哪里打印的？”
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ta1 de5 peng2 you5 men5 dou1 shuo1 tai4 hao3 kan4 le5 zai4 na3 li3 da3 yin4 de5
sentences.english: But her friends all said: "They look amazing! Where did you print them?"

sentences.hanzi: “不是打印的。这是旧的，已经五十岁了。”
sentences.pinyin: bu4 shi4 da3 yin4 de5 zhe4 shi4 jiu4 de5 yi3 jing1 wu3 shi2 sui4 le5
sentences.english: "They're not printed. They're old—fifty years old."

sentences.hanzi: 大家都不相信：衣服怎么会这么旧？
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 bu4 xiang1 xin4 yi1 fu5 zen3 me5 hui4 zhe4 me5 jiu4
sentences.english: Nobody believed it: how could clothes be that old?

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，小雨的朋友们都穿上了有洞的牛仔裤。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 xiao3 yu3 de5 peng2 you5 men5 dou1 chuan1 shang4 le5 you3 dong4 de5 niu2 zai3 ku4
sentences.english: The next day, all of Xiaoyu's friends were wearing jeans with holes.

sentences.hanzi: 几天以后，大家都穿上了。这是最流行的样子。
sentences.pinyin: ji3 tian1 yi3 hou4 da4 jia1 dou1 chuan1 shang4 le5 zhe4 shi4 zui4 liu2 xing2 de5 yang4 zi5
sentences.english: A few days later, everyone was wearing them. It was the latest fashion.

sentences.hanzi: 可是这些裤子都是新打印的，洞也是打印的。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zhe4 xie1 ku4 zi5 dou1 shi4 xin1 da3 yin4 de5 dong4 ye3 shi4 da3 yin4 de5
sentences.english: But these trousers were all freshly printed—and so were the holes.

sentences.hanzi: 小雨回家告诉了爷爷。爷爷说：“没什么奇怪的。”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 yu3 hui2 jia1 gao4 su5 le5 ye2 ye5 ye2 ye5 shuo1 mei2 shen2 me5 qi2 guai4 de5
sentences.english: Xiaoyu went home and told Grandpa. Grandpa said: "Nothing strange about that."

sentences.hanzi: “我二十岁的时候，我们也花很多钱，去买有洞的新裤子。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 er4 shi2 sui4 de5 shi2 hou5 wo3 men5 ye3 hua1 hen3 duo1 qian2 qu4 mai3 you3 dong4 de5 xin1 ku4 zi5
sentences.english: "When I was twenty, we also spent a lot of money on new trousers with holes in them."

sentences.hanzi: 我第一次来北京，就迷路了。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 di4 yi1 ci4 lai2 bei3 jing1 jiu4 mi2 lu4 le5
sentences.english: The first time I came to Beijing, I got lost straight away.

sentences.hanzi: 路口有一个老人，我问他：“请问，地铁站在哪儿？”
sentences.pinyin: lu4 kou3 you3 yi1 ge5 lao3 ren2 wo3 wen4 ta1 qing3 wen4 di4 tie3 zhan4 zai4 na3 r5
sentences.english: There was an old man at the crossroads, and I asked him: "Excuse me, where's the subway station?"

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“往北走，到了第二个路口，再往东走一点。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 wang3 bei3 zou3 dao4 le5 di4 er4 ge4 lu4 kou3 zai4 wang3 dong1 zou3 yi1 dian3
sentences.english: He said: "Head north, and when you get to the second crossing, go a little way east."

sentences.hanzi: 我站在马路旁边，看看左边，又看看右边。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zhan4 zai4 ma3 lu4 pang2 bian1 kan4 kan5 zuo3 bian5 you4 kan4 kan5 you4 bian5
sentences.english: I stood by the road, looked left, then looked right.

sentences.hanzi: 北在哪儿？我真不知道。
sentences.pinyin: bei3 zai4 na3 r5 wo3 zhen1 bu4 zhi1 dao4
sentences.english: Which way was north? I really had no idea.

sentences.hanzi: 我说：“对不起，是往左走，还是往右走？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 dui4 bu5 qi3 shi4 wang3 zuo3 zou3 hai2 shi5 wang3 you4 zou3
sentences.english: I said: "Sorry, is that to the left or to the right?"

sentences.hanzi: 老人想了想，说：“北就是北啊。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ren2 xiang3 le5 xiang3 shuo1 bei3 jiu4 shi4 bei3 a5
sentences.english: The old man thought for a moment and said: "North is north."

sentences.hanzi: “你看太阳。太阳出来的地方，就是东。”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 kan4 tai4 yang5 tai4 yang5 chu1 lai2 de5 di4 fang5 jiu4 shi4 dong1
sentences.english: "Look at the sun. Where the sun comes up, that's east."

sentences.hanzi: 过了一个月，我才明白。
sentences.pinyin: guo4 le5 yi1 ge5 yue4 wo3 cai2 ming2 bai5
sentences.english: It was a month before I understood.

sentences.hanzi: 很多北京人告诉别人怎么走，都用东南西北，不太用左和右。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 bei3 jing1 ren2 gao4 su5 bie2 ren5 zen3 me5 zou3 dou1 yong4 dong1 nan2 xi1 bei3 bu4 tai4 yong4 zuo3 he2 you4
sentences.english: When many Beijing people tell you the way, they use east, south, west and north, and hardly ever left and right.

sentences.hanzi: 为什么呢？
sentences.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 ne5
sentences.english: Why is that?

sentences.hanzi: 因为老北京的很多街，不是从南到北，就是从东到西。
sentences.pinyin: yin1 wei4 lao3 bei3 jing1 de5 hen3 duo1 jie1 bu4 shi4 cong2 nan2 dao4 bei3 jiu4 shi4 cong2 dong1 dao4 xi1
sentences.english: Because many of old Beijing's streets run either from south to north or from east to west.

sentences.hanzi: 在这样的地方，东南西北比左和右更清楚。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 yang4 de5 di4 fang5 dong1 nan2 xi1 bei3 bi3 zuo3 he2 you4 geng4 qing1 chu5
sentences.english: In a place like that, the compass points are clearer than left and right.

sentences.hanzi: 你往回走，左边就成了右边，可是北一直是北。
sentences.pinyin: ni3 wang3 hui2 zou3 zuo3 bian5 jiu4 cheng2 le5 you4 bian5 ke3 shi4 bei3 yi1 zhi2 shi4 bei3
sentences.english: Turn around and walk back, and left becomes right, but north is always north.

sentences.hanzi: 三个月以后，我在北京已经可以自己找路了。
sentences.pinyin: san1 ge4 yue4 yi3 hou4 wo3 zai4 bei3 jing1 yi3 jing1 ke3 yi3 zi4 ji3 zhao3 lu4 le5
sentences.english: Three months later, I could find my own way around Beijing.

sentences.hanzi: 有一天，一个上海朋友来看我，问我公园怎么走。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 yi1 ge5 shang4 hai3 peng2 you5 lai2 kan4 wo3 wen4 wo3 gong1 yuan2 zen3 me5 zou3
sentences.english: One day a friend from Shanghai came to see me and asked how to get to the park.

sentences.hanzi: 我说：“往南走，过了桥，再往西走。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 wang3 nan2 zou3 guo4 le5 qiao2 zai4 wang3 xi1 zou3
sentences.english: I said: "Head south, cross the bridge, then go west."

sentences.hanzi: 他站在路口，看看左边，又看看右边，问我：“南在哪儿？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zhan4 zai4 lu4 kou3 kan4 kan5 zuo3 bian5 you4 kan4 kan5 you4 bian5 wen4 wo3 nan2 zai4 na3 r5
sentences.english: He stood at the crossroads, looked left, then looked right, and asked me: "Where's south?"

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸离开老家，已经三十年了。
sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 li2 kai1 lao3 jia1 yi3 jing1 san1 shi2 nian2 le5
sentences.english: It has been thirty years since Dad left his hometown.

sentences.hanzi: 我要去那里看看，他给了我一张自己做的地图。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 yao4 qu4 na4 li5 kan4 kan5 ta1 gei3 le5 wo3 yi1 zhang1 zi4 ji3 zuo4 de5 di4 tu2
sentences.english: I was going there for a visit, and he gave me a map he had made himself.

sentences.hanzi: 地图上写着：
sentences.pinyin: di4 tu2 shang4 xie3 zhe5
sentences.english: On the map was written:

sentences.hanzi: “出了车站，往右走，一直走。”
sentences.pinyin: chu1 le5 che1 zhan4 wang3 you4 zou3 yi1 zhi2 zou3
sentences.english: "Come out of the station, turn right and keep going straight."

sentences.hanzi: “看到一个大银行，往左拐。”
sentences.pinyin: kan4 dao4 yi1 ge5 da4 yin2 hang2 wang3 zuo3 guai3
sentences.english: "When you see a big bank, turn left."

sentences.hanzi: “银行对面是一个学校。过了学校前面的桥，第三个门，就是我们家。”
sentences.pinyin: yin2 hang2 dui4 mian4 shi4 yi1 ge5 xue2 xiao4 guo4 le5 xue2 xiao4 qian2 mian4 de5 qiao2 di4 san1 ge4 men2 jiu4 shi4 wo3 men5 jia1
sentences.english: "Opposite the bank is a school. Cross the bridge in front of the school, and the third door is our home."

sentences.hanzi: 我出了车站，往右走。可是前面没有银行，只有一个很大的超市。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 chu1 le5 che1 zhan4 wang3 you4 zou3 ke3 shi4 qian2 mian4 mei2 you3 yin2 hang2 zhi3 you3 yi1 ge5 hen3 da4 de5 chao1 shi4
sentences.english: I came out of the station and turned right. But there was no bank ahead, only a huge supermarket.

sentences.hanzi: 我往左拐，也没有看到学校，只看到一个停车场。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wang3 zuo3 guai3 ye3 mei2 you3 kan4 dao4 xue2 xiao4 zhi3 kan4 dao4 yi1 ge5 ting2 che1 chang3
sentences.english: I turned left, and there was no school either, only a car park.

sentences.hanzi: 桥也没有了，那里现在是一条大马路。我迷路了。
sentences.pinyin: qiao2 ye3 mei2 you3 le5 na4 li5 xian4 zai4 shi4 yi1 tiao2 da4 ma3 lu4 wo3 mi2 lu4 le5
sentences.english: The bridge was gone too. There was a big road there now. I was lost.

sentences.hanzi: 超市外面坐着一个老人，我拿着地图去问路。
sentences.pinyin: chao1 shi4 wai4 mian4 zuo4 zhe5 yi1 ge5 lao3 ren2 wo3 na2 zhe5 di4 tu2 qu4 wen4 lu4
sentences.english: An old man was sitting outside the supermarket, so I took the map and asked him the way.

sentences.hanzi: 老人看了看地图，说：“这是三十年前的地图吧？”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ren2 kan4 le5 kan4 di4 tu2 shuo1 zhe4 shi4 san1 shi2 nian2 qian2 de5 di4 tu2 ba5
sentences.english: The old man looked at the map and said: "This map is from thirty years ago, isn't it?"

sentences.hanzi: “以前，这里是银行，那里是学校。现在都没有了。”
sentences.pinyin: yi3 qian2 zhe4 li3 shi4 yin2 hang2 na4 li5 shi4 xue2 xiao4 xian4 zai4 dou1 mei2 you3 le5
sentences.english: "There used to be a bank here and a school there. They're all gone now."

sentences.hanzi: 我说出了爸爸的名字。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 chu1 le5 ba4 ba5 de5 ming2 zi5
sentences.english: I told him my father's name.

sentences.hanzi: 老人站了起来，看了我很久。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ren2 zhan4 le5 qi3 lai5 kan4 le5 wo3 hen3 jiu3
sentences.english: The old man stood up and looked at me for a long time.

sentences.hanzi: “你是他的孩子？他走的时候，比你还小。他是我的好朋友。”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 shi4 ta1 de5 hai2 zi5 ta1 zou3 de5 shi2 hou5 bi3 ni3 hai2 xiao3 ta1 shi4 wo3 de5 hao3 peng2 you5
sentences.english: "You're his child? When he left, he was younger than you. He was a good friend of mine."

sentences.hanzi: 他没有看地图，带我往东走了十分钟。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 mei2 you3 kan4 di4 tu2 dai4 wo3 wang3 dong1 zou3 le5 shi2 fen1 zhong1
sentences.english: Without looking at the map, he walked me east for ten minutes.

sentences.hanzi: 前面有一个很老的门。门还在，门上的名字也还在。
sentences.pinyin: qian2 mian4 you3 yi1 ge5 hen3 lao3 de5 men2 men2 hai2 zai4 men2 shang4 de5 ming2 zi5 ye3 hai2 zai4
sentences.english: Ahead was a very old door. The door was still there, and so was the family name on it.

sentences.hanzi: 老人说：“这就是你们家。三十年了，这里很多东西都没有了。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ren2 shuo1 zhe4 jiu4 shi4 ni3 men5 jia1 san1 shi2 nian2 le5 zhe4 li3 hen3 duo1 dong1 xi5 dou1 mei2 you3 le5
sentences.english: The old man said: "This is your family's house. In thirty years, a lot of things here have gone."

sentences.hanzi: “可是我还在。你回去告诉你爸爸，让他自己回来看看。”
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 wo3 hai2 zai4 ni3 hui2 qu5 gao4 su5 ni3 ba4 ba5 rang4 ta1 zi4 ji3 hui2 lai5 kan4 kan5
sentences.english: "But I'm still here. Go back and tell your dad to come and see for himself."

sentences.hanzi: 晚上十点，我迷路了。
sentences.pinyin: wan3 shang5 shi2 dian3 wo3 mi2 lu4 le5
sentences.english: At ten at night, I was lost.

sentences.hanzi: 我有地图，可是太晚了，什么都看不清楚。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 you3 di4 tu2 ke3 shi4 tai4 wan3 le5 shen2 me5 dou1 kan4 bu4 qing1 chu5
sentences.english: I had a map, but it was too dark to make anything out.

sentences.hanzi: 外面一个人也没有。
sentences.pinyin: wai4 mian4 yi1 ge5 ren2 ye3 mei2 you3
sentences.english: There was nobody about.

sentences.hanzi: 走了很久，我才看到路口坐着一个老人。
sentences.pinyin: zou3 le5 hen3 jiu3 wo3 cai2 kan4 dao4 lu4 kou3 zuo4 zhe5 yi1 ge5 lao3 ren2
sentences.english: After walking a long time, I finally saw an old man sitting at a crossing.

sentences.hanzi: 我去问路：“请问，车站怎么走？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 qu4 wen4 lu4 qing3 wen4 che1 zhan4 zen3 me5 zou3
sentences.english: I asked him the way: "Excuse me, how do I get to the station?"

sentences.hanzi: 他想也没想，就说：“从这里一直往前走。听到水的声音，那就是桥。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 ye3 mei2 xiang3 jiu4 shuo1 cong2 zhe4 li3 yi1 zhi2 wang3 qian2 zou3 ting1 dao4 shui3 de5 sheng1 yin1 na4 jiu4 shi4 qiao2
sentences.english: Without even stopping to think, he said: "Go straight ahead from here. When you hear water, that's the bridge."

sentences.hanzi: “过了桥，往左拐。你会听到很多人在说话，那是一家超市。”
sentences.pinyin: guo4 le5 qiao2 wang3 zuo3 guai3 ni3 hui4 ting1 dao4 hen3 duo1 ren2 zai4 shuo1 hua4 na4 shi4 yi1 jia1 chao1 shi4
sentences.english: "Cross the bridge and turn left. You'll hear lots of people talking. That's a supermarket."

sentences.hanzi: “过了超市，往右拐，一直走，就到车站了。”
sentences.pinyin: guo4 le5 chao1 shi4 wang3 you4 guai3 yi1 zhi2 zou3 jiu4 dao4 che1 zhan4 le5
sentences.english: "Go past the supermarket, turn right and keep going, and you'll reach the station."

sentences.hanzi: 我说了谢谢，往前走。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 le5 xie4 xie5 wang3 qian2 zou3
sentences.english: I said thank you and walked on.

sentences.hanzi: 外面还是什么都看不清楚。
sentences.pinyin: wai4 mian4 hai2 shi5 shen2 me5 dou1 kan4 bu4 qing1 chu5
sentences.english: I still couldn't make anything out.

sentences.hanzi: 可是走了五分钟，我就听到了水的声音。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zou3 le5 wu3 fen1 zhong1 wo3 jiu4 ting1 dao4 le5 shui3 de5 sheng1 yin1
sentences.english: But after five minutes, I heard water.

sentences.hanzi: 过了桥，往左拐，很多人在超市里说话。
sentences.pinyin: guo4 le5 qiao2 wang3 zuo3 guai3 hen3 duo1 ren2 zai4 chao1 shi4 li3 shuo1 hua4
sentences.english: Over the bridge, I turned left, and there were lots of people talking in the supermarket.

sentences.hanzi: 过了超市，往右拐，一直走，车站就在前面。
sentences.pinyin: guo4 le5 chao1 shi4 wang3 you4 guai3 yi1 zhi2 zou3 che1 zhan4 jiu4 zai4 qian2 mian4
sentences.english: Past the supermarket, I turned right, kept going, and there was the station ahead.

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，我又去了那个路口，想再谢谢他。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 wo3 you4 qu4 le5 na4 ge5 lu4 kou3 xiang3 zai4 xie4 xie5 ta1
sentences.english: The next day I went back to that crossing to thank him again.

sentences.hanzi: 老人还坐在那里。他听到我说话，就说：“你是那个问路的人吧？”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ren2 hai2 zuo4 zai4 na4 li5 ta1 ting1 dao4 wo3 shuo1 hua4 jiu4 shuo1 ni3 shi4 na4 ge5 wen4 lu4 de5 ren2 ba5
sentences.english: The old man was sitting there again. When he heard me speak, he said: "You're the one who asked the way, aren't you?"

sentences.hanzi: 这时候我才知道，他什么都看不见。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 hou5 wo3 cai2 zhi1 dao4 ta1 shen2 me5 dou1 kan4 bu4 jian4
sentences.english: Only then did I realise that he couldn't see at all.

sentences.hanzi: 我问他：“您看不见，为什么对路这么清楚？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wen4 ta1 nin2 kan4 bu4 jian4 wei4 shen2 me5 dui4 lu4 zhe4 me5 qing1 chu5
sentences.english: I asked him: "You can't see, so how do you know the way so well?"

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“我看不见，可是我听得见。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 wo3 kan4 bu4 jian4 ke3 shi4 wo3 ting1 de5 jian4
sentences.english: He said: "I can't see, but I can hear."

sentences.hanzi: “晚上，你们都看不清楚。这时候，我的地图比你的好用。”
sentences.pinyin: wan3 shang5 ni3 men5 dou1 kan4 bu4 qing1 chu5 zhe4 shi2 hou5 wo3 de5 di4 tu2 bi3 ni3 de5 hao3 yong4
sentences.english: "At night, none of you can see clearly. That's when my map works better than yours."

title: 没有名字的街
titlePinyin: mei2 you3 ming2 zi5 de5 jie1

sentences.hanzi: 你给朋友写地址，会怎么写？
sentences.pinyin: ni3 gei3 peng2 you5 xie3 di4 zhi3 hui4 zen3 me5 xie3
sentences.english: When you write an address for a friend, how do you write it?

sentences.hanzi: 在很多地方，地址上有一条街的名字，还有一个号。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 hen3 duo1 di4 fang5 di4 zhi3 shang4 you3 yi1 tiao2 jie1 de5 ming2 zi5 hai2 you3 yi1 ge5 hao4
sentences.english: In many places, an address has the name of a street and a number.

sentences.hanzi: 可是在日本，除了大马路，很多街都没有名字。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zai4 ri4 ben3 chu2 le5 da4 ma3 lu4 hen3 duo1 jie1 dou1 mei2 you3 ming2 zi5
sentences.english: But in Japan, apart from the big roads, many streets have no name at all.

sentences.hanzi: 那地址怎么写呢？
sentences.pinyin: na4 di4 zhi3 zen3 me5 xie3 ne5
sentences.english: So how do you write an address?

sentences.hanzi: 日本的一个地方里面，有很多小块，每一块都有一个号。
sentences.pinyin: ri4 ben3 de5 yi1 ge5 di4 fang5 li3 mian4 you3 hen3 duo1 xiao3 kuai4 mei3 yi1 kuai4 dou1 you3 yi1 ge5 hao4
sentences.english: In Japan, an area is made up of many small blocks, and every block has a number.

sentences.hanzi: 地址上写的，是在哪一块，不是在哪条街。
sentences.pinyin: di4 zhi3 shang4 xie3 de5 shi4 zai4 na3 yi1 kuai4 bu4 shi4 zai4 na3 tiao2 jie1
sentences.english: What the address tells you is which block, not which street.

sentences.hanzi: 还有更奇怪的。
sentences.pinyin: hai2 you3 geng4 qi2 guai4 de5
sentences.english: There's something even stranger.

sentences.hanzi: 在一块里面，每一家的号也不是从左到右，一个一个来的。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 yi1 kuai4 li3 mian4 mei3 yi1 jia1 de5 hao4 ye3 bu4 shi4 cong2 zuo3 dao4 you4 yi1 ge5 yi1 ge5 lai2 de5
sentences.english: Inside a block, the buildings aren't numbered one by one from left to right either.

sentences.hanzi: 很多地方，号是看时间的：第一家是一号，第二家是二号。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 di4 fang5 hao4 shi4 kan4 shi2 jian1 de5 di4 yi1 jia1 shi4 yi1 hao4 di4 er4 jia1 shi4 er4 hao4
sentences.english: In many places, the numbers go by time: the first building is number one, the second is number two.

sentences.hanzi: 所以，一号的旁边，可能是十五号；十五号的对面，可能是三号。
sentences.pinyin: suo3 yi3 yi1 hao4 de5 pang2 bian1 ke3 neng2 shi4 shi2 wu3 hao4 shi2 wu3 hao4 de5 dui4 mian4 ke3 neng2 shi4 san1 hao4
sentences.english: So next to number one might be number fifteen, and opposite number fifteen might be number three.

sentences.hanzi: 第一次来日本的人，拿着地图，也会迷路。
sentences.pinyin: di4 yi1 ci4 lai2 ri4 ben3 de5 ren2 na2 zhe5 di4 tu2 ye3 hui4 mi2 lu4
sentences.english: People visiting Japan for the first time get lost even with a map in their hands.

sentences.hanzi: 不过，有一个地方不一样：京都。
sentences.pinyin: bu4 guo4 you3 yi1 ge5 di4 fang5 bu4 yi1 yang4 jing1 du1
sentences.english: There is one place that's different, though: Kyoto.

sentences.hanzi: 在京都，很多人说地址的时候，会说街的名字，还会说是往北，还是往南。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 jing1 du1 hen3 duo1 ren2 shuo1 di4 zhi3 de5 shi2 hou5 hui4 shuo1 jie1 de5 ming2 zi5 hai2 hui4 shuo1 shi4 wang3 bei3 hai2 shi5 wang3 nan2
sentences.english: In Kyoto, many people give an address with a street name, and say whether to go north or south along it.

sentences.hanzi: 为什么呢？
sentences.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 ne5
sentences.english: Why?

sentences.hanzi: 因为京都的街，和唐朝的长安一样，一条一条，从南到北，从东到西。
sentences.pinyin: yin1 wei4 jing1 du1 de5 jie1 he2 tang2 chao2 de5 chang2 an1 yi1 yang4 yi1 tiao2 yi1 tiao2 cong2 nan2 dao4 bei3 cong2 dong1 dao4 xi1
sentences.english: Because Kyoto's streets, like those of Tang dynasty Chang'an, run in neat lines from south to north and from east to west.

sentences.hanzi: 一千多年前，京都的街，就是看着长安的街做的。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 qian1 duo1 nian2 qian2 jing1 du1 de5 jie1 jiu4 shi4 kan4 zhe5 chang2 an1 de5 jie1 zuo4 de5
sentences.english: More than a thousand years ago, Kyoto's streets were laid out on the model of Chang'an's.

sentences.hanzi: 你看，一千多年前的长安，今天还在帮人找路。
sentences.pinyin: ni3 kan4 yi1 qian1 duo1 nian2 qian2 de5 chang2 an1 jin1 tian1 hai2 zai4 bang1 ren2 zhao3 lu4
sentences.english: So you see, the Chang'an of a thousand years ago is still helping people find their way today.

sentences.hanzi: 我在火星上已经住了三年。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zai4 huo3 xing1 shang4 yi3 jing1 zhu4 le5 san1 nian2
sentences.english: I've lived on Mars for three years now.

sentences.hanzi: 我们住的地方不大，只有几条街，一个公园，一个医院，一个学校。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhu4 de5 di4 fang5 bu4 da4 zhi3 you3 ji3 tiao2 jie1 yi1 ge5 gong1 yuan2 yi1 ge5 yi1 yuan4 yi1 ge5 xue2 xiao4
sentences.english: The place we live isn't big: just a few streets, a park, a hospital and a school.

sentences.hanzi: 有一天，我一个人去很远的地方工作。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 wo3 yi1 ge5 ren2 qu4 hen3 yuan3 de5 di4 fang5 gong1 zuo4
sentences.english: One day I went alone to a faraway place for work.

sentences.hanzi: 回来的时候，车上的地图坏了。
sentences.pinyin: hui2 lai5 de5 shi2 hou5 che1 shang4 de5 di4 tu2 huai4 le5
sentences.english: On the way back, the map in the car broke.

sentences.hanzi: 外面什么都没有，前面、后面、左边、右边，都是一样的。
sentences.pinyin: wai4 mian4 shen2 me5 dou1 mei2 you3 qian2 mian4 hou4 mian5 zuo3 bian5 you4 bian5 dou1 shi4 yi1 yang4 de5
sentences.english: Outside there was nothing. Ahead, behind, left and right, it all looked the same.

sentences.hanzi: 我想：我还有指南针。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 wo3 hai2 you3 zhi3 nan2 zhen1
sentences.english: I thought: I still have a compass.

sentences.hanzi: 可是指南针一直在动，一下往左，一下往右。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zhi3 nan2 zhen1 yi1 zhi2 zai4 dong4 yi1 xia4 wang3 zuo3 yi1 xia4 wang3 you4
sentences.english: But the compass needle kept moving, one moment left, the next moment right.

sentences.hanzi: 我这才想起来：在火星上，指南针是没有用的。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zhe4 cai2 xiang3 qi3 lai5 zai4 huo3 xing1 shang4 zhi3 nan2 zhen1 shi4 mei2 you3 yong4 de5
sentences.english: Only then did I remember: on Mars, a compass is useless.

sentences.hanzi: 我迷路了。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 mi2 lu4 le5
sentences.english: I was lost.

sentences.hanzi: 东边在哪儿？北边在哪儿？
sentences.pinyin: dong1 bian5 zai4 na3 r5 bei3 bian1 zai4 na3 r5
sentences.english: Where was east? Where was north?

sentences.hanzi: 太阳快下去了。我看着天，想到了妈妈说过的一句话：
sentences.pinyin: tai4 yang5 kuai4 xia4 qu4 le5 wo3 kan4 zhe5 tian1 xiang3 dao4 le5 ma1 ma5 shuo1 guo5 de5 yi1 ju4 hua4
sentences.english: The sun was about to set. I looked at the sky and thought of something my mother used to say:

sentences.hanzi: “太阳从东边出来，从西边下去。”
sentences.pinyin: tai4 yang5 cong2 dong1 bian5 chu1 lai2 cong2 xi1 bian1 xia4 qu4
sentences.english: "The sun comes up in the east and goes down in the west."

sentences.hanzi: 在火星上，也是一样的。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 huo3 xing1 shang4 ye3 shi4 yi1 yang4 de5
sentences.english: On Mars, it's the same.

sentences.hanzi: 太阳在我后面下去了，那我前面就是东。
sentences.pinyin: tai4 yang5 zai4 wo3 hou4 mian5 xia4 qu4 le5 na4 wo3 qian2 mian4 jiu4 shi4 dong1
sentences.english: The sun was setting behind me, so in front of me was east.

sentences.hanzi: 我们的家，就在东边。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 de5 jia1 jiu4 zai4 dong1 bian5
sentences.english: And our home was to the east.

sentences.hanzi: 我往东开了两个小时，才看到了我们的家。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wang3 dong1 kai1 le5 liang3 ge4 xiao3 shi2 cai2 kan4 dao4 le5 wo3 men5 de5 jia1
sentences.english: I drove east for two hours before I saw our home.

sentences.hanzi: 回家以后，我对孩子说：“在火星上，别相信指南针。”
sentences.pinyin: hui2 jia1 yi3 hou4 wo3 dui4 hai2 zi5 shuo1 zai4 huo3 xing1 shang4 bie2 xiang1 xin4 zhi3 nan2 zhen1
sentences.english: When I got home, I told my child: "On Mars, don't trust a compass."

sentences.hanzi: “要相信太阳，也要相信妈妈。”
sentences.pinyin: yao4 xiang1 xin4 tai4 yang5 ye3 yao4 xiang1 xin4 ma1 ma5
sentences.english: "Trust the sun, and trust your mother."

title: 你家有几个人
titlePinyin: ni3 jia1 you3 ji3 ge4 ren2
titleEnglish: How Many People Are in Your Family?

sentences.hanzi: 我有一个朋友，叫阿明。他是客家人。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 you3 yi1 ge5 peng2 you5 jiao4 a1 ming2 ta1 shi4 ke4 jia1 ren2
sentences.english: I have a friend called Aming. He's Hakka.

sentences.hanzi: 有一天，他带我回家看看。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 ta1 dai4 wo3 hui2 jia1 kan4 kan5
sentences.english: One day he took me home for a visit.

sentences.hanzi: 我问：“你家有几个人？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wen4 ni3 jia1 you3 ji3 ge4 ren2
sentences.english: I asked: "How many people are in your family?"

sentences.hanzi: 他想了想，说：“今天家里有两百多个。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 le5 xiang3 shuo1 jin1 tian1 jia1 li3 you3 liang3 bai3 duo1 ge4
sentences.english: He thought about it and said: "Today? Over two hundred at home."

sentences.hanzi: 我不相信。这么大的家，住在哪里？
sentences.pinyin: wo3 bu4 xiang1 xin4 zhe4 me5 da4 de5 jia1 zhu4 zai4 na3 li3
sentences.english: I didn't believe him. Where could a family that big live?

sentences.hanzi: 我们坐了很久的车，到了福建。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 zuo4 le5 hen3 jiu3 de5 che1 dao4 le5 fu2 jian4
sentences.english: We rode for a long time and reached Fujian.

sentences.hanzi: 我看见了他的家：一个很大很高的圆楼。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 kan4 jian4 le5 ta1 de5 jia1 yi1 ge5 hen3 da4 hen3 gao1 de5 yuan2 lou2
sentences.english: I saw his home: a huge, tall, round building.

sentences.hanzi: 这就是土楼。门很小，可是进了门，里面就是一个世界。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 tu3 lou2 men2 hen3 xiao3 ke3 shi4 jin4 le5 men2 li3 mian4 jiu4 shi4 yi1 ge5 shi4 jie4
sentences.english: This was a tulou. The door was small, but inside was a whole world.

sentences.hanzi: 这里有住的地方，有放东西的地方，孩子们也有玩的地方。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 li3 you3 zhu4 de5 di4 fang5 you3 fang4 dong1 xi5 de5 di4 fang5 hai2 zi5 men5 ye3 you3 wan2 de5 di4 fang5
sentences.english: There were places to live, places to store things, and places for the children to play.

sentences.hanzi: 阿明说：“这是我爷爷的弟弟，这是我叔叔，这是我姐姐的孩子。”
sentences.pinyin: a1 ming2 shuo1 zhe4 shi4 wo3 ye2 ye5 de5 di4 di5 zhe4 shi4 wo3 shu1 shu5 zhe4 shi4 wo3 jie3 jie5 de5 hai2 zi5
sentences.english: Aming said: "This is my grandpa's brother, this is my uncle, this is my sister's child."

sentences.hanzi: 我问：“你们的邻居呢？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wen4 ni3 men5 de5 lin2 ju1 ne5
sentences.english: I asked: "What about your neighbours?"

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“我们没有邻居。这里的人，都是一个家族的。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 wo3 men5 mei2 you3 lin2 ju1 zhe4 li3 de5 ren2 dou1 shi4 yi1 ge5 jia1 zu2 de5
sentences.english: He said: "We don't have neighbours. Everyone here belongs to one clan."

sentences.hanzi: 他告诉我，很久以前，他们的家族从北方到了这里。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 gao4 su5 wo3 hen3 jiu3 yi3 qian2 ta1 men5 de5 jia1 zu2 cong2 bei3 fang1 dao4 le5 zhe4 li3
sentences.english: He told me that long ago, his clan had come here from the north.

sentences.hanzi: 他们人不多，只有住在一起，别人才不敢来打他们。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 ren2 bu4 duo1 zhi3 you3 zhu4 zai4 yi1 qi3 bie2 ren2 cai2 bu4 gan3 lai2 da3 ta1 men5
sentences.english: There weren't many of them. Only by living together could they stop others from attacking.

sentences.hanzi: 所以一个楼就是一个家，一个家就是几百个人。
sentences.pinyin: suo3 yi3 yi1 ge5 lou2 jiu4 shi4 yi1 ge5 jia1 yi1 ge5 jia1 jiu4 shi4 ji3 bai3 ge4 ren2
sentences.english: So one building is one family, and one family is several hundred people.

sentences.hanzi: 回家以后，我站在我住的楼前面，看了很久。
sentences.pinyin: hui2 jia1 yi3 hou4 wo3 zhan4 zai4 wo3 zhu4 de5 lou2 qian2 mian4 kan4 le5 hen3 jiu3
sentences.english: After I got home, I stood in front of my own building and looked at it for a long time.

sentences.hanzi: 这个楼也很大，也住着两百多个人。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 lou2 ye3 hen3 da4 ye3 zhu4 zhe5 liang3 bai3 duo1 ge4 ren2
sentences.english: This building was big too, and over two hundred people lived in it as well.

sentences.hanzi: 可是我一个也不认识。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 wo3 yi1 ge5 ye3 bu4 ren4 shi5
sentences.english: But I didn't know a single one of them.

glossed.meaning: Fujian, a province in southeast China

title: 两千年前的家信
titlePinyin: liang3 qian1 nian2 qian2 de5 jia1 xin4
titleEnglish: A Letter Home from Two Thousand Years Ago

sentences.hanzi: 有人在中国发现了一个两千多年前的墓。
sentences.pinyin: you3 ren2 zai4 zhong1 guo2 fa1 xian4 le5 yi1 ge5 liang3 qian1 duo1 nian2 qian2 de5 mu4
sentences.english: Someone in China found a tomb more than two thousand years old.

sentences.hanzi: 墓里有两块木头。木头上，是两份家信。
sentences.pinyin: mu4 li3 you3 liang3 kuai4 mu4 tou5 mu4 tou5 shang4 shi4 liang3 fen4 jia1 xin4
sentences.english: In the tomb were two pieces of wood. On the wood were two letters home.

sentences.hanzi: 这是现在知道的中国最老的家信。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 xian4 zai4 zhi1 dao4 de5 zhong1 guo2 zui4 lao3 de5 jia1 xin4
sentences.english: They are the oldest family letters known in China.

sentences.hanzi: 写信的是兄弟俩，一个叫黑夫，一个叫惊。
sentences.pinyin: xie3 xin4 de5 shi4 xiong1 di4 lia3 yi1 ge5 jiao4 hei1 fu1 yi1 ge5 jiao4 jing1
sentences.english: The writers were two brothers, one called Heifu, the other called Jing.

sentences.hanzi: 那时候，秦国正在打楚国，兄弟俩都去了。
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi2 hou5 qin2 guo2 zheng4 zai4 da3 chu3 guo2 xiong1 di4 lia3 dou1 qu4 le5
sentences.english: At the time, the state of Qin was at war with Chu, and both brothers had gone.

sentences.hanzi: 他们离家很远，很久没有见到家人。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 li2 jia1 hen3 yuan3 hen3 jiu3 mei2 you3 jian4 dao4 jia1 ren2
sentences.english: They were far from home and hadn't seen their family for a long time.

sentences.hanzi: 两千多年前的人，给家里写信，会写什么呢？
sentences.pinyin: liang3 qian1 duo1 nian2 qian2 de5 ren2 gei3 jia1 li3 xie3 xin4 hui4 xie3 shen2 me5 ne5
sentences.english: What would people two thousand years ago write home about?

sentences.hanzi: 黑夫说：“哥哥好吗？母亲好吗？我们都好。”
sentences.pinyin: hei1 fu1 shuo1 ge1 ge5 hao3 ma5 mu3 qin1 hao3 ma5 wo3 men5 dou1 hao3
sentences.english: Heifu said: "How are you, brother? How is Mother? We are both well."

sentences.hanzi: “请母亲给我做衣服，再送一点钱来。”
sentences.pinyin: qing3 mu3 qin1 gei3 wo3 zuo4 yi1 fu5 zai4 song4 yi1 dian3 qian2 lai2
sentences.english: "Please ask Mother to make me clothes, and send a little money."

sentences.hanzi: 惊说：“请母亲给我五六百钱。”
sentences.pinyin: jing1 shuo1 qing3 mu3 qin1 gei3 wo3 wu3 liu4 bai3 qian2
sentences.english: Jing said: "Please ask Mother to give me five or six hundred coins."

sentences.hanzi: “如果家里不送，我就要死了。快！快！快！”
sentences.pinyin: ru2 guo3 jia1 li3 bu4 song4 wo3 jiu4 yao4 si3 le5 kuai4 kuai4 kuai4
sentences.english: "If home doesn't send it, I'll die. Quick! Quick! Quick!"

sentences.hanzi: 两千多年过去了，世界完全变了。
sentences.pinyin: liang3 qian1 duo1 nian2 guo4 qu4 le5 shi4 jie4 wan2 quan2 bian4 le5
sentences.english: More than two thousand years have passed, and the world has changed completely.

sentences.hanzi: 可是离开家的儿子，还是在给妈妈打电话要钱。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 li2 kai1 jia1 de5 er2 zi5 hai2 shi5 zai4 gei3 ma1 ma5 da3 dian4 hua4 yao4 qian2
sentences.english: But sons who leave home are still phoning their mothers for money.

sentences.hanzi: 我们不知道兄弟俩有没有回家。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 bu4 zhi1 dao4 xiong1 di4 lia3 you3 mei2 you3 hui2 jia1
sentences.english: We don't know if the brothers ever came home.

sentences.hanzi: 也不知道母亲有没有送钱。
sentences.pinyin: ye3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 mu3 qin1 you3 mei2 you3 song4 qian2
sentences.english: We don't know if their mother sent the money.

sentences.hanzi: 很多人认为，这是他们哥哥的墓。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 ren2 ren4 wei2 zhe4 shi4 ta1 men5 ge1 ge5 de5 mu4
sentences.english: Many people think this was their older brother's tomb.

sentences.hanzi: 他死的时候，还带着弟弟的信。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 si3 de5 shi2 hou5 hai2 dai4 zhe5 di4 di5 de5 xin4
sentences.english: When he died, he still had his younger brothers' letters with him.

sentences.hanzi: 今天弟弟一岁了。家里来了很多人。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 di4 di5 yi1 sui4 le5 jia1 li3 lai2 le5 hen3 duo1 ren2
sentences.english: My little brother turned one today. Lots of people came to our home.

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷、奶奶、叔叔都来了，可是谁也没有看我。
sentences.pinyin: ye2 ye5 nai3 nai5 shu1 shu5 dou1 lai2 le5 ke3 shi4 shei2 ye3 mei2 you3 kan4 wo3
sentences.english: Grandpa, Grandma and my uncle all came, but nobody looked at me.

sentences.hanzi: 从弟弟来了以后，大家都只看他。
sentences.pinyin: cong2 di4 di5 lai2 le5 yi3 hou4 da4 jia1 dou1 zhi3 kan4 ta1
sentences.english: Ever since my brother came along, everyone only looks at him.

sentences.hanzi: 妈妈说，今天要抓周。
sentences.pinyin: ma1 ma5 shuo1 jin1 tian1 yao4 zhua1 zhou1
sentences.english: Mum said that today we'd do the zhuazhou.

sentences.hanzi: 孩子一岁生日的时候，家人把很多东西放在他前面。
sentences.pinyin: hai2 zi5 yi1 sui4 sheng1 ri4 de5 shi2 hou5 jia1 ren2 ba3 hen3 duo1 dong1 xi5 fang4 zai4 ta1 qian2 mian4
sentences.english: On a child's first birthday, the family puts lots of things in front of him.

sentences.hanzi: 他先抓什么，以后就可能做什么。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xian1 zhua1 shen2 me5 yi3 hou4 jiu4 ke3 neng2 zuo4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: Whatever he grabs first is what he may do in life.

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷放了一本书：“宝贝，抓书！书里什么都有！”
sentences.pinyin: ye2 ye5 fang4 le5 yi1 ben3 shu1 bao3 bei4 zhua1 shu1 shu1 li3 shen2 me5 dou1 you3
sentences.english: Grandpa put down a book: "Sweetheart, grab the book! Everything's in books!"

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸放了他的电话：“抓这个！”
sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 fang4 le5 ta1 de5 dian4 hua4 zhua1 zhe4 ge5
sentences.english: Dad put down his phone: "Grab this!"

sentences.hanzi: 叔叔放了一些钱：“抓钱！这个才重要！”
sentences.pinyin: shu1 shu5 fang4 le5 yi1 xie1 qian2 zhua1 qian2 zhe4 ge5 cai2 zhong4 yao4
sentences.english: My uncle put down some money: "Grab the money! That's what matters!"

sentences.hanzi: 大家都很高兴。我站在门旁边，没有人叫我。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 hen3 gao1 xing4 wo3 zhan4 zai4 men2 pang2 bian1 mei2 you3 ren2 jiao4 wo3
sentences.english: Everyone was happy. I stood by the door, and nobody called me.

sentences.hanzi: 弟弟看看书，看看电话，看看钱，不动。
sentences.pinyin: di4 di5 kan4 kan5 shu1 kan4 kan5 dian4 hua4 kan4 kan5 qian2 bu4 dong4
sentences.english: My brother looked at the book, the phone and the money, and didn't move.

sentences.hanzi: 大家都不说话了。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 bu4 shuo1 hua4 le5
sentences.english: Everyone went quiet.

sentences.hanzi: 然后，他动了。
sentences.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ta1 dong4 le5
sentences.english: Then he moved.

sentences.hanzi: 他从书的旁边过去，从钱的旁边过去，一直到了门旁边。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 cong2 shu1 de5 pang2 bian1 guo4 qu4 cong2 qian2 de5 pang2 bian1 guo4 qu4 yi1 zhi2 dao4 le5 men2 pang2 bian1
sentences.english: He went past the book, past the money, all the way to the door.

sentences.hanzi: 他抓了我的手。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zhua1 le5 wo3 de5 shou3
sentences.english: He grabbed my hand.

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷问：“这是什么意思？”
sentences.pinyin: ye2 ye5 wen4 zhe4 shi4 shen2 me5 yi4 si5
sentences.english: Grandpa asked: "What does that mean?"

sentences.hanzi: 奶奶说：“这孩子什么都知道。书和钱以后都会有，姐姐只有一个。”
sentences.pinyin: nai3 nai5 shuo1 zhe4 hai2 zi5 shen2 me5 dou1 zhi1 dao4 shu1 he2 qian2 yi3 hou4 dou1 hui4 you3 jie3 jie5 zhi3 you3 yi1 ge5
sentences.english: Grandma said: "This child knows everything. Books and money will come later. He only has one big sister."

sentences.hanzi: 他的手很小，抓着我，不放。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 shou3 hen3 xiao3 zhua1 zhe5 wo3 bu4 fang4
sentences.english: His hand was tiny. It held on to me and wouldn't let go.

sentences.hanzi: 晚上，我把最大的一块蛋糕给了他。
sentences.pinyin: wan3 shang5 wo3 ba3 zui4 da4 de5 yi1 kuai4 dan4 gao1 gei3 le5 ta1
sentences.english: That night, I gave him the biggest piece of cake.

sentences.hanzi: 九百多年前的宋朝，有一对夫妇。
sentences.pinyin: jiu3 bai3 duo1 nian2 qian2 de5 song4 chao2 you3 yi1 dui4 fu1 fu4
sentences.english: Over nine hundred years ago, in the Song dynasty, there was a married couple.

sentences.hanzi: 妻子叫李清照，丈夫叫赵明诚。
sentences.pinyin: qi1 zi5 jiao4 li3 qing1 zhao4 zhang4 fu5 jiao4 zhao4 ming2 cheng2
sentences.english: The wife was called Li Qingzhao, and the husband Zhao Mingcheng.

sentences.hanzi: 李清照会写诗，是中国最有名的女诗人。
sentences.pinyin: li3 qing1 zhao4 hui4 xie3 shi1 shi4 zhong1 guo2 zui4 you3 ming2 de5 nu:3 shi1 ren2
sentences.english: Li Qingzhao wrote poetry, and she is China's most famous woman poet.

sentences.hanzi: 他们结婚以后，没有很多钱，可是两个人都爱书。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 jie2 hun1 yi3 hou4 mei2 you3 hen3 duo1 qian2 ke3 shi4 liang3 ge4 ren2 dou1 ai4 shu1
sentences.english: After they married they didn't have much money, but they both loved books.

sentences.hanzi: 有了一点钱，他们就去买书。没有钱，就拿衣服去换。
sentences.pinyin: you3 le5 yi1 dian3 qian2 ta1 men5 jiu4 qu4 mai3 shu1 mei2 you3 qian2 jiu4 na2 yi1 fu5 qu4 huan4
sentences.english: When they had a little money, they bought books. When they had none, they traded clothes for them.

sentences.hanzi: 家里的书一年比一年多。晚上，两个人有一件最喜欢的事。
sentences.pinyin: jia1 li3 de5 shu1 yi1 nian2 bi3 yi1 nian2 duo1 wan3 shang5 liang3 ge4 ren2 you3 yi1 jian4 zui4 xi3 huan5 de5 shi4
sentences.english: Their home filled with more books every year. In the evenings, the two had a favourite thing to do.

sentences.hanzi: 他们坐在一起，一个人说一句话，另一个人要说出，这句话在什么书的什么地方。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 zuo4 zai4 yi1 qi3 yi1 ge5 ren2 shuo1 yi1 ju4 hua4 ling4 yi1 ge5 ren2 yao4 shuo1 chu1 zhe4 ju4 hua4 zai4 shen2 me5 shu1 de5 shen2 me5 di4 fang5
sentences.english: They sat together. One would say a line, and the other had to say which book it was in, and where.

sentences.hanzi: 谁说对了，谁就先喝茶。
sentences.pinyin: shei2 shuo1 dui4 le5 shei2 jiu4 xian1 he1 cha2
sentences.english: Whoever got it right drank tea first.

sentences.hanzi: 李清照说对的时候很多。
sentences.pinyin: li3 qing1 zhao4 shuo1 dui4 de5 shi2 hou5 hen3 duo1
sentences.english: Li Qingzhao was often right.

sentences.hanzi: 有一次，她又说对了。她太高兴了，手上的茶全倒在了衣服上。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 ci4 ta1 you4 shuo1 dui4 le5 ta1 tai4 gao1 xing4 le5 shou3 shang4 de5 cha2 quan2 dao4 zai4 le5 yi1 fu5 shang4
sentences.english: Once she got it right again. She was so happy that the tea in her hand spilled all over her clothes.

sentences.hanzi: 结果，她什么也没有喝到。
sentences.pinyin: jie2 guo3 ta1 shen2 me5 ye3 mei2 you3 he1 dao4
sentences.english: So she got nothing to drink at all.

sentences.hanzi: 那是他们最亲密的时候。
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi4 ta1 men5 zui4 qin1 mi4 de5 shi2 hou5
sentences.english: That was the closest they ever were.

sentences.hanzi: 之后，金国打了过来，他们必须离开家。
sentences.pinyin: zhi1 hou4 jin1 guo2 da3 le5 guo4 lai2 ta1 men5 bi4 xu1 li2 kai1 jia1
sentences.english: Later the Jin invaded, and they had to leave home.

sentences.hanzi: 很多书都没有了。丈夫也死了。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 shu1 dou1 mei2 you3 le5 zhang4 fu5 ye3 si3 le5
sentences.english: Many of the books were lost. Her husband died too.

sentences.hanzi: 李清照一个人带着最后的一些书，向南走了很多年。
sentences.pinyin: li3 qing1 zhao4 yi1 ge5 ren2 dai4 zhe5 zui4 hou4 de5 yi1 xie1 shu1 xiang4 nan2 zou3 le5 hen3 duo1 nian2
sentences.english: Li Qingzhao alone carried the last of the books, moving south for many years.

sentences.hanzi: 老了以后，她把这些事都写了下来。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 le5 yi3 hou4 ta1 ba3 zhe4 xie1 shi4 dou1 xie3 le5 xia4 lai5
sentences.english: When she was old, she wrote it all down.

sentences.hanzi: 那杯茶，她写得非常清楚。
sentences.pinyin: na4 bei1 cha2 ta1 xie3 de5 fei1 chang2 qing1 chu5
sentences.english: That cup of tea, she described very clearly.

sentences.hanzi: 那杯茶她没有喝到。可是她最想再喝的，就是那一杯。
sentences.pinyin: na4 bei1 cha2 ta1 mei2 you3 he1 dao4 ke3 shi4 ta1 zui4 xiang3 zai4 he1 de5 jiu4 shi4 na4 yi1 bei1
sentences.english: She never drank that cup of tea. But it was the one she most wanted to have again.

glossed.meaning: Li Qingzhao, a Song dynasty poet

sentences.hanzi: 我七岁生日的时候，爸爸走了。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 qi1 sui4 sheng1 ri4 de5 shi2 hou5 ba4 ba5 zou3 le5
sentences.english: On my seventh birthday, my father left.

sentences.hanzi: 他要坐飞船去很远的地方。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yao4 zuo4 fei1 chuan2 qu4 hen3 yuan3 de5 di4 fang5
sentences.english: He was going far away on a spaceship.

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“宝贝，爸爸回来的时候，给你过生日。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 bao3 bei4 ba4 ba5 hui2 lai5 de5 shi2 hou5 gei3 ni3 guo4 sheng1 ri4
sentences.english: He said: "Sweetheart, when Daddy gets back, we'll celebrate your birthday."

sentences.hanzi: 这个飞船非常快，快到时间都变了。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 fei1 chuan2 fei1 chang2 kuai4 kuai4 dao4 shi2 jian1 dou1 bian4 le5
sentences.english: The ship was so fast that time itself changed.

sentences.hanzi: 在飞船上过一年，我们这里就过了十二年。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 fei1 chuan2 shang4 guo4 yi1 nian2 wo3 men5 zhe4 li3 jiu4 guo4 le5 shi2 er4 nian2
sentences.english: One year on the ship was twelve years here.

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸走了五年。我等了六十年。
sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 zou3 le5 wu3 nian2 wo3 deng3 le5 liu4 shi2 nian2
sentences.english: My father was gone five years. I waited sixty.

sentences.hanzi: 我结婚了，有了孩子，孩子又有了孩子。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 jie2 hun1 le5 you3 le5 hai2 zi5 hai2 zi5 you4 you3 le5 hai2 zi5
sentences.english: I married and had children, and they had children.

sentences.hanzi: 我已经是老奶奶了。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 yi3 jing1 shi4 lao3 nai3 nai5 le5
sentences.english: I became a grandmother.

sentences.hanzi: 今天，飞船回来了。很多人在等。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 fei1 chuan2 hui2 lai5 le5 hen3 duo1 ren2 zai4 deng3
sentences.english: Today, the ship came back. Many people were waiting.

sentences.hanzi: 一个年轻的男人走了出来。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 nian2 qing1 de5 nan2 ren2 zou3 le5 chu1 lai2
sentences.english: A young man walked out.

sentences.hanzi: 他看了看每个人，还在找。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 le5 kan4 mei3 ge5 ren2 hai2 zai4 zhao3
sentences.english: He looked at everyone, still searching.

sentences.hanzi: 我知道他在找谁。他在找一个七岁的女孩。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zhi1 dao4 ta1 zai4 zhao3 shei2 ta1 zai4 zhao3 yi1 ge5 qi1 sui4 de5 nu:3 hai2
sentences.english: I knew who he was looking for. A seven-year-old girl.

sentences.hanzi: 我走过去，说：“爸爸。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zou3 guo4 qu4 shuo1 ba4 ba5
sentences.english: I walked over and said: "Dad."

sentences.hanzi: 他看着我，很久没有说话。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 zhe5 wo3 hen3 jiu3 mei2 you3 shuo1 hua4
sentences.english: He looked at me and said nothing for a long time.

sentences.hanzi: 这个比我年轻很多的男人，是我的父亲。
