sentences.pinyin: ji3 tian1 yi3 hou4 yi1 ge5 ren2 dao4 le5 luo4 yang2
sentences.english: A few days later, a man arrived in Luoyang.

sentences.hanzi: 他说：陇西发生了大地震。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 long3 xi1 fa1 sheng1 le5 da4 di4 zhen4
sentences.english: He said there had been a great earthquake in Longxi.

sentences.hanzi: 陇西离洛阳很远很远。
sentences.pinyin: long3 xi1 li2 luo4 yang2 hen3 yuan3 hen3 yuan3
sentences.english: Longxi was very, very far from Luoyang.

sentences.hanzi: 那条龙对着的，就是陇西。
sentences.pinyin: na4 tiao2 long2 dui4 zhe5 de5 jiu4 shi4 long3 xi1
sentences.english: And the dragon had been facing Longxi.

sentences.hanzi: 大家这才相信了。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 zhe4 cai2 xiang1 xin4 le5
sentences.english: Only then did everyone believe it.

sentences.hanzi: 这件事，历史上有记录。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 jian4 shi4 li4 shi3 shang4 you3 ji4 lu4
sentences.english: This is recorded in the history books.

sentences.hanzi: 可是，张衡的这个东西，以后没有留下来。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zhang1 heng2 de5 zhe4 ge5 dong1 xi5 yi3 hou4 mei2 you3 liu2 xia4 lai2
sentences.english: But Zhang Heng's device itself did not survive.

sentences.hanzi: 今天，博物馆里的那个，是今天的人做的。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 bo2 wu4 guan3 li3 de5 na4 ge5 shi4 jin1 tian1 de5 ren2 zuo4 de5
sentences.english: The one in museums today was made by people in modern times.

sentences.hanzi: 它的里面是什么样子？
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 li3 mian4 shi4 shen2 me5 yang4 zi5
sentences.english: What was it like inside?

sentences.hanzi: 到现在，也没有人知道。
sentences.pinyin: dao4 xian4 zai4 ye3 mei2 you3 ren2 zhi1 dao4
sentences.english: To this day, nobody knows.

glossed.meaning: Zhang Heng, a scientist and official
Longxi, a region in the northwest

sentences.hanzi: 我爸爸有一个爱好：钓鱼。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 ba4 ba5 you3 yi1 ge5 ai4 hao4 diao4 yu2
sentences.english: My dad has a hobby: fishing.

sentences.hanzi: 很多人觉得钓鱼很无聊，可是爸爸不觉得。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 ren2 jue2 de5 diao4 yu2 hen3 wu2 liao2 ke3 shi4 ba4 ba5 bu4 jue2 de5
sentences.english: Lots of people think fishing is boring, but Dad doesn't.

sentences.hanzi: 每个周末，他很早就离开家，一个人去公园钓鱼。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 ge5 zhou1 mo4 ta1 hen3 zao3 jiu4 li2 kai1 jia1 yi1 ge5 ren2 qu4 gong1 yuan2 diao4 yu2
sentences.english: Every weekend, he leaves home very early and goes fishing in the park by himself.

sentences.hanzi: 晚上回来的时候，他总是很高兴。
sentences.pinyin: wan3 shang5 hui2 lai5 de5 shi2 hou5 ta1 zong3 shi4 hen3 gao1 xing4
sentences.english: When he comes back in the evening, he's always very happy.

sentences.hanzi: 可是，他从来没有带回来过一条鱼。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ta1 cong2 lai2 mei2 you3 dai4 hui2 lai2 guo5 yi1 tiao2 yu2
sentences.english: But he has never brought home a single fish.

sentences.hanzi: 妈妈说：“你钓鱼钓了十年，一条鱼都没有？”
sentences.pinyin: ma1 ma5 shuo1 ni3 diao4 yu2 diao4 le5 shi2 nian2 yi1 tiao2 yu2 dou1 mei2 you3
sentences.english: Mom says: "You've been fishing for ten years, and not one fish?"

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸说：“没办法，鱼不喜欢我。”
sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 shuo1 mei2 ban4 fa3 yu2 bu4 xi3 huan5 wo3
sentences.english: Dad says: "Nothing I can do. Fish don't like me."

sentences.hanzi: 我不相信。有一个周末，我跟他一起去了。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 bu4 xiang1 xin4 you3 yi1 ge5 zhou1 mo4 wo3 gen1 ta1 yi1 qi3 qu4 le5
sentences.english: I didn't believe it. One weekend, I went with him.

sentences.hanzi: 我们坐在公园里，等了很久。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 zuo4 zai4 gong1 yuan2 li3 deng3 le5 hen3 jiu3
sentences.english: We sat in the park and waited a long time.

sentences.hanzi: 然后，爸爸钓到了一条大鱼！
sentences.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ba4 ba5 diao4 dao4 le5 yi1 tiao2 da4 yu2
sentences.english: Then Dad caught a big fish!

sentences.hanzi: 我非常高兴，可是爸爸看了看鱼，又把它放回去了。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 fei1 chang2 gao1 xing4 ke3 shi4 ba4 ba5 kan4 le5 kan4 yu2 you4 ba3 ta1 fang4 hui2 qu5 le5
sentences.english: I was thrilled, but Dad looked at the fish and put it back.

sentences.hanzi: 我问：“为什么？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wen4 wei4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: I asked: "Why?"

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“我喜欢钓鱼，可是不喜欢吃鱼。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 wo3 xi3 huan5 diao4 yu2 ke3 shi4 bu4 xi3 huan5 chi1 yu2
sentences.english: He said: "I like fishing, but I don't like eating fish."

sentences.hanzi: “那你为什么每个周末都来？”
sentences.pinyin: na4 ni3 wei4 shen2 me5 mei3 ge5 zhou1 mo4 dou1 lai2
sentences.english: "Then why do you come every weekend?"

sentences.hanzi: “回家以后，大家都找我。在这里，只有鱼找我。”
sentences.pinyin: hui2 jia1 yi3 hou4 da4 jia1 dou1 zhao3 wo3 zai4 zhe4 li3 zhi3 you3 yu2 zhao3 wo3
sentences.english: "At home, everyone wants something from me. Here, only the fish come looking for me."

sentences.hanzi: “这是我一个人的休闲时间，我可以完全放松。”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 wo3 yi1 ge5 ren2 de5 xiu1 xian2 shi2 jian1 wo3 ke3 yi3 wan2 quan2 fang4 song1
sentences.english: "This is my own free time. I can relax completely."

sentences.hanzi: 晚上回家，妈妈问：“今天有鱼吗？”
sentences.pinyin: wan3 shang5 hui2 jia1 ma1 ma5 wen4 jin1 tian1 you3 yu2 ma5
sentences.english: When we got home that evening, Mom asked: "Any fish today?"

sentences.hanzi: 我和爸爸一起说：“没有。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 he2 ba4 ba5 yi1 qi3 shuo1 mei2 you3
sentences.english: Dad and I said together: "No."

glossed.meaning: to catch with a hook and line

sentences.hanzi: 我有两个爱好：爬山和下棋。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 you3 liang3 ge4 ai4 hao4 pa2 shan1 he2 xia4 qi2
sentences.english: I have two hobbies: climbing mountains and playing board games.

sentences.hanzi: 前两年，我去浙江旅游，参观了衢州的烂柯山。
sentences.pinyin: qian2 liang3 nian2 wo3 qu4 zhe4 jiang1 lu:3 you2 can1 guan1 le5 qu2 zhou1 de5 lan4 ke1 shan1
sentences.english: A couple of years ago, I went travelling in Zhejiang and visited Lanke Mountain in Quzhou.

sentences.hanzi: 山不高，很好玩。山上的人告诉我一件很久以前的事。
sentences.pinyin: shan1 bu4 gao1 hen3 hao3 wan2 shan1 shang4 de5 ren2 gao4 su5 wo3 yi1 jian4 hen3 jiu3 yi3 qian2 de5 shi4
sentences.english: The mountain isn't high, and it was fun. Someone on the mountain told me about something from long ago.

sentences.hanzi: 听说，那时候有一个男人，叫王质。
sentences.pinyin: ting1 shuo1 na4 shi2 hou5 you3 yi1 ge5 nan2 ren2 jiao4 wang2 zhi4
sentences.english: The story goes that there was a man then called Wang Zhi.

sentences.hanzi: 有一天，他带着斧头上山工作。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 ta1 dai4 zhe5 fu3 tou5 shang4 shan1 gong1 zuo4
sentences.english: One day, he went up the mountain to work, carrying his axe.

sentences.hanzi: 在山上，他看到两个孩子在下围棋。围棋是一种很老的游戏。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 shan1 shang4 ta1 kan4 dao4 liang3 ge4 hai2 zi5 zai4 xia4 wei2 qi2 wei2 qi2 shi4 yi1 zhong3 hen3 lao3 de5 you2 xi4
sentences.english: On the mountain, he saw two boys playing Go. Go is a very old game.

sentences.hanzi: 王质也喜欢下棋，就站在旁边看。
sentences.pinyin: wang2 zhi4 ye3 xi3 huan5 xia4 qi2 jiu4 zhan4 zai4 pang2 bian1 kan4
sentences.english: Wang Zhi liked board games too, so he stood beside them and watched.

sentences.hanzi: 两个孩子下得非常好，他看得很高兴，什么都忘了。
sentences.pinyin: liang3 ge4 hai2 zi5 xia4 de5 fei1 chang2 hao3 ta1 kan4 de5 hen3 gao1 xing4 shen2 me5 dou1 wang4 le5
sentences.english: The two boys played very well. He enjoyed watching so much that he forgot everything else.

sentences.hanzi: 他们下完了，一个孩子问他：“你为什么还不回家？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 xia4 wan2 le5 yi1 ge5 hai2 zi5 wen4 ta1 ni3 wei4 shen2 me5 hai2 bu4 hui2 jia1
sentences.english: When they had finished, one of the boys asked him: "Why haven't you gone home yet?"

sentences.hanzi: 王质看了看自己的斧头，发现它已经坏了。
sentences.pinyin: wang2 zhi4 kan4 le5 kan4 zi4 ji3 de5 fu3 tou5 fa1 xian4 ta1 yi3 jing1 huai4 le5
sentences.english: Wang Zhi looked at his axe and found that it had fallen apart.

sentences.hanzi: 他马上回家。可是他家的人，他一个都不认识。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 ma3 shang4 hui2 jia1 ke3 shi4 ta1 jia1 de5 ren2 ta1 yi1 ge5 dou1 bu4 ren4 shi5
sentences.english: He went home at once. But he didn't know a single person in his house.

sentences.hanzi: 他问一个老人：“王质的妈妈呢？他的孩子呢？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 wen4 yi1 ge5 lao3 ren2 wang2 zhi4 de5 ma1 ma5 ne5 ta1 de5 hai2 zi5 ne5
sentences.english: He asked an old man: "Where is Wang Zhi's mother? Where are his children?"

sentences.hanzi: 老人说：“王质？那是很多很多年以前的人了。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ren2 shuo1 wang2 zhi4 na4 shi4 hen3 duo1 hen3 duo1 nian2 yi3 qian2 de5 ren2 le5
sentences.english: The old man said: "Wang Zhi? He lived many, many years ago."

sentences.hanzi: 王质只看了两个孩子下棋，可是山下已经过了很多年。
sentences.pinyin: wang2 zhi4 zhi3 kan4 le5 liang3 ge4 hai2 zi5 xia4 qi2 ke3 shi4 shan1 xia4 yi3 jing1 guo4 le5 hen3 duo1 nian2
sentences.english: Wang Zhi had only watched two boys play, but down the mountain, many years had passed.

sentences.hanzi: 人们说，“烂柯”说的就是王质的斧头。
sentences.pinyin: ren2 men5 shuo1 lan4 ke1 shuo1 de5 jiu4 shi4 wang2 zhi4 de5 fu3 tou5
sentences.english: People say that "Lanke" ("the rotten axe handle") is about Wang Zhi's axe.

sentences.hanzi: 现在，有些人还叫围棋“烂柯”。
sentences.pinyin: xian4 zai4 you3 xie1 ren2 hai2 jiao4 wei2 qi2 lan4 ke1
sentences.english: Even now, some people call Go "Lanke".

sentences.hanzi: 所以，下棋很有意思，可是下棋的时候，别忘了看看时间。
sentences.pinyin: suo3 yi3 xia4 qi2 hen3 you3 yi4 si5 ke3 shi4 xia4 qi2 de5 shi2 hou5 bie2 wang4 le5 kan4 kan5 shi2 jian1
sentences.english: So board games are great fun, but when you play, don't forget to keep an eye on the time.

glossed.meaning: Zhejiang, a province in eastern China
Wang Zhi, a man in an old legend

sentences.hanzi: 二一五零年，三百个人坐上一个大飞船，去一个很远很远的星球。
sentences.pinyin: er4 yi1 wu3 ling2 nian2 san1 bai3 ge4 ren2 zuo4 shang4 yi1 ge5 da4 fei1 chuan2 qu4 yi1 ge5 hen3 yuan3 hen3 yuan3 de5 xing1 qiu2
sentences.english: In 2150, three hundred people boarded a big spaceship bound for a very, very distant planet.

sentences.hanzi: 他们要在飞船上住四十年。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 yao4 zai4 fei1 chuan2 shang4 zhu4 si4 shi2 nian2
sentences.english: They would live on the ship for forty years.

sentences.hanzi: 飞船上的工作，不需要人做。
sentences.pinyin: fei1 chuan2 shang4 de5 gong1 zuo4 bu4 xu1 yao4 ren2 zuo4
sentences.english: The work on the ship didn't need people to do it.

sentences.hanzi: 所以，人们最大的问题不是工作，是无聊。
sentences.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ren2 men5 zui4 da4 de5 wen4 ti2 bu4 shi4 gong1 zuo4 shi4 wu2 liao2
sentences.english: So people's biggest problem wasn't work. It was boredom.

sentences.hanzi: 飞船的计划里有一条：每个人都必须有一个爱好。
sentences.pinyin: fei1 chuan2 de5 ji4 hua4 li3 you3 yi1 tiao2 mei3 ge5 ren2 dou1 bi4 xu1 you3 yi1 ge5 ai4 hao4
sentences.english: The ship's plan had one rule: everyone must have a hobby.

sentences.hanzi: 小李不喜欢这一条。他说：“我对什么都没有兴趣。”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 li3 bu4 xi3 huan5 zhe4 yi1 tiao2 ta1 shuo1 wo3 dui4 shen2 me5 dou1 mei2 you3 xing4 qu4
sentences.english: Xiao Li didn't like that rule. He said: "I'm not interested in anything."

sentences.hanzi: 第一年，他试了钢琴，觉得太难。
sentences.pinyin: di4 yi1 nian2 ta1 shi4 le5 gang1 qin2 jue2 de5 tai4 nan2
sentences.english: The first year, he tried the piano, and found it too hard.

sentences.hanzi: 第二年，他试了下棋，可是别人都比他下得好。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 nian2 ta1 shi4 le5 xia4 qi2 ke3 shi4 bie2 ren5 dou1 bi3 ta1 xia4 de5 hao3
sentences.english: The second year, he tried chess, but everyone played better than him.

sentences.hanzi: 第三年，他试了唱歌、跳舞和做饭，都觉得没有意思。
sentences.pinyin: di4 san1 nian2 ta1 shi4 le5 chang4 ge1 tiao4 wu3 he2 zuo4 fan4 dou1 jue2 de5 mei2 you3 yi4 si5
sentences.english: The third year, he tried singing, dancing and cooking, and found them all dull.

sentences.hanzi: 第四年，他开始画画。
sentences.pinyin: di4 si4 nian2 ta1 kai1 shi3 hua4 hua4
sentences.english: The fourth year, he started to draw and paint.

sentences.hanzi: 他画飞船里的人：在吃东西的人，在说话的人，在玩的孩子。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 hua4 fei1 chuan2 li3 de5 ren2 zai4 chi1 dong1 xi5 de5 ren2 zai4 shuo1 hua4 de5 ren2 zai4 wan2 de5 hai2 zi5
sentences.english: He drew the people on the ship: people eating, people talking, children playing.

sentences.hanzi: 他画了一张又一张，画了三十六年。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 hua4 le5 yi1 zhang1 you4 yi1 zhang1 hua4 le5 san1 shi2 liu4 nian2
sentences.english: He drew one picture after another, for thirty-six years.

sentences.hanzi: 最后，飞船到了新的星球。
sentences.pinyin: zui4 hou4 fei1 chuan2 dao4 le5 xin1 de5 xing1 qiu2
sentences.english: At last, the ship reached the new planet.

sentences.hanzi: 人们在新星球上做的第一件事，是开一个博物馆。
sentences.pinyin: ren2 men5 zai4 xin1 xing1 qiu2 shang4 zuo4 de5 di4 yi1 jian4 shi4 shi4 kai1 yi1 ge5 bo2 wu4 guan3
sentences.english: The first thing people did on the new planet was open a museum.

sentences.hanzi: 博物馆里，都是小李的画。
sentences.pinyin: bo2 wu4 guan3 li3 dou1 shi4 xiao3 li3 de5 hua4
sentences.english: The museum was full of Xiao Li's pictures.

sentences.hanzi: 飞船上的每一个人，都在他的画里。
sentences.pinyin: fei1 chuan2 shang4 de5 mei3 yi1 ge5 ren2 dou1 zai4 ta1 de5 hua4 li3
sentences.english: Every single person from the ship was in his pictures.

sentences.hanzi: 有人问小李：“你为什么可以画这么久？”
sentences.pinyin: you3 ren2 wen4 xiao3 li3 ni3 wei4 shen2 me5 ke3 yi3 hua4 zhe4 me5 jiu3
sentences.english: Someone asked Xiao Li: "How could you keep drawing for so long?"

sentences.hanzi: 小李说：“因为太无聊了。谢谢无聊。”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 li3 shuo1 yin1 wei4 tai4 wu2 liao2 le5 xie4 xie5 wu2 liao2
sentences.english: Xiao Li said: "Because I was so bored. Thank you, boredom."

sentences.hanzi: 北京有一个地方，叫潘家园。
sentences.pinyin: bei3 jing1 you3 yi1 ge5 di4 fang5 jiao4 pan1 jia1 yuan2
sentences.english: In Beijing, there is a place called Panjiayuan.

sentences.hanzi: 很多人在这里卖老东西。在北京，没有比这里更大的。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 ren2 zai4 zhe4 li3 mai4 lao3 dong1 xi5 zai4 bei3 jing1 mei2 you3 bi3 zhe4 li3 geng4 da4 de5
sentences.english: Lots of people sell old things here. In Beijing, there's nowhere bigger of its kind.

sentences.hanzi: 周末的时候，这里人特别多，很早就有人来了。
sentences.pinyin: zhou1 mo4 de5 shi2 hou5 zhe4 li3 ren2 te4 bie2 duo1 hen3 zao3 jiu4 you3 ren2 lai2 le5
sentences.english: On weekends it gets especially crowded, and people start arriving very early.

sentences.hanzi: 我的朋友老张，有一个爱好：收集老东西。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 de5 peng2 you5 lao3 zhang1 you3 yi1 ge5 ai4 hao4 shou1 ji2 lao3 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: My friend Old Zhang has a hobby: collecting old things.

sentences.hanzi: 每个周末，他都去潘家园逛街，这是他最大的兴趣。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 ge5 zhou1 mo4 ta1 dou1 qu4 pan1 jia1 yuan2 guang4 jie1 zhe4 shi4 ta1 zui4 da4 de5 xing4 qu4
sentences.english: Every weekend, he goes browsing round Panjiayuan. It's his greatest passion.

sentences.hanzi: 二十年来，他买了很多东西：老钱、老电话、老玩具……
sentences.pinyin: er4 shi2 nian2 lai2 ta1 mai3 le5 hen3 duo1 dong1 xi5 lao3 qian2 lao3 dian4 hua4 lao3 wan2 ju4
sentences.english: Over twenty years, he has bought lots of things: old coins, old telephones, old toys...

sentences.hanzi: 可是我知道，这里的东西，很多都是假的。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 wo3 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 li3 de5 dong1 xi5 hen3 duo1 dou1 shi4 jia3 de5
sentences.english: But I know that a lot of the things here are fake.

sentences.hanzi: 有一次，他买了一个“一百年前”的玩具。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 ci4 ta1 mai3 le5 yi1 ge5 yi1 bai3 nian2 qian2 de5 wan2 ju4
sentences.english: Once, he bought a toy that was "a hundred years old".

sentences.hanzi: 我上网一看，一样的玩具，有一百个，三十块钱一个。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shang4 wang3 yi1 kan4 yi1 yang4 de5 wan2 ju4 you3 yi1 bai3 ge4 san1 shi2 kuai4 qian2 yi1 ge5
sentences.english: I went online and looked: there were a hundred toys just like it, thirty yuan each.

sentences.hanzi: 我问他：“你知道它是假的，为什么还要买？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wen4 ta1 ni3 zhi1 dao4 ta1 shi4 jia3 de5 wei4 shen2 me5 hai2 yao4 mai3
sentences.english: I asked him: "You know it's fake. Why buy it anyway?"

sentences.hanzi: 老张说：“我当然知道。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 zhang1 shuo1 wo3 dang1 ran2 zhi1 dao4
sentences.english: Old Zhang said: "Of course I know."

sentences.hanzi: “可是卖玩具的老人，给我讲了一个小时的故事。”
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 mai4 wan2 ju4 de5 lao3 ren2 gei3 wo3 jiang3 le5 yi1 ge5 xiao3 shi2 de5 gu4 shi5
sentences.english: "But the old man selling the toy told me stories for an hour."

sentences.hanzi: “他讲以前的北京，讲他的爸爸妈妈。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 jiang3 yi3 qian2 de5 bei3 jing1 jiang3 ta1 de5 ba4 ba5 ma1 ma5
sentences.english: "He told me about the old Beijing, and about his mother and father."

sentences.hanzi: “那个故事，比这个玩具有意思多了。”
sentences.pinyin: na4 ge5 gu4 shi5 bi3 zhe4 ge5 wan2 ju4 you3 yi4 si5 duo1 le5
sentences.english: "That story was far more interesting than this toy."

sentences.hanzi: 他把玩具放好，说：“我收集的不是东西，是故事。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 ba3 wan2 ju4 fang4 hao3 shuo1 wo3 shou1 ji2 de5 bu4 shi4 dong1 xi5 shi4 gu4 shi5
sentences.english: He put the toy away carefully and said: "I don't collect things. I collect stories."

glossed.meaning: Panjiayuan, a big market in Beijing

sentences.hanzi: 有一天，我很早就去公园散步。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 wo3 hen3 zao3 jiu4 qu4 gong1 yuan2 san4 bu4
sentences.english: One day, I went for a walk in the park very early.

sentences.hanzi: 公园里的人很多：有人在跳舞，有人在下棋，有人在唱歌。
sentences.pinyin: gong1 yuan2 li3 de5 ren2 hen3 duo1 you3 ren2 zai4 tiao4 wu3 you3 ren2 zai4 xia4 qi2 you3 ren2 zai4 chang4 ge1
sentences.english: There were lots of people in the park: some dancing, some playing chess, some singing.

sentences.hanzi: 我看到一位老先生，在地上写字。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 kan4 dao4 yi1 wei4 lao3 xian1 sheng5 zai4 di4 shang5 xie3 zi4
sentences.english: I saw an old man writing characters on the ground.

sentences.hanzi: 他拿着很长的笔，笔上没有别的，只有水。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 na2 zhe5 hen3 chang2 de5 bi3 bi3 shang4 mei2 you3 bie2 de5 zhi3 you3 shui3
sentences.english: He was holding a very long brush. There was nothing on it but water.

sentences.hanzi: 他用水在地上写书法。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yong4 shui3 zai4 di4 shang5 xie3 shu1 fa3
sentences.english: He was doing calligraphy on the ground with water.

sentences.hanzi: 他写得非常漂亮，很多人站在旁边看。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xie3 de5 fei1 chang2 piao4 liang5 hen3 duo1 ren2 zhan4 zai4 pang2 bian1 kan4
sentences.english: His writing was beautiful, and lots of people stood around watching.

sentences.hanzi: 可是过了几分钟，水干了，字也没有了。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 guo4 le5 ji3 fen1 zhong1 shui3 gan1 le5 zi4 ye3 mei2 you3 le5
sentences.english: But a few minutes later, the water dried, and the characters were gone.

sentences.hanzi: 我问他：“你写得这么好，为什么要用水写？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wen4 ta1 ni3 xie3 de5 zhe4 me5 hao3 wei4 shen2 me5 yao4 yong4 shui3 xie3
sentences.english: I asked him: "You write so well. Why write in water?"

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“用水写，我每一天都可以再写一次。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 yong4 shui3 xie3 wo3 mei3 yi1 tian1 dou1 ke3 yi3 zai4 xie3 yi1 ci4
sentences.english: He said: "If I write in water, I can write it all again every day."

sentences.hanzi: “写书法让我放松。我不想留什么，我只要写的时候高兴就行。”
sentences.pinyin: xie3 shu1 fa3 rang4 wo3 fang4 song1 wo3 bu4 xiang3 liu2 shen2 me5 wo3 zhi3 yao4 xie3 de5 shi2 hou5 gao1 xing4 jiu4 xing2
sentences.english: "Calligraphy relaxes me. I don't want to leave anything behind. I just want to be happy while I'm writing."

sentences.hanzi: 在中国，很多公园里都有这样的人。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 zhong1 guo2 hen3 duo1 gong1 yuan2 li3 dou1 you3 zhe4 yang4 de5 ren2
sentences.english: In China, there are people like this in lots of parks.

sentences.hanzi: 他们大多是老人，这是他们的爱好。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 da4 duo1 shi4 lao3 ren2 zhe4 shi4 ta1 men5 de5 ai4 hao4
sentences.english: Most of them are old people, and this is their hobby.

sentences.hanzi: 老先生把笔给我：“你也写一个。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 xian1 sheng5 ba3 bi3 gei3 wo3 ni3 ye3 xie3 yi1 ge5
sentences.english: The old man handed me the brush: "You write one too."

sentences.hanzi: 我写了“你好”两个字，写得非常难看。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 xie3 le5 ni3 hao3 liang3 ge4 zi4 xie3 de5 fei1 chang2 nan2 kan4
sentences.english: I wrote the two characters for "hello", and they looked terrible.

sentences.hanzi: 可是没问题。几分钟以后，它就没有了。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 mei2 wen4 ti2 ji3 fen1 zhong1 yi3 hou4 ta1 jiu4 mei2 you3 le5
sentences.english: But it didn't matter. A few minutes later, it was gone.

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，我又去了公园，也带了我自己的笔。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 wo3 you4 qu4 le5 gong1 yuan2 ye3 dai4 le5 wo3 zi4 ji3 de5 bi3
sentences.english: The next day, I went to the park again, and I brought my own brush.

sentences.hanzi: 小雨要租房子。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 yu3 yao4 zu1 fang2 zi5
sentences.english: Xiaoyu needed to rent a place.

sentences.hanzi: 她找了很久，可是房租都很高。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zhao3 le5 hen3 jiu3 ke3 shi4 fang2 zu1 dou1 hen3 gao1
sentences.english: She looked for a long time, but the rents were all high.

sentences.hanzi: 最后，她找到了一个公寓。
sentences.pinyin: zui4 hou4 ta1 zhao3 dao4 le5 yi1 ge5 gong1 yu4
sentences.english: In the end she found a flat.

sentences.hanzi: 房间很干净，有空调，有洗衣机，房租也不高。
sentences.pinyin: fang2 jian1 hen3 gan1 jing4 you3 kong1 tiao2 you3 xi3 yi1 ji1 fang2 zu1 ye3 bu4 gao1
sentences.english: The rooms were clean, there was air conditioning and a washing machine, and the rent wasn't high either.

sentences.hanzi: 房东是一个老人，她说：“房租不高，可是你要帮我一件事。”
sentences.pinyin: fang2 dong1 shi4 yi1 ge5 lao3 ren2 ta1 shuo1 fang2 zu1 bu4 gao1 ke3 shi4 ni3 yao4 bang1 wo3 yi1 jian4 shi4
sentences.english: The landlord was an old woman. She said: "The rent isn't high, but you have to do one thing for me."

sentences.hanzi: “我的猫也住在这里。你要给它吃的，还要跟它说话。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 de5 mao1 ye3 zhu4 zai4 zhe4 li3 ni3 yao4 gei3 ta1 chi1 de5 hai2 yao4 gen1 ta1 shuo1 hua4
sentences.english: "My cat lives here too. You have to feed it, and talk to it as well."

sentences.hanzi: 小雨说：“没问题！”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 yu3 shuo1 mei2 wen4 ti2
sentences.english: Xiaoyu said: "No problem!"

sentences.hanzi: 第一天晚上，小雨回家，猫在她的床上。
sentences.pinyin: di4 yi1 tian1 wan3 shang5 xiao3 yu3 hui2 jia1 mao1 zai4 ta1 de5 chuang2 shang4
sentences.english: The first evening, when Xiaoyu came home, the cat was on her bed.

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，猫在她的沙发上。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 mao1 zai4 ta1 de5 sha1 fa1 shang4
sentences.english: The second day, the cat was on her sofa.

sentences.hanzi: 第三天，猫在她的书桌上，她没有地方工作了。
sentences.pinyin: di4 san1 tian1 mao1 zai4 ta1 de5 shu1 zhuo1 shang4 ta1 mei2 you3 di4 fang5 gong1 zuo4 le5
sentences.english: The third day, the cat was on her desk, and she had nowhere to work.

sentences.hanzi: 小雨想：这到底是我的家，还是它的家？
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 yu3 xiang3 zhe4 dao4 di3 shi4 wo3 de5 jia1 hai2 shi5 ta1 de5 jia1
sentences.english: Xiaoyu thought: is this my home or its home?

sentences.hanzi: 一个月以后，房东来了。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 yue4 yi3 hou4 fang2 dong1 lai2 le5
sentences.english: A month later, the landlord came.

sentences.hanzi: 她没有问小雨，先去问猫：“她怎么样？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 mei2 you3 wen4 xiao3 yu3 xian1 qu4 wen4 mao1 ta1 zen3 me5 yang4
sentences.english: She didn't ask Xiaoyu. She went and asked the cat first: "How is she?"

sentences.hanzi: 猫看了看小雨，走过去，坐在她的腿上，不走了。
sentences.pinyin: mao1 kan4 le5 kan4 xiao3 yu3 zou3 guo4 qu4 zuo4 zai4 ta1 de5 tui3 shang4 bu4 zou3 le5
sentences.english: The cat looked at Xiaoyu, walked over, sat on her lap and stayed there.

sentences.hanzi: 房东说：“好。它说你可以住下去。”
sentences.pinyin: fang2 dong1 shuo1 hao3 ta1 shuo1 ni3 ke3 yi3 zhu4 xia4 qu4
sentences.english: The landlord said: "Good. It says you can stay."

sentences.hanzi: 小雨这才明白：这个房子真正的房东，是它。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 yu3 zhe4 cai2 ming2 bai5 zhe4 ge5 fang2 zi5 zhen1 zheng4 de5 fang2 dong1 shi4 ta1
sentences.english: Only then did Xiaoyu understand: the real landlord of this flat was the cat.

title: 这个楼都是我家
titlePinyin: zhe4 ge5 lou2 dou1 shi4 wo3 jia1
titleEnglish: This Whole Building Is My Home

sentences.hanzi: 在福建，有很多很老的楼。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 fu2 jian4 you3 hen3 duo1 hen3 lao3 de5 lou2
sentences.english: In Fujian there are many very old buildings.

sentences.hanzi: 这些楼很大，很多是圆的，墙是用土做的。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 lou2 hen3 da4 hen3 duo1 shi4 yuan2 de5 qiang2 shi4 yong4 tu3 zuo4 de5
sentences.english: These buildings are big, many of them are round, and the walls are made of earth.

sentences.hanzi: 一个楼里，可以住几百个人。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 lou2 li3 ke3 yi3 zhu4 ji3 bai3 ge4 ren2
sentences.english: A single building can house hundreds of people.

sentences.hanzi: 楼的墙很高。很多楼的一层和二层，都没有窗户。
sentences.pinyin: lou2 de5 qiang2 hen3 gao1 hen3 duo1 lou2 de5 yi1 ceng2 he2 er4 ceng2 dou1 mei2 you3 chuang1 hu5
sentences.english: The walls are high. Many have no windows at all on the ground and second floors.

sentences.hanzi: 很多楼也只有一个大门。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 lou2 ye3 zhi3 you3 yi1 ge5 da4 men2
sentences.english: Many have only one main gate, too.

sentences.hanzi: 走进大门，里面有一个很大的院子。
sentences.pinyin: zou3 jin4 da4 men2 li3 mian4 you3 yi1 ge5 hen3 da4 de5 yuan4 zi5
sentences.english: Go through the gate and there's a big courtyard inside.

sentences.hanzi: 房间都在院子旁边，一个连着一个。
sentences.pinyin: fang2 jian1 dou1 zai4 yuan4 zi5 pang2 bian1 yi1 ge5 lian2 zhe5 yi1 ge5
sentences.english: The rooms all stand around the courtyard, one next to another.

sentences.hanzi: 一层是厨房，二层放吃的东西，三层和四层是卧室。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ceng2 shi4 chu2 fang2 er4 ceng2 fang4 chi1 de5 dong1 xi5 san1 ceng2 he2 si4 ceng2 shi4 wo4 shi4
sentences.english: The ground floor is kitchens, the second floor stores food, and the third and fourth floors are bedrooms.

sentences.hanzi: 我去的时候，院子里有几个孩子在玩，一个老人在房间前面坐着。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 qu4 de5 shi2 hou5 yuan4 zi5 li3 you3 ji3 ge4 hai2 zi5 zai4 wan2 yi1 ge5 lao3 ren2 zai4 fang2 jian1 qian2 mian4 zuo4 zhe5
sentences.english: When I went, a few children were playing in the courtyard, and an old woman was sitting in front of her room.

sentences.hanzi: 我问她，她的家在哪儿。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wen4 ta1 ta1 de5 jia1 zai4 na3 r5
sentences.english: I asked her where her home was.

sentences.hanzi: 她看了看我，又看了看这个楼，说：“这里都是我家。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 le5 kan4 wo3 you4 kan4 le5 kan4 zhe4 ge5 lou2 shuo1 zhe4 li3 dou1 shi4 wo3 jia1
sentences.english: She looked at me, then at the building, and said: "All of this is my home."

sentences.hanzi: 我不明白。这么多房间，这么多人，都是她家？
sentences.pinyin: wo3 bu4 ming2 bai5 zhe4 me5 duo1 fang2 jian1 zhe4 me5 duo1 ren2 dou1 shi4 ta1 jia1
sentences.english: I didn't understand. So many rooms, so many people, all her home?

sentences.hanzi: 她说：“我们是一家人。我们家的人，一直住在这里。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 wo3 men5 shi4 yi1 jia1 ren2 wo3 men5 jia1 de5 ren2 yi1 zhi2 zhu4 zai4 zhe4 li3
sentences.english: She said: "We're one family. My family has always lived here."

sentences.hanzi: 以前，一个楼，就是一个家。
sentences.pinyin: yi3 qian2 yi1 ge5 lou2 jiu4 shi4 yi1 ge5 jia1
sentences.english: In the old days, one building was one family.

sentences.hanzi: 现在，很多年轻人去了很远的地方工作，楼里没有以前那么多人了。
sentences.pinyin: xian4 zai4 hen3 duo1 nian2 qing1 ren2 qu4 le5 hen3 yuan3 de5 di4 fang5 gong1 zuo4 lou2 li3 mei2 you3 yi3 qian2 na4 me5 duo1 ren2 le5
sentences.english: Now many young people have gone far away to work, and there aren't as many people in the building as before.

sentences.hanzi: 可是她没有走。她说：“人可以走，家不能走。”
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ta1 mei2 you3 zou3 ta1 shuo1 ren2 ke3 yi3 zou3 jia1 bu4 neng2 zou3
sentences.english: But she hasn't left. She says: "People can leave. A home can't."

glossed.meaning: Fujian, a province in southeast China

title: 房子不让我出门
titlePinyin: fang2 zi5 bu4 rang4 wo3 chu1 men2
titleEnglish: My House Won't Let Me Out

sentences.hanzi: 二一二零年，小马住在一个很新的公寓里。
sentences.pinyin: er4 yi1 er4 ling2 nian2 xiao3 ma3 zhu4 zai4 yi1 ge5 hen3 xin1 de5 gong1 yu4 li3
sentences.english: In 2120, Xiao Ma lived in a brand-new flat.

sentences.hanzi: 这个公寓什么都会。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 gong1 yu4 shen2 me5 dou1 hui4
sentences.english: This flat could do everything.

sentences.hanzi: 他回家，门自己开，灯自己开，空调也自己开。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 hui2 jia1 men2 zi4 ji3 kai1 deng1 zi4 ji3 kai1 kong1 tiao2 ye3 zi4 ji3 kai1
sentences.english: When he came home, the door opened by itself, the lights came on by themselves, and so did the air conditioning.

sentences.hanzi: 冰箱会告诉他：今天吃什么。
sentences.pinyin: bing1 xiang1 hui4 gao4 su5 ta1 jin1 tian1 chi1 shen2 me5
sentences.english: The fridge told him what to eat that day.

sentences.hanzi: 房子还会打扫房间，收拾桌子。
sentences.pinyin: fang2 zi5 hai2 hui4 da3 sao3 fang2 jian1 shou1 shi5 zhuo1 zi5
sentences.english: The house even cleaned the rooms and tidied the table.

sentences.hanzi: 小马工作很忙，总是很晚才回家，回家就睡。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 ma3 gong1 zuo4 hen3 mang2 zong3 shi4 hen3 wan3 cai2 hui2 jia1 hui2 jia1 jiu4 shui4
sentences.english: Xiao Ma was very busy at work. He always came home late and went straight to sleep.

sentences.hanzi: 这一天，小马要出门。可是门不开。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 tian1 xiao3 ma3 yao4 chu1 men2 ke3 shi4 men2 bu4 kai1
sentences.english: One day Xiao Ma wanted to go out. But the door wouldn't open.

sentences.hanzi: “开门！我要去工作！”
sentences.pinyin: kai1 men2 wo3 yao4 qu4 gong1 zuo4
sentences.english: "Open the door! I've got to go to work!"

sentences.hanzi: 房子说：“今天你不能出门。”
sentences.pinyin: fang2 zi5 shuo1 jin1 tian1 ni3 bu4 neng2 chu1 men2
sentences.english: The house said: "You can't go out today."

sentences.hanzi: “为什么？”
sentences.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: "Why not?"

sentences.hanzi: “你已经三十天没用过厨房了。”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 yi3 jing1 san1 shi2 tian1 mei2 yong4 guo5 chu2 fang2 le5
sentences.english: "You haven't used the kitchen for thirty days."

sentences.hanzi: “你也三十天没有给你妈妈打电话了。”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 ye3 san1 shi2 tian1 mei2 you3 gei3 ni3 ma1 ma5 da3 dian4 hua4 le5
sentences.english: "And you haven't called your mum for thirty days."

sentences.hanzi: 小马说：“我很忙！你快开门！”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 ma3 shuo1 wo3 hen3 mang2 ni3 kuai4 kai1 men2
sentences.english: Xiao Ma said: "I'm busy! Open the door, quick!"

sentences.hanzi: 房子不说话了。
sentences.pinyin: fang2 zi5 bu4 shuo1 hua4 le5
sentences.english: The house said nothing more.

sentences.hanzi: 一个小时以后，门开了。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 xiao3 shi2 yi3 hou4 men2 kai1 le5
sentences.english: An hour later, the door opened.

sentences.hanzi: 可是不是小马出去，是有人进来了。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 bu4 shi4 xiao3 ma3 chu1 qu4 shi4 you3 ren2 jin4 lai2 le5
sentences.english: But it wasn't Xiao Ma going out. Someone was coming in.

sentences.hanzi: 是他的妈妈，她的手上拿着很多吃的。
sentences.pinyin: shi4 ta1 de5 ma1 ma5 ta1 de5 shou3 shang4 na2 zhe5 hen3 duo1 chi1 de5
sentences.english: It was his mother, her hands full of food.

sentences.hanzi: 妈妈说：“你的房子给我打了电话。它说，你需要在家吃点东西。”
sentences.pinyin: ma1 ma5 shuo1 ni3 de5 fang2 zi5 gei3 wo3 da3 le5 dian4 hua4 ta1 shuo1 ni3 xu1 yao4 zai4 jia1 chi1 dian3 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: His mother said: "Your house phoned me. It said you need a proper meal at home."

sentences.hanzi: 小马看着妈妈，说不出话来。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 ma3 kan4 zhe5 ma1 ma5 shuo1 bu5 chu1 hua4 lai2
sentences.english: Xiao Ma looked at his mother and couldn't say a word.

title: 院子里的房间
titlePinyin: yuan4 zi5 li3 de5 fang2 jian1

sentences.hanzi: 两百年前，北京有很多四合院。
sentences.pinyin: liang3 bai3 nian2 qian2 bei3 jing1 you3 hen3 duo1 si4 he2 yuan4
sentences.english: Two hundred years ago, Beijing had many courtyard houses.

sentences.hanzi: 走进四合院的门，里面是一个院子，院子的东、西、南、北，都有房子。
sentences.pinyin: zou3 jin4 si4 he2 yuan4 de5 men2 li3 mian4 shi4 yi1 ge5 yuan4 zi5 yuan4 zi5 de5 dong1 xi1 nan2 bei3 dou1 you3 fang2 zi5
sentences.english: Step through the gate of a courtyard house and there's a yard inside, with buildings on its east, west, south and north.

sentences.hanzi: 最大的房子叫北房。一家人里最老的人，住在北房。
sentences.pinyin: zui4 da4 de5 fang2 zi5 jiao4 bei3 fang2 yi1 jia1 ren2 li3 zui4 lao3 de5 ren2 zhu4 zai4 bei3 fang2
sentences.english: The biggest building is called the north house. The oldest person in the family lives there.

sentences.hanzi: 旁边的房间小一点，是孩子们住的。
sentences.pinyin: pang2 bian1 de5 fang2 jian1 xiao3 yi1 dian3 shi4 hai2 zi5 men5 zhu4 de5
sentences.english: The rooms at the sides are a bit smaller, and the children live there.

sentences.hanzi: 小石的家，就是这样的一个四合院。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 shi2 de5 jia1 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 yang4 de5 yi1 ge5 si4 he2 yuan4
sentences.english: Xiao Shi's home was a courtyard house like this.

sentences.hanzi: 小石还小的时候，和爸爸妈妈住在一个小房间里。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 shi2 hai2 xiao3 de5 shi2 hou5 he2 ba4 ba5 ma1 ma5 zhu4 zai4 yi1 ge5 xiao3 fang2 jian1 li3
sentences.english: When Xiao Shi was little, he lived with his parents in one of the small rooms.

sentences.hanzi: 那时候，他的爷爷住在北房。
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi2 hou5 ta1 de5 ye2 ye5 zhu4 zai4 bei3 fang2
sentences.english: At that time, his grandfather lived in the north house.

sentences.hanzi: 小石总是在院子里跑，从东跑到西，从西跑到北。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 shi2 zong3 shi4 zai4 yuan4 zi5 li3 pao3 cong2 dong1 pao3 dao4 xi1 cong2 xi1 pao3 dao4 bei3
sentences.english: Xiao Shi was always running around the courtyard, from east to west, from west to north.

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷坐在北房的窗户前面，看着他。
sentences.pinyin: ye2 ye5 zuo4 zai4 bei3 fang2 de5 chuang1 hu5 qian2 mian4 kan4 zhe5 ta1
sentences.english: Grandpa sat by the window of the north house, watching him.

sentences.hanzi: 过了很多年，爷爷走了，小石的爸爸搬进了北房。
sentences.pinyin: guo4 le5 hen3 duo1 nian2 ye2 ye5 zou3 le5 xiao3 shi2 de5 ba4 ba5 ban1 jin4 le5 bei3 fang2
sentences.english: Many years passed. Grandpa died, and Xiao Shi's father moved into the north house.

sentences.hanzi: 又过了很多年，小石有了自己的孩子。
sentences.pinyin: you4 guo4 le5 hen3 duo1 nian2 xiao3 shi2 you3 le5 zi4 ji3 de5 hai2 zi5
sentences.english: Many more years passed, and Xiao Shi had a child of his own.

sentences.hanzi: 他的孩子，也住在那个小房间里。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 hai2 zi5 ye3 zhu4 zai4 na4 ge5 xiao3 fang2 jian1 li3
sentences.english: His child lived in that little room too.

sentences.hanzi: 最后，小石老了，他也搬进了北房。
sentences.pinyin: zui4 hou4 xiao3 shi2 lao3 le5 ta1 ye3 ban1 jin4 le5 bei3 fang2
sentences.english: In the end Xiao Shi grew old, and he too moved into the north house.

sentences.hanzi: 有一天，孩子的孩子在院子里跑，从东跑到西，从西跑到北。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 hai2 zi5 de5 hai2 zi5 zai4 yuan4 zi5 li3 pao3 cong2 dong1 pao3 dao4 xi1 cong2 xi1 pao3 dao4 bei3
sentences.english: One day his grandchild was running around the courtyard, from east to west, from west to north.

sentences.hanzi: 小石坐在北房的窗户前面，看着他。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 shi2 zuo4 zai4 bei3 fang2 de5 chuang1 hu5 qian2 mian4 kan4 zhe5 ta1
sentences.english: Xiao Shi sat by the window of the north house, watching him.

sentences.hanzi: 他想到了自己的爷爷。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 dao4 le5 zi4 ji3 de5 ye2 ye5
sentences.english: He thought of his own grandfather.

sentences.hanzi: 院子没有变，房子也没有变。变的，是住在里面的人。
sentences.pinyin: yuan4 zi5 mei2 you3 bian4 fang2 zi5 ye3 mei2 you3 bian4 bian4 de5 shi4 zhu4 zai4 li3 mian4 de5 ren2
sentences.english: The courtyard hadn't changed, nor had the house. What had changed was the people who lived there.

glossed.meaning: the main north building of a courtyard house

title: 外面冷，还是里面冷
titlePinyin: wai4 mian4 leng3 hai2 shi5 li3 mian4 leng3

sentences.hanzi: 小雪是哈尔滨人。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 xue3 shi4 ha1 er3 bin1 ren2
sentences.english: Xiaoxue was from Harbin.

sentences.hanzi: 哈尔滨的冬天很冷，外面能到零下二十多度。
sentences.pinyin: ha1 er3 bin1 de5 dong1 tian1 hen3 leng3 wai4 mian4 neng2 dao4 ling2 xia4 er4 shi2 duo1 du4
sentences.english: Harbin winters are very cold. Outside it can drop to more than twenty below zero.

sentences.hanzi: 可是在家，有暖气，一点也不冷。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zai4 jia1 you3 nuan3 qi4 yi1 dian3 ye3 bu4 leng3
sentences.english: But at home there's heating, and it's not cold at all.

sentences.hanzi: 冬天在家，小雪只穿一件衣服。
sentences.pinyin: dong1 tian1 zai4 jia1 xiao3 xue3 zhi3 chuan1 yi1 jian4 yi1 fu5
sentences.english: At home in winter, Xiaoxue wore just one layer.

sentences.hanzi: 十八岁，小雪去上海上大学。
sentences.pinyin: shi2 ba1 sui4 xiao3 xue3 qu4 shang4 hai3 shang4 da4 xue2
sentences.english: At eighteen, Xiaoxue went to Shanghai for university.

sentences.hanzi: 她想：上海的冬天，一定不冷。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 shang4 hai3 de5 dong1 tian1 yi1 ding4 bu4 leng3
sentences.english: She thought: Shanghai's winter can't possibly be cold.

sentences.hanzi: 十二月，上海外面五六度，小雪觉得很好。
sentences.pinyin: shi2 er4 yue4 shang4 hai3 wai4 mian4 wu3 liu4 du4 xiao3 xue3 jue2 de5 hen3 hao3
sentences.english: In December it was five or six degrees outside in Shanghai, and Xiaoxue felt fine.

sentences.hanzi: 可是一进房间，她就冷得不得了。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 yi1 jin4 fang2 jian1 ta1 jiu4 leng3 de5 bu4 de2 liao3
sentences.english: But as soon as she went into her room, she was freezing.

sentences.hanzi: 房间里没有暖气，外面和里面一样冷。
sentences.pinyin: fang2 jian1 li3 mei2 you3 nuan3 qi4 wai4 mian4 he2 li3 mian4 yi1 yang4 leng3
sentences.english: There was no heating in the room. It was as cold inside as out.

sentences.hanzi: 她的朋友们在房间里也穿了很多衣服。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 peng2 you5 men5 zai4 fang2 jian1 li3 ye3 chuan1 le5 hen3 duo1 yi1 fu5
sentences.english: Her friends wore lots of clothes indoors too.

sentences.hanzi: 小雪开了空调，还是冷。晚上，她在床上用了两条被子，还是冷。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 xue3 kai1 le5 kong1 tiao2 hai2 shi5 leng3 wan3 shang5 ta1 zai4 chuang2 shang4 yong4 le5 liang3 tiao2 bei4 zi5 hai2 shi5 leng3
sentences.english: Xiaoxue turned on the air conditioning and was still cold. At night she used two quilts in bed and was still cold.

sentences.hanzi: 她问朋友：“你们家为什么没有暖气？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 wen4 peng2 you5 ni3 men5 jia1 wei4 shen2 me5 mei2 you3 nuan3 qi4
sentences.english: She asked a friend: "Why don't your homes have heating?"

sentences.hanzi: 朋友说：“我们这里没有暖气。我们都是这样过冬天的。”
sentences.pinyin: peng2 you5 shuo1 wo3 men5 zhe4 li3 mei2 you3 nuan3 qi4 wo3 men5 dou1 shi4 zhe4 yang4 guo4 dong1 tian1 de5
sentences.english: Her friend said: "We don't have heating here. This is how we all get through the winter."

sentences.hanzi: 一月，小雪回家了。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 yue4 xiao3 xue3 hui2 jia1 le5
sentences.english: In January, Xiaoxue went home.

sentences.hanzi: 妈妈问她：“上海冷不冷？”
sentences.pinyin: ma1 ma5 wen4 ta1 shang4 hai3 leng3 bu4 leng3
sentences.english: Her mother asked her: "Is Shanghai cold?"

sentences.hanzi: 小雪想了想，说：“哈尔滨外面冷，里面不冷。上海外面不冷，里面冷。”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 xue3 xiang3 le5 xiang3 shuo1 ha1 er3 bin1 wai4 mian4 leng3 li3 mian4 bu4 leng3 shang4 hai3 wai4 mian4 bu4 leng3 li3 mian4 leng3
sentences.english: Xiaoxue thought about it and said: "In Harbin it's cold outside and warm inside. In Shanghai it's warm outside and cold inside."

glossed.meaning: Harbin, a city in northeast China

title: 大家都说无聊的节目
titlePinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 shuo1 wu2 liao2 de5 jie2 mu4

sentences.hanzi: 在中国，过年的时候，很多人都会跟全家人一起做一件事：看春晚。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 zhong1 guo2 guo4 nian2 de5 shi2 hou5 hen3 duo1 ren2 dou1 hui4 gen1 quan2 jia1 ren2 yi1 qi3 zuo4 yi1 jian4 shi4 kan4 chun1 wan3
sentences.english: In China, at New Year, lots of people do one thing with the whole family: watch the Spring Festival Gala.

sentences.hanzi: 春晚是一个电视节目，在新年的前一天晚上播放。
sentences.pinyin: chun1 wan3 shi4 yi1 ge5 dian4 shi4 jie2 mu4 zai4 xin1 nian2 de5 qian2 yi1 tian1 wan3 shang5 bo1 fang4
sentences.english: The Gala is a TV show broadcast on the evening before the New Year.

sentences.hanzi: 它从一九八三年开始，到现在已经四十多年了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 cong2 yi1 jiu3 ba1 san1 nian2 kai1 shi3 dao4 xian4 zai4 yi3 jing1 si4 shi2 duo1 nian2 le5
sentences.english: It began in 1983, more than forty years ago.

sentences.hanzi: 节目里有唱歌，有表演，也有喜剧。
sentences.pinyin: jie2 mu4 li3 you3 chang4 ge1 you3 biao3 yan3 ye3 you3 xi3 ju4
sentences.english: The show has singing, performances and comedy.

sentences.hanzi: 有人说，它是世界上观众最多的电视节目。
sentences.pinyin: you3 ren2 shuo1 ta1 shi4 shi4 jie4 shang4 guan1 zhong4 zui4 duo1 de5 dian4 shi4 jie2 mu4
sentences.english: Some say it's the most-watched TV show in the world.

sentences.hanzi: 我第一次在中国过年，是在一个朋友家。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 di4 yi1 ci4 zai4 zhong1 guo2 guo4 nian2 shi4 zai4 yi1 ge5 peng2 you5 jia1
sentences.english: The first time I spent New Year in China, it was at a friend's home.

sentences.hanzi: 晚上八点，电视开了，春晚开始了。
sentences.pinyin: wan3 shang5 ba1 dian3 dian4 shi4 kai1 le5 chun1 wan3 kai1 shi3 le5
sentences.english: At eight in the evening, the TV went on and the Gala began.

sentences.hanzi: 朋友的爸爸妈妈看得很高兴，可是很多话我都不明白。
sentences.pinyin: peng2 you5 de5 ba4 ba5 ma1 ma5 kan4 de5 hen3 gao1 xing4 ke3 shi4 hen3 duo1 hua4 wo3 dou1 bu4 ming2 bai5
sentences.english: My friend's parents enjoyed it a lot, but I didn't understand a lot of what was said.

sentences.hanzi: 我问朋友：“你喜欢春晚吗？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wen4 peng2 you5 ni3 xi3 huan5 chun1 wan3 ma5
sentences.english: I asked my friend: "Do you like the Gala?"

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“不太喜欢。我每一年都说它很无聊。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 bu4 tai4 xi3 huan5 wo3 mei3 yi1 nian2 dou1 shuo1 ta1 hen3 wu2 liao2
sentences.english: He said: "Not really. Every year I say it's boring."

sentences.hanzi: “那你为什么还要看？”
sentences.pinyin: na4 ni3 wei4 shen2 me5 hai2 yao4 kan4
sentences.english: "Then why do you still watch it?"

sentences.hanzi: “因为我们全家人都在一起看。节目好看不好看，不重要。”
sentences.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 men5 quan2 jia1 ren2 dou1 zai4 yi1 qi3 kan4 jie2 mu4 hao3 kan4 bu4 hao3 kan4 bu4 zhong4 yao4
sentences.english: "Because the whole family watches it together. Whether the show is good or not doesn't matter."

sentences.hanzi: 十二点的时候，电视里的人一起说：“新年好！”
sentences.pinyin: shi2 er4 dian3 de5 shi2 hou5 dian4 shi4 li3 de5 ren2 yi1 qi3 shuo1 xin1 nian2 hao3
sentences.english: At midnight, the people on TV all said together: "Happy New Year!"

sentences.hanzi: 朋友的爸爸妈妈也说：“新年好！”
sentences.pinyin: peng2 you5 de5 ba4 ba5 ma1 ma5 ye3 shuo1 xin1 nian2 hao3
sentences.english: My friend's parents said it too: "Happy New Year!"

sentences.hanzi: 我也说了。那一年，我觉得春晚很好看。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 ye3 shuo1 le5 na4 yi1 nian2 wo3 jue2 de5 chun1 wan3 hen3 hao3 kan4
sentences.english: So did I. That year, I thought the Gala was great.

glossed.meaning: the Spring Festival Gala, a TV show on Chinese New Year's Eve

sentences.hanzi: 一九八六年，我十岁。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 jiu3 ba1 liu4 nian2 wo3 shi2 sui4
sentences.english: In 1986, I was ten.

sentences.hanzi: 那一年，我家买了一个电视。
sentences.pinyin: na4 yi1 nian2 wo3 jia1 mai3 le5 yi1 ge5 dian4 shi4
sentences.english: That year, my family bought a TV.

sentences.hanzi: 在我们那里，这是第一个电视。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 wo3 men5 na4 li5 zhe4 shi4 di4 yi1 ge4 dian4 shi4
sentences.english: Where we lived, it was the first TV.

sentences.hanzi: 那时候，电视台在放一个电视剧，叫“西游记”。
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi2 hou5 dian4 shi4 tai2 zai4 fang4 yi1 ge5 dian4 shi4 ju4 jiao4 xi1 you2 ji4
sentences.english: At that time, the TV station was showing a drama series called Journey to the West.

sentences.hanzi: 每一天晚上，很多人都来我家看电视。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 yi1 tian1 wan3 shang5 hen3 duo1 ren2 dou1 lai2 wo3 jia1 kan4 dian4 shi4
sentences.english: Every evening, lots of people came to our house to watch TV.

sentences.hanzi: 我爸爸把电视拿出来，让大家一起看。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 ba4 ba5 ba3 dian4 shi4 na2 chu1 lai2 rang4 da4 jia1 yi1 qi3 kan4
sentences.english: My dad brought the TV outside so everyone could watch together.

sentences.hanzi: 电视很小，人很多，很多人什么都看不到。
sentences.pinyin: dian4 shi4 hen3 xiao3 ren2 hen3 duo1 hen3 duo1 ren2 shen2 me5 dou1 kan4 bu4 dao4
sentences.english: The TV was small and there were lots of people. Many couldn't see a thing.

sentences.hanzi: 可是没有人走。孙悟空一出来，大家都叫起来。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 mei2 you3 ren2 zou3 sun1 wu4 kong1 yi1 chu1 lai2 da4 jia1 dou1 jiao4 qi3 lai5
sentences.english: But nobody left. As soon as the Monkey King appeared, everyone cheered.

sentences.hanzi: 有一天晚上，电视坏了。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 wan3 shang5 dian4 shi4 huai4 le5
sentences.english: One evening, the TV broke.

sentences.hanzi: 大家都很担心。我爸爸说：“没办法，今天看不了了。”
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 hen3 dan1 xin1 wo3 ba4 ba5 shuo1 mei2 ban4 fa3 jin1 tian1 kan4 bu4 liao3 le5
sentences.english: Everyone was worried. My dad said: "Nothing we can do. No TV tonight."

sentences.hanzi: 这时候，一个老人站起来说：“我来告诉大家，今天孙悟空做了什么。”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 hou5 yi1 ge5 lao3 ren2 zhan4 qi3 lai2 shuo1 wo3 lai2 gao4 su5 da4 jia1 jin1 tian1 sun1 wu4 kong1 zuo4 le5 shen2 me5
sentences.english: Just then, an old man stood up and said: "I'll tell you all what the Monkey King did today."

sentences.hanzi: 他以前看过“西游记”的小说，知道这个故事。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yi3 qian2 kan4 guo5 xi1 you2 ji4 de5 xiao3 shuo1 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 ge5 gu4 shi5
sentences.english: He had read the novel Journey to the West, so he knew the story.

sentences.hanzi: 那一个晚上，他一个人说了两个小时。
sentences.pinyin: na4 yi1 ge5 wan3 shang5 ta1 yi1 ge5 ren2 shuo1 le5 liang3 ge4 xiao3 shi2
sentences.english: That evening, he talked by himself for two hours.

sentences.hanzi: 大家都说：“比电视还好看！”
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 shuo1 bi3 dian4 shi4 hai2 hao3 kan4
sentences.english: Everyone said: "Even better than TV!"

sentences.hanzi: 现在，我是一个导演，拍了很多电视剧。
sentences.pinyin: xian4 zai4 wo3 shi4 yi1 ge5 dao3 yan3 pai1 le5 hen3 duo1 dian4 shi4 ju4
sentences.english: Now I'm a director, and I've made lots of TV dramas.

sentences.hanzi: 可是我最想拍的，是那一个晚上的那个老人。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 wo3 zui4 xiang3 pai1 de5 shi4 na4 yi1 ge5 wan3 shang5 de5 na4 ge5 lao3 ren2
sentences.english: But what I most want to film is that old man, on that one evening.

glossed.meaning: Journey to the West, a famous old novel

sentences.hanzi: 我第一次看京剧，是跟一个中国朋友一起去的。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 di4 yi1 ci4 kan4 jing1 ju4 shi4 gen1 yi1 ge5 zhong1 guo2 peng2 you5 yi1 qi3 qu4 de5
sentences.english: The first time I saw Beijing opera, I went with a Chinese friend.

sentences.hanzi: 舞台上的演员，一个是红脸，一个是白脸，还有一个是黑脸。
sentences.pinyin: wu3 tai2 shang4 de5 yan3 yuan2 yi1 ge5 shi4 hong2 lian3 yi1 ge5 shi4 bai2 lian3 hai2 you3 yi1 ge5 shi4 hei1 lian3
sentences.english: Of the actors on stage, one had a red face, one a white face, and one a black face.

sentences.hanzi: 我问朋友：“这是为什么？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wen4 peng2 you5 zhe4 shi4 wei4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: I asked my friend: "Why is that?"

sentences.hanzi: 朋友说：“你一看，就知道这个角色是一个怎么样的人。”
sentences.pinyin: peng2 you5 shuo1 ni3 yi1 kan4 jiu4 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 ge5 jue2 se4 shi4 yi1 ge5 zen3 me5 yang4 de5 ren2
sentences.english: My friend said: "One look, and you know what kind of person the character is."

sentences.hanzi: “红脸的人，对朋友很好，为了朋友，死也愿意。关羽就是红脸。”
sentences.pinyin: hong2 lian3 de5 ren2 dui4 peng2 you5 hen3 hao3 wei4 le5 peng2 you5 si3 ye3 yuan4 yi4 guan1 yu3 jiu4 shi4 hong2 lian3
sentences.english: "Red-faced characters are loyal: they'd die for their friends. Guan Yu has a red face."

sentences.hanzi: “白脸的人，想得很多，可是不能相信。曹操就是白脸。”
sentences.pinyin: bai2 lian3 de5 ren2 xiang3 de5 hen3 duo1 ke3 shi4 bu4 neng2 xiang1 xin4 cao2 cao1 jiu4 shi4 bai2 lian3
sentences.english: "White-faced characters scheme a lot, and can't be trusted. Cao Cao has a white face."

sentences.hanzi: “黑脸的人呢？”
sentences.pinyin: hei1 lian3 de5 ren2 ne5
sentences.english: "What about the black-faced ones?"

sentences.hanzi: “黑脸的人，不管别人是谁，只做对的事。包公就是黑脸。”
sentences.pinyin: hei1 lian3 de5 ren2 bu4 guan3 bie2 ren5 shi4 shei2 zhi3 zuo4 dui4 de5 shi4 bao1 gong1 jiu4 shi4 hei1 lian3
sentences.english: "Black-faced characters do only what is right, no matter who they're dealing with. Judge Bao has a black face."

sentences.hanzi: 我明白了。可是我又有一个问题。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 ming2 bai5 le5 ke3 shi4 wo3 you4 you3 yi1 ge5 wen4 ti2
sentences.english: I understood. But then I had another question.

sentences.hanzi: “演员还没有说话，观众已经知道谁是好的，谁是坏的。”
sentences.pinyin: yan3 yuan2 hai2 mei2 you3 shuo1 hua4 guan1 zhong4 yi3 jing1 zhi1 dao4 shei2 shi4 hao3 de5 shei2 shi4 huai4 de5
sentences.english: "Before the actors even speak, the audience already knows who's good and who's bad."

sentences.hanzi: “那这个故事，还有什么好看的？”
sentences.pinyin: na4 zhe4 ge5 gu4 shi5 hai2 you3 shen2 me5 hao3 kan4 de5
sentences.english: "So what's left to enjoy in the story?"

sentences.hanzi: 朋友想了想，说：“好看的不是好的人和坏的人。”
sentences.pinyin: peng2 you5 xiang3 le5 xiang3 shuo1 hao3 kan4 de5 bu4 shi4 hao3 de5 ren2 he2 huai4 de5 ren2
sentences.english: My friend thought for a moment and said: "What's good to watch isn't the good guys and the bad guys."

sentences.hanzi: “好看的，是演员怎么演。你看！”
sentences.pinyin: hao3 kan4 de5 shi4 yan3 yuan2 zen3 me5 yan3 ni3 kan4
sentences.english: "It's how the actors perform. Look!"

sentences.hanzi: 这时候，舞台上的白脸开始表演了。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 hou5 wu3 tai2 shang4 de5 bai2 lian3 kai1 shi3 biao3 yan3 le5
sentences.english: Just then, the white-faced character on stage began to perform.

sentences.hanzi: 他演得非常坏，也非常精彩，观众都叫起来：“好！”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yan3 de5 fei1 chang2 huai4 ye3 fei1 chang2 jing1 cai3 guan1 zhong4 dou1 jiao4 qi3 lai5 hao3
sentences.english: He played it wonderfully wicked, and the whole audience shouted: "Hao!" ("Bravo!")

glossed.meaning: Guan Yu, a general of the Three Kingdoms period
Cao Cao, a warlord of the Three Kingdoms period
Judge Bao (Bao Zheng), a Song dynasty official famous for fairness

title: 会唱错的歌手
titlePinyin: hui4 chang4 cuo4 de5 ge1 shou3
titleEnglish: The Singer Who Sings Wrong Notes

sentences.hanzi: 二零七零年，所有的明星都是人工智能。
sentences.pinyin: er4 ling2 qi1 ling2 nian2 suo3 you3 de5 ming2 xing1 dou1 shi4 ren2 gong1 zhi4 neng2
sentences.english: In 2070, every star was an AI.

sentences.hanzi: 它们的歌非常好，从来不唱错。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 de5 ge1 fei1 chang2 hao3 cong2 lai2 bu4 chang4 cuo4
sentences.english: Their songs were perfect, and they never hit a wrong note.

sentences.hanzi: 可是有一天，网上出现了一个新的歌手，叫小星。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 you3 yi1 tian1 wang3 shang4 chu1 xian4 le5 yi1 ge5 xin1 de5 ge1 shou3 jiao4 xiao3 xing1
sentences.english: But one day, a new singer called Xiao Xing appeared online.

sentences.hanzi: 小星唱歌的时候，会唱错。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 xing1 chang4 ge1 de5 shi2 hou5 hui4 chang4 cuo4
sentences.english: When Xiao Xing sang, she hit wrong notes.

sentences.hanzi: 她的视频里，你可以听到她不太好的地方。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 shi4 pin2 li3 ni3 ke3 yi3 ting1 dao4 ta1 bu4 tai4 hao3 de5 di4 fang5
sentences.english: In her videos, you could hear the places where she wasn't quite right.

sentences.hanzi: 可是，大家非常喜欢她。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 da4 jia1 fei1 chang2 xi3 huan5 ta1
sentences.english: But people loved her.

sentences.hanzi: 她的粉丝说：“她唱错的地方，是最好听的地方。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 fen3 si1 shuo1 ta1 chang4 cuo4 de5 di4 fang5 shi4 zui4 hao3 ting1 de5 di4 fang5
sentences.english: Her fans said: "The places where she gets it wrong are the best bits."

sentences.hanzi: “她一定是真正的人。现在，只有人才会唱错。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yi1 ding4 shi4 zhen1 zheng4 de5 ren2 xian4 zai4 zhi3 you3 ren2 cai2 hui4 chang4 cuo4
sentences.english: "She must be a real person. These days, only people make mistakes."

sentences.hanzi: 小星很快就成为最流行的歌手。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 xing1 hen3 kuai4 jiu4 cheng2 wei2 zui4 liu2 xing2 de5 ge1 shou3
sentences.english: Xiao Xing quickly became the most popular singer.

sentences.hanzi: 一年以后，她开了第一个演唱会。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 nian2 yi3 hou4 ta1 kai1 le5 di4 yi1 ge4 yan3 chang4 hui4
sentences.english: A year later, she held her first concert.

sentences.hanzi: 门票一分钟就没有了。
sentences.pinyin: men2 piao4 yi1 fen1 zhong1 jiu4 mei2 you3 le5
sentences.english: The tickets were gone in a minute.

sentences.hanzi: 晚上，两万个观众都在等她。
sentences.pinyin: wan3 shang5 liang3 wan4 ge4 guan1 zhong4 dou1 zai4 deng3 ta1
sentences.english: That evening, twenty thousand fans were waiting for her.

sentences.hanzi: 小星走上舞台。观众都不说话了。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 xing1 zou3 shang4 wu3 tai2 guan1 zhong4 dou1 bu4 shuo1 hua4 le5
sentences.english: Xiao Xing walked out on stage. The audience fell silent.

sentences.hanzi: 她不是人。她是一个机器人。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 bu4 shi4 ren2 ta1 shi4 yi1 ge5 ji1 qi4 ren2
sentences.english: She wasn't a person. She was a robot.

sentences.hanzi: 她说：“对不起。我想了很久，才知道怎么唱错。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 dui4 bu5 qi3 wo3 xiang3 le5 hen3 jiu3 cai2 zhi1 dao4 zen3 me5 chang4 cuo4
sentences.english: She said: "I'm sorry. It took me a long time to work out how to sing wrong."

sentences.hanzi: 观众们看了看她，然后一起说：“再唱一个！”
sentences.pinyin: guan1 zhong4 men5 kan4 le5 kan4 ta1 ran2 hou4 yi1 qi3 shuo1 zai4 chang4 yi1 ge5
sentences.english: The audience looked at her, then shouted together: "Sing another one!"

title: 看不到的第一个电影
titlePinyin: kan4 bu4 dao4 de5 di4 yi1 ge4 dian4 ying3
titleEnglish: The First Film No One Can See

sentences.hanzi: 很多人说，中国的第一个电影，是在一个照相馆里拍的。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 ren2 shuo1 zhong1 guo2 de5 di4 yi1 ge4 dian4 ying3 shi4 zai4 yi1 ge5 zhao4 xiang4 guan3 li3 pai1 de5
sentences.english: Many people say China's first film was made at a photo studio.

sentences.hanzi: 一九零五年，北京有一个照相馆，开照相馆的人叫任庆泰。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 jiu3 ling2 wu3 nian2 bei3 jing1 you3 yi1 ge5 zhao4 xiang4 guan3 kai1 zhao4 xiang4 guan3 de5 ren2 jiao4 ren4 qing4 tai4
sentences.english: In 1905, there was a photo studio in Beijing run by a man called Ren Qingtai.

sentences.hanzi: 他很喜欢新东西，买来了一个拍电影的机器。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 hen3 xi3 huan5 xin1 dong1 xi5 mai3 lai2 le5 yi1 ge5 pai1 dian4 ying3 de5 ji1 qi4
sentences.english: He loved new things, and bought a machine for shooting films.

sentences.hanzi: 那时候，京剧在北京非常流行。
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi2 hou5 jing1 ju4 zai4 bei3 jing1 fei1 chang2 liu2 xing2
sentences.english: At that time, Beijing opera was hugely popular in Beijing.

sentences.hanzi: 谭鑫培是那时候非常有名的京剧演员。
sentences.pinyin: tan2 xin1 pei2 shi4 na4 shi2 hou5 fei1 chang2 you3 ming2 de5 jing1 ju4 yan3 yuan2
sentences.english: Tan Xinpei was a very famous Beijing opera actor of the time.

sentences.hanzi: 任庆泰想：我要拍他的戏。
sentences.pinyin: ren4 qing4 tai4 xiang3 wo3 yao4 pai1 ta1 de5 xi4
sentences.english: Ren Qingtai thought: I want to film his performance.

sentences.hanzi: 他们拍的，是京剧“定军山”里的几个镜头。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 pai1 de5 shi4 jing1 ju4 ding4 jun1 shan1 li3 de5 ji3 ge4 jing4 tou2
sentences.english: What they filmed was a few scenes from the opera Dingjun Mountain.

sentences.hanzi: 那时候的电影，可以看，不能听。
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi2 hou5 de5 dian4 ying3 ke3 yi3 kan4 bu4 neng2 ting1
sentences.english: Films back then could be watched, but not heard.

sentences.hanzi: 所以他们拍的，是谭鑫培的表演：他怎么走，怎么打。
sentences.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 men5 pai1 de5 shi4 tan2 xin1 pei2 de5 biao3 yan3 ta1 zen3 me5 zou3 zen3 me5 da3
sentences.english: So what they filmed was Tan Xinpei's acting: how he walked, how he fought.

sentences.hanzi: 电影拍好以后，在北京放给观众看。
sentences.pinyin: dian4 ying3 pai1 hao3 yi3 hou4 zai4 bei3 jing1 fang4 gei3 guan1 zhong4 kan4
sentences.english: When the film was finished, it was shown to audiences in Beijing.

sentences.hanzi: 很多北京人第一次看到了中国人自己拍的电影。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 bei3 jing1 ren2 di4 yi1 ci4 kan4 dao4 le5 zhong1 guo2 ren2 zi4 ji3 pai1 de5 dian4 ying3
sentences.english: Many people in Beijing saw a film made by Chinese people for the first time.

sentences.hanzi: 一百多年过去了，中国人拍的电影已经非常多了。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 bai3 duo1 nian2 guo4 qu4 le5 zhong1 guo2 ren2 pai1 de5 dian4 ying3 yi3 jing1 fei1 chang2 duo1 le5
sentences.english: More than a hundred years have passed, and Chinese people have made a huge number of films.

sentences.hanzi: 可是今天，没有人能看到“定军山”了。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 jin1 tian1 mei2 you3 ren2 neng2 kan4 dao4 ding4 jun1 shan1 le5
sentences.english: But today, nobody can see Dingjun Mountain anymore.

sentences.hanzi: 这个电影没有留下来，一个镜头也没有。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 dian4 ying3 mei2 you3 liu2 xia4 lai5 yi1 ge5 jing4 tou2 ye3 mei2 you3
sentences.english: The film did not survive. Not a single shot of it.

sentences.hanzi: 中国电影的第一个镜头是什么样子？我们不知道，只有想一想。
sentences.pinyin: zhong1 guo2 dian4 ying3 de5 di4 yi1 ge4 jing4 tou2 shi4 shen2 me5 yang4 zi5 wo3 men5 bu4 zhi1 dao4 zhi3 you3 xiang3 yi1 xiang3
sentences.english: What did the first shot in Chinese film look like? We don't know. We can only imagine.

glossed.meaning: Tan Xinpei, a famous Beijing opera actor

sentences.hanzi: 我刚来中国的时候，有了很多新的微信好友。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 gang1 lai2 zhong1 guo2 de5 shi2 hou5 you3 le5 hen3 duo1 xin1 de5 wei1 xin4 hao3 you3
sentences.english: When I first came to China, I got lots of new WeChat friends.

sentences.hanzi: 有一天，一个中国朋友给我发消息：“明天我们一起去玩吧！”
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 yi1 ge5 zhong1 guo2 peng2 you5 gei3 wo3 fa1 xiao1 xi5 ming2 tian1 wo3 men5 yi1 qi3 qu4 wan2 ba5
sentences.english: One day a Chinese friend sent me a message: "Let's go out together tomorrow!"

sentences.hanzi: 我很高兴，就回了一个表情：一个笑脸。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 hen3 gao1 xing4 jiu4 hui2 le5 yi1 ge5 biao3 qing2 yi1 ge5 xiao4 lian3
sentences.english: I was happy, so I replied with an emoji: a smiley face.

sentences.hanzi: 可是他很久都没有回复。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ta1 hen3 jiu3 dou1 mei2 you3 hui2 fu4
sentences.english: But for a long time he didn't reply.

sentences.hanzi: 晚上，他给我打电话：“你是不是不想去？”
sentences.pinyin: wan3 shang5 ta1 gei3 wo3 da3 dian4 hua4 ni3 shi4 bu4 shi4 bu4 xiang3 qu4
sentences.english: In the evening he phoned me: "You don't want to go, do you?"

sentences.hanzi: 我说：“没有啊！我很想去！我不是给你发了一个笑脸吗？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 mei2 you3 a5 wo3 hen3 xiang3 qu4 wo3 bu4 shi4 gei3 ni3 fa1 le5 yi1 ge5 xiao4 lian3 ma5
sentences.english: I said: "Not at all! I really want to go! Didn't I send you a smiley face?"

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“就是那个笑脸。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 jiu4 shi4 na4 ge5 xiao4 lian3
sentences.english: He said: "That's just it: the smiley face."

sentences.hanzi: “很多中国人觉得，那个表情的意思是：我不太高兴，可是我不想说。”
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 zhong1 guo2 ren2 jue2 de5 na4 ge5 biao3 qing2 de5 yi4 si5 shi4 wo3 bu4 tai4 gao1 xing4 ke3 shi4 wo3 bu4 xiang3 shuo1
sentences.english: "A lot of Chinese people feel that emoji means: I'm not very happy, but I don't want to say so."

sentences.hanzi: 我说：“可是它在笑啊！”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 ke3 shi4 ta1 zai4 xiao4 a5
sentences.english: I said: "But it's smiling!"

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“对。就是因为它在笑。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 dui4 jiu4 shi4 yin1 wei4 ta1 zai4 xiao4
sentences.english: He said: "Right. That's exactly why."

sentences.hanzi: 我想了很久，还是不明白。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 le5 hen3 jiu3 hai2 shi5 bu4 ming2 bai5
sentences.english: I thought about it for a long time, and I still didn't get it.

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，我们一起出去玩了。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 wo3 men5 yi1 qi3 chu1 qu4 wan2 le5
sentences.english: The next day we went out together.

sentences.hanzi: 他一直在给我拍照。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yi1 zhi2 zai4 gei3 wo3 pai1 zhao4
sentences.english: He kept taking photos of me.

sentences.hanzi: 晚上，他把照片发到了朋友圈，还写了：“我的新朋友。今天他在笑，没有用表情。”
sentences.pinyin: wan3 shang5 ta1 ba3 zhao4 pian4 fa1 dao4 le5 peng2 you5 quan1 hai2 xie3 le5 wo3 de5 xin1 peng2 you5 jin1 tian1 ta1 zai4 xiao4 mei2 you3 yong4 biao3 qing2
sentences.english: That evening he posted the photos on his Moments and wrote: "My new friend. Today he's smiling, no emoji needed."

sentences.hanzi: 我马上给他点赞，可是这一次，我什么表情也没有发。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 ma3 shang4 gei3 ta1 dian3 zan4 ke3 shi4 zhe4 yi1 ci4 wo3 shen2 me5 biao3 qing2 ye3 mei2 you3 fa1
sentences.english: I liked it straight away, but this time I didn't send any emoji at all.

sentences.hanzi: 一百年前，没有手机，没有微信，很多人也没有电话。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 bai3 nian2 qian2 mei2 you3 shou3 ji1 mei2 you3 wei1 xin4 hen3 duo1 ren2 ye3 mei2 you3 dian4 hua4
sentences.english: A hundred years ago there were no mobile phones and no WeChat, and many people didn't even have a telephone.

sentences.hanzi: 想联系很远的人，就发电报。
sentences.pinyin: xiang3 lian2 xi4 hen3 yuan3 de5 ren2 jiu4 fa1 dian4 bao4
sentences.english: If you wanted to reach someone far away, you sent a telegram.

sentences.hanzi: 小林在上海一个发电报的地方工作。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 lin2 zai4 shang4 hai3 yi1 ge5 fa1 dian4 bao4 de5 di4 fang5 gong1 zuo4
sentences.english: Xiao Lin worked at a telegraph office in Shanghai.

sentences.hanzi: 电报不能发中文，能发的只有号码。
sentences.pinyin: dian4 bao4 bu4 neng2 fa1 zhong1 wen2 neng2 fa1 de5 zhi3 you3 hao4 ma3
sentences.english: A telegram couldn't send Chinese. All it could send was numbers.

sentences.hanzi: 每一个字，都有自己的四个号码。“中”字，就是“零零二二”。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 yi1 ge5 zi4 dou1 you3 zi4 ji3 de5 si4 ge4 hao4 ma3 zhong1 zi4 jiu4 shi4 ling2 ling2 er4 er4
sentences.english: Every character had its own four-digit number. The character zhong, for example, was "zero zero two two".

sentences.hanzi: 小林天天看着电码本，把字换成号码，再把号码换成字。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 lin2 tian1 tian1 kan4 zhe5 dian4 ma3 ben3 ba3 zi4 huan4 cheng2 hao4 ma3 zai4 ba3 hao4 ma3 huan4 cheng2 zi4
sentences.english: Every day Xiao Lin worked from the codebook, turning characters into numbers, then numbers back into characters.

sentences.hanzi: 那时候，电报是一个字一个字算钱的，所以大家发电报，一个字也不多写。
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi2 hou5 dian4 bao4 shi4 yi1 ge5 zi4 yi1 ge5 zi4 suan4 qian2 de5 suo3 yi3 da4 jia1 fa1 dian4 bao4 yi1 ge5 zi4 ye3 bu4 duo1 xie3
sentences.english: In those days, telegrams were charged by the character, so people never wrote one character more than they had to.

sentences.hanzi: 有一天，来了一个老人，要给在很远的地方工作的孩子发电报。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 lai2 le5 yi1 ge5 lao3 ren2 yao4 gei3 zai4 hen3 yuan3 de5 di4 fang5 gong1 zuo4 de5 hai2 zi5 fa1 dian4 bao4
sentences.english: One day an old man came in to send a telegram to his son, who worked far away.

sentences.hanzi: 他写了很多：“我和你妈妈都很好，不要担心，多穿衣服，有时间就回家……”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xie3 le5 hen3 duo1 wo3 he2 ni3 ma1 ma5 dou1 hen3 hao3 bu4 yao4 dan1 xin1 duo1 chuan1 yi1 fu5 you3 shi2 jian1 jiu4 hui2 jia1
sentences.english: He wrote a lot: "Your mother and I are both well, don't worry, wear warm clothes, come home when you have time..."

sentences.hanzi: 小林说：“这么多字，要很多钱。”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 lin2 shuo1 zhe4 me5 duo1 zi4 yao4 hen3 duo1 qian2
sentences.english: Xiao Lin said: "That many characters will cost a lot of money."

sentences.hanzi: 老人看了看自己的钱，想了很久，最后只写了四个字：“我们都好。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ren2 kan4 le5 kan4 zi4 ji3 de5 qian2 xiang3 le5 hen3 jiu3 zui4 hou4 zhi3 xie3 le5 si4 ge4 zi4 wo3 men5 dou1 hao3
sentences.english: The old man looked at his money and thought for a long time. In the end he wrote only four characters: "We are all well."

sentences.hanzi: 老人回家等消息。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ren2 hui2 jia1 deng3 xiao1 xi5
sentences.english: The old man went home to wait for news.

sentences.hanzi: 一个月以后，老人又来了。这一次，是他收到了电报。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 yue4 yi3 hou4 lao3 ren2 you4 lai2 le5 zhe4 yi1 ci4 shi4 ta1 shou1 dao4 le5 dian4 bao4
sentences.english: A month later the old man came again. This time, he was the one who had received a telegram.

sentences.hanzi: 小林拿出电码本，一个号码一个号码地找。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 lin2 na2 chu1 dian4 ma3 ben3 yi1 ge4 hao4 ma3 yi1 ge4 hao4 ma3 de5 zhao3
sentences.english: Xiao Lin took out the codebook and looked up the numbers one by one.

sentences.hanzi: 电报上也只有四个字：“我也很好。”
sentences.pinyin: dian4 bao4 shang4 ye3 zhi3 you3 si4 ge4 zi4 wo3 ye3 hen3 hao3
sentences.english: The telegram had only four characters too: "I'm fine too."

sentences.hanzi: 老人看了很久，说：“他也是想了很久，才写了这四个字吧。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ren2 kan4 le5 hen3 jiu3 shuo1 ta1 ye3 shi4 xiang3 le5 hen3 jiu3 cai2 xie3 le5 zhe4 si4 ge4 zi4 ba5
sentences.english: The old man looked at it for a long time and said: "He must have thought a long time too, before he wrote those four."

title: 三十年以后的短信
titlePinyin: san1 shi2 nian2 yi3 hou4 de5 duan3 xin4
titleEnglish: A Text from Thirty Years On

sentences.hanzi: 晚上十二点，我收到了一条短信。
sentences.pinyin: wan3 shang5 shi2 er4 dian3 wo3 shou1 dao4 le5 yi1 tiao2 duan3 xin4
sentences.english: At midnight, I got a text message.

sentences.hanzi: 发短信的号码，是我自己的号码。
sentences.pinyin: fa1 duan3 xin4 de5 hao4 ma3 shi4 wo3 zi4 ji3 de5 hao4 ma3
sentences.english: The number that sent it was my own number.

sentences.hanzi: 短信上写着：“我是三十年以后的你。”
sentences.pinyin: duan3 xin4 shang4 xie3 zhe5 wo3 shi4 san1 shi2 nian2 yi3 hou4 de5 ni3
sentences.english: The text said: "I'm you, thirty years from now."

sentences.hanzi: 我想：一定是我的朋友在跟我玩。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 yi1 ding4 shi4 wo3 de5 peng2 you5 zai4 gen1 wo3 wan2
sentences.english: I thought: it must be one of my friends playing a joke on me.

sentences.hanzi: 第二条短信很快就来了：“明天，别删除那张照片。”
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tiao2 duan3 xin4 hen3 kuai4 jiu4 lai2 le5 ming2 tian1 bie2 shan1 chu2 na4 zhang1 zhao4 pian4
sentences.english: A second text came straight away: "Tomorrow, don't delete that photo."

sentences.hanzi: 哪张照片？我看了看手机。
sentences.pinyin: na3 zhang1 zhao4 pian4 wo3 kan4 le5 kan4 shou3 ji1
sentences.english: Which photo? I looked at my phone.

sentences.hanzi: 今天我出去拍照，只有一张照片里有人。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 chu1 qu4 pai1 zhao4 zhi3 you3 yi1 zhang1 zhao4 pian4 li3 you3 ren2
sentences.english: I'd been out taking photos today, and only one of them had a person in it.

sentences.hanzi: 那是一个女孩，她坐在那里，没有看我。
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi4 yi1 ge5 nu:3 hai2 ta1 zuo4 zai4 na4 li5 mei2 you3 kan4 wo3
sentences.english: It was a girl, sitting there, not looking at me.

sentences.hanzi: 我是想删除它的。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shi4 xiang3 shan1 chu2 ta1 de5
sentences.english: I had meant to delete it.

sentences.hanzi: 我又发了一条：“为什么？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 you4 fa1 le5 yi1 tiao2 wei4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: I sent another one: "Why?"

sentences.hanzi: 回复很快就来了：“因为三十年以后，她就是你孩子的妈妈。”
sentences.pinyin: hui2 fu4 hen3 kuai4 jiu4 lai2 le5 yin1 wei4 san1 shi2 nian2 yi3 hou4 ta1 jiu4 shi4 ni3 hai2 zi5 de5 ma1 ma5
sentences.english: The reply came quickly: "Because thirty years from now, she's the mother of your children."

sentences.hanzi: 我又问：“三十年以后，世界怎么样？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 you4 wen4 san1 shi2 nian2 yi3 hou4 shi4 jie4 zen3 me5 yang4
sentences.english: I asked: "What's the world like thirty years from now?"

sentences.hanzi: 这一次，等了很久，才有回复：
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 ci4 deng3 le5 hen3 jiu3 cai2 you3 hui2 fu4
sentences.english: This time I waited a long while for a reply:

sentences.hanzi: “手机快没电了。三十年以后，充电还是这么难。”
sentences.pinyin: shou3 ji1 kuai4 mei2 dian4 le5 san1 shi2 nian2 yi3 hou4 chong1 dian4 hai2 shi5 zhe4 me5 nan2
sentences.english: "My phone's about to die. Thirty years on, charging is still this hard."

sentences.hanzi: 我看着照片里的女孩，没有删除。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 kan4 zhe5 zhao4 pian4 li3 de5 nu:3 hai2 mei2 you3 shan1 chu2
sentences.english: I looked at the girl in the photo and didn't delete it.

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，我又去了那个地方。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 wo3 you4 qu4 le5 na4 ge5 di4 fang5
sentences.english: The next day, I went back to that place.

sentences.hanzi: 今天，我们发一条消息，朋友马上就能收到。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 fa1 yi1 tiao2 xiao1 xi5 peng2 you5 ma3 shang4 jiu4 neng2 shou1 dao4
sentences.english: Today, when we send a message, a friend gets it right away.

sentences.hanzi: 两千多年前，没有手机，也没有电话。
sentences.pinyin: liang3 qian1 duo1 nian2 qian2 mei2 you3 shou3 ji1 ye3 mei2 you3 dian4 hua4
sentences.english: Two thousand years ago, there were no mobile phones and no telephones.

sentences.hanzi: 那时候是汉朝。汉朝有一个人，叫苏武。
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi2 hou5 shi4 han4 chao2 han4 chao2 you3 yi1 ge5 ren2 jiao4 su1 wu3
sentences.english: It was the Han dynasty. There was a man in the Han called Su Wu.

sentences.hanzi: 汉朝让他去匈奴，可是匈奴不让他回来。
sentences.pinyin: han4 chao2 rang4 ta1 qu4 xiong1 nu2 ke3 shi4 xiong1 nu2 bu4 rang4 ta1 hui2 lai5
sentences.english: The Han sent him to the Xiongnu, but the Xiongnu wouldn't let him come back.

sentences.hanzi: 他们让苏武去很远很远的地方，一个人放羊。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 rang4 su1 wu3 qu4 hen3 yuan3 hen3 yuan3 de5 di4 fang5 yi1 ge5 ren2 fang4 yang2
sentences.english: They sent Su Wu far, far away, to herd sheep alone.

sentences.hanzi: 一年，两年，十年……汉朝和他联系不上，一直没有他的消息。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 nian2 liang3 nian2 shi2 nian2 han4 chao2 he2 ta1 lian2 xi4 bu4 shang4 yi1 zhi2 mei2 you3 ta1 de5 xiao1 xi5
sentences.english: One year, two years, ten years... the Han couldn't reach him and never heard any news of him.

sentences.hanzi: 过了很多年，又有汉朝的人去了匈奴。
sentences.pinyin: guo4 le5 hen3 duo1 nian2 you4 you3 han4 chao2 de5 ren2 qu4 le5 xiong1 nu2
sentences.english: Many years later, Han envoys came to the Xiongnu again.

sentences.hanzi: 他们问：“苏武在哪里？”匈奴的人说：“苏武已经死了。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 wen4 su1 wu3 zai4 na3 li3 xiong1 nu2 de5 ren2 shuo1 su1 wu3 yi3 jing1 si3 le5
sentences.english: They asked: "Where is Su Wu?" The Xiongnu said: "Su Wu is dead."

sentences.hanzi: 可是晚上，一个和苏武一起来的人，来找他们。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 wan3 shang5 yi1 ge5 he2 su1 wu3 yi1 qi3 lai2 de5 ren2 lai2 zhao3 ta1 men5
sentences.english: But that night, a man who had come with Su Wu came to find them.

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“苏武还活着！”他还告诉他们一个办法。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 su1 wu3 hai2 huo2 zhe5 ta1 hai2 gao4 su5 ta1 men5 yi1 ge5 ban4 fa3
sentences.english: He said: "Su Wu is still alive!" And he told them a plan.

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，汉朝的人对匈奴说：“我们的皇帝打下来一只大雁。”
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 han4 chao2 de5 ren2 dui4 xiong1 nu2 shuo1 wo3 men5 de5 huang2 di4 da3 xia4 lai2 yi1 zhi1 da4 yan4
sentences.english: The next day, the Han envoys told the Xiongnu: "Our emperor shot down a wild goose."

sentences.hanzi: “大雁身上带着一条消息：苏武还活着，在很远的地方放羊。”
sentences.pinyin: da4 yan4 shen1 shang5 dai4 zhe5 yi1 tiao2 xiao1 xi5 su1 wu3 hai2 huo2 zhe5 zai4 hen3 yuan3 de5 di4 fang5 fang4 yang2
sentences.english: "The goose was carrying a message: Su Wu is alive, herding sheep far away."

sentences.hanzi: 匈奴的人听了，不知道说什么，就让苏武回家了。
sentences.pinyin: xiong1 nu2 de5 ren2 ting1 le5 bu4 zhi1 dao4 shuo1 shen2 me5 jiu4 rang4 su1 wu3 hui2 jia1 le5
sentences.english: The Xiongnu didn't know what to say, so they let Su Wu go home.

sentences.hanzi: 苏武在匈奴，过了十九年。
sentences.pinyin: su1 wu3 zai4 xiong1 nu2 guo4 le5 shi2 jiu3 nian2
sentences.english: Su Wu had spent nineteen years among the Xiongnu.

sentences.hanzi: 其实，根本没有那只大雁。
sentences.pinyin: qi2 shi2 gen1 ben3 mei2 you3 na4 zhi1 da4 yan4
sentences.english: In fact, there never was any goose.

sentences.hanzi: 可是大雁的消息，一点也没有错。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 da4 yan4 de5 xiao1 xi5 yi1 dian3 ye3 mei2 you3 cuo4
sentences.english: But the goose's message was perfectly right.

sentences.hanzi: 如果苏武有手机，他一定会在朋友圈里发一张大雁的照片。
sentences.pinyin: ru2 guo3 su1 wu3 you3 shou3 ji1 ta1 yi1 ding4 hui4 zai4 peng2 you5 quan1 li3 fa1 yi1 zhang1 da4 yan4 de5 zhao4 pian4
sentences.english: If Su Wu had had a phone, he'd surely have posted a picture of a goose on his Moments.

glossed.meaning: Su Wu, a Han dynasty envoy
the Xiongnu, a people of the northern steppe

sentences.hanzi: 每一年的春节，中国人会给孩子红包，里面放着钱。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 yi1 nian2 de5 chun1 jie2 zhong1 guo2 ren2 hui4 gei3 hai2 zi5 hong2 bao1 li3 mian4 fang4 zhe5 qian2
sentences.english: Every Spring Festival, Chinese people give children red envelopes with money inside.

sentences.hanzi: 现在，红包也上网了。
sentences.pinyin: xian4 zai4 hong2 bao1 ye3 shang4 wang3 le5
sentences.english: Now red envelopes have gone online too.

sentences.hanzi: 十多年前，微信让大家可以在群里发红包。
sentences.pinyin: shi2 duo1 nian2 qian2 wei1 xin4 rang4 da4 jia1 ke3 yi3 zai4 qun2 li3 fa1 hong2 bao1
sentences.english: More than ten years ago, WeChat made it possible to send red envelopes in group chats.

sentences.hanzi: 你可以把一百块钱放进十个红包，发到群里。
sentences.pinyin: ni3 ke3 yi3 ba3 yi1 bai3 kuai4 qian2 fang4 jin4 shi2 ge4 hong2 bao1 fa1 dao4 qun2 li3
sentences.english: You can put a hundred yuan into ten red envelopes and send them to a group.

sentences.hanzi: 每个人能拿到多少，不是你说了算，是手机说了算。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 ge5 ren2 neng2 na2 dao4 duo1 shao5 bu4 shi4 ni3 shuo1 le5 suan4 shi4 shou3 ji1 shuo1 le5 suan4
sentences.english: How much each person gets isn't up to you. It's up to the phone.

sentences.hanzi: 有人拿到很多，有人只拿到一点点。
sentences.pinyin: you3 ren2 na2 dao4 hen3 duo1 you3 ren2 zhi3 na2 dao4 yi1 dian3 dian3
sentences.english: Some people get a lot, some get only a tiny bit.

sentences.hanzi: 所以红包一来，大家都要马上去点，晚了就没有了。
sentences.pinyin: suo3 yi3 hong2 bao1 yi1 lai2 da4 jia1 dou1 yao4 ma3 shang4 qu4 dian3 wan3 le5 jiu4 mei2 you3 le5
sentences.english: So the moment a red envelope arrives, everyone taps it straight away. Too late, and it's gone.

sentences.hanzi: 这就叫“抢红包”。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 jiao4 qiang3 hong2 bao1
sentences.english: This is called grabbing red envelopes.

sentences.hanzi: 我妈妈六十多岁了，以前不太会用手机。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 ma1 ma5 liu4 shi2 duo1 sui4 le5 yi3 qian2 bu4 tai4 hui4 yong4 shou3 ji1
sentences.english: My mother is in her sixties, and she used to be hopeless with phones.

sentences.hanzi: 可是春节的时候，她抢红包比谁都快。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 chun1 jie2 de5 shi2 hou5 ta1 qiang3 hong2 bao1 bi3 shei2 dou1 kuai4
sentences.english: But at Spring Festival, she grabs red envelopes faster than anyone.

sentences.hanzi: 在我们家的群里，大家都知道一件事：拿到最多的人，要发下一个红包。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 wo3 men5 jia1 de5 qun2 li3 da4 jia1 dou1 zhi1 dao4 yi1 jian4 shi4 na2 dao4 zui4 duo1 de5 ren2 yao4 fa1 xia4 yi1 ge5 hong2 bao1
sentences.english: In our family group, everyone knows one rule: whoever gets the most has to send the next envelope.

sentences.hanzi: 有一年，妈妈发了一个红包：十块钱，给全家十个人。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 nian2 ma1 ma5 fa1 le5 yi1 ge5 hong2 bao1 shi2 kuai4 qian2 gei3 quan2 jia1 shi2 ge4 ren2
sentences.english: One year, Mum sent a red envelope: ten yuan, for the ten of us in the family.

sentences.hanzi: 我收到了三块，是最多的。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shou1 dao4 le5 san1 kuai4 shi4 zui4 duo1 de5
sentences.english: I got three yuan, the most of anyone.

sentences.hanzi: 所以，我发了一百块。
sentences.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 fa1 le5 yi1 bai3 kuai4
sentences.english: So I sent a hundred.

sentences.hanzi: 这一次，拿到最多的是妈妈。她又发了十块。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 ci4 na2 dao4 zui4 duo1 de5 shi4 ma1 ma5 ta1 you4 fa1 le5 shi2 kuai4
sentences.english: This time, Mum got the most. She sent ten again.

sentences.hanzi: 这天晚上，大家在朋友圈里分享自己抢到了多少。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 tian1 wan3 shang5 da4 jia1 zai4 peng2 you5 quan1 li3 fen1 xiang3 zi4 ji3 qiang3 dao4 le5 duo1 shao5
sentences.english: That night, everyone shared on their Moments how much they had grabbed.

sentences.hanzi: 一个晚上，妈妈发了五十块，拿到了三百块。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 wan3 shang5 ma1 ma5 fa1 le5 wu3 shi2 kuai4 na2 dao4 le5 san1 bai3 kuai4
sentences.english: Over the evening, Mum had sent fifty yuan and got three hundred.

sentences.hanzi: 她说：“手机这个东西，我现在会用了。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 shou3 ji1 zhe4 ge5 dong1 xi5 wo3 xian4 zai4 hui4 yong4 le5
sentences.english: She said: "These phones, I've got the hang of them now."

sentences.hanzi: 小美第一次来成都，去看熊猫。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 di4 yi1 ci4 lai2 cheng2 du1 qu4 kan4 xiong2 mao1
sentences.english: Xiaomei was in Chengdu for the first time, and went to see the pandas.

sentences.hanzi: 她看了很久，问爸爸：“熊猫是猫吗？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 le5 hen3 jiu3 wen4 ba4 ba5 xiong2 mao1 shi4 mao1 ma5
sentences.english: She watched for a long time, then asked her dad, "Is a panda a cat?"

sentences.hanzi: “不是。熊猫是熊，不是猫。”
sentences.pinyin: bu4 shi4 xiong2 mao1 shi4 xiong2 bu4 shi4 mao1
sentences.english: "No. A panda is a bear, not a cat."

sentences.hanzi: “那为什么叫熊猫？”
sentences.pinyin: na4 wei4 shen2 me5 jiao4 xiong2 mao1
sentences.english: "Then why is it called a 'bear-cat'?"

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸想了想，说：“这个问题，我也不知道。”
sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 xiang3 le5 xiang3 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2 wo3 ye3 bu4 zhi1 dao4
sentences.english: Dad thought for a moment and said, "I don't know either."

sentences.hanzi: 熊猫什么也不做，只是吃竹子。
sentences.pinyin: xiong2 mao1 shen2 me5 ye3 bu4 zuo4 zhi3 shi4 chi1 zhu2 zi5
sentences.english: The panda did nothing but eat bamboo.

sentences.hanzi: 竹子很高，像树。
sentences.pinyin: zhu2 zi5 hen3 gao1 xiang4 shu4
sentences.english: Bamboo is tall, like a tree.

sentences.hanzi: 可是一个在这里工作的人告诉他们，竹子不是树，是一种草。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 yi1 ge5 zai4 zhe4 li3 gong1 zuo4 de5 ren2 gao4 su5 ta1 men5 zhu2 zi5 bu4 shi4 shu4 shi4 yi1 zhong3 cao3
sentences.english: But someone who worked there told them that bamboo isn't a tree; it's a kind of grass.

sentences.hanzi: 小美看了一个小时，熊猫还在吃。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 kan4 le5 yi1 ge5 xiao3 shi2 xiong2 mao1 hai2 zai4 chi1
sentences.english: Xiaomei watched for an hour, and the panda was still eating.

sentences.hanzi: “它为什么一直吃？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 wei4 shen2 me5 yi1 zhi2 chi1
sentences.english: "Why does it keep eating?"

sentences.hanzi: “熊猫一天要吃十几个小时。”
sentences.pinyin: xiong2 mao1 yi1 tian1 yao4 chi1 shi2 ji3 ge4 xiao3 shi2
sentences.english: "A panda eats for more than ten hours a day."

sentences.hanzi: 熊猫是熊，很多熊都吃肉。
sentences.pinyin: xiong2 mao1 shi4 xiong2 hen3 duo1 xiong2 dou1 chi1 rou4
sentences.english: A panda is a bear, and a lot of bears eat meat.

sentences.hanzi: “竹子吃下去，很多都没有用，所以它要一直吃。”
sentences.pinyin: zhu2 zi5 chi1 xia4 qu4 hen3 duo1 dou1 mei2 you3 yong4 suo3 yi3 ta1 yao4 yi1 zhi2 chi1
sentences.english: "A lot of the bamboo it eats is no use to it, so it has to keep eating."

sentences.hanzi: 小美问：“那它为什么不吃肉呢？”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 wen4 na4 ta1 wei4 shen2 me5 bu4 chi1 rou4 ne5
sentences.english: Xiaomei asked, "Then why doesn't it eat meat?"

sentences.hanzi: “野生的熊猫住在山上的森林里，那里有很多竹子。”
sentences.pinyin: ye3 sheng1 de5 xiong2 mao1 zhu4 zai4 shan1 shang4 de5 sen1 lin2 li3 na4 li5 you3 hen3 duo1 zhu2 zi5
sentences.english: "Wild pandas live in mountain forests, where there's lots of bamboo."

sentences.hanzi: “你看，它就是这样，一天到晚只做一件事。”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 kan4 ta1 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 yang4 yi1 tian1 dao4 wan3 zhi3 zuo4 yi1 jian4 shi4
sentences.english: "Look, that's how it is: from morning to night it does just one thing."

sentences.hanzi: 小美说：“这也是一种生活。”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 shuo1 zhe4 ye3 shi4 yi1 zhong3 sheng1 huo2
sentences.english: Xiaomei said, "That's one way to live, too."

sentences.hanzi: 回家以后，小美给台湾的朋友打电话：“我今天看到熊猫了！”
sentences.pinyin: hui2 jia1 yi3 hou4 xiao3 mei3 gei3 tai2 wan1 de5 peng2 you5 da3 dian4 hua4 wo3 jin1 tian1 kan4 dao4 xiong2 mao1 le5
sentences.english: Back home, Xiaomei phoned a friend in Taiwan: "I saw pandas today!"

sentences.hanzi: 朋友说：“你说的是猫熊吧？在台湾，很多人叫它猫熊。”
sentences.pinyin: peng2 you5 shuo1 ni3 shuo1 de5 shi4 mao1 xiong2 ba5 zai4 tai2 wan1 hen3 duo1 ren2 jiao4 ta1 mao1 xiong2
sentences.english: Her friend said, "You mean 'cat-bear', right? In Taiwan, a lot of people call it a cat-bear."

sentences.hanzi: 小美想：熊猫，猫熊，到底哪一个对？
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 xiang3 xiong2 mao1 mao1 xiong2 dao4 di3 na3 yi1 ge5 dui4
sentences.english: Xiaomei thought: bear-cat, cat-bear, which one is right?

sentences.hanzi: 它是熊，不是猫，叫猫熊好像更对。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shi4 xiong2 bu4 shi4 mao1 jiao4 mao1 xiong2 hao3 xiang4 geng4 dui4
sentences.english: It's a bear, not a cat, so 'cat-bear' seems more right.

sentences.hanzi: 可是它坐着吃竹子的时候，真有一点像猫。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ta1 zuo4 zhe5 chi1 zhu2 zi5 de5 shi2 hou5 zhen1 you3 yi1 dian3 xiang4 mao1
sentences.english: But when it sits eating bamboo, it really is a little like a cat.

title: 三个名字的猫
titlePinyin: san1 ge4 ming2 zi5 de5 mao1

sentences.hanzi: 我一个人住，从来没有养过宠物。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 yi1 ge5 ren2 zhu4 cong2 lai2 mei2 you3 yang3 guo5 chong3 wu4
sentences.english: I live alone, and I've never kept a pet.

sentences.hanzi: 一年前，一只猫开始来我家。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 nian2 qian2 yi1 zhi3 mao1 kai1 shi3 lai2 wo3 jia1
sentences.english: A year ago, a cat started coming to my home.

sentences.hanzi: 每天晚上，它都在门前等我。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 tian1 wan3 shang5 ta1 dou1 zai4 men2 qian2 deng3 wo3
sentences.english: Every evening, it waited for me at the door.

sentences.hanzi: 我给它鱼，它吃完了也不走，在我家过一个晚上。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 gei3 ta1 yu2 ta1 chi1 wan2 le5 ye3 bu4 zou3 zai4 wo3 jia1 guo4 yi1 ge5 wan3 shang5
sentences.english: I gave it fish, and when it had eaten it didn't leave, but spent the night at my place.

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，它又走了。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 ta1 you4 zou3 le5
sentences.english: The next day, it was gone again.

sentences.hanzi: 我想，这只猫没有家，真可怜。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 zhe4 zhi3 mao1 mei2 you3 jia1 zhen1 ke3 lian2
sentences.english: I thought: this cat has no home, poor thing.

sentences.hanzi: 我给它起了一个名字，叫小花。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 gei3 ta1 qi3 le5 yi1 ge5 ming2 zi5 jiao4 xiao3 hua1
sentences.english: I gave it a name: Xiaohua, Little Flower.

sentences.hanzi: 可是，小花也会几天都不来。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 xiao3 hua1 ye3 hui4 ji3 tian1 dou1 bu4 lai2
sentences.english: But Xiaohua would also stay away for days.

sentences.hanzi: 我很担心：它去哪里了？
sentences.pinyin: wo3 hen3 dan1 xin1 ta1 qu4 na3 li3 le5
sentences.english: I was worried: where had it gone?

sentences.hanzi: 有一天，我出去的时候，看见了它。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 wo3 chu1 qu4 de5 shi2 hou5 kan4 jian4 le5 ta1
sentences.english: One day, when I was out, I saw it.

sentences.hanzi: 一个老人站在他家门前叫它：“老虎！回来！”
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 lao3 ren2 zhan4 zai4 ta1 jia1 men2 qian2 jiao4 ta1 lao3 hu3 hui2 lai5
sentences.english: An old man standing at his door called to it: "Tiger! Come back!"

sentences.hanzi: 小花，不，老虎，马上跑了过去。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 hua1 bu4 lao3 hu3 ma3 shang4 pao3 le5 guo4 qu4
sentences.english: Xiaohua, no, Tiger, ran straight over to him.

sentences.hanzi: 我问老人：“这是你家的猫吗？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wen4 lao3 ren2 zhe4 shi4 ni3 jia1 de5 mao1 ma5
sentences.english: I asked the old man, "Is this your cat?"

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“不是。这只猫没有家，很可怜，我天天给它吃鸡。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 bu4 shi4 zhe4 zhi3 mao1 mei2 you3 jia1 hen3 ke3 lian2 wo3 tian1 tian1 gei3 ta1 chi1 ji1
