sentences.english: He said, "No. This cat has no home, poor thing. I give it chicken every day."

sentences.hanzi: 这天晚上，对面的女孩也来找我。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 tian1 wan3 shang5 dui4 mian4 de5 nu:3 hai2 ye3 lai2 zhao3 wo3
sentences.english: That evening, the girl across the hall came to see me too.

sentences.hanzi: “你看见宝贝了吗？它好几天没来了。”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 kan4 jian4 bao3 bei4 le5 ma5 ta1 hao3 ji3 tian1 mei2 lai2 le5
sentences.english: "Have you seen Baobei? It hasn't come for days."

sentences.hanzi: “宝贝？”
sentences.pinyin: bao3 bei4
sentences.english: "Baobei?"

sentences.hanzi: “一只猫。它没有家，很可怜，晚上总是来我家。”
sentences.pinyin: yi1 zhi3 mao1 ta1 mei2 you3 jia1 hen3 ke3 lian2 wan3 shang5 zong3 shi4 lai2 wo3 jia1
sentences.english: "A cat. It has no home, poor thing. It always comes to my place at night."

sentences.hanzi: 我们三个人站在那里，你看我，我看你。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 san1 ge4 ren2 zhan4 zai4 na4 li5 ni3 kan4 wo3 wo3 kan4 ni3
sentences.english: The three of us stood there, looking at each other.

sentences.hanzi: 这时候我们才知道：这只猫有三个家，三个名字。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 hou5 wo3 men5 cai2 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 zhi3 mao1 you3 san1 ge4 jia1 san1 ge4 ming2 zi5
sentences.english: Only then did we realise: this cat had three homes and three names.

sentences.hanzi: 每一家都以为，它是一只没有家的猫。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 yi1 jia1 dou1 yi3 wei2 ta1 shi4 yi1 zhi3 mei2 you3 jia1 de5 mao1
sentences.english: Each home thought it was a cat with no home.

sentences.hanzi: 现在，我们三个人总是一起去公园，坐在树下等它。
sentences.pinyin: xian4 zai4 wo3 men5 san1 ge4 ren2 zong3 shi4 yi1 qi3 qu4 gong1 yuan2 zuo4 zai4 shu4 xia4 deng3 ta1
sentences.english: Now the three of us always go to the park together and sit under a tree waiting for it.

sentences.hanzi: 我想：到底是我们在养它，还是它在养我们？
sentences.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 dao4 di3 shi4 wo3 men5 zai4 yang3 ta1 hai2 shi5 ta1 zai4 yang3 wo3 men5
sentences.english: I wonder: are we keeping it, or is it keeping us?

glossed.meaning: Xiaohua, Little Flower, a cat's name

title: 带鸟去公园
titleEnglish: Taking the Bird to the Park

sentences.hanzi: 太阳一出来，北京的很多公园里，就有一些老人带着鸟笼来。
sentences.pinyin: tai4 yang5 yi1 chu1 lai2 bei3 jing1 de5 hen3 duo1 gong1 yuan2 li3 jiu4 you3 yi1 xie1 lao3 ren2 dai4 zhe5 niao3 long2 lai2
sentences.english: As soon as the sun is up, old men arrive in many of Beijing's parks carrying birdcages.

sentences.hanzi: 他们把鸟笼挂在树上，自己坐在树下说话。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 ba3 niao3 long2 gua4 zai4 shu4 shang4 zi4 ji3 zuo4 zai4 shu4 xia4 shuo1 hua4
sentences.english: They hang the cages in the trees and sit underneath to chat.

sentences.hanzi: 小东的爷爷养鸟，已经养了二十年。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 dong1 de5 ye2 ye5 yang3 niao3 yi3 jing1 yang3 le5 er4 shi2 nian2
sentences.english: Xiaodong's grandpa has kept birds for twenty years.

sentences.hanzi: 这一天，小东跟爷爷一起去公园。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 tian1 xiao3 dong1 gen1 ye2 ye5 yi1 qi3 qu4 gong1 yuan2
sentences.english: That day, Xiaodong went to the park with his grandpa.

sentences.hanzi: “爷爷，为什么要带鸟去公园？”
sentences.pinyin: ye2 ye5 wei4 shen2 me5 yao4 dai4 niao3 qu4 gong1 yuan2
sentences.english: "Grandpa, why do you take the bird to the park?"

sentences.hanzi: “鸟一直不出去，会不高兴，就不叫了。”
sentences.pinyin: niao3 yi1 zhi2 bu4 chu1 qu4 hui4 bu4 gao1 xing4 jiu4 bu4 jiao4 le5
sentences.english: "If a bird never goes out, it gets unhappy and stops singing."

sentences.hanzi: “在公园里，它能听到别的鸟叫，自己也会叫得更好。”
sentences.pinyin: zai4 gong1 yuan2 li3 ta1 neng2 ting1 dao4 bie2 de5 niao3 jiao4 zi4 ji3 ye3 hui4 jiao4 de5 geng4 hao3
sentences.english: "In the park it can hear other birds sing, and it learns to sing better itself."

sentences.hanzi: 到了公园，树上已经挂着十几个鸟笼了。
sentences.pinyin: dao4 le5 gong1 yuan2 shu4 shang4 yi3 jing1 gua4 zhe5 shi2 ji3 ge4 niao3 long2 le5
sentences.english: When they got to the park, a dozen or more cages were already hanging in the trees.

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷也把鸟笼挂上去。
sentences.pinyin: ye2 ye5 ye3 ba3 niao3 long2 gua4 shang4 qu4
sentences.english: Grandpa hung his cage up too.

sentences.hanzi: 很快，一只鸟开始叫，别的鸟也一起叫。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 kuai4 yi1 zhi3 niao3 kai1 shi3 jiao4 bie2 de5 niao3 ye3 yi1 qi3 jiao4
sentences.english: Soon one bird began to sing, and the others joined in.

sentences.hanzi: 整个公园都是鸟叫。
sentences.pinyin: zheng3 ge4 gong1 yuan2 dou1 shi4 niao3 jiao4
sentences.english: The whole park was full of birdsong.

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷说：“你看，这里有树，有花，有草，有天空，就像大自然。”
sentences.pinyin: ye2 ye5 shuo1 ni3 kan4 zhe4 li3 you3 shu4 you3 hua1 you3 cao3 you3 tian1 kong1 jiu4 xiang4 da4 zi4 ran2
sentences.english: Grandpa said, "Look, there are trees, flowers, grass and sky here. It's just like the wild."

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷和几个老人坐在树下，开始说话。
sentences.pinyin: ye2 ye5 he2 ji3 ge4 lao3 ren2 zuo4 zai4 shu4 xia4 kai1 shi3 shuo1 hua4
sentences.english: Grandpa and a few old men sat under the tree and began to talk.

sentences.hanzi: 他们说了很久，从吃的说到孩子，又从孩子说到以前的北京。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 shuo1 le5 hen3 jiu3 cong2 chi1 de5 shuo1 dao4 hai2 zi5 you4 cong2 hai2 zi5 shuo1 dao4 yi3 qian2 de5 bei3 jing1
sentences.english: They talked for a long time, from food to children, and from children to the Beijing of the old days.

sentences.hanzi: 小东发现，爷爷一次也没有看他的鸟。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 dong1 fa1 xian4 ye2 ye5 yi1 ci4 ye3 mei2 you3 kan4 ta1 de5 niao3
sentences.english: Xiaodong noticed that Grandpa didn't look at his bird even once.

sentences.hanzi: 回家的时候，小东问：“爷爷，你说鸟一直不出去，会不高兴。”
sentences.pinyin: hui2 jia1 de5 shi2 hou5 xiao3 dong1 wen4 ye2 ye5 ni3 shuo1 niao3 yi1 zhi2 bu4 chu1 qu4 hui4 bu4 gao1 xing4
sentences.english: On the way home, Xiaodong asked, "Grandpa, you said a bird gets unhappy if it never goes out."

sentences.hanzi: “对啊。”
sentences.pinyin: dui4 a5
sentences.english: "That's right."

sentences.hanzi: “那人呢？”
sentences.pinyin: na4 ren2 ne5
sentences.english: "What about people?"

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷看了看小东，又看了看他的鸟，什么也没说。
sentences.pinyin: ye2 ye5 kan4 le5 kan4 xiao3 dong1 you4 kan4 le5 kan4 ta1 de5 niao3 shen2 me5 ye3 mei2 shuo1
sentences.english: Grandpa looked at Xiaodong, then at his bird, and said nothing.

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，太阳一出来，爷爷又拿着鸟笼出去了。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 tai4 yang5 yi1 chu1 lai2 ye2 ye5 you4 na2 zhe5 niao3 long2 chu1 qu4 le5
sentences.english: The next day, as soon as the sun was up, Grandpa went out with the birdcage again.

sentences.hanzi: 走到门前，他回过头说：“小东，你也一起来吧。”
sentences.pinyin: zou3 dao4 men2 qian2 ta1 hui2 guo4 tou2 shuo1 xiao3 dong1 ni3 ye3 yi1 qi3 lai2 ba5
sentences.english: At the door he turned around and said, "Xiaodong, you come along too."

title: 老马认识路
titleEnglish: The Old Horses Know the Way

sentences.hanzi: 两千六百多年前，齐国的齐桓公带着很多人向北走，去打孤竹。
sentences.pinyin: liang3 qian1 liu4 bai3 duo1 nian2 qian2 qi2 guo2 de5 qi2 huan2 gong1 dai4 zhe5 hen3 duo1 ren2 xiang4 bei3 zou3 qu4 da3 gu1 zhu2
sentences.english: Over two thousand six hundred years ago, Duke Huan of Qi led a great many men north to fight Guzhu.

sentences.hanzi: 他们是春天去的，回来的时候，已经是冬天了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 shi4 chun1 tian1 qu4 de5 hui2 lai5 de5 shi2 hou5 yi3 jing1 shi4 dong1 tian1 le5
sentences.english: They went in spring, and by the time they came back it was winter.

sentences.hanzi: 山很多，大家都不认识路了。
sentences.pinyin: shan1 hen3 duo1 da4 jia1 dou1 bu4 ren4 shi5 lu4 le5
sentences.english: There were mountains everywhere, and no one knew the way any more.

sentences.hanzi: 这时候，管仲说：“老马认识路。”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 hou5 guan3 zhong4 shuo1 lao3 ma3 ren4 shi5 lu4
sentences.english: Then Guan Zhong said, "Old horses know the way."

sentences.hanzi: 他让人把老马放出去。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 rang4 ren2 ba3 lao3 ma3 fang4 chu1 qu4
sentences.english: He had the old horses let loose.

sentences.hanzi: 马在前面走，大家就跟马走。
sentences.pinyin: ma3 zai4 qian2 mian4 zou3 da4 jia1 jiu4 gen1 ma3 zou3
sentences.english: The horses walked in front, and everyone followed them.

sentences.hanzi: 走了很久，他们真找到了路。
sentences.pinyin: zou3 le5 hen3 jiu3 ta1 men5 zhen1 zhao3 dao4 le5 lu4
sentences.english: After walking a long time, they really did find the road.

sentences.hanzi: 可是，又有了新的问题：没有水了。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 you4 you3 le5 xin1 de5 wen4 ti2 mei2 you3 shui3 le5
sentences.english: But then there was a new problem: they had run out of water.

sentences.hanzi: 山上没有河，也没有湖。
sentences.pinyin: shan1 shang4 mei2 you3 he2 ye3 mei2 you3 hu2
sentences.english: There was no river and no lake on the mountain.

sentences.hanzi: 这时候，隰朋说：“冬天，蚂蚁住在山上有太阳的地方。”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 hou5 xi2 peng2 shuo1 dong1 tian1 ma3 yi3 zhu4 zai4 shan1 shang4 you3 tai4 yang5 de5 di4 fang5
sentences.english: Then Xi Peng said, "In winter, ants live on the sunny side of the mountain."

sentences.hanzi: “找到蚂蚁的家，在那里挖，就有水。”
sentences.pinyin: zhao3 dao4 ma3 yi3 de5 jia1 zai4 na4 li5 wa1 jiu4 you3 shui3
sentences.english: "Find the ants' home, dig there, and there will be water."

sentences.hanzi: 大家找到了蚂蚁的家，在那里挖，真挖出了水。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 zhao3 dao4 le5 ma3 yi3 de5 jia1 zai4 na4 li5 wa1 zhen1 wa1 chu1 le5 shui3
sentences.english: They found the ants' home, dug there, and really did find water.

sentences.hanzi: 那一次，帮了他们的，是两种动物：老马和小虫子。
sentences.pinyin: na4 yi1 ci4 bang1 le5 ta1 men5 de5 shi4 liang3 zhong3 dong4 wu4 lao3 ma3 he2 xiao3 chong2 zi5
sentences.english: That time, the ones who helped them were two kinds of animals: old horses and little insects.

sentences.hanzi: 很多年以后，有人把这件事写了下来。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 nian2 yi3 hou4 you3 ren2 ba3 zhe4 jian4 shi4 xie3 le5 xia4 lai5
sentences.english: Many years later, someone wrote this story down.

sentences.hanzi: 他说：管仲和隰朋知道很多事。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 guan3 zhong4 he2 xi2 peng2 zhi1 dao4 hen3 duo1 shi4
sentences.english: He said: Guan Zhong and Xi Peng knew a great many things.

sentences.hanzi: 可是在大自然里，有不知道的事，他们就去问老马，问虫子。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zai4 da4 zi4 ran2 li3 you3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 de5 shi4 ta1 men5 jiu4 qu4 wen4 lao3 ma3 wen4 chong2 zi5
sentences.english: But out in nature, when there was something they didn't know, they asked old horses and insects.

sentences.hanzi: 今天的人呢？
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 de5 ren2 ne5
sentences.english: And people today?

sentences.hanzi: 我们不知道的时候，愿意问谁？
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 bu4 zhi1 dao4 de5 shi2 hou5 yuan4 yi4 wen4 shei2
sentences.english: When we don't know something, who are we willing to ask?

glossed.meaning: Guzhu, a small state in the north

sentences.hanzi: 小月十岁了，她一直住在月亮上。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 yue4 shi2 sui4 le5 ta1 yi1 zhi2 zhu4 zai4 yue4 liang5 shang4
sentences.english: Xiaoyue was ten, and she had always lived on the Moon.

sentences.hanzi: 月亮上没有风，也没有动物。
sentences.pinyin: yue4 liang5 shang4 mei2 you3 feng1 ye3 mei2 you3 dong4 wu4
sentences.english: On the Moon there was no wind, and there were no animals.

sentences.hanzi: 大家都住在一个大大的家，头上总是有东西。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 zhu4 zai4 yi1 ge5 da4 da4 de5 jia1 tou2 shang4 zong3 shi4 you3 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: Everyone lived in one big, big home, and there was always something over their heads.

sentences.hanzi: 每天晚上，小月都看天空里的地球。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 tian1 wan3 shang5 xiao3 yue4 dou1 kan4 tian1 kong1 li3 de5 di4 qiu2
sentences.english: Every night, Xiaoyue looked at the Earth in the sky.

sentences.hanzi: 从月亮上看，地球一直在那个地方，不出来，也不下去。
sentences.pinyin: cong2 yue4 liang5 shang4 kan4 di4 qiu2 yi1 zhi2 zai4 na4 ge5 di4 fang5 bu4 chu1 lai2 ye3 bu4 xia4 qu4
sentences.english: Seen from the Moon, the Earth always stays in the same place. It never rises and never sets.

sentences.hanzi: 这一年，小月和妈妈第一次去地球。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 nian2 xiao3 yue4 he2 ma1 ma5 di4 yi1 ci4 qu4 di4 qiu2
sentences.english: That year, Xiaoyue and her mum went to Earth for the first time.

sentences.hanzi: 下了飞船，小月站在草原上，一动也不动。
sentences.pinyin: xia4 le5 fei1 chuan2 xiao3 yue4 zhan4 zai4 cao3 yuan2 shang4 yi1 dong4 ye3 bu4 dong4
sentences.english: Getting off the spaceship, Xiaoyue stood on the grassland and didn't move at all.

sentences.hanzi: 妈妈问：“怎么了？”
sentences.pinyin: ma1 ma5 wen4 zen3 me5 le5
sentences.english: Her mum asked, "What's wrong?"

sentences.hanzi: “妈妈，上面为什么什么都没有？”
sentences.pinyin: ma1 ma5 shang4 mian4 wei4 shen2 me5 shen2 me5 dou1 mei2 you3
sentences.english: "Mum, why is there nothing up above?"

sentences.hanzi: 地球的天空太大了，她有一点害怕。
sentences.pinyin: di4 qiu2 de5 tian1 kong1 tai4 da4 le5 ta1 you3 yi1 dian3 hai4 pa4
sentences.english: The sky on Earth was too big, and she was a little afraid.

sentences.hanzi: 这时候，风来了。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 hou5 feng1 lai2 le5
sentences.english: Just then, the wind came.

sentences.hanzi: 小月叫了起来：“谁在推我？”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 yue4 jiao4 le5 qi3 lai5 shei2 zai4 tui1 wo3
sentences.english: Xiaoyue cried out, "Who's pushing me?"

sentences.hanzi: “那是风。”
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi4 feng1
sentences.english: "That's the wind."

sentences.hanzi: 草在动，树在动，树上的叶子也在动。
sentences.pinyin: cao3 zai4 dong4 shu4 zai4 dong4 shu4 shang4 de5 ye4 zi5 ye3 zai4 dong4
sentences.english: The grass was moving, the trees were moving, and the leaves on the trees were moving too.

sentences.hanzi: “它们都是活的吗？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 dou1 shi4 huo2 de5 ma5
sentences.english: "Are they all alive?"

sentences.hanzi: “是的，都是活的。”
sentences.pinyin: shi4 de5 dou1 shi4 huo2 de5
sentences.english: "Yes, they're all alive."

sentences.hanzi: 一只蝴蝶来了，站在她的手上。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 zhi3 hu2 die2 lai2 le5 zhan4 zai4 ta1 de5 shou3 shang4
sentences.english: A butterfly came and landed on her hand.

sentences.hanzi: 小月不敢动，也不敢说话。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 yue4 bu4 gan3 dong4 ye3 bu4 gan3 shuo1 hua4
sentences.english: Xiaoyue didn't dare move, or speak.

sentences.hanzi: 晚上，妈妈和小月坐在湖旁边，看天上的月亮和星星。
sentences.pinyin: wan3 shang5 ma1 ma5 he2 xiao3 yue4 zuo4 zai4 hu2 pang2 bian1 kan4 tian1 shang4 de5 yue4 liang5 he2 xing1 xing5
sentences.english: That night, Mum and Xiaoyue sat by the lake, looking at the Moon and the stars in the sky.

sentences.hanzi: “妈妈，我们的家在那里！它怎么这么小？”
sentences.pinyin: ma1 ma5 wo3 men5 de5 jia1 zai4 na4 li5 ta1 zen3 me5 zhe4 me5 xiao3
sentences.english: "Mum, our home is up there! Why is it so small?"

sentences.hanzi: “在这里，月亮会出来，也会下去。”
sentences.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 li3 yue4 liang5 hui4 chu1 lai2 ye3 hui4 xia4 qu4
sentences.english: "Here, the Moon rises, and it sets too."

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，太阳出来了，小月又站在草原上。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 tai4 yang5 chu1 lai2 le5 xiao3 yue4 you4 zhan4 zai4 cao3 yuan2 shang4
sentences.english: The next day, the sun came up, and Xiaoyue stood on the grassland again.

sentences.hanzi: 这一次，她没有害怕。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 ci4 ta1 mei2 you3 hai4 pa4
sentences.english: This time she wasn't afraid.

sentences.hanzi: 她站在风里，让风推着她，在草上跑了起来。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zhan4 zai4 feng1 li3 rang4 feng1 tui1 zhe5 ta1 zai4 cao3 shang4 pao3 le5 qi3 lai5
sentences.english: She stood in the wind, let it push her, and began to run across the grass.

sentences.hanzi: 山姆刚来中国，他的中文还不太好。
sentences.pinyin: shan1 mu3 gang1 lai2 zhong1 guo2 ta1 de5 zhong1 wen2 hai2 bu4 tai4 hao3
sentences.english: Sam had just come to China, and his Chinese wasn't very good yet.

sentences.hanzi: 这一天，朋友们要来他家，他出去买水。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 tian1 peng2 you5 men5 yao4 lai2 ta1 jia1 ta1 chu1 qu4 mai3 shui3
sentences.english: That day some friends were coming to his place, so he went out to buy water.

sentences.hanzi: 他对一个老人说：“我要十瓶水。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 dui4 yi1 ge5 lao3 ren2 shuo1 wo3 yao4 shi2 ping2 shui3
sentences.english: He said to an old man: "I'd like ten bottles of water."

sentences.hanzi: 老人给了他四瓶。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ren2 gei3 le5 ta1 si4 ping2
sentences.english: The old man gave him four bottles.

sentences.hanzi: “不是四，是十！”
sentences.pinyin: bu4 shi4 si4 shi4 shi2
sentences.english: "Not four, ten!"

sentences.hanzi: 老人看着他，说：“四十瓶？”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ren2 kan4 zhe5 ta1 shuo1 si4 shi2 ping2
sentences.english: The old man looked at him and said: "Forty bottles?"

sentences.hanzi: “不不不！”
sentences.pinyin: bu4 bu4 bu4
sentences.english: "No, no, no!"

sentences.hanzi: 这时候，他记得朋友说过：在中国，用手就能说出一到十。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 hou5 ta1 ji4 de5 peng2 you5 shuo1 guo5 zai4 zhong1 guo2 yong4 shou3 jiu4 neng2 shuo1 chu1 yi1 dao4 shi2
sentences.english: Just then he remembered a friend saying: in China, you can show one to ten with your hands.

sentences.hanzi: 六，是这样：大拇指和小手指出来，其他的都不出来。
sentences.pinyin: liu4 shi4 zhe4 yang4 da4 mu3 zhi3 he2 xiao3 shou3 zhi3 chu1 lai2 qi2 ta1 de5 dou1 bu4 chu1 lai2
sentences.english: Six is like this: thumb and little finger out, the others in.

sentences.hanzi: 八，是这样：大拇指和旁边的手指出来。
sentences.pinyin: ba1 shi4 zhe4 yang4 da4 mu3 zhi3 he2 pang2 bian1 de5 shou3 zhi3 chu1 lai2
sentences.english: Eight is like this: thumb and the finger next to it out.

sentences.hanzi: 十呢？两个手指放成中文的“十”。
sentences.pinyin: shi2 ne5 liang3 ge4 shou3 zhi3 fang4 cheng2 zhong1 wen2 de5 shi2
sentences.english: And ten? Lay two fingers across each other to make the character for ten.

sentences.hanzi: 山姆用两个手指做了一个“十”。
sentences.pinyin: shan1 mu3 yong4 liang3 ge4 shou3 zhi3 zuo4 le5 yi1 ge5 shi2
sentences.english: Sam made a "ten" with two fingers.

sentences.hanzi: 老人看了看，说：“哦，十瓶！”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ren2 kan4 le5 kan4 shuo1 o4 shi2 ping2
sentences.english: The old man looked and said: "Oh, ten bottles!"

sentences.hanzi: 他给了山姆十瓶水，然后用手做了一个“十”，又做了一个“八”。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 gei3 le5 shan1 mu3 shi2 ping2 shui3 ran2 hou4 yong4 shou3 zuo4 le5 yi1 ge5 shi2 you4 zuo4 le5 yi1 ge5 ba1
sentences.english: He gave Sam ten bottles of water, then made a "ten" with his hands, and then an "eight".

sentences.hanzi: 山姆明白了：十八块。
sentences.pinyin: shan1 mu3 ming2 bai5 le5 shi2 ba1 kuai4
sentences.english: Sam understood: eighteen kuai.

sentences.hanzi: 他给了老人十八块，对自己说：“我的手，比我的中文好用。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 gei3 le5 lao3 ren2 shi2 ba1 kuai4 dui4 zi4 ji3 shuo1 wo3 de5 shou3 bi3 wo3 de5 zhong1 wen2 hao3 yong4
sentences.english: He gave the old man eighteen kuai and said to himself: "My hands work better than my Chinese."

sentences.hanzi: 小月的爷爷七十多岁了。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 yue4 de5 ye2 ye5 qi1 shi2 duo1 sui4 le5
sentences.english: Xiaoyue's grandfather was over seventy.

sentences.hanzi: 他总是说：“半斤八两。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zong3 shi4 shuo1 ban4 jin1 ba1 liang3
sentences.english: He was always saying: "Half a jin, eight liang."

sentences.hanzi: 小月听了很多次，有一天，她问：“爷爷，半斤怎么是八两？”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 yue4 ting1 le5 hen3 duo1 ci4 you3 yi1 tian1 ta1 wen4 ye2 ye5 ban4 jin1 zen3 me5 shi4 ba1 liang3
sentences.english: Xiaoyue had heard it many times. One day she asked: "Grandpa, how can half a jin be eight liang?"

sentences.hanzi: “一斤是十两，半斤是五两，不是八两！”
sentences.pinyin: yi1 jin1 shi4 shi2 liang3 ban4 jin1 shi4 wu3 liang3 bu4 shi4 ba1 liang3
sentences.english: "One jin is ten liang, so half a jin is five liang, not eight!"

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷说：“现在一斤是十两。可是以前，一斤有十六两。”
sentences.pinyin: ye2 ye5 shuo1 xian4 zai4 yi1 jin1 shi4 shi2 liang3 ke3 shi4 yi3 qian2 yi1 jin1 you3 shi2 liu4 liang3
sentences.english: Grandpa said: "Now a jin is ten liang. But in the old days, a jin had sixteen liang."

sentences.hanzi: “十六两的一半，是多少？”
sentences.pinyin: shi2 liu4 liang3 de5 yi1 ban4 shi4 duo1 shao5
sentences.english: "What's half of sixteen liang?"

sentences.hanzi: 小月算了一下：“八两。”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 yue4 suan4 le5 yi1 xia4 ba1 liang3
sentences.english: Xiaoyue worked it out: "Eight liang."

sentences.hanzi: “对了。所以半斤，就是八两。”
sentences.pinyin: dui4 le5 suo3 yi3 ban4 jin1 jiu4 shi4 ba1 liang3
sentences.english: "That's right. So half a jin is eight liang."

sentences.hanzi: “半斤和八两，重量一样，只是说法不一样。”
sentences.pinyin: ban4 jin1 he2 ba1 liang3 zhong4 liang4 yi1 yang4 zhi3 shi4 shuo1 fa3 bu4 yi1 yang4
sentences.english: "Half a jin and eight liang weigh the same. They're just said differently."

sentences.hanzi: “所以，两个人一样好，或者一样坏，我们就说：半斤八两。”
sentences.pinyin: suo3 yi3 liang3 ge4 ren2 yi1 yang4 hao3 huo4 zhe3 yi1 yang4 huai4 wo3 men5 jiu4 shuo1 ban4 jin1 ba1 liang3
sentences.english: "So when two people are just as good as each other, or just as bad, we say: half a jin, eight liang."

sentences.hanzi: 小月明白了。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 yue4 ming2 bai5 le5
sentences.english: Xiaoyue understood.

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，小月和弟弟谁也不让谁。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 xiao3 yue4 he2 di4 di5 shei2 ye3 bu4 rang4 shei2
sentences.english: The next day Xiaoyue and her little brother were squabbling.

sentences.hanzi: 小月说：“我比你会算！”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 yue4 shuo1 wo3 bi3 ni3 hui4 suan4
sentences.english: Xiaoyue said: "I'm better at sums than you!"

sentences.hanzi: 弟弟说：“不是，我比你会算！”
sentences.pinyin: di4 di5 shuo1 bu4 shi4 wo3 bi3 ni3 hui4 suan4
sentences.english: Her brother said: "No, I'm better at sums than you!"

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷在旁边看了看，说：“你们两个啊，半斤八两。”
sentences.pinyin: ye2 ye5 zai4 pang2 bian1 kan4 le5 kan4 shuo1 ni3 men5 liang3 ge4 a5 ban4 jin1 ba1 liang3
sentences.english: Grandpa looked on and said: "You two? Half a jin, eight liang."

title: 五楼就是四楼
titlePinyin: wu3 lou2 jiu4 shi4 si4 lou2
titleEnglish: The Fifth Floor Is the Fourth Floor

sentences.hanzi: 在中国，很多人喜欢八，不喜欢四。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 zhong1 guo2 hen3 duo1 ren2 xi3 huan5 ba1 bu4 xi3 huan5 si4
sentences.english: In China, many people like eight and dislike four.

sentences.hanzi: 为什么？因为说“八”，很像在说“发”；说“四”，很像在说“死”。
sentences.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 yin1 wei4 shuo1 ba1 hen3 xiang4 zai4 shuo1 fa1 shuo1 si4 hen3 xiang4 zai4 shuo1 si3
sentences.english: Why? Because "eight" sounds like "prosper", and "four" sounds like "die".

sentences.hanzi: 二零零八年，北京奥运会是八月八号晚上八点零八分开始的。
sentences.pinyin: er4 ling2 ling2 ba1 nian2 bei3 jing1 ao4 yun4 hui4 shi4 ba1 yue4 ba1 hao4 wan3 shang5 ba1 dian3 ling2 ba1 fen1 kai1 shi3 de5
sentences.english: In 2008, the Beijing Olympics began at eight minutes past eight on the evening of the eighth of August.

sentences.hanzi: 很多人买电话号码，也想要很多八。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 ren2 mai3 dian4 hua4 hao4 ma3 ye3 xiang3 yao4 hen3 duo1 ba1
sentences.english: When people buy phone numbers, many also want lots of eights.

sentences.hanzi: 有很多八的号码，价格比别的号码高很多。
sentences.pinyin: you3 hen3 duo1 ba1 de5 hao4 ma3 jia4 ge2 bi3 bie2 de5 hao4 ma3 gao1 hen3 duo1
sentences.english: Numbers with lots of eights cost a lot more than other numbers.

sentences.hanzi: 小高刚到北京工作，在找住的地方。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 gao1 gang1 dao4 bei3 jing1 gong1 zuo4 zai4 zhao3 zhu4 de5 di4 fang5
sentences.english: Xiao Gao had just started work in Beijing and was looking for somewhere to live.

sentences.hanzi: 他看了很多地方。最后，他找到了一个很好的地方，在五楼。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 le5 hen3 duo1 di4 fang5 zui4 hou4 ta1 zhao3 dao4 le5 yi1 ge5 hen3 hao3 de5 di4 fang5 zai4 wu3 lou2
sentences.english: He looked at a lot of places. In the end he found a very good one, on the fifth floor.

sentences.hanzi: 价格也不高，他马上就住了进去。
sentences.pinyin: jia4 ge2 ye3 bu4 gao1 ta1 ma3 shang4 jiu4 zhu4 le5 jin4 qu4
sentences.english: The price wasn't high either, and he moved in straight away.

sentences.hanzi: 第一天回家，他看到：一楼，二楼，三楼，五楼。
sentences.pinyin: di4 yi1 tian1 hui2 jia1 ta1 kan4 dao4 yi1 lou2 er4 lou2 san1 lou2 wu3 lou2
sentences.english: The first day he came home, he saw: first floor, second floor, third floor, fifth floor.

sentences.hanzi: 他又看了一次。还是一，二，三，五。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 you4 kan4 le5 yi1 ci4 hai2 shi5 yi1 er4 san1 wu3
sentences.english: He looked again. Still one, two, three, five.

sentences.hanzi: 没有四楼。
sentences.pinyin: mei2 you3 si4 lou2
sentences.english: There was no fourth floor.

sentences.hanzi: 他问对面的人：“四楼在哪儿？”

sentences.hanzi: “是地球太重了。”
sentences.pinyin: shi4 di4 qiu2 tai4 zhong4 le5
