sentences.english: Xiao Liu listened to the end and went off.

sentences.hanzi: 十个菜来了，一个也没有错。
sentences.pinyin: shi2 ge4 cai4 lai2 le5 yi1 ge5 ye3 mei2 you3 cuo4
sentences.english: The ten dishes came, and not one was wrong.

sentences.hanzi: 客人说：“好！明天我还来，还要一样的。”
sentences.pinyin: ke4 ren2 shuo1 hao3 ming2 tian1 wo3 hai2 lai2 hai2 yao4 yi1 yang4 de5
sentences.english: The customer said: "Bravo! I'll come back tomorrow and have the same."

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，客人来了，只说了一句：“跟昨天一样。”
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 ke4 ren2 lai2 le5 zhi3 shuo1 le5 yi1 ju4 gen1 zuo2 tian1 yi1 yang4
sentences.english: The next day the customer came and said just one thing: "Same as yesterday."

sentences.hanzi: 小六说：“好的。昨天第三个菜，您说汤不要太多，今天也一样吗？”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 liu4 shuo1 hao3 de5 zuo2 tian1 di4 san1 ge4 cai4 nin2 shuo1 tang1 bu4 yao4 tai4 duo1 jin1 tian1 ye3 yi1 yang4 ma5
sentences.english: Xiao Liu said: "Very good. Yesterday you asked for not too much soup in the third dish. Same again today?"

sentences.hanzi: 二一零零年，餐厅里做菜的都是机器人。
sentences.pinyin: er4 yi1 ling2 ling2 nian2 can1 ting1 li3 zuo4 cai4 de5 dou1 shi4 ji1 qi4 ren2
sentences.english: In 2100, all the cooking in restaurants was done by robots.

sentences.hanzi: 你想吃什么，说一句话，机器人就能做出来。
sentences.pinyin: ni3 xiang3 chi1 shen2 me5 shuo1 yi1 ju4 hua4 ji1 qi4 ren2 jiu4 neng2 zuo4 chu1 lai2
sentences.english: Whatever you wanted to eat, you said one sentence and the robot could make it.

sentences.hanzi: 什么味道都可以。
sentences.pinyin: shen2 me5 wei4 dao5 dou1 ke3 yi3
sentences.english: Any flavour at all.

sentences.hanzi: 老周七十岁了。他走进一家餐厅，坐了下来。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 zhou1 qi1 shi2 sui4 le5 ta1 zou3 jin4 yi1 jia1 can1 ting1 zuo4 le5 xia4 lai5
sentences.english: Old Zhou was seventy. He walked into a restaurant and sat down.

sentences.hanzi: 他对机器人说：“我要一碗豆腐汤，要和我妈妈做的一样。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 dui4 ji1 qi4 ren2 shuo1 wo3 yao4 yi1 wan3 dou4 fu5 tang1 yao4 he2 wo3 ma1 ma5 zuo4 de5 yi1 yang4
sentences.english: He said to the robot: "I'd like a bowl of tofu soup, just like my mum used to make."

sentences.hanzi: 机器人问：“您妈妈的汤，是什么味道？”
sentences.pinyin: ji1 qi4 ren2 wen4 nin2 ma1 ma5 de5 tang1 shi4 shen2 me5 wei4 dao5
sentences.english: The robot asked: "What did your mother's soup taste like?"

sentences.hanzi: 老周想了很久：“有一点咸，有一点酸，很香。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 zhou1 xiang3 le5 hen3 jiu3 you3 yi1 dian3 xian2 you3 yi1 dian3 suan1 hen3 xiang1
sentences.english: Old Zhou thought for a long time: "A bit salty, a bit sour, and very fragrant."

sentences.hanzi: 机器人做了一碗。老周尝了尝，说：“不是这个味道。”
sentences.pinyin: ji1 qi4 ren2 zuo4 le5 yi1 wan3 lao3 zhou1 chang2 le5 chang2 shuo1 bu4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 wei4 dao5
sentences.english: The robot made a bowl. Old Zhou tasted it and said: "That's not the taste."

sentences.hanzi: 机器人又做了一碗，又一碗，做了十碗。
sentences.pinyin: ji1 qi4 ren2 you4 zuo4 le5 yi1 wan3 you4 yi1 wan3 zuo4 le5 shi2 wan3
sentences.english: The robot made another bowl, and another, ten bowls in all.

sentences.hanzi: 每一碗都很好吃，可是都不是那个味道。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 yi1 wan3 dou1 hen3 hao3 chi1 ke3 shi4 dou1 bu4 shi4 na4 ge5 wei4 dao5
sentences.english: Every bowl was delicious, but none had that taste.

sentences.hanzi: 机器人问：“您妈妈做汤的时候，您在做什么？”
sentences.pinyin: ji1 qi4 ren2 wen4 nin2 ma1 ma5 zuo4 tang1 de5 shi2 hou5 nin2 zai4 zuo4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: The robot asked: "When your mother was making soup, what were you doing?"

sentences.hanzi: 老周说：“我坐在旁边等，很饿。我一直问：好了吗？好了吗？”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 zhou1 shuo1 wo3 zuo4 zai4 pang2 bian1 deng3 hen3 e4 wo3 yi1 zhi2 wen4 hao3 le5 ma5 hao3 le5 ma5
sentences.english: Old Zhou said: "I sat beside her and waited. I was so hungry. I kept asking: is it ready? Is it ready?"

sentences.hanzi: 机器人说：“好的。请您等两个小时。”
sentences.pinyin: ji1 qi4 ren2 shuo1 hao3 de5 qing3 nin2 deng3 liang3 ge4 xiao3 shi2
sentences.english: The robot said: "Very well. Please wait two hours."

sentences.hanzi: 老周等了两个小时，饿得不得了。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 zhou1 deng3 le5 liang3 ge4 xiao3 shi2 e4 de5 bu4 de2 liao3
sentences.english: Old Zhou waited two hours and got terribly hungry.

sentences.hanzi: 最后，汤来了。他尝了尝。
sentences.pinyin: zui4 hou4 tang1 lai2 le5 ta1 chang2 le5 chang2
sentences.english: At last the soup came. He tasted it.

sentences.hanzi: “就是这个！这就是妈妈的味道！”
sentences.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 zhe4 jiu4 shi4 ma1 ma5 de5 wei4 dao5
sentences.english: "This is it! This is the taste of Mum's cooking!"

sentences.hanzi: 机器人说：“这碗汤，和第一碗一样。”
sentences.pinyin: ji1 qi4 ren2 shuo1 zhe4 wan3 tang1 he2 di4 yi1 wan3 yi1 yang4
sentences.english: The robot said: "This bowl of soup is the same as the first one."

sentences.hanzi: “不一样的，是您。”
sentences.pinyin: bu4 yi1 yang4 de5 shi4 nin2
sentences.english: "What's different is you."

title: 用手说谢谢
titleEnglish: Saying Thank You with Your Hand

sentences.hanzi: 我第一次去广州，朋友阿明请我去饭店喝茶。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 di4 yi1 ci4 qu4 guang3 zhou1 peng2 you5 a1 ming2 qing3 wo3 qu4 fan4 dian4 he1 cha2
sentences.english: The first time I went to Guangzhou, my friend Ah Ming took me to a restaurant for tea.

sentences.hanzi: 饭店里人很多，大家喝着茶，说着话。
sentences.pinyin: fan4 dian4 li3 ren2 hen3 duo1 da4 jia1 he1 zhe5 cha2 shuo1 zhe5 hua4
sentences.english: The restaurant was full. Everyone was drinking tea and chatting.

sentences.hanzi: 阿明点了包子和饺子，茶也很香。
sentences.pinyin: a1 ming2 dian3 le5 bao1 zi5 he2 jiao3 zi5 cha2 ye3 hen3 xiang1
sentences.english: Ah Ming ordered buns and dumplings, and the tea smelled lovely.

sentences.hanzi: 服务员来给我们倒茶。
sentences.pinyin: fu2 wu4 yuan2 lai2 gei3 wo3 men5 dao4 cha2
sentences.english: The waiter came to pour our tea.

sentences.hanzi: 每一次服务员倒茶，阿明都用手在桌子上点两下。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 yi1 ci4 fu2 wu4 yuan2 dao4 cha2 a1 ming2 dou1 yong4 shou3 zai4 zhuo1 zi5 shang4 dian3 liang3 xia4
sentences.english: Every time the waiter poured tea, Ah Ming tapped the table twice with his fingers.

sentences.hanzi: 他一句话也不说。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yi1 ju4 hua4 ye3 bu4 shuo1
sentences.english: He didn't say a word.

sentences.hanzi: 我问他：“你这是在做什么？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wen4 ta1 ni3 zhe4 shi4 zai4 zuo4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: I asked him: "What are you doing?"

sentences.hanzi: 阿明说：“这是在说谢谢。”
sentences.pinyin: a1 ming2 shuo1 zhe4 shi4 zai4 shuo1 xie4 xie5
sentences.english: Ah Ming said: "I'm saying thank you."

sentences.hanzi: “为什么不说出来？”
sentences.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 bu4 shuo1 chu1 lai2
sentences.english: "Why not say it out loud?"

sentences.hanzi: 阿明说：“你听我说。”
sentences.pinyin: a1 ming2 shuo1 ni3 ting1 wo3 shuo1
sentences.english: Ah Ming said: "Let me tell you."

sentences.hanzi: 听说，很多年以前，乾隆皇帝出来旅游。
sentences.pinyin: ting1 shuo1 hen3 duo1 nian2 yi3 qian2 qian2 long2 huang2 di4 chu1 lai2 lu:3 you2
sentences.english: They say that long ago, the Qianlong Emperor went out travelling.

sentences.hanzi: 他不想让别人知道他是皇帝。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 bu4 xiang3 rang4 bie2 ren5 zhi1 dao4 ta1 shi4 huang2 di4
sentences.english: He didn't want anyone to know he was the emperor.

sentences.hanzi: 有一天，他带着一个人，走进了一家饭店。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 ta1 dai4 zhe5 yi1 ge5 ren2 zou3 jin4 le5 yi1 jia1 fan4 dian4
sentences.english: One day he walked into a restaurant with one of his men.

sentences.hanzi: 皇帝自己拿起茶，给这个人倒了一杯。
sentences.pinyin: huang2 di4 zi4 ji3 na2 qi3 cha2 gei3 zhe4 ge5 ren2 dao4 le5 yi1 bei1
sentences.english: The emperor picked up the tea himself and poured the man a cup.

sentences.hanzi: 这个人很害怕：皇帝给你倒茶，你要跪下！
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ren2 hen3 hai4 pa4 huang2 di4 gei3 ni3 dao4 cha2 ni3 yao4 gui4 xia4
sentences.english: The man was terrified: when the emperor pours you tea, you must kneel!

sentences.hanzi: 可是他不能跪下，跪下了，大家就知道这是皇帝了。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ta1 bu4 neng2 gui4 xia4 gui4 xia4 le5 da4 jia1 jiu4 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 shi4 huang2 di4 le5
sentences.english: But he couldn't kneel. If he knelt, everyone would know this was the emperor.

sentences.hanzi: 他想了一个办法：用手在桌子上点了点，就像跪下一样。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 le5 yi1 ge5 ban4 fa3 yong4 shou3 zai4 zhuo1 zi5 shang4 dian3 le5 dian3 jiu4 xiang4 gui4 xia4 yi1 yang4
sentences.english: He thought of a way: he tapped the table with his fingers, as if he were kneeling.

sentences.hanzi: 从那以后，人们就用这个办法说谢谢。
sentences.pinyin: cong2 na4 yi3 hou4 ren2 men5 jiu4 yong4 zhe4 ge5 ban4 fa3 shuo1 xie4 xie5
sentences.english: Ever since, people have said thank you this way.

sentences.hanzi: 我问：“真是这样吗？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wen4 zhen1 shi5 zhe4 yang4 ma5
sentences.english: I asked: "Is that really how it happened?"

sentences.hanzi: 阿明说：“谁知道呢？”
sentences.pinyin: a1 ming2 shuo1 shei2 zhi1 dao4 ne5
sentences.english: Ah Ming said: "Who knows?"

sentences.hanzi: 这时，服务员又来倒茶了。我也用手在桌子上点了两下。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 fu2 wu4 yuan2 you4 lai2 dao4 cha2 le5 wo3 ye3 yong4 shou3 zai4 zhuo1 zi5 shang4 dian3 le5 liang3 xia4
sentences.english: Just then the waiter came to pour tea again. I tapped the table twice too.

sentences.hanzi: 服务员说：“不客气。”
sentences.pinyin: fu2 wu4 yuan2 shuo1 bu4 ke4 qi5
sentences.english: The waiter said: "You're welcome."

glossed.meaning: Guangzhou, a city in southern China

sentences.hanzi: 老周每天早上五点起床。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 zhou1 mei3 tian1 zao3 shang5 wu3 dian3 qi3 chuang2
sentences.english: Old Zhou gets up at five every morning.

sentences.hanzi: 他先洗脸，刷牙，然后出门散步。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xian1 xi3 lian3 shua1 ya2 ran2 hou4 chu1 men2 san4 bu4
sentences.english: First he washes his face and brushes his teeth, then he goes out for a walk.

sentences.hanzi: 他每天都走一个小时，再回家吃早饭。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 mei3 tian1 dou1 zou3 yi1 ge5 xiao3 shi2 zai4 hui2 jia1 chi1 zao3 fan4
sentences.english: Every day he walks for an hour, then goes home for breakfast.

sentences.hanzi: 他每天都会走过一家面包店。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 mei3 tian1 dou1 hui4 zou3 guo4 yi1 jia1 mian4 bao1 dian4
sentences.english: Every day he walks past a bakery.

sentences.hanzi: 老周走过面包店的时候，总是六点。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 zhou1 zou3 guo4 mian4 bao1 dian4 de5 shi2 hou5 zong3 shi4 liu4 dian3
sentences.english: When Old Zhou walks past the bakery, it's always six o'clock.

sentences.hanzi: 面包店的小李一看见他，就开始做面包。
sentences.pinyin: mian4 bao1 dian4 de5 xiao3 li3 yi1 kan4 jian4 ta1 jiu4 kai1 shi3 zuo4 mian4 bao1
sentences.english: As soon as Xiao Li at the bakery sees him, she starts making bread.

sentences.hanzi: 二十年了，每天都是这样。
sentences.pinyin: er4 shi2 nian2 le5 mei3 tian1 dou1 shi4 zhe4 yang4
sentences.english: For twenty years, it had been like this every day.

sentences.hanzi: 有一天早上，六点过去了，老周没有来。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 zao3 shang5 liu4 dian3 guo4 qu4 le5 lao3 zhou1 mei2 you3 lai2
sentences.english: One morning, six o'clock came and went, and Old Zhou didn't come.

sentences.hanzi: 七点，他还是没有来。
sentences.pinyin: qi1 dian3 ta1 hai2 shi5 mei2 you3 lai2
sentences.english: At seven, he still hadn't come.

sentences.hanzi: 小李很担心，就去老周家找他。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 li3 hen3 dan1 xin1 jiu4 qu4 lao3 zhou1 jia1 zhao3 ta1
sentences.english: Xiao Li got worried and went to Old Zhou's home to look for him.

sentences.hanzi: 老周开了门。他刚醒，还没有洗脸。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 zhou1 kai1 le5 men2 ta1 gang1 xing3 hai2 mei2 you3 xi3 lian3
sentences.english: Old Zhou opened the door. He had only just woken up and hadn't even washed his face.

sentences.hanzi: “你还好吗？你从来不迟到的！”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 hai2 hao3 ma5 ni3 cong2 lai2 bu4 chi2 dao4 de5
sentences.english: "Are you all right? You're never late!"

sentences.hanzi: 老周说：“我很好。我没有闹钟。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 zhou1 shuo1 wo3 hen3 hao3 wo3 mei2 you3 nao4 zhong1
sentences.english: Old Zhou said: "I'm fine. I don't have an alarm clock."

sentences.hanzi: “每天早上，你的面包一香，我就醒了。”
sentences.pinyin: mei3 tian1 zao3 shang5 ni3 de5 mian4 bao1 yi1 xiang1 wo3 jiu4 xing3 le5
sentences.english: "Every morning, as soon as your bread smells good, I wake up."

sentences.hanzi: “可是今天早上，面包不香。”
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 jin1 tian1 zao3 shang5 mian4 bao1 bu4 xiang1
sentences.english: "But this morning, the bread didn't smell."

sentences.hanzi: 小李看着他，很久没有说话。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 li3 kan4 zhe5 ta1 hen3 jiu3 mei2 you3 shuo1 hua4
sentences.english: Xiao Li looked at him and said nothing for a long time.

sentences.hanzi: “可是……我每天都是看见你，才开始做面包的。”
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 wo3 mei3 tian1 dou1 shi4 kan4 jian4 ni3 cai2 kai1 shi3 zuo4 mian4 bao1 de5
sentences.english: "But... every day, I only start making bread after I see you."

sentences.hanzi: 两个人你看我，我看你。
sentences.pinyin: liang3 ge4 ren2 ni3 kan4 wo3 wo3 kan4 ni3
sentences.english: The two of them just stared at each other.

sentences.hanzi: 那么，二十年来，是谁先醒的？
sentences.pinyin: na4 me5 er4 shi2 nian2 lai2 shi4 shei2 xian1 xing3 de5
sentences.english: So, for twenty years, who had been waking up first?

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，老周买了一个闹钟。小李也买了一个。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 lao3 zhou1 mai3 le5 yi1 ge5 nao4 zhong1 xiao3 li3 ye3 mai3 le5 yi1 ge5
sentences.english: The next day, Old Zhou bought an alarm clock. So did Xiao Li.

sentences.hanzi: 安娜第一次来中国，住在一个公园旁边。
sentences.pinyin: an1 na4 di4 yi1 ci4 lai2 zhong1 guo2 zhu4 zai4 yi1 ge5 gong1 yuan2 pang2 bian1
sentences.english: Anna had come to China for the first time and was staying next to a park.

sentences.hanzi: 她还不习惯这里的时间，每天早上五点就醒了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 hai2 bu4 xi2 guan4 zhe4 li3 de5 shi2 jian1 mei3 tian1 zao3 shang5 wu3 dian3 jiu4 xing3 le5
sentences.english: She still wasn't used to the time here, and woke at five every morning.

sentences.hanzi: 有一天，她出门去公园散步。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 ta1 chu1 men2 qu4 gong1 yuan2 san4 bu4
sentences.english: One day she went out for a walk in the park.

sentences.hanzi: 公园里已经有很多人了，大多是老人。
sentences.pinyin: gong1 yuan2 li3 yi3 jing1 you3 hen3 duo1 ren2 le5 da4 duo1 shi4 lao3 ren2
sentences.english: There were already lots of people in the park, mostly old people.

sentences.hanzi: 有人在打太极拳，有人在锻炼，有人在散步。
sentences.pinyin: you3 ren2 zai4 da3 tai4 ji2 quan2 you3 ren2 zai4 duan4 lian4 you3 ren2 zai4 san4 bu4
sentences.english: Some were doing tai chi, some were exercising, some were walking.

sentences.hanzi: 还有一个老人，在倒着走。
sentences.pinyin: hai2 you3 yi1 ge5 lao3 ren2 zai4 dao4 zhe5 zou3
sentences.english: And there was one old man walking backwards.

sentences.hanzi: 他走得不快，可是一次也不向后看。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zou3 de5 bu4 kuai4 ke3 shi4 yi1 ci4 ye3 bu4 xiang4 hou4 kan4
sentences.english: He didn't walk fast, but he never once looked behind him.

sentences.hanzi: 安娜很担心：这样走，安全吗？
sentences.pinyin: an1 na4 hen3 dan1 xin1 zhe4 yang4 zou3 an1 quan2 ma5
sentences.english: Anna was worried: was it safe to walk like that?

sentences.hanzi: 走着走着，她发现，倒着走的不只一个人。
sentences.pinyin: zou3 zhe5 zou3 zhe5 ta1 fa1 xian4 dao4 zhe5 zou3 de5 bu4 zhi3 yi1 ge5 ren2
sentences.english: As she walked on, she found that he wasn't the only one walking backwards.

sentences.hanzi: 安娜问一个奶奶，为什么要倒着走。
sentences.pinyin: an1 na4 wen4 yi1 ge5 nai3 nai5 wei4 shen2 me5 yao4 dao4 zhe5 zou3
sentences.english: Anna asked a grandma why she walked backwards.

sentences.hanzi: 奶奶说：“锻炼啊！我每天早上都来，走一个小时。”
sentences.pinyin: nai3 nai5 shuo1 duan4 lian4 a5 wo3 mei3 tian1 zao3 shang5 dou1 lai2 zou3 yi1 ge5 xiao3 shi2
sentences.english: The grandma said: "For exercise! I come every morning and walk for an hour."

sentences.hanzi: “你也试试？”
sentences.pinyin: ni3 ye3 shi4 shi4
sentences.english: "Want to try?"

sentences.hanzi: 安娜试了一下，可是她总是想向后看。
sentences.pinyin: an1 na4 shi4 le5 yi1 xia4 ke3 shi4 ta1 zong3 shi4 xiang3 xiang4 hou4 kan4
sentences.english: Anna gave it a try, but she kept wanting to look behind her.

sentences.hanzi: 奶奶说：“别向后看。走一个月，你就习惯了。”
sentences.pinyin: nai3 nai5 shuo1 bie2 xiang4 hou4 kan4 zou3 yi1 ge5 yue4 ni3 jiu4 xi2 guan4 le5
sentences.english: The grandma said: "Don't look back. Do it for a month and you'll get used to it."

sentences.hanzi: 从那以后，安娜每天早上都去公园。
sentences.pinyin: cong2 na4 yi3 hou4 an1 na4 mei3 tian1 zao3 shang5 dou1 qu4 gong1 yuan2
sentences.english: From then on, Anna went to the park every morning.

sentences.hanzi: 一个月以后，她要回家了。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 yue4 yi3 hou4 ta1 yao4 hui2 jia1 le5
sentences.english: A month later, she had to go home.

sentences.hanzi: 回家以后，她还是习惯早上五点起床，去公园倒着走。
sentences.pinyin: hui2 jia1 yi3 hou4 ta1 hai2 shi5 xi2 guan4 zao3 shang5 wu3 dian3 qi3 chuang2 qu4 gong1 yuan2 dao4 zhe5 zou3
sentences.english: Back home, she still got up at five out of habit and went to the park to walk backwards.

sentences.hanzi: 那里的人都看着她，不知道她在做什么。
sentences.pinyin: na4 li5 de5 ren2 dou1 kan4 zhe5 ta1 bu4 zhi1 dao4 ta1 zai4 zuo4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: People there stared at her, with no idea what she was doing.

sentences.hanzi: 可是第二天早上，她发现，她的前面多了一个人。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 di4 er4 tian1 zao3 shang5 ta1 fa1 xian4 ta1 de5 qian2 mian4 duo1 le5 yi1 ge5 ren2
sentences.english: But the next morning she noticed there was one more person in front of her.

sentences.hanzi: 那个人也在倒着走。
sentences.pinyin: na4 ge5 ren2 ye3 zai4 dao4 zhe5 zou3
sentences.english: That person was walking backwards too.

glossed.meaning: grandma; also a polite word for an old woman

sentences.hanzi: 两百年前，在英国，很多人还没有闹钟。
sentences.pinyin: liang3 bai3 nian2 qian2 zai4 ying1 guo2 hen3 duo1 ren2 hai2 mei2 you3 nao4 zhong1
sentences.english: Two hundred years ago in Britain, many people still had no alarm clock.

sentences.hanzi: 可是他们每天都要很早起床，去上班。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ta1 men5 mei3 tian1 dou1 yao4 hen3 zao3 qi3 chuang2 qu4 shang4 ban1
sentences.english: But every day they had to get up very early and go to work.

sentences.hanzi: 如果迟到了，那一天的钱就可能没有了。
sentences.pinyin: ru2 guo3 chi2 dao4 le5 na4 yi1 tian1 de5 qian2 jiu4 ke3 neng2 mei2 you3 le5
sentences.english: If they were late, they might lose that day's pay.

sentences.hanzi: 怎么办呢？这时候，有了一种新的工作。
sentences.pinyin: zen3 me5 ban4 ne5 zhe4 shi2 hou5 you3 le5 yi1 zhong3 xin1 de5 gong1 zuo4
sentences.english: What could they do? That was when a new kind of job appeared.

sentences.hanzi: 每天夜里三四点，有人走来走去，敲大家的窗户。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 tian1 ye4 li5 san1 si4 dian3 you3 ren2 zou3 lai2 zou3 qu4 qiao1 da4 jia1 de5 chuang1 hu5
sentences.english: Every night at three or four o'clock, people walked the streets knocking on everyone's windows.

sentences.hanzi: 他们拿着很长的东西，很高的窗户也能敲到。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 na2 zhe5 hen3 chang2 de5 dong1 xi5 hen3 gao1 de5 chuang1 hu5 ye3 neng2 qiao1 dao4
sentences.english: They carried something very long, so they could reach even high windows.

sentences.hanzi: 他们会一直敲。等你醒了，到窗户前面让他们看见，他们才走。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 hui4 yi1 zhi2 qiao1 deng3 ni3 xing3 le5 dao4 chuang1 hu5 qian2 mian4 rang4 ta1 men5 kan4 jian4 ta1 men5 cai2 zou3
sentences.english: They would keep knocking. Only when you were awake and came to the window where they could see you would they move on.

sentences.hanzi: 每个人一周只要给他们一点钱。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 ge5 ren2 yi1 zhou1 zhi3 yao4 gei3 ta1 men5 yi1 dian3 qian2
sentences.english: Each person only had to pay them a little each week.

sentences.hanzi: 在伦敦，有一个女人很有名。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 lun2 dun1 you3 yi1 ge5 nu:3 ren2 hen3 you3 ming2
sentences.english: In London, one woman was famous.

sentences.hanzi: 她不敲窗户，她向窗户打豆子。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 bu4 qiao1 chuang1 hu5 ta1 xiang4 chuang1 hu5 da3 dou4 zi5
sentences.english: She didn't knock on windows; she shot dried peas at them.

sentences.hanzi: 有了闹钟以后，这个工作就没有了。
sentences.pinyin: you3 le5 nao4 zhong1 yi3 hou4 zhe4 ge5 gong1 zuo4 jiu4 mei2 you3 le5
sentences.english: Once there were alarm clocks, the job disappeared.

sentences.hanzi: 可是很多人都想过一个问题：
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 hen3 duo1 ren2 dou1 xiang3 guo4 yi1 ge5 wen4 ti2
sentences.english: But many people have wondered about one question:

sentences.hanzi: 敲窗户的人，是谁叫他们起床的呢？
sentences.pinyin: qiao1 chuang1 hu5 de5 ren2 shi4 shei2 jiao4 ta1 men5 qi3 chuang2 de5 ne5
sentences.english: Who woke up the window knockers?

sentences.hanzi: 其实，很多敲窗户的人，夜里工作，下午才起床。
sentences.pinyin: qi2 shi2 hen3 duo1 qiao1 chuang1 hu5 de5 ren2 ye4 li5 gong1 zuo4 xia4 wu3 cai2 qi3 chuang2
sentences.english: In fact, many window knockers worked at night and only got up in the afternoon.

sentences.hanzi: 别人睡觉的时候，他们在工作。
sentences.pinyin: bie2 ren5 shui4 jiao4 de5 shi2 hou5 ta1 men5 zai4 gong1 zuo4
sentences.english: When other people were sleeping, they were working.

sentences.hanzi: 别人起床的时候，他们准备睡觉了。
sentences.pinyin: bie2 ren5 qi3 chuang2 de5 shi2 hou5 ta1 men5 zhun3 bei4 shui4 jiao4 le5
sentences.english: When other people were getting up, they were getting ready for bed.

sentences.hanzi: 他们不需要闹钟。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 bu4 xu1 yao4 nao4 zhong1
sentences.english: They didn't need an alarm clock.

sentences.hanzi: 他们自己，就是大家的闹钟。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 zi4 ji3 jiu4 shi4 da4 jia1 de5 nao4 zhong1
sentences.english: They themselves were everyone's alarm clock.

sentences.hanzi: 九百多年前，宋朝的开封是一个很大的地方。
sentences.pinyin: jiu3 bai3 duo1 nian2 qian2 song4 chao2 de5 kai1 feng1 shi4 yi1 ge5 hen3 da4 de5 di4 fang5
sentences.english: Over nine hundred years ago, in the Song dynasty, Kaifeng was a very big place.

sentences.hanzi: 那时候没有闹钟，大家怎么起床呢？
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi2 hou5 mei2 you3 nao4 zhong1 da4 jia1 zen3 me5 qi3 chuang2 ne5
sentences.english: There were no alarm clocks then. So how did people get up?

sentences.hanzi: 每天天还没有亮，和尚们就出门了。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 tian1 tian1 hai2 mei2 you3 liang4 he2 shang5 men5 jiu4 chu1 men2 le5
sentences.english: Every day, before it was light, the monks went out.

sentences.hanzi: 小和尚明心也是这样。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 he2 shang5 ming2 xin1 ye3 shi4 zhe4 yang4
sentences.english: The young monk Mingxin was one of them.

sentences.hanzi: 他总是夜里三四点起床，洗脸，然后拿起铁牌出门。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zong3 shi4 ye4 li5 san1 si4 dian3 qi3 chuang2 xi3 lian3 ran2 hou4 na2 qi3 tie3 pai2 chu1 men2
sentences.english: He always got up at three or four at night, washed his face, then picked up his iron plate and went out.

sentences.hanzi: 他走着，打着铁牌，说：
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zou3 zhe5 da3 zhe5 tie3 pai2 shuo1
sentences.english: As he walked, he struck the iron plate and called out:

sentences.hanzi: “天快亮了！起床了！”
sentences.pinyin: tian1 kuai4 liang4 le5 qi3 chuang2 le5
sentences.english: "It's almost light! Time to get up!"

sentences.hanzi: 他走过的地方，大家一个一个起床了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zou3 guo4 de5 di4 fang5 da4 jia1 yi1 ge4 yi1 ge4 qi3 chuang2 le5
sentences.english: Wherever he passed, people got up one by one.

sentences.hanzi: 做饭的，上班的，上学的，都起来了。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 fan4 de5 shang4 ban1 de5 shang4 xue2 de5 dou1 qi3 lai5 le5
sentences.english: The cooks, the workers, the schoolchildren—everyone got up.

sentences.hanzi: 一年，两年，明心从来没有迟到过。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 nian2 liang3 nian2 ming2 xin1 cong2 lai2 mei2 you3 chi2 dao4 guo5
sentences.english: One year, two years—Mingxin was never once late.

sentences.hanzi: 有一天，明心太累了，一直睡到中午。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 ming2 xin1 tai4 lei4 le5 yi1 zhi2 shui4 dao4 zhong1 wu3
sentences.english: One day, Mingxin was so tired that he slept right through till noon.

sentences.hanzi: 他醒了，一看，已经是中午了！完了！今天大家都会迟到！
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xing3 le5 yi1 kan4 yi3 jing1 shi4 zhong1 wu3 le5 wan2 le5 jin1 tian1 da4 jia1 dou1 hui4 chi2 dao4
sentences.english: He woke up and looked: it was already noon! Disaster! Everyone would be late today!

sentences.hanzi: 可是他跑出门一看，人和每天一样多。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ta1 pao3 chu1 men2 yi1 kan4 ren2 he2 mei3 tian1 yi1 yang4 duo1
sentences.english: But when he ran out to look, there were as many people about as on any other day.

sentences.hanzi: 做饭的在做饭，上班的已经在工作了。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 fan4 de5 zai4 zuo4 fan4 shang4 ban1 de5 yi3 jing1 zai4 gong1 zuo4 le5
sentences.english: The cooks were cooking, and the workers were already at work.

sentences.hanzi: 一个老人说：“小和尚，你还没睡醒吧？”
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 lao3 ren2 shuo1 xiao3 he2 shang5 ni3 hai2 mei2 shui4 xing3 ba5
sentences.english: An old man said: "Little monk, still not awake?"

sentences.hanzi: “今天早上，有人打铁牌，比你还准时。”
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 zao3 shang5 you3 ren2 da3 tie3 pai2 bi3 ni3 hai2 zhun3 shi2
sentences.english: "This morning someone was striking the iron plate, even more on time than you."

sentences.hanzi: 明心回去一看，老和尚正在洗脸，旁边放着一个铁牌。
sentences.pinyin: ming2 xin1 hui2 qu5 yi1 kan4 lao3 he2 shang5 zheng4 zai4 xi3 lian3 pang2 bian1 fang4 zhe5 yi1 ge5 tie3 pai2
sentences.english: Mingxin went back and saw the old monk washing his face, with an iron plate next to him.

sentences.hanzi: 老和尚说：“四十年前，这也是我的工作。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 he2 shang5 shuo1 si4 shi2 nian2 qian2 zhe4 ye3 shi4 wo3 de5 gong1 zuo4
sentences.english: The old monk said: "Forty years ago, this was my job too."

sentences.hanzi: “六十岁了，还没有忘。”
sentences.pinyin: liu4 shi2 sui4 le5 hai2 mei2 you3 wang4
sentences.english: "I'm sixty now, and I still haven't forgotten."

title: 火星上的早上
titlePinyin: huo3 xing1 shang4 de5 zao3 shang5

sentences.hanzi: 李文住在火星上，已经一年了。
sentences.pinyin: li3 wen2 zhu4 zai4 huo3 xing1 shang4 yi3 jing1 yi1 nian2 le5
sentences.english: Li Wen had been living on Mars for a year.

sentences.hanzi: 在火星上，一天比地球上长四十分钟。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 huo3 xing1 shang4 yi1 tian1 bi3 di4 qiu2 shang4 chang2 si4 shi2 fen1 zhong1
sentences.english: On Mars, a day is forty minutes longer than on Earth.

sentences.hanzi: 四十分钟，听起来不多，可是很麻烦。
sentences.pinyin: si4 shi2 fen1 zhong1 ting1 qi3 lai5 bu4 duo1 ke3 shi4 hen3 ma2 fan5
sentences.english: Forty minutes doesn't sound like much, but it's a lot of trouble.

sentences.hanzi: 李文的妻子在地球上。他们每天都发消息。
sentences.pinyin: li3 wen2 de5 qi1 zi5 zai4 di4 qiu2 shang4 ta1 men5 mei3 tian1 dou1 fa1 xiao1 xi5
sentences.english: Li Wen's wife was on Earth. They sent each other messages every day.

sentences.hanzi: 第一天，李文早上起床，妻子那里也是早上。
sentences.pinyin: di4 yi1 tian1 li3 wen2 zao3 shang5 qi3 chuang2 qi1 zi5 na4 li5 ye3 shi4 zao3 shang5
sentences.english: On the first day, when Li Wen got up in the morning, it was morning where his wife was too.

sentences.hanzi: 她说：“早上好！今天吃什么早饭？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 zao3 shang5 hao3 jin1 tian1 chi1 shen2 me5 zao3 fan4
sentences.english: She said: "Good morning! What are you having for breakfast today?"

sentences.hanzi: 可是每一天，火星的早上都比地球晚四十分钟。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 mei3 yi1 tian1 huo3 xing1 de5 zao3 shang5 dou1 bi3 di4 qiu2 wan3 si4 shi2 fen1 zhong1
sentences.english: But every day, the Martian morning came forty minutes later than Earth's.

sentences.hanzi: 十天以后，李文刷牙的时候，妻子那里已经是下午了。
sentences.pinyin: shi2 tian1 yi3 hou4 li3 wen2 shua1 ya2 de5 shi2 hou5 qi1 zi5 na4 li5 yi3 jing1 shi4 xia4 wu3 le5
sentences.english: Ten days later, when Li Wen was brushing his teeth, it was already afternoon where his wife was.

sentences.hanzi: 二十天以后，他吃早饭，她吃晚饭。
sentences.pinyin: er4 shi2 tian1 yi3 hou4 ta1 chi1 zao3 fan4 ta1 chi1 wan3 fan4
sentences.english: Twenty days later, he was eating breakfast while she ate dinner.

sentences.hanzi: 再过几天，他起床的时候，妻子已经睡觉了。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 guo4 ji3 tian1 ta1 qi3 chuang2 de5 shi2 hou5 qi1 zi5 yi3 jing1 shui4 jiao4 le5
sentences.english: A few days after that, when he got up, his wife had already gone to bed.

sentences.hanzi: 他们说话的时间，一天比一天少。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 shuo1 hua4 de5 shi2 jian1 yi1 tian1 bi3 yi1 tian1 shao3
sentences.english: They had less time to talk every day.

sentences.hanzi: 李文很不习惯。
sentences.pinyin: li3 wen2 hen3 bu4 xi2 guan4
sentences.english: Li Wen found it very hard.

sentences.hanzi: 可是有一天早上，他刚醒，妻子的消息就来了。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 you3 yi1 tian1 zao3 shang5 ta1 gang1 xing3 qi1 zi5 de5 xiao1 xi5 jiu4 lai2 le5
sentences.english: But one morning, he had only just woken up when a message from his wife arrived.

sentences.hanzi: “早上好！今天吃什么早饭？”
sentences.pinyin: zao3 shang5 hao3 jin1 tian1 chi1 shen2 me5 zao3 fan4
sentences.english: "Good morning! What are you having for breakfast today?"

sentences.hanzi: 李文想了想：已经过去了三十六天。
sentences.pinyin: li3 wen2 xiang3 le5 xiang3 yi3 jing1 guo4 qu4 le5 san1 shi2 liu4 tian1
sentences.english: Li Wen thought about it: thirty-six days had gone by.

sentences.hanzi: 他们又有了一样的早上。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 you4 you3 le5 yi1 yang4 de5 zao3 shang5
sentences.english: They had the same morning again.

sentences.hanzi: 从那以后，李文叫这一天“我们的早上”。
sentences.pinyin: cong2 na4 yi3 hou4 li3 wen2 jiao4 zhe4 yi1 tian1 wo3 men5 de5 zao3 shang5
sentences.english: After that, Li Wen called this day "our morning."

sentences.hanzi: 在火星上，这样的早上不多。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 huo3 xing1 shang4 zhe4 yang4 de5 zao3 shang5 bu4 duo1
sentences.english: On Mars, mornings like this were rare.

sentences.hanzi: 可是每一个，他都准时起床。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 mei3 yi1 ge5 ta1 dou1 zhun3 shi2 qi3 chuang2
sentences.english: But for every one of them, he got up right on time.

title: 七十岁的学生
titlePinyin: qi1 shi2 sui4 de5 xue2 sheng5

sentences.hanzi: 我们的教室里，来了一个新同学。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 de5 jiao4 shi4 li3 lai2 le5 yi1 ge5 xin1 tong2 xue2
sentences.english: A new classmate came to our classroom.

sentences.hanzi: 她七十多岁了，是我们小学最老的学生。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 qi1 shi2 duo1 sui4 le5 shi4 wo3 men5 xiao3 xue2 zui4 lao3 de5 xue2 sheng5
sentences.english: She was over seventy, the oldest student in our primary school.

sentences.hanzi: 她还是孩子的时候，她家没有钱，她不能上学。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 hai2 shi5 hai2 zi5 de5 shi2 hou5 ta1 jia1 mei2 you3 qian2 ta1 bu4 neng2 shang4 xue2
sentences.english: When she was a child, her family had no money, and she couldn't go to school.

sentences.hanzi: 所以，她一个字也不认识。
sentences.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 yi1 ge5 zi4 ye3 bu4 ren4 shi5
sentences.english: So she couldn't read a single character.

sentences.hanzi: 她天天第一个来教室，坐在最前面。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 tian1 tian1 di4 yi1 ge4 lai2 jiao4 shi4 zuo4 zai4 zui4 qian2 mian4
sentences.english: Every day she was first into the classroom, and she sat right at the front.

sentences.hanzi: 老师教一个字，她就在纸上写很多很多次。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 shi1 jiao1 yi1 ge5 zi4 ta1 jiu4 zai4 zhi3 shang4 xie3 hen3 duo1 hen3 duo1 ci4
sentences.english: When the teacher taught a character, she wrote it on paper over and over again.

sentences.hanzi: 听写的时候，她总是最后一个写完。
sentences.pinyin: ting1 xie3 de5 shi2 hou5 ta1 zong3 shi4 zui4 hou4 yi1 ge5 xie3 wan2
sentences.english: In dictation she was always the last to finish.

sentences.hanzi: 可是她从来不说难。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ta1 cong2 lai2 bu4 shuo1 nan2
sentences.english: But she never said it was hard.

sentences.hanzi: 有一天，老师问大家：“你们为什么要学写字？”
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 lao3 shi1 wen4 da4 jia1 ni3 men5 wei4 shen2 me5 yao4 xue2 xie3 zi4
sentences.english: One day the teacher asked everyone: "Why do you want to learn to write?"

sentences.hanzi: 一个同学说：“为了考试。”另一个说：“为了上大学。”
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 tong2 xue2 shuo1 wei4 le5 kao3 shi4 ling4 yi1 ge5 shuo1 wei4 le5 shang4 da4 xue2
sentences.english: One classmate said: "To pass exams." Another said: "To go to university."

sentences.hanzi: 老师也问了她。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 shi1 ye3 wen4 le5 ta1
sentences.english: The teacher asked her too.

sentences.hanzi: 她说：“我想知道，我的名字怎么写。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 wo3 xiang3 zhi1 dao4 wo3 de5 ming2 zi5 zen3 me5 xie3
sentences.english: She said: "I want to know how to write my name."

sentences.hanzi: “七十年了，大家都叫我这个名字，可是我从来没有见过它。”
sentences.pinyin: qi1 shi2 nian2 le5 da4 jia1 dou1 jiao4 wo3 zhe4 ge5 ming2 zi5 ke3 shi4 wo3 cong2 lai2 mei2 you3 jian4 guo5 ta1
sentences.english: "For seventy years, everyone has called me by this name, but I have never seen it."

sentences.hanzi: 教室里，一个人也没有说话。
sentences.pinyin: jiao4 shi4 li3 yi1 ge5 ren2 ye3 mei2 you3 shuo1 hua4
sentences.english: Nobody in the classroom said a word.

sentences.hanzi: 老师走到黑板前面，写了三个大字。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 shi1 zou3 dao4 hei1 ban3 qian2 mian4 xie3 le5 san1 ge4 da4 zi4
sentences.english: The teacher went up to the blackboard and wrote three big characters.

sentences.hanzi: 她看了很久很久，然后拿起笔，在纸上写了一次，又写了一次。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 le5 hen3 jiu3 hen3 jiu3 ran2 hou4 na2 qi3 bi3 zai4 zhi3 shang4 xie3 le5 yi1 ci4 you4 xie3 le5 yi1 ci4
sentences.english: She looked at them for a long, long time. Then she picked up her pen and wrote them on paper, once, and then again.

sentences.hanzi: 这天放学以后，她没有回家，一直坐在教室里写。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 tian1 fang4 xue2 yi3 hou4 ta1 mei2 you3 hui2 jia1 yi1 zhi2 zuo4 zai4 jiao4 shi4 li3 xie3
sentences.english: That day after school, she didn't go home. She sat in the classroom writing, on and on.

sentences.hanzi: 你觉得考试难吗？
sentences.pinyin: ni3 jue2 de5 kao3 shi4 nan2 ma5
sentences.english: Do you find exams hard?

sentences.hanzi: 几百年前，在明朝和清朝，读书人要考一个很大的考试。
sentences.pinyin: ji3 bai3 nian2 qian2 zai4 ming2 chao2 he2 qing1 chao2 du2 shu1 ren2 yao4 kao3 yi1 ge5 hen3 da4 de5 kao3 shi4
sentences.english: A few hundred years ago, in the Ming and Qing dynasties, scholars had to sit a huge exam.

sentences.hanzi: 为了这个考试，他们要复习很多很多年。
sentences.pinyin: wei4 le5 zhe4 ge5 kao3 shi4 ta1 men5 yao4 fu4 xi2 hen3 duo1 hen3 duo1 nian2
sentences.english: They spent many, many years studying for it.

sentences.hanzi: 考试的地方非常大。南京的一个考场，有两万多个号舍。
sentences.pinyin: kao3 shi4 de5 di4 fang5 fei1 chang2 da4 nan2 jing1 de5 yi1 ge5 kao3 chang3 you3 liang3 wan4 duo1 ge4 hao4 she4
sentences.english: The exam places were enormous. One exam hall in Nanjing had more than twenty thousand cells.

sentences.hanzi: 号舍非常小，一个人坐在里面，就没有地方了。
sentences.pinyin: hao4 she4 fei1 chang2 xiao3 yi1 ge4 ren2 zuo4 zai4 li3 mian4 jiu4 mei2 you3 di4 fang5 le5
sentences.english: A cell was tiny. Once one person sat inside, there was no room left.

sentences.hanzi: 号舍也没有门，前面是开着的。
sentences.pinyin: hao4 she4 ye3 mei2 you3 men2 qian2 mian4 shi4 kai1 zhe5 de5
sentences.english: The cells had no doors either. The front was open.

sentences.hanzi: 一场考试，要考三天两晚，不能出来。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 chang3 kao3 shi4 yao4 kao3 san1 tian1 liang3 wan3 bu4 neng2 chu1 lai2
sentences.english: One round of the exam lasted three days and two nights, and you couldn't come out.

sentences.hanzi: 读书人自己带吃的，在里面吃，晚上也在里面过。
sentences.pinyin: du2 shu1 ren2 zi4 ji3 dai4 chi1 de5 zai4 li3 mian4 chi1 wan3 shang5 ye3 zai4 li3 mian4 guo4
sentences.english: Scholars brought their own food, ate inside and spent the nights there too.

sentences.hanzi: 考试的时候，要写很多很多字，回答很难的问题。
sentences.pinyin: kao3 shi4 de5 shi2 hou5 yao4 xie3 hen3 duo1 hen3 duo1 zi4 hui2 da2 hen3 nan2 de5 wen4 ti2
sentences.english: During the exam, they had to write a huge number of characters and answer very hard questions.

sentences.hanzi: 要考三场，前前后后，就是九天。
sentences.pinyin: yao4 kao3 san1 chang3 qian2 qian2 hou4 hou4 jiu4 shi4 jiu3 tian1
sentences.english: There were three rounds in all, nine days from start to finish.

sentences.hanzi: 考完了，就是等成绩。
sentences.pinyin: kao3 wan2 le5 jiu4 shi4 deng3 cheng2 ji4
sentences.english: Once it was over, all that was left was to wait for the results.

sentences.hanzi: 很多人考了一次又一次，都没有考上。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 ren2 kao3 le5 yi1 ci4 you4 yi1 ci4 dou1 mei2 you3 kao3 shang4
sentences.english: Many people sat the exam again and again and never passed.

sentences.hanzi: 有人一直考到很老。
sentences.pinyin: you3 ren2 yi1 zhi2 kao3 dao4 hen3 lao3
sentences.english: Some kept taking it until they were very old.

sentences.hanzi: 所以，下一次你考试的时候，可以这样想：
sentences.pinyin: suo3 yi3 xia4 yi1 ci4 ni3 kao3 shi4 de5 shi2 hou5 ke3 yi3 zhe4 yang4 xiang3
sentences.english: So next time you sit an exam, you can think of it like this:

sentences.hanzi: 至少，考完了，你今天晚上就可以回家。
sentences.pinyin: zhi4 shao3 kao3 wan2 le5 ni3 jin1 tian1 wan3 shang5 jiu4 ke3 yi3 hui2 jia1
sentences.english: At least, when it's over, you can go home tonight.

sentences.hanzi: 这是宋朝的事。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 song4 chao2 de5 shi4
sentences.english: This happened in the Song dynasty.

sentences.hanzi: 有一个小女孩，叫小月。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 ge5 xiao3 nu:3 hai2 jiao4 xiao3 yue4
sentences.english: There was a little girl called Xiaoyue.

sentences.hanzi: 她的哥哥天天去上学，她不能去。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 ge1 ge5 tian1 tian1 qu4 shang4 xue2 ta1 bu4 neng2 qu4
sentences.english: Her brother went to school every day, but she couldn't go.

sentences.hanzi: 那时候，很多女孩是不上学的。
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi2 hou5 hen3 duo1 nu:3 hai2 shi4 bu4 shang4 xue2 de5
sentences.english: In those days, many girls didn't go to school.

sentences.hanzi: 晚上，哥哥念书，写字。
sentences.pinyin: wan3 shang5 ge1 ge5 nian4 shu1 xie3 zi4
sentences.english: In the evenings, her brother read aloud and practised writing.

sentences.hanzi: 小月就坐在门外听。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 yue4 jiu4 zuo4 zai4 men2 wai4 ting1
sentences.english: Xiaoyue would sit outside the door and listen.

sentences.hanzi: 哥哥念一句，她就记住一句。
sentences.pinyin: ge1 ge5 nian4 yi1 ju4 ta1 jiu4 ji4 zhu5 yi1 ju4
sentences.english: Every line her brother read, she remembered.

sentences.hanzi: 她没有纸，也没有笔，就在门外用手写。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 mei2 you3 zhi3 ye3 mei2 you3 bi3 jiu4 zai4 men2 wai4 yong4 shou3 xie3
sentences.english: She had no paper and no brush, so she wrote with her finger on the ground outside the door.

sentences.hanzi: 有一天，哥哥的老师来了。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 ge1 ge5 de5 lao3 shi1 lai2 le5
sentences.english: One day, her brother's teacher came.

sentences.hanzi: 老师问了哥哥一个问题，哥哥回答不出来。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 shi1 wen4 le5 ge1 ge5 yi1 ge5 wen4 ti2 ge1 ge5 hui2 da2 bu4 chu1 lai2
sentences.english: The teacher asked her brother a question, and he couldn't answer it.

sentences.hanzi: 这时，门外有人说出了答案。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 men2 wai4 you3 ren2 shuo1 chu1 le5 da2 an4
sentences.english: Just then, someone outside the door said the answer.

sentences.hanzi: 老师走出去，看到了小月，也看到了她写的字。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 shi1 zou3 chu1 qu4 kan4 dao4 le5 xiao3 yue4 ye3 kan4 dao4 le5 ta1 xie3 de5 zi4
sentences.english: The teacher went outside and saw Xiaoyue, and the characters she had written.

sentences.hanzi: 门外全是字，一个一个，都写得很小心。
sentences.pinyin: men2 wai4 quan2 shi4 zi4 yi1 ge4 yi1 ge4 dou1 xie3 de5 hen3 xiao3 xin1
sentences.english: The ground outside the door was covered in characters, each one written with great care.

sentences.hanzi: 老师问：“这些字，是谁教你的？”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 shi1 wen4 zhe4 xie1 zi4 shi4 shei2 jiao1 ni3 de5
sentences.english: The teacher asked: "Who taught you these characters?"

sentences.hanzi: 小月说：“没有人教我。我是在门外学的。”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 yue4 shuo1 mei2 you3 ren2 jiao1 wo3 wo3 shi4 zai4 men2 wai4 xue2 de5
sentences.english: Xiaoyue said: "Nobody taught me. I learned them outside the door."

sentences.hanzi: 老师看了她很久，没有说话。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 shi1 kan4 le5 ta1 hen3 jiu3 mei2 you3 shuo1 hua4
sentences.english: The teacher looked at her for a long time without speaking.

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，老师给了她一本书，还有纸和笔。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 lao3 shi1 gei3 le5 ta1 yi1 ben3 shu1 hai2 you3 zhi3 he2 bi3
sentences.english: The next day, the teacher gave her a book, and paper and a brush.

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“以后，你别在门外听了。你可以坐到里面来。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 yi3 hou4 ni3 bie2 zai4 men2 wai4 ting1 le5 ni3 ke3 yi3 zuo4 dao4 li3 mian4 lai2
sentences.english: He said: "From now on, don't listen outside the door. You can come and sit inside."

title: 没有问题的考试
titlePinyin: mei2 you3 wen4 ti2 de5 kao3 shi4

sentences.hanzi: 很多年以后，学生们什么都不需要记住。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 nian2 yi3 hou4 xue2 sheng5 men5 shen2 me5 dou1 bu4 xu1 yao4 ji4 zhu5
sentences.english: Many years from now, students don't need to remember anything.

sentences.hanzi: 不管有什么问题，问一下小智，马上就有答案。
sentences.pinyin: bu4 guan3 you3 shen2 me5 wen4 ti2 wen4 yi1 xia4 xiao3 zhi4 ma3 shang4 jiu4 you3 da2 an4
sentences.english: Whatever the question, you just ask Xiaozhi, and the answer comes right away.

sentences.hanzi: 小智什么都知道。所以，学校里已经很久没有考试了。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 zhi4 shen2 me5 dou1 zhi1 dao4 suo3 yi3 xue2 xiao4 li3 yi3 jing1 hen3 jiu3 mei2 you3 kao3 shi4 le5
sentences.english: Xiaozhi knows everything. So schools haven't had exams for a long time.

sentences.hanzi: 可是有一天，老师说：“明天，我们考试。”
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 you3 yi1 tian1 lao3 shi1 shuo1 ming2 tian1 wo3 men5 kao3 shi4
sentences.english: But one day the teacher said: "Tomorrow, we have an exam."

sentences.hanzi: 学生们都觉得很奇怪：“考什么？我们问小智就行了。”
sentences.pinyin: xue2 sheng5 men5 dou1 jue2 de5 hen3 qi2 guai4 kao3 shen2 me5 wo3 men5 wen4 xiao3 zhi4 jiu4 xing2 le5
sentences.english: The students all found this strange: "What's there to test? We can just ask Xiaozhi."

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，每个学生都拿到了一张纸。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 mei3 ge5 xue2 sheng5 dou1 na2 dao4 le5 yi1 zhang1 zhi3
sentences.english: The next day, every student was handed a sheet of paper.

sentences.hanzi: 纸上没有问题，只有一句话：
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 shang4 mei2 you3 wen4 ti2 zhi3 you3 yi1 ju4 hua4
sentences.english: There were no questions on it, only one sentence:

sentences.hanzi: “请写一个问题，一个小智回答不了的问题。”
sentences.pinyin: qing3 xie3 yi1 ge4 wen4 ti2 yi1 ge4 xiao3 zhi4 hui2 da2 bu4 liao3 de5 wen4 ti2
sentences.english: "Please write a question, one that Xiaozhi can't answer."

sentences.hanzi: 教室里，谁也不说话。
sentences.pinyin: jiao4 shi4 li3 shei2 ye3 bu4 shuo1 hua4
sentences.english: Nobody in the classroom said a word.

sentences.hanzi: 有人写：“明天会下雨吗？”小智马上就回答了。
sentences.pinyin: you3 ren2 xie3 ming2 tian1 hui4 xia4 yu3 ma5 xiao3 zhi4 ma3 shang4 jiu4 hui2 da2 le5
sentences.english: Someone wrote: "Will it rain tomorrow?" Xiaozhi answered at once.

sentences.hanzi: 有人写：“一千年以后，人们说什么语言？”小智也回答了。
sentences.pinyin: you3 ren2 xie3 yi1 qian1 nian2 yi3 hou4 ren2 men5 shuo1 shen2 me5 yu3 yan2 xiao3 zhi4 ye3 hui2 da2 le5
sentences.english: Someone wrote: "What language will people speak in a thousand years?" Xiaozhi answered that too.

sentences.hanzi: 一个小时过去了，大家都没有写出来。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 xiao3 shi2 guo4 qu4 le5 da4 jia1 dou1 mei2 you3 xie3 chu1 lai2
sentences.english: An hour went by, and nobody had managed to write one.

sentences.hanzi: 最后，一个小女孩写了一句：“小智，你喜欢回答问题吗？”
sentences.pinyin: zui4 hou4 yi1 ge5 xiao3 nu:3 hai2 xie3 le5 yi1 ju4 xiao3 zhi4 ni3 xi3 huan5 hui2 da2 wen4 ti2 ma5
sentences.english: In the end, a little girl wrote: "Xiaozhi, do you like answering questions?"

sentences.hanzi: 小智想了很久，没有回答。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 zhi4 xiang3 le5 hen3 jiu3 mei2 you3 hui2 da2
sentences.english: Xiaozhi thought for a long time and gave no answer.

sentences.hanzi: 老师看了大家的纸，只有她一个人及格了。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 shi1 kan4 le5 da4 jia1 de5 zhi3 zhi3 you3 ta1 yi1 ge5 ren2 ji2 ge2 le5
sentences.english: The teacher looked at everyone's paper. She was the only one who passed.

sentences.hanzi: 老师说：“找答案不难。难的，是问一个好问题。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 shi1 shuo1 zhao3 da2 an4 bu4 nan2 nan2 de5 shi4 wen4 yi1 ge5 hao3 wen4 ti2
sentences.english: The teacher said: "Finding answers isn't hard. The hard part is asking a good question."

title: 穿旗袍的妈妈
titlePinyin: chuan1 qi2 pao2 de5 ma1 ma5

sentences.hanzi: 每一年的六月，中国有一千多万个学生，参加一个很大的考试。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 yi1 nian2 de5 liu4 yue4 zhong1 guo2 you3 yi1 qian1 duo1 wan4 ge4 xue2 sheng5 can1 jia1 yi1 ge5 hen3 da4 de5 kao3 shi4
sentences.english: Every June, more than ten million students in China sit one huge exam.

sentences.hanzi: 这个考试叫“高考”。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 kao3 shi4 jiao4 gao1 kao3
sentences.english: This exam is called the gaokao.

sentences.hanzi: 高中三年的学习和复习，都是为了这几天。
sentences.pinyin: gao1 zhong1 san1 nian2 de5 xue2 xi2 he2 fu4 xi2 dou1 shi4 wei4 le5 zhe4 ji3 tian1
sentences.english: Three years of high school study and revision all lead up to these few days.

sentences.hanzi: 考得好，就能上一个好大学。
sentences.pinyin: kao3 de5 hao3 jiu4 neng2 shang4 yi1 ge5 hao3 da4 xue2
sentences.english: Do well, and you can get into a good university.

sentences.hanzi: 高考的那几天，很多人都在帮这些学生。
sentences.pinyin: gao1 kao3 de5 na4 ji3 tian1 hen3 duo1 ren2 dou1 zai4 bang1 zhe4 xie1 xue2 sheng5
sentences.english: During the days of the gaokao, lots of people help these students.

sentences.hanzi: 有人用自己的车送他们去考场，一块钱也不要。
sentences.pinyin: you3 ren2 yong4 zi4 ji3 de5 che1 song4 ta1 men5 qu4 kao3 chang3 yi1 kuai4 qian2 ye3 bu4 yao4
sentences.english: Some people drive them to the exam halls in their own cars and won't take a single yuan.

sentences.hanzi: 还有一件特别的事：很多妈妈会穿上旗袍。
sentences.pinyin: hai2 you3 yi1 jian4 te4 bie2 de5 shi4 hen3 duo1 ma1 ma5 hui4 chuan1 shang4 qi2 pao2
sentences.english: And here's something special: many mothers put on a qipao.

sentences.hanzi: 为什么呢？因为旗袍让人想到一句话：“旗开得胜”。
sentences.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 ne5 yin1 wei4 qi2 pao2 rang4 ren2 xiang3 dao4 yi1 ju4 hua4 qi2 kai1 de2 sheng4
sentences.english: Why? Because qipao reminds people of a saying that starts with the same sound: qi kai de sheng.

sentences.hanzi: 意思是：一开始就成功。
sentences.pinyin: yi4 si5 shi4 yi1 kai1 shi3 jiu4 cheng2 gong1
sentences.english: It means: succeed right from the start.

sentences.hanzi: 考试的那几天，考场外面站着很多穿旗袍的妈妈。
sentences.pinyin: kao3 shi4 de5 na4 ji3 tian1 kao3 chang3 wai4 mian4 zhan4 zhe5 hen3 duo1 chuan1 qi2 pao2 de5 ma1 ma5
sentences.english: On the exam days, many mothers in qipao stand outside the exam halls.

sentences.hanzi: 也有爸爸穿上了旗袍，站在妈妈们旁边。
sentences.pinyin: ye3 you3 ba4 ba5 chuan1 shang4 le5 qi2 pao2 zhan4 zai4 ma1 ma5 men5 pang2 bian1
sentences.english: Some fathers put on a qipao too, and stand beside the mothers.

sentences.hanzi: 学生们考完出来，看到这么多旗袍，都觉得很特别。
sentences.pinyin: xue2 sheng5 men5 kao3 wan2 chu1 lai2 kan4 dao4 zhe4 me5 duo1 qi2 pao2 dou1 jue2 de5 hen3 te4 bie2
sentences.english: When the students come out after the exam and see so many qipao, they find it quite something.

sentences.hanzi: 不管成绩怎么样，那一天他们都记住了：
sentences.pinyin: bu4 guan3 cheng2 ji4 zen3 me5 yang4 na4 yi1 tian1 ta1 men5 dou1 ji4 zhu5 le5
sentences.english: Whatever their results, that day they all remember one thing:

sentences.hanzi: 有人一直在外面等着他们。
sentences.pinyin: you3 ren2 yi1 zhi2 zai4 wai4 mian4 deng3 zhe5 ta1 men5
sentences.english: Someone was waiting outside for them the whole time.

glossed.meaning: victory as soon as the banner is raised

title: 我们这里不讲价
titlePinyin: wo3 men5 zhe4 li3 bu4 jiang3 jia4

sentences.hanzi: 马克第一次来中国，他想买一个新包。
sentences.pinyin: ma3 ke4 di4 yi1 ci4 lai2 zhong1 guo2 ta1 xiang3 mai3 yi1 ge5 xin1 bao1
sentences.english: Mark was in China for the first time, and he wanted to buy a new bag.

sentences.hanzi: 朋友告诉他：“在中国买东西，一定要讲价。”
sentences.pinyin: peng2 you5 gao4 su5 ta1 zai4 zhong1 guo2 mai3 dong1 xi5 yi1 ding4 yao4 jiang3 jia4
sentences.english: A friend told him: "When you buy things in China, you must haggle."

sentences.hanzi: “他说一百块，你就说五十块。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 yi1 bai3 kuai4 ni3 jiu4 shuo1 wu3 shi2 kuai4
sentences.english: "If they say a hundred kuai, you say fifty."

sentences.hanzi: 马克说：“好，我知道了。”
sentences.pinyin: ma3 ke4 shuo1 hao3 wo3 zhi1 dao4 le5
sentences.english: Mark said: "OK, got it."

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，他走进一家很大的商场。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 ta1 zou3 jin4 yi1 jia1 hen3 da4 de5 shang1 chang3
sentences.english: The next day he walked into a very big shopping mall.

sentences.hanzi: 他看到一个包，价格是三百块。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 dao4 yi1 ge5 bao1 jia4 ge2 shi4 san1 bai3 kuai4
sentences.english: He saw a bag. The price was three hundred kuai.

sentences.hanzi: 马克说：“一百五十块，可以吗？”
sentences.pinyin: ma3 ke4 shuo1 yi1 bai3 wu3 shi2 kuai4 ke3 yi3 ma5
sentences.english: Mark said: "A hundred and fifty, OK?"

sentences.hanzi: 售货员说：“先生，对不起，我们这里不讲价。”
sentences.pinyin: shou4 huo4 yuan2 shuo1 xian1 sheng5 dui4 bu5 qi3 wo3 men5 zhe4 li3 bu4 jiang3 jia4
sentences.english: The sales assistant said: "Sorry, sir, we don't haggle here."

sentences.hanzi: 马克想：她也在讲价。
sentences.pinyin: ma3 ke4 xiang3 ta1 ye3 zai4 jiang3 jia4
sentences.english: Mark thought: she's haggling too.

sentences.hanzi: “两百块！不能再多了！”
sentences.pinyin: liang3 bai3 kuai4 bu4 neng2 zai4 duo1 le5
sentences.english: "Two hundred! Not a kuai more!"

sentences.hanzi: 售货员不说话了，旁边的顾客都在看他。
sentences.pinyin: shou4 huo4 yuan2 bu4 shuo1 hua4 le5 pang2 bian1 de5 gu4 ke4 dou1 zai4 kan4 ta1
sentences.english: The sales assistant said nothing, and the customers nearby were all looking at him.

sentences.hanzi: 马克没有办法，付了三百块就走了。
sentences.pinyin: ma3 ke4 mei2 you3 ban4 fa3 fu4 le5 san1 bai3 kuai4 jiu4 zou3 le5
sentences.english: Mark had no choice. He paid the three hundred and left.

sentences.hanzi: 晚上，他去了一个小市场。
sentences.pinyin: wan3 shang5 ta1 qu4 le5 yi1 ge5 xiao3 shi4 chang3
sentences.english: In the evening he went to a small market.

sentences.hanzi: 一个老人在卖钱包。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 lao3 ren2 zai4 mai4 qian2 bao1
sentences.english: An old man was selling wallets.

sentences.hanzi: 马克问：“这个钱包多少钱？”
sentences.pinyin: ma3 ke4 wen4 zhe4 ge5 qian2 bao1 duo1 shao5 qian2
sentences.english: Mark asked: "How much is this wallet?"

sentences.hanzi: 老人说：“八十。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ren2 shuo1 ba1 shi2
sentences.english: The old man said: "Eighty."

sentences.hanzi: 马克已经不敢讲价了，他说：“好，八十。”
sentences.pinyin: ma3 ke4 yi3 jing1 bu4 gan3 jiang3 jia4 le5 ta1 shuo1 hao3 ba1 shi2
sentences.english: Mark didn't dare haggle any more. He said: "OK, eighty."

sentences.hanzi: 老人看了看他，问：“你不讲价？”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ren2 kan4 le5 kan4 ta1 wen4 ni3 bu4 jiang3 jia4
sentences.english: The old man looked him over and asked: "You're not going to haggle?"

sentences.hanzi: “那六十吧。这个小包也给你，免费。”
sentences.pinyin: na4 liu4 shi2 ba5 zhe4 ge5 xiao3 bao1 ye3 gei3 ni3 mian3 fei4
sentences.english: "Sixty, then. And you can have this little bag too, free."

sentences.hanzi: 回家以后，马克对朋友说：“今天我知道了：在大商场，讲价没有用；在小市场，不讲价也能省钱。”
sentences.pinyin: hui2 jia1 yi3 hou4 ma3 ke4 dui4 peng2 you5 shuo1 jin1 tian1 wo3 zhi1 dao4 le5 zai4 da4 shang1 chang3 jiang3 jia4 mei2 you3 yong4 zai4 xiao3 shi4 chang3 bu4 jiang3 jia4 ye3 neng2 sheng3 qian2
sentences.english: Back home, Mark told his friend: "Today I learned something. In a big mall, haggling gets you nowhere. In a small market, you can save money without haggling."

title: 一张纸能买东西吗
titlePinyin: yi1 zhang1 zhi3 neng2 mai3 dong1 xi5 ma5
titleEnglish: Can a Piece of Paper Buy Things?

sentences.hanzi: 今天，我们买东西的时候，可以刷卡，不一定要用现金。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 mai3 dong1 xi5 de5 shi2 hou5 ke3 yi3 shua1 ka3 bu4 yi1 ding4 yao4 yong4 xian4 jin1
sentences.english: Today, when we buy things, we can pay by card. We don't have to use cash.

sentences.hanzi: 可是你知道吗？纸做的钱，最早出现在中国。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ni3 zhi1 dao4 ma5 zhi3 zuo4 de5 qian2 zui4 zao3 chu1 xian4 zai4 zhong1 guo2
sentences.english: But did you know? Money made of paper first appeared in China.

sentences.hanzi: 一千年前，中国是宋朝。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 qian1 nian2 qian2 zhong1 guo2 shi4 song4 chao2
sentences.english: A thousand years ago, China was ruled by the Song dynasty.

sentences.hanzi: 那时候，四川人买东西，用的是铁钱。
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi2 hou5 si4 chuan1 ren2 mai3 dong1 xi5 yong4 de5 shi4 tie3 qian2
sentences.english: In those days, people in Sichuan used iron coins to buy things.

sentences.hanzi: 一个铁钱买不了什么。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 tie3 qian2 mai3 bu5 liao3 shen2 me5
sentences.english: One iron coin couldn't buy much.

sentences.hanzi: 买一件衣服，要带很多很多铁钱，一个人都拿不动。
sentences.pinyin: mai3 yi1 jian4 yi1 fu5 yao4 dai4 hen3 duo1 hen3 duo1 tie3 qian2 yi1 ge5 ren2 dou1 na2 bu5 dong4
sentences.english: To buy one piece of clothing, you had to bring so many iron coins that one person couldn't carry them.

sentences.hanzi: 钱多的人去买东西，真是太麻烦了。
sentences.pinyin: qian2 duo1 de5 ren2 qu4 mai3 dong1 xi5 zhen1 shi5 tai4 ma2 fan5 le5
sentences.english: For people with a lot of money, going shopping was a real nuisance.

sentences.hanzi: 所以，成都的一些店想了一个办法。
sentences.pinyin: suo3 yi3 cheng2 du1 de5 yi1 xie1 dian4 xiang3 le5 yi1 ge5 ban4 fa3
sentences.english: So some shops in Chengdu came up with an idea.

sentences.hanzi: 你把铁钱存到店里，店里给你一张纸。
sentences.pinyin: ni3 ba3 tie3 qian2 cun2 dao4 dian4 li3 dian4 li3 gei3 ni3 yi1 zhang1 zhi3
sentences.english: You deposited your iron coins at the shop, and the shop gave you a piece of paper.

sentences.hanzi: 纸上写着：这个人存了多少钱。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 shang4 xie3 zhe5 zhe4 ge5 ren2 cun2 le5 duo1 shao5 qian2
sentences.english: On the paper it said how much money this person had deposited.

sentences.hanzi: 这张纸，叫“交子”。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 zhang1 zhi3 jiao4 jiao1 zi5
sentences.english: This piece of paper was called a "jiaozi".

sentences.hanzi: 你拿着交子去买东西。
sentences.pinyin: ni3 na2 zhe5 jiao1 zi5 qu4 mai3 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: You took the jiaozi and went shopping with it.

sentences.hanzi: 卖东西的人收了交子，也可以去店里换铁钱。
sentences.pinyin: mai4 dong1 xi5 de5 ren2 shou1 le5 jiao1 zi5 ye3 ke3 yi3 qu4 dian4 li3 huan4 tie3 qian2
sentences.english: The seller took the jiaozi, and could also go to the shop and change it for iron coins.

sentences.hanzi: 大家都觉得，这个办法比带铁钱好。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 jue2 de5 zhe4 ge5 ban4 fa3 bi3 dai4 tie3 qian2 hao3
sentences.english: Everyone felt this was better than carrying iron coins around.

sentences.hanzi: 可是过了一些年，有一些店出了问题，钱也没有了。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 guo4 le5 yi1 xie1 nian2 you3 yi1 xie1 dian4 chu1 le5 wen4 ti2 qian2 ye3 mei2 you3 le5
sentences.english: But some years later, a few of the shops ran into trouble, and the money was gone.

sentences.hanzi: 所以，宋朝开始自己做交子。
sentences.pinyin: suo3 yi3 song4 chao2 kai1 shi3 zi4 ji3 zuo4 jiao1 zi5
sentences.english: So the Song government began making jiaozi itself.

sentences.hanzi: 很多人说，这是世界上最早的纸做的钱。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 ren2 shuo1 zhe4 shi4 shi4 jie4 shang4 zui4 zao3 de5 zhi3 zuo4 de5 qian2
sentences.english: Many people say this was the world's earliest paper money.

sentences.hanzi: 一千年前，人们问：一张纸，怎么能买东西？
sentences.pinyin: yi1 qian1 nian2 qian2 ren2 men5 wen4 yi1 zhang1 zhi3 zen3 me5 neng2 mai3 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: A thousand years ago, people asked: how can a piece of paper buy things?

sentences.hanzi: 今天，很多人买东西，连纸做的钱也不带了。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 hen3 duo1 ren2 mai3 dong1 xi5 lian2 zhi3 zuo4 de5 qian2 ye3 bu4 dai4 le5
sentences.english: Today, many people go shopping without even carrying paper money.

glossed.meaning: Sichuan, a province in southwest China

title: 为什么不买南北
titlePinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 bu4 mai3 nan2 bei3

sentences.hanzi: 唐朝的时候，长安很大很大，住着很多很多人。
sentences.pinyin: tang2 chao2 de5 shi2 hou5 chang2 an1 hen3 da4 hen3 da4 zhu4 zhe5 hen3 duo1 hen3 duo1 ren2
sentences.english: In the Tang dynasty, Chang'an was huge, and a great many people lived there.

sentences.hanzi: 长安有两个大市场，一个在东，叫东市；一个在西，叫西市。
sentences.pinyin: chang2 an1 you3 liang3 ge4 da4 shi4 chang3 yi1 ge5 zai4 dong1 jiao4 dong1 shi4 yi1 ge5 zai4 xi1 jiao4 xi1 shi4
sentences.english: Chang'an had two big markets: one in the east, called the East Market, and one in the west, called the West Market.

sentences.hanzi: 人们要买东西，就去东市或者西市。
sentences.pinyin: ren2 men5 yao4 mai3 dong1 xi5 jiu4 qu4 dong1 shi4 huo4 zhe3 xi1 shi4
sentences.english: When people wanted to buy things, they went to the East Market or the West Market.

sentences.hanzi: 小安八岁。这一天，妈妈第一次带他去西市。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 an1 ba1 sui4 zhe4 yi1 tian1 ma1 ma5 di4 yi1 ci4 dai4 ta1 qu4 xi1 shi4
sentences.english: Xiao'an was eight. On this day his mother took him to the West Market for the first time.

sentences.hanzi: 西市里人很多，店也很多。
sentences.pinyin: xi1 shi4 li3 ren2 hen3 duo1 dian4 ye3 hen3 duo1
sentences.english: The West Market was full of people, and full of shops.

sentences.hanzi: 有卖衣服的，有卖吃的，什么东西都有。
sentences.pinyin: you3 mai4 yi1 fu5 de5 you3 mai4 chi1 de5 shen2 me5 dong1 xi5 dou1 you3
sentences.english: There were people selling clothes and people selling food. There was everything.

sentences.hanzi: 还有很多人从很远很远的地方来卖东西。
sentences.pinyin: hai2 you3 hen3 duo1 ren2 cong2 hen3 yuan3 hen3 yuan3 de5 di4 fang5 lai2 mai4 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: And many people had come from very, very far away to sell things.

sentences.hanzi: 他们说什么，小安一句也不明白。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 shuo1 shen2 me5 xiao3 an1 yi1 ju4 ye3 bu4 ming2 bai5
sentences.english: Xiao'an couldn't understand a word they said.

sentences.hanzi: 妈妈买了很多东西，付了很多钱。
sentences.pinyin: ma1 ma5 mai3 le5 hen3 duo1 dong1 xi5 fu4 le5 hen3 duo1 qian2
sentences.english: His mother bought a lot of things and paid a lot of money.

sentences.hanzi: 小安帮她拿着包。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 an1 bang1 ta1 na2 zhe5 bao1
sentences.english: Xiao'an helped her carry the bags.

sentences.hanzi: 回家的时候，小安问：“妈妈，为什么我们说“买东西”？”
sentences.pinyin: hui2 jia1 de5 shi2 hou5 xiao3 an1 wen4 ma1 ma5 wei4 shen2 me5 wo3 men5 shuo1 mai3 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: On the way home, Xiao'an asked: "Mum, why do we say 'buy east-west'?"

sentences.hanzi: 妈妈说：“因为我们去东市，去西市，所以叫“买东西”。”
sentences.pinyin: ma1 ma5 shuo1 yin1 wei4 wo3 men5 qu4 dong1 shi4 qu4 xi1 shi4 suo3 yi3 jiao4 mai3 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: His mother said: "Because we go to the East Market and the West Market, so we call it 'buying east-west'."

sentences.hanzi: 小安想了想，又问：“那为什么没有人说“买南北”？”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 an1 xiang3 le5 xiang3 you4 wen4 na4 wei4 shen2 me5 mei2 you3 ren2 shuo1 mai3 nan2 bei3
sentences.english: Xiao'an thought about it and asked again: "Then why does nobody say 'buy south-north'?"

sentences.hanzi: 妈妈不说话了。她也不知道。
sentences.pinyin: ma1 ma5 bu4 shuo1 hua4 le5 ta1 ye3 bu4 zhi1 dao4
sentences.english: His mother went quiet. She didn't know either.

sentences.hanzi: 最后她说：“你这个孩子，问题比西市的东西还多。”
sentences.pinyin: zui4 hou4 ta1 shuo1 ni3 zhe4 ge5 hai2 zi5 wen4 ti2 bi3 xi1 shi4 de5 dong1 xi5 hai2 duo1
sentences.english: In the end she said: "You child, you've got more questions than the West Market has things."

sentences.hanzi: 一千多年过去了。我们今天还在说“买东西”。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 qian1 duo1 nian2 guo4 qu4 le5 wo3 men5 jin1 tian1 hai2 zai4 shuo1 mai3 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: More than a thousand years have passed, and today we still say "buy east-west".

sentences.hanzi: 有人说，“买东西”就是从长安的东市和西市来的。
sentences.pinyin: you3 ren2 shuo1 mai3 dong1 xi5 jiu4 shi4 cong2 chang2 an1 de5 dong1 shi4 he2 xi1 shi4 lai2 de5
sentences.english: Some people say "buy east-west" comes from Chang'an's East and West Markets.

sentences.hanzi: 可是也有很多人说，不是这样。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ye3 you3 hen3 duo1 ren2 shuo1 bu4 shi4 zhe4 yang4
sentences.english: But many others say it isn't so.

sentences.hanzi: 小安的问题，到今天大家还在说。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 an1 de5 wen4 ti2 dao4 jin1 tian1 da4 jia1 hai2 zai4 shuo1
sentences.english: And people are still arguing about Xiao'an's question today.

glossed.meaning: Chang'an, the Tang capital, today's Xi'an

sentences.hanzi: 十一月十一号，有四个“一”。
sentences.pinyin: shi2 yi1 yue4 shi2 yi1 hao4 you3 si4 ge4 yi1
sentences.english: The eleventh of November has four ones in it.

sentences.hanzi: 在中国，有人说，“一”就是“一个人”的意思。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 zhong1 guo2 you3 ren2 shuo1 yi1 jiu4 shi4 yi1 ge5 ren2 de5 yi4 si5
sentences.english: In China, some people say each "one" stands for a person on their own.

sentences.hanzi: 所以，这一天叫“光棍节”。
sentences.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 yi1 tian1 jiao4 guang1 gun4 jie2
sentences.english: So this day is called "Singles' Day".

sentences.hanzi: 听说，光棍节是很多年前南京的大学生开始过的。
sentences.pinyin: ting1 shuo1 guang1 gun4 jie2 shi4 hen3 duo1 nian2 qian2 nan2 jing1 de5 da4 xue2 sheng1 kai1 shi3 guo4 de5
sentences.english: They say Singles' Day was started many years ago by university students in Nanjing.

sentences.hanzi: 从二零零九年开始，光棍节也成了大家网购的一天。
sentences.pinyin: cong2 er4 ling2 ling2 jiu3 nian2 kai1 shi3 guang1 gun4 jie2 ye3 cheng2 le5 da4 jia1 wang3 gou4 de5 yi1 tian1
sentences.english: Since 2009, Singles' Day has also been a day when everyone shops online.

sentences.hanzi: 很多东西都打折，特价的东西也很多，大家都在买买买。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 dong1 xi5 dou1 da3 zhe2 te4 jia4 de5 dong1 xi5 ye3 hen3 duo1 da4 jia1 dou1 zai4 mai3 mai3 mai3
sentences.english: Lots of things are discounted, there are lots of special offers, and everyone buys, buys, buys.

sentences.hanzi: 小王一个人住。他想：一个人过光棍节，也要对自己好一点。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 wang2 yi1 ge5 ren2 zhu4 ta1 xiang3 yi1 ge5 ren2 guo4 guang1 gun4 jie2 ye3 yao4 dui4 zi4 ji3 hao3 yi1 dian3
sentences.english: Xiao Wang lived alone. He thought: even spending Singles' Day alone, I should treat myself.

sentences.hanzi: 十一月十一号，他网购了两件衣服、三个包，还有很多吃的。
sentences.pinyin: shi2 yi1 yue4 shi2 yi1 hao4 ta1 wang3 gou4 le5 liang3 jian4 yi1 fu5 san1 ge4 bao1 hai2 you3 hen3 duo1 chi1 de5
sentences.english: On the eleventh of November he bought two pieces of clothing, three bags and lots of snacks online.

sentences.hanzi: 他觉得自己很会省钱：这些都是打折的！
sentences.pinyin: ta1 jue2 de5 zi4 ji3 hen3 hui4 sheng3 qian2 zhe4 xie1 dou1 shi4 da3 zhe2 de5
sentences.english: He felt he was very good at saving money: it was all on discount!

sentences.hanzi: 可是一共花了多少钱？他不敢算。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 yi1 gong4 hua1 le5 duo1 shao5 qian2 ta1 bu4 gan3 suan4
sentences.english: But how much had he spent in total? He didn't dare work it out.

sentences.hanzi: 几天以后，他买的东西都到了，放在大门旁边。
sentences.pinyin: ji3 tian1 yi3 hou4 ta1 mai3 de5 dong1 xi5 dou1 dao4 le5 fang4 zai4 da4 men2 pang2 bian1
sentences.english: A few days later all his things arrived and were left beside the main entrance.

sentences.hanzi: 小王去拿，看到一个女孩也在拿她的东西。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 wang2 qu4 na2 kan4 dao4 yi1 ge5 nu:3 hai2 ye3 zai4 na2 ta1 de5 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: Xiao Wang went to collect them and saw a girl also collecting her things.

sentences.hanzi: 她买的东西，比他的还多。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 mai3 de5 dong1 xi5 bi3 ta1 de5 hai2 duo1
sentences.english: She had bought even more than he had.

sentences.hanzi: 东西太多了，两个人就一起帮忙拿。
sentences.pinyin: dong1 xi5 tai4 duo1 le5 liang3 ge4 ren2 jiu4 yi1 qi3 bang1 mang2 na2
sentences.english: There was too much, so the two of them helped each other carry it all.

sentences.hanzi: 女孩说：“我也是一个人过光棍节。”
sentences.pinyin: nu:3 hai2 shuo1 wo3 ye3 shi4 yi1 ge5 ren2 guo4 guang1 gun4 jie2
sentences.english: The girl said: "I'm spending Singles' Day alone too."

sentences.hanzi: 小王说：“我知道。我就住在你对面，三年了。”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 wang2 shuo1 wo3 zhi1 dao4 wo3 jiu4 zhu4 zai4 ni3 dui4 mian4 san1 nian2 le5
sentences.english: Xiao Wang said: "I know. I've lived across the hall from you for three years."

sentences.hanzi: 第二年的十一月十一号，他们没有过光棍节。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 nian2 de5 shi2 yi1 yue4 shi2 yi1 hao4 ta1 men5 mei2 you3 guo4 guang1 gun4 jie2
sentences.english: On the eleventh of November the next year, they didn't celebrate Singles' Day.

sentences.hanzi: 可是他们还是一起网购了，买得更多。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ta1 men5 hai2 shi5 yi1 qi3 wang3 gou4 le5 mai3 de5 geng4 duo1
sentences.english: But they still shopped online together, and bought even more.

glossed.meaning: Nanjing, a city in eastern China

title: 火星上的超市
titlePinyin: huo3 xing1 shang4 de5 chao1 shi4

sentences.hanzi: 二一五零年，李远坐了六个月的飞船，到了火星。
sentences.pinyin: er4 yi1 wu3 ling2 nian2 li3 yuan3 zuo4 le5 liu4 ge4 yue4 de5 fei1 chuan2 dao4 le5 huo3 xing1
sentences.english: In 2150, after six months on a spaceship, Li Yuan arrived on Mars.

sentences.hanzi: 他很想喝水，看到前面有一家超市，就走了进去。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 hen3 xiang3 he1 shui3 kan4 dao4 qian2 mian4 you3 yi1 jia1 chao1 shi4 jiu4 zou3 le5 jin4 qu4
sentences.english: He badly wanted a drink of water. He saw a supermarket ahead and walked in.

sentences.hanzi: 超市里东西不多，价格也很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: chao1 shi4 li3 dong1 xi5 bu4 duo1 jia4 ge2 ye3 hen3 qi2 guai4
sentences.english: There weren't many things in the supermarket, and the prices were strange too.

sentences.hanzi: 一个水果：一杯水。一件衣服：十杯水。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 shui3 guo3 yi1 bei1 shui3 yi1 jian4 yi1 fu5 shi2 bei1 shui3
sentences.english: One piece of fruit: one cup of water. One piece of clothing: ten cups of water.

sentences.hanzi: 李远想买一杯水，他问售货员：“多少钱？”
sentences.pinyin: li3 yuan3 xiang3 mai3 yi1 bei1 shui3 ta1 wen4 shou4 huo4 yuan2 duo1 shao5 qian2
sentences.english: Li Yuan wanted to buy a cup of water. He asked the sales assistant: "How much?"

sentences.hanzi: 售货员是一个机器人，它说：“一杯水，一杯水。”
sentences.pinyin: shou4 huo4 yuan2 shi4 yi1 ge5 ji1 qi4 ren2 ta1 shuo1 yi1 bei1 shui3 yi1 bei1 shui3
sentences.english: The sales assistant was a robot. It said: "A cup of water costs a cup of water."

sentences.hanzi: “我没有水。我可以刷卡吗？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 mei2 you3 shui3 wo3 ke3 yi3 shua1 ka3 ma5
sentences.english: "I don't have any water. Can I pay by card?"

sentences.hanzi: “地球的银行卡，在火星上没有用。”
sentences.pinyin: di4 qiu2 de5 yin2 hang2 ka3 zai4 huo3 xing1 shang4 mei2 you3 yong4
sentences.english: "Earth bank cards are no use on Mars."

sentences.hanzi: 李远拿出钱包：“现金呢？我有美元，也有人民币。”
sentences.pinyin: li3 yuan3 na2 chu1 qian2 bao1 xian4 jin1 ne5 wo3 you3 mei3 yuan2 ye3 you3 ren2 min2 bi4
sentences.english: Li Yuan took out his wallet: "What about cash? I have US dollars, and renminbi too."

sentences.hanzi: 机器人说：“在火星上，这些钱什么也买不了。”
sentences.pinyin: ji1 qi4 ren2 shuo1 zai4 huo3 xing1 shang4 zhe4 xie1 qian2 shen2 me5 ye3 mai3 bu5 liao3
sentences.english: The robot said: "On Mars, that money can't buy anything."

sentences.hanzi: 李远说：“那我可以用什么付？”
sentences.pinyin: li3 yuan3 shuo1 na4 wo3 ke3 yi3 yong4 shen2 me5 fu4
sentences.english: Li Yuan said: "Then what can I pay with?"

sentences.hanzi: 机器人说：“你的包里还有什么东西？”
sentences.pinyin: ji1 qi4 ren2 shuo1 ni3 de5 bao1 li3 hai2 you3 shen2 me5 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: The robot said: "What else is in your bag?"

sentences.hanzi: 李远看了看包里，只有几个小袋子。
sentences.pinyin: li3 yuan3 kan4 le5 kan4 bao1 li3 zhi3 you3 ji3 ge4 xiao3 dai4 zi5
sentences.english: Li Yuan looked in his bag. There were only a few little packets.

sentences.hanzi: 那是妈妈给他的种子，是她家门前那些花的种子。
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi4 ma1 ma5 gei3 ta1 de5 zhong3 zi5 shi4 ta1 jia1 men2 qian2 na4 xie1 hua1 de5 zhong3 zi5
sentences.english: They were seeds his mother had given him, from the flowers outside her door.

sentences.hanzi: 机器人看了很久，说：“这些种子，可以换一百杯水。”
sentences.pinyin: ji1 qi4 ren2 kan4 le5 hen3 jiu3 shuo1 zhe4 xie1 zhong3 zi5 ke3 yi3 huan4 yi1 bai3 bei1 shui3
sentences.english: The robot looked for a long time, then said: "These seeds can be exchanged for a hundred cups of water."

sentences.hanzi: 李远想了想，只给了它一个袋子。
sentences.pinyin: li3 yuan3 xiang3 le5 xiang3 zhi3 gei3 le5 ta1 yi1 ge5 dai4 zi5
sentences.english: Li Yuan thought about it, and gave it just one packet.

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“别的，我要自己种。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 bie2 de5 wo3 yao4 zi4 ji3 zhong4
sentences.english: He said: "The rest I'm going to plant myself."

sentences.hanzi: 在地球上，钱可以买东西。在火星上，东西才是钱。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 di4 qiu2 shang4 qian2 ke3 yi3 mai3 dong1 xi5 zai4 huo3 xing1 shang4 dong1 xi5 cai2 shi4 qian2
sentences.english: On Earth, money buys things. On Mars, things are the money.

title: 你是什么垃圾
titlePinyin: ni3 shi4 shen2 me5 la1 ji1
titleEnglish: What Kind of Rubbish Are You?

sentences.hanzi: 二零一九年，上海有了一个新的法律：垃圾不能放在一起了。
sentences.pinyin: er4 ling2 yi1 jiu3 nian2 shang4 hai3 you3 le5 yi1 ge5 xin1 de5 fa3 lu:4 la1 ji1 bu4 neng2 fang4 zai4 yi1 qi3 le5
sentences.english: In 2019, Shanghai got a new law: rubbish could no longer all go in together.

sentences.hanzi: 现在，垃圾有四种，要放在四个地方，不这样做，就是违法。
sentences.pinyin: xian4 zai4 la1 ji1 you3 si4 zhong3 yao4 fang4 zai4 si4 ge4 di4 fang5 bu4 zhe4 yang4 zuo4 jiu4 shi4 wei2 fa3
sentences.english: Now there were four kinds of rubbish, each going in its own place, and not doing it was against the law.

sentences.hanzi: 小李一个人住，从来不管这些。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 li3 yi1 ge5 ren2 zhu4 cong2 lai2 bu4 guan3 zhe4 xie1
sentences.english: Xiao Li lived alone and had never bothered about any of this.

sentences.hanzi: 这天晚上，他拿着很多垃圾下来。

sentences.hanzi: 他也成了这里的志愿者。

sentences.pinyin: xiao3 li3 ma3 shang4 wen4 ni3 shi4 shen2 me5 la1 ji1
sentences.english: Xiao Li asked straight away, "What kind of rubbish are you?"

sentences.english: In 2020, a herd of more than a dozen elephants in Yunnan left their home.

sentences.english: They walked north, and nobody knew where they were going.

sentences.hanzi: 一年多以后，大象走了五百多公里，到了昆明。

sentences.english: More than a year later, they had walked over five hundred kilometres and reached Kunming.

sentences.hanzi: 这件事成了全球的新闻。

sentences.english: It became world news.

sentences.hanzi: 很多人天天第一件事，就是看大象的消息。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 ren2 tian1 tian1 di4 yi1 jian4 shi4 jiu4 shi4 kan4 da4 xiang4 de5 xiao1 xi5
sentences.english: For many people, the first thing they did every day was check the news about the elephants.

sentences.pinyin: da4 xiang4 zou3 jin4 nong2 cun1 chi1 le5 ren2 men5 di4 li3 de5 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: The elephants walked into villages and ate people's crops.

sentences.hanzi: 大象也走进了城市，在城市里走来走去。
sentences.pinyin: da4 xiang4 ye3 zou3 jin4 le5 cheng2 shi4 zai4 cheng2 shi4 li3 zou3 lai2 zou3 qu4
sentences.english: They walked into towns too, wandering this way and that.

sentences.hanzi: 为了安全，警察和很多人天天看着大象。
sentences.pinyin: wei4 le5 an1 quan2 jing3 cha2 he2 hen3 duo1 ren2 tian1 tian1 kan4 zhe5 da4 xiang4
sentences.english: To keep everyone safe, police and many others watched them day after day.

sentences.hanzi: 他们让人们不要出来，让大象先走。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 rang4 ren2 men5 bu4 yao4 chu1 lai2 rang4 da4 xiang4 xian1 zou3
sentences.english: They told people to stay inside and let the elephants go first.

sentences.hanzi: 有一天，人们从天上看到，大象们都睡在一起。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 ren2 men5 cong2 tian1 shang4 kan4 dao4 da4 xiang4 men5 dou1 shui4 zai4 yi1 qi3
sentences.english: One day, people watching from the sky saw the elephants all asleep together.

sentences.hanzi: 很多国家的人都看到了。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 guo2 jia1 de5 ren2 dou1 kan4 dao4 le5
sentences.english: People in many countries saw it.

sentences.hanzi: 大象为什么要走？
sentences.pinyin: da4 xiang4 wei4 shen2 me5 yao4 zou3
sentences.english: Why did they set off?

sentences.hanzi: 有人说，是因为大象的家变小了，吃的东西没有以前多了。
sentences.pinyin: you3 ren2 shuo1 shi4 yin1 wei4 da4 xiang4 de5 jia1 bian4 xiao3 le5 chi1 de5 dong1 xi5 mei2 you3 yi3 qian2 duo1 le5
sentences.english: Some said it was because their home had shrunk and there was less to eat than before.

sentences.hanzi: 到现在，也没有人能说清楚。
sentences.pinyin: dao4 xian4 zai4 ye3 mei2 you3 ren2 neng2 shuo1 qing1 chu5
sentences.english: To this day, nobody can say for sure.

sentences.hanzi: 二零二一年八月，大象们开始向南走，回家了。
sentences.pinyin: er4 ling2 er4 yi1 nian2 ba1 yue4 da4 xiang4 men5 kai1 shi3 xiang4 nan2 zou3 hui2 jia1 le5
sentences.english: In August 2021, the elephants began walking south, heading home.

sentences.english: Alan was one of them. She was twenty.

sentences.english: But by spring, very few of the trees had survived.
