sentences.english: I tried very hard, but all the children were watching me.

sentences.hanzi: 一个小女孩说：“你做错了！先动右手，再动左手！你要多练习！”
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 xiao3 nu:3 hai2 shuo1 ni3 zuo4 cuo4 le5 xian1 dong4 you4 shou3 zai4 dong4 zuo3 shou3 ni3 yao4 duo1 lian4 xi2
sentences.english: A little girl said: "You're doing it wrong! Right hand first, then the left! You need more practice!"

glossed.meaning: radio exercises, exercises done to a broadcast

sentences.hanzi: 我来中国以前，在网上看到：在中国，什么都可以用手机。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 lai2 zhong1 guo2 yi3 qian2 zai4 wang3 shang4 kan4 dao4 zai4 zhong1 guo2 shen2 me5 dou1 ke3 yi3 yong4 shou3 ji1
sentences.english: Before I came to China, I read online that in China you can do everything with your phone.

sentences.hanzi: 来了以后，我发现真是这样。
sentences.pinyin: lai2 le5 yi3 hou4 wo3 fa1 xian4 zhen1 shi4 zhe4 yang4
sentences.english: After I arrived, I found it really was true.

sentences.hanzi: 坐车、买东西、吃东西，都是扫一下二维码就行。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 che1 mai3 dong1 xi5 chi1 dong1 xi5 dou1 shi4 sao3 yi1 xia4 er4 wei2 ma3 jiu4 xing2
sentences.english: Taking the bus, shopping, eating out: you just scan a QR code and that's it.

sentences.hanzi: 三个月了，我身上从来不带钱。
sentences.pinyin: san1 ge4 yue4 le5 wo3 shen1 shang5 cong2 lai2 bu4 dai4 qian2
sentences.english: For three months, I never carried any cash.

sentences.hanzi: 一天晚上，我在一个小饭馆吃东西。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 tian1 wan3 shang5 wo3 zai4 yi1 ge5 xiao3 fan4 guan3 chi1 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: One evening, I was eating at a little restaurant.

sentences.hanzi: 吃完以后，我拿出手机，想扫二维码。
sentences.pinyin: chi1 wan2 yi3 hou4 wo3 na2 chu1 shou3 ji1 xiang3 sao3 er4 wei2 ma3
sentences.english: When I finished, I took out my phone to scan the QR code.

sentences.hanzi: 可是，手机没电了，屏幕上什么都没有。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 shou3 ji1 mei2 dian4 le5 ping2 mu4 shang4 shen2 me5 dou1 mei2 you3
sentences.english: But my phone had died. There was nothing on the screen.

sentences.hanzi: 没有电，我不能上网，也不能扫二维码。
sentences.pinyin: mei2 you3 dian4 wo3 bu4 neng2 shang4 wang3 ye3 bu4 neng2 sao3 er4 wei2 ma3
sentences.english: With no power, I couldn't go online or scan the code.

sentences.hanzi: 我身上没有钱，也没有带充电宝。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shen1 shang5 mei2 you3 qian2 ye3 mei2 you3 dai4 chong1 dian4 bao3
sentences.english: I had no cash on me, and I hadn't brought a power bank.

sentences.hanzi: 饭馆的老先生走过来，看了看我。
sentences.pinyin: fan4 guan3 de5 lao3 xian1 sheng5 zou3 guo4 lai5 kan4 le5 kan4 wo3
sentences.english: The old man who ran the restaurant came over and looked at me.

sentences.hanzi: 我说：“对不起，我的手机没电了。我明天再来给你钱，可以吗？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 dui4 bu5 qi3 wo3 de5 shou3 ji1 mei2 dian4 le5 wo3 ming2 tian1 zai4 lai2 gei3 ni3 qian2 ke3 yi3 ma5
sentences.english: I said: "Sorry, my phone has died. Can I come back tomorrow and pay you?"

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“别担心，你先坐，给手机充电。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 bie2 dan1 xin1 ni3 xian1 zuo4 gei3 shou3 ji1 chong1 dian4
sentences.english: He said: "Don't worry. Have a seat and charge your phone."

sentences.hanzi: 二十分钟以后，手机又可以用了。
sentences.pinyin: er4 shi2 fen1 zhong1 yi3 hou4 shou3 ji1 you4 ke3 yi3 yong4 le5
sentences.english: Twenty minutes later, the phone worked again.

sentences.hanzi: 我说：“好了！我现在就扫！”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 hao3 le5 wo3 xian4 zai4 jiu4 sao3
sentences.english: I said: "OK! I'll scan right now!"

sentences.hanzi: 老先生说：“扫什么？你看看，我这里有二维码吗？”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 xian1 sheng5 shuo1 sao3 shen2 me5 ni3 kan4 kan5 wo3 zhe4 li3 you3 er4 wei2 ma3 ma5
sentences.english: The old man said: "Scan what? Take a look. Do I have a QR code here?"

sentences.hanzi: 我找了找，真是没有。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 zhao3 le5 zhao3 zhen1 shi4 mei2 you3
sentences.english: I looked around. There really wasn't one.

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“我这里不扫二维码，只要现金。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 wo3 zhe4 li3 bu4 sao3 er4 wei2 ma3 zhi3 yao4 xian4 jin1
sentences.english: He said: "There's no scanning here. Cash only."

sentences.hanzi: “那你为什么让我充电？”
sentences.pinyin: na4 ni3 wei4 shen2 me5 rang4 wo3 chong1 dian4
sentences.english: "Then why did you let me charge my phone?"

sentences.hanzi: “因为你好像非常担心。明天带钱来吧。”
sentences.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ni3 hao3 xiang4 fei1 chang2 dan1 xin1 ming2 tian1 dai4 qian2 lai2 ba5
sentences.english: "Because you looked so worried. Bring the money tomorrow."

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，我带了钱，也带了三个朋友。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 wo3 dai4 le5 qian2 ye3 dai4 le5 san1 ge4 peng2 you5
sentences.english: The next day, I brought the money, and three friends too.

sentences.hanzi: 我爸爸八岁的时候，听到过一首从太空来的歌。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 ba4 ba5 ba1 sui4 de5 shi2 hou5 ting1 dao4 guo5 yi1 shou3 cong2 tai4 kong1 lai2 de5 ge1
sentences.english: When my dad was eight, he heard a song that came from outer space.

sentences.hanzi: 一九七零年四月，中国的第一个卫星上了太空。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 jiu3 qi1 ling2 nian2 si4 yue4 zhong1 guo2 de5 di4 yi1 ge4 wei4 xing1 shang4 le5 tai4 kong1
sentences.english: In April 1970, China's first satellite went into space.

sentences.hanzi: 它的名字叫“东方红一号”。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 ming2 zi5 jiao4 dong1 fang1 hong2 yi1 hao4
sentences.english: Its name was Dong Fang Hong 1.

sentences.hanzi: 这个卫星不大，可是它会做一件特别的事情：放歌。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 wei4 xing1 bu4 da4 ke3 shi4 ta1 hui4 zuo4 yi1 jian4 te4 bie2 de5 shi4 qing5 fang4 ge1
sentences.english: The satellite wasn't big, but it could do something special: play a song.

sentences.hanzi: 工程师在卫星里放了一个小小的机器。
sentences.pinyin: gong1 cheng2 shi1 zai4 wei4 xing1 li3 fang4 le5 yi1 ge5 xiao3 xiao3 de5 ji1 qi4
sentences.english: Engineers put a tiny machine inside the satellite.

sentences.hanzi: 卫星在太空里的时候，这个机器一直放一首歌，叫“东方红”。
sentences.pinyin: wei4 xing1 zai4 tai4 kong1 li3 de5 shi2 hou5 zhe4 ge5 ji1 qi4 yi1 zhi2 fang4 yi1 shou3 ge1 jiao4 dong1 fang1 hong2
sentences.english: While the satellite was in space, the machine kept playing a song called "The East Is Red".

sentences.hanzi: 人们用收音机，就可以听到它。
sentences.pinyin: ren2 men5 yong4 shou1 yin1 ji1 jiu4 ke3 yi3 ting1 dao4 ta1
sentences.english: People could hear it on the radio.

sentences.hanzi: 工程师和科学家们用了很多年研究这个卫星，也研究送它上天的火箭。
sentences.pinyin: gong1 cheng2 shi1 he2 ke1 xue2 jia1 men5 yong4 le5 hen3 duo1 nian2 yan2 jiu1 zhe4 ge5 wei4 xing1 ye3 yan2 jiu1 song4 ta1 shang4 tian1 de5 huo3 jian4
sentences.english: Engineers and scientists spent years working on this satellite, and on the rocket that sent it up.

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸说，那时候，他和朋友们晚上总是站在门前，看着天上。
sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 shuo1 na4 shi2 hou5 ta1 he2 peng2 you5 men5 wan3 shang5 zong3 shi4 zhan4 zai4 men2 qian2 kan4 zhe5 tian1 shang4
sentences.english: Dad says that back then, he and his friends always stood in front of their homes at night, looking at the sky.

sentences.hanzi: 他们都想知道：哪一个是我们的卫星？
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 dou1 xiang3 zhi1 dao4 na3 yi1 ge5 shi4 wo3 men5 de5 wei4 xing1
sentences.english: They all wanted to know: which one is our satellite?

sentences.hanzi: 二十多天以后，卫星的电池没电了，歌也停了。
sentences.pinyin: er4 shi2 duo1 tian1 yi3 hou4 wei4 xing1 de5 dian4 chi2 mei2 dian4 le5 ge1 ye3 ting2 le5
sentences.english: About twenty days later, the satellite's batteries ran out and the song stopped.

sentences.hanzi: 可是卫星没有掉下来。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 wei4 xing1 mei2 you3 diao4 xia4 lai5
sentences.english: But the satellite didn't fall down.

sentences.hanzi: 五十多年过去了，它还在太空里。
sentences.pinyin: wu3 shi2 duo1 nian2 guo4 qu4 le5 ta1 hai2 zai4 tai4 kong1 li3
sentences.english: More than fifty years later, it's still up in space.

sentences.hanzi: 现在，爸爸晚上还会站在门前，看看天上。
sentences.pinyin: xian4 zai4 ba4 ba5 wan3 shang5 hai2 hui4 zhan4 zai4 men2 qian2 kan4 kan5 tian1 shang4
sentences.english: Even now, Dad still stands outside his door at night and looks up at the sky.

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“它还在那里，只是不放歌了。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 ta1 hai2 zai4 na4 li5 zhi3 shi4 bu4 fang4 ge1 le5
sentences.english: He says: "It's still up there. It just doesn't play the song anymore."

glossed.meaning: Dong Fang Hong 1, China's first satellite

title: 没有网络的一天
titlePinyin: mei2 you3 wang3 luo4 de5 yi1 tian1

sentences.hanzi: 这是未来，二零九零年。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 wei4 lai2 er4 ling2 jiu3 ling2 nian2
sentences.english: This is the future: the year 2090.

sentences.hanzi: 现在，大家已经没有手机了。
sentences.pinyin: xian4 zai4 da4 jia1 yi3 jing1 mei2 you3 shou3 ji1 le5
sentences.english: Nowadays, nobody has a phone anymore.

sentences.hanzi: 每个人的头里都有一个小小的电脑。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 ge5 ren2 de5 tou2 li3 dou1 you3 yi1 ge5 xiao3 xiao3 de5 dian4 nao3
sentences.english: Everyone has a tiny computer in their head.

sentences.hanzi: 你想知道什么，信息就自动出现了。
sentences.pinyin: ni3 xiang3 zhi1 dao4 shen2 me5 xin4 xi1 jiu4 zi4 dong4 chu1 xian4 le5
sentences.english: Whatever you want to know, the information just appears automatically.

sentences.hanzi: 有一天，网络停了。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 wang3 luo4 ting2 le5
sentences.english: One day, the internet stopped.

sentences.hanzi: 不是一个地方，是整个世界。
sentences.pinyin: bu4 shi4 yi1 ge5 di4 fang5 shi4 zheng3 ge4 shi4 jie4
sentences.english: Not in one place, but in the whole world.

sentences.hanzi: 工程师们说：“系统出了问题，可能需要一天。”
sentences.pinyin: gong1 cheng2 shi1 men5 shuo1 xi4 tong3 chu1 le5 wen4 ti2 ke3 neng2 xu1 yao4 yi1 tian1
sentences.english: The engineers said: "There's a problem with the system. It may take a day."

sentences.hanzi: 一开始，大家都非常担心。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 kai1 shi3 da4 jia1 dou1 fei1 chang2 dan1 xin1
sentences.english: At first, everyone was very worried.

sentences.hanzi: 没有网络，人们不知道车几点来，不知道朋友在哪里。
sentences.pinyin: mei2 you3 wang3 luo4 ren2 men5 bu4 zhi1 dao4 che1 ji3 dian3 lai2 bu4 zhi1 dao4 peng2 you5 zai4 na3 li3
sentences.english: Without the internet, people didn't know when the bus would come, or where their friends were.

sentences.hanzi: 他们必须走着去，必须问别人。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 bi4 xu1 zou3 zhe5 qu4 bi4 xu1 wen4 bie2 ren5
sentences.english: They had to walk, and had to ask other people.

sentences.hanzi: 孩子们跑出去玩，老人坐在门前说话。
sentences.pinyin: hai2 zi5 men5 pao3 chu1 qu4 wan2 lao3 ren2 zuo4 zai4 men2 qian2 shuo1 hua4
sentences.english: The children ran outside to play, and old people sat in their doorways talking.

sentences.hanzi: 很多人第一次认识了住在自己旁边的人。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 ren2 di4 yi1 ci4 ren4 shi5 le5 zhu4 zai4 zi4 ji3 pang2 bian1 de5 ren2
sentences.english: Many people met their neighbours for the first time.

sentences.hanzi: 晚上，网络又回来了。
sentences.pinyin: wan3 shang5 wang3 luo4 you4 hui2 lai5 le5
sentences.english: That evening, the internet came back.

sentences.hanzi: 可是第二天，很多人给工程师们写了信息：
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 di4 er4 tian1 hen3 duo1 ren2 gei3 gong1 cheng2 shi1 men5 xie3 le5 xin4 xi1
sentences.english: But the next day, many people sent messages to the engineers:

sentences.hanzi: “我们可以再要一天没有网络的日子吗？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 zai4 yao4 yi1 tian1 mei2 you3 wang3 luo4 de5 ri4 zi5 ma5
sentences.english: "Can we have another day without the internet?"

sentences.hanzi: 现在，每一年的这一天，网络都会停。
sentences.pinyin: xian4 zai4 mei3 yi1 nian2 de5 zhe4 yi1 tian1 wang3 luo4 dou1 hui4 ting2
sentences.english: Now, on this day every year, the internet stops.

sentences.hanzi: 大家说，这是一个新的节日。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 shuo1 zhe4 shi4 yi1 ge5 xin1 de5 jie2 ri4
sentences.english: People say it's a new holiday.

sentences.hanzi: 没有人知道，网络停下来，是不是工程师们自己做的。
sentences.pinyin: mei2 you3 ren2 zhi1 dao4 wang3 luo4 ting2 xia4 lai5 shi4 bu4 shi4 gong1 cheng2 shi1 men5 zi4 ji3 zuo4 de5
sentences.english: Nobody knows whether the engineers stopped the internet themselves.

title: 在海边看火箭
titlePinyin: zai4 hai3 bian1 kan4 huo3 jian4

sentences.hanzi: 很多人去海南，是为了在海边玩。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 ren2 qu4 hai3 nan2 shi4 wei4 le5 zai4 hai3 bian1 wan2
sentences.english: Many people go to Hainan to have fun on the beach.

sentences.hanzi: 可是在海南的文昌，有些人来海边，是为了看火箭。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zai4 hai3 nan2 de5 wen2 chang1 you3 xie1 ren2 lai2 hai3 bian1 shi4 wei4 le5 kan4 huo3 jian4
sentences.english: But in Wenchang, in Hainan, some people come to the beach to watch rockets.

sentences.hanzi: 文昌的火箭发射场，就在海边。
sentences.pinyin: wen2 chang1 de5 huo3 jian4 fa1 she4 chang3 jiu4 zai4 hai3 bian1
sentences.english: Wenchang's rocket launch site is right by the sea.

sentences.hanzi: 它是中国第一个在海边的发射场。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shi4 zhong1 guo2 di4 yi1 ge4 zai4 hai3 bian1 de5 fa1 she4 chang3
sentences.english: It was China's first launch site on the coast.

sentences.hanzi: 每一次有火箭要上太空，很多人就从别的地方来这里。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 yi1 ci4 you3 huo3 jian4 yao4 shang4 tai4 kong1 hen3 duo1 ren2 jiu4 cong2 bie2 de5 di4 fang5 lai2 zhe4 li3
sentences.english: Every time a rocket is going up into space, lots of people come here from other places.

sentences.hanzi: 他们坐在海边，拿着手机，等着。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 zuo4 zai4 hai3 bian1 na2 zhe5 shou3 ji1 deng3 zhe5
sentences.english: They sit on the beach, holding their phones, waiting.

sentences.hanzi: 这一天，我也来了。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 tian1 wo3 ye3 lai2 le5
sentences.english: That day, I came too.

sentences.hanzi: 我旁边是一个小女孩和她的爸爸。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 pang2 bian1 shi4 yi1 ge5 xiao3 nu:3 hai2 he2 ta1 de5 ba4 ba5
sentences.english: Next to me were a little girl and her dad.

sentences.hanzi: 女孩问：“爸爸，火箭上有人吗？”
sentences.pinyin: nu:3 hai2 wen4 ba4 ba5 huo3 jian4 shang4 you3 ren2 ma5
sentences.english: The girl asked: "Dad, are there people on the rocket?"

sentences.hanzi: “没有，今天的火箭带的是卫星。”
sentences.pinyin: mei2 you3 jin1 tian1 de5 huo3 jian4 dai4 de5 shi4 wei4 xing1
sentences.english: "No. Today's rocket is carrying a satellite."

sentences.hanzi: “卫星去太空做什么？”
sentences.pinyin: wei4 xing1 qu4 tai4 kong1 zuo4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: "What does the satellite do in space?"

sentences.hanzi: “做科学研究，看天气，帮我们找路，也帮你的手机上网。”
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 ke1 xue2 yan2 jiu1 kan4 tian1 qi4 bang1 wo3 men5 zhao3 lu4 ye3 bang1 ni3 de5 shou3 ji1 shang4 wang3
sentences.english: "It does scientific research, watches the weather, helps us find our way, and helps your phone go online."

sentences.hanzi: 我们等了很久。最后，大家一起说：“十，九，八……”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 deng3 le5 hen3 jiu3 zui4 hou4 da4 jia1 yi1 qi3 shuo1 shi2 jiu3 ba1
sentences.english: We waited a long time. Finally, everyone counted together: "Ten, nine, eight..."

sentences.hanzi: 火箭上天了，速度非常快。
sentences.pinyin: huo3 jian4 shang4 tian1 le5 su4 du4 fei1 chang2 kuai4
sentences.english: The rocket went up, very fast.

sentences.hanzi: 很快，它就变成了天上的一个小点。
sentences.pinyin: hen3 kuai4 ta1 jiu4 bian4 cheng2 le5 tian1 shang4 de5 yi1 ge5 xiao3 dian3
sentences.english: Soon it became a tiny dot in the sky.

sentences.hanzi: 女孩一直看着天上，然后说：“爸爸，我以后要做工程师。”
sentences.pinyin: nu:3 hai2 yi1 zhi2 kan4 zhe5 tian1 shang4 ran2 hou4 shuo1 ba4 ba5 wo3 yi3 hou4 yao4 zuo4 gong1 cheng2 shi1
sentences.english: The girl kept looking at the sky, then said: "Dad, I'm going to be an engineer when I grow up."

sentences.hanzi: 她爸爸说：“好啊。那你先别玩手机了。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 ba4 ba5 shuo1 hao3 a5 na4 ni3 xian1 bie2 wan2 shou3 ji1 le5
sentences.english: Her dad said: "Great. Then put your phone down first."

glossed.meaning: Hainan, an island province in southern China

title: 会说老家话的机器人
titlePinyin: hui4 shuo1 lao3 jia1 hua4 de5 ji1 qi4 ren2
titleEnglish: The Robot That Spoke the Old Dialect

sentences.hanzi: 小林是一个工程师，她设计机器人。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 lin2 shi4 yi1 ge5 gong1 cheng2 shi1 ta1 she4 ji4 ji1 qi4 ren2
sentences.english: Xiao Lin is an engineer. She designs robots.

sentences.hanzi: 她的奶奶一个人住在很远的老家。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 nai3 nai5 yi1 ge5 ren2 zhu4 zai4 hen3 yuan3 de5 lao3 jia1
sentences.english: Her grandmother lives alone, far away in their family's home village.

sentences.hanzi: 小林很担心，就给奶奶送去一个人工智能机器人。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 lin2 hen3 dan1 xin1 jiu4 gei3 nai3 nai5 song4 qu4 yi1 ge5 ren2 gong1 zhi4 neng2 ji1 qi4 ren2
sentences.english: Xiao Lin worried, so she sent her grandmother an AI robot.

sentences.hanzi: 可是奶奶不喜欢它。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 nai3 nai5 bu4 xi3 huan5 ta1
sentences.english: But Grandma didn't like it.

sentences.hanzi: “它说什么，我听不懂。我说什么，它也听不懂。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 shen2 me5 wo3 ting1 bu4 dong3 wo3 shuo1 shen2 me5 ta1 ye3 ting1 bu4 dong3
sentences.english: "I can't understand what it says, and it can't understand what I say."

sentences.hanzi: 奶奶只会说老家话。现在，会说这种话的人已经很少了。
sentences.pinyin: nai3 nai5 zhi3 hui4 shuo1 lao3 jia1 hua4 xian4 zai4 hui4 shuo1 zhe4 zhong3 hua4 de5 ren2 yi3 jing1 hen3 shao3 le5
sentences.english: Grandma only speaks the local dialect of her hometown. Very few people speak it now.

sentences.hanzi: 小林想了想，给机器人安装了一个新的程序。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 lin2 xiang3 le5 xiang3 gei3 ji1 qi4 ren2 an1 zhuang1 le5 yi1 ge5 xin1 de5 cheng2 xu4
sentences.english: Xiao Lin thought about it, and installed a new program on the robot.

sentences.hanzi: 从那以后，机器人每一天都听奶奶说话，学奶奶说话。
sentences.pinyin: cong2 na4 yi3 hou4 ji1 qi4 ren2 mei3 yi1 tian1 dou1 ting1 nai3 nai5 shuo1 hua4 xue2 nai3 nai5 shuo1 hua4
sentences.english: From that day on, the robot listened to Grandma and learned to talk like her every day.

sentences.hanzi: 奶奶给它讲以前的事情，讲老家的老故事。
sentences.pinyin: nai3 nai5 gei3 ta1 jiang3 yi3 qian2 de5 shi4 qing5 jiang3 lao3 jia1 de5 lao3 gu4 shi5
sentences.english: Grandma told it about the old days, and old stories from back home.

sentences.hanzi: 机器人把这些都保存下来，变成了很多很多数据。
sentences.pinyin: ji1 qi4 ren2 ba3 zhe4 xie1 dou1 bao3 cun2 xia4 lai5 bian4 cheng2 le5 hen3 duo1 hen3 duo1 shu4 ju4
sentences.english: The robot saved all of it, and it turned into lots and lots of data.

sentences.hanzi: 一年以后，机器人已经可以用老家话跟奶奶说话了。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 nian2 yi3 hou4 ji1 qi4 ren2 yi3 jing1 ke3 yi3 yong4 lao3 jia1 hua4 gen1 nai3 nai5 shuo1 hua4 le5
sentences.english: A year later, the robot could chat with Grandma in her dialect.

sentences.hanzi: 奶奶很高兴，说它比小林说得还好。
sentences.pinyin: nai3 nai5 hen3 gao1 xing4 shuo1 ta1 bi3 xiao3 lin2 shuo1 de5 hai2 hao3
sentences.english: Grandma was delighted, and said it spoke it even better than Xiao Lin.

sentences.hanzi: 又过了很多年，奶奶不在了。
sentences.pinyin: you4 guo4 le5 hen3 duo1 nian2 nai3 nai5 bu4 zai4 le5
sentences.english: Many years later, Grandma passed away.

sentences.hanzi: 小林的孩子问：“妈妈，你的奶奶以前是怎么说话的？”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 lin2 de5 hai2 zi5 wen4 ma1 ma5 ni3 de5 nai3 nai5 yi3 qian2 shi4 zen3 me5 shuo1 hua4 de5
sentences.english: Xiao Lin's child asked: "Mom, how did your grandma use to talk?"

sentences.hanzi: 小林不知道怎么说。她自己也只会说几句。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 lin2 bu4 zhi1 dao4 zen3 me5 shuo1 ta1 zi4 ji3 ye3 zhi3 hui4 shuo1 ji3 ju4
sentences.english: Xiao Lin didn't know what to say. She could only manage a few sentences herself.

sentences.hanzi: 这时候，机器人走过来，用奶奶的老家话说：
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 hou5 ji1 qi4 ren2 zou3 guo4 lai5 yong4 nai3 nai5 de5 lao3 jia1 hua4 shuo1
sentences.english: Just then, the robot walked over and said, in Grandma's dialect:

sentences.hanzi: “孩子，来，我给你讲一个老家的故事。”
sentences.pinyin: hai2 zi5 lai2 wo3 gei3 ni3 jiang3 yi1 ge5 lao3 jia1 de5 gu4 shi5
sentences.english: "Come here, child. Let me tell you a story from back home."

glossed.meaning: hometown, where one's family comes from

title: 爷爷的第二十个生日
titlePinyin: ye2 ye5 de5 di4 er4 shi2 ge4 sheng1 ri4

sentences.hanzi: 今天是二月二十九号，是爷爷的生日。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 shi4 er4 yue4 er4 shi2 jiu3 hao4 shi4 ye2 ye5 de5 sheng1 ri4
sentences.english: Today is the twenty-ninth of February, Grandpa's birthday.

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷今年八十岁了。
sentences.pinyin: ye2 ye5 jin1 nian2 ba1 shi2 sui4 le5
sentences.english: Grandpa is eighty this year.

sentences.hanzi: 可是爷爷说：“这是我的第二十个生日。”
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ye2 ye5 shuo1 zhe4 shi4 wo3 de5 di4 er4 shi2 ge4 sheng1 ri4
sentences.english: But Grandpa says: "This is my twentieth birthday."

sentences.hanzi: 我不明白：八十岁的人，怎么只过了二十个生日？
sentences.pinyin: wo3 bu4 ming2 bai5 ba1 shi2 sui4 de5 ren2 zen3 me5 zhi3 guo4 le5 er4 shi2 ge4 sheng1 ri4
sentences.english: I don't get it: how can an eighty-year-old have had only twenty birthdays?

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷说：“你去看看日历。”
sentences.pinyin: ye2 ye5 shuo1 ni3 qu4 kan4 kan5 ri4 li4
sentences.english: Grandpa says: "Go and look at the calendar."

sentences.hanzi: 我看了看去年的日历。二月只有二十八天，没有二十九号。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 kan4 le5 kan4 qu4 nian2 de5 ri4 li4 er4 yue4 zhi3 you3 er4 shi2 ba1 tian1 mei2 you3 er4 shi2 jiu3 hao4
sentences.english: I look at last year's calendar. February has only twenty-eight days. There's no twenty-ninth.

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷说：“四年才有一个二月二十九号。所以，我四年才过一次生日。”
sentences.pinyin: ye2 ye5 shuo1 si4 nian2 cai2 you3 yi1 ge5 er4 yue4 er4 shi2 jiu3 hao4 suo3 yi3 wo3 si4 nian2 cai2 guo4 yi1 ci4 sheng1 ri4
sentences.english: Grandpa says: "There's only a twenty-ninth of February every four years. So I only have a birthday every four years."

sentences.hanzi: 我算了一下：八十年，四年一次，就是二十次。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 suan4 le5 yi1 xia4 ba1 shi2 nian2 si4 nian2 yi1 ci4 jiu4 shi4 er4 shi2 ci4
sentences.english: I work it out: eighty years, once every four years, makes twenty.

sentences.hanzi: 我问：“那没有二十九号的年呢？你什么时候过生日？”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 wen4 na4 mei2 you3 er4 shi2 jiu3 hao4 de5 nian2 ne5 ni3 shen2 me5 shi2 hou5 guo4 sheng1 ri4
sentences.english: I ask: "What about the years with no twenty-ninth? When do you have your birthday?"

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷说：“你奶奶说二十八号过，我说三月一号过。”
sentences.pinyin: ye2 ye5 shuo1 ni3 nai3 nai5 shuo1 er4 shi2 ba1 hao4 guo4 wo3 shuo1 san1 yue4 yi1 hao4 guo4
sentences.english: Grandpa says: "Your grandma says the twenty-eighth, and I say the first of March."

sentences.hanzi: “我们说了五十年，到现在也没有说好。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 shuo1 le5 wu3 shi2 nian2 dao4 xian4 zai4 ye3 mei2 you3 shuo1 hao3
sentences.english: "We've argued about it for fifty years, and we still haven't settled it."

sentences.hanzi: 奶奶在旁边说：“今天别说了。今天就是你的生日。”
sentences.pinyin: nai3 nai5 zai4 pang2 bian1 shuo1 jin1 tian1 bie2 shuo1 le5 jin1 tian1 jiu4 shi4 ni3 de5 sheng1 ri4
sentences.english: Grandma says from beside him: "No arguing today. Today really is your birthday."

sentences.hanzi: 晚上，我们给爷爷做了一个大蛋糕。蛋糕上写着：二十岁！
sentences.pinyin: wan3 shang5 wo3 men5 gei3 ye2 ye5 zuo4 le5 yi1 ge5 da4 dan4 gao1 dan4 gao1 shang4 xie3 zhe5 er4 shi2 sui4
sentences.english: In the evening, we make Grandpa a big cake. On the cake it says: Twenty!

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷看了，非常高兴：“二十岁！我还是个孩子！”
sentences.pinyin: ye2 ye5 kan4 le5 fei1 chang2 gao1 xing4 er4 shi2 sui4 wo3 hai2 shi5 ge4 hai2 zi5
sentences.english: Grandpa sees it and is delighted: "Twenty! I'm still a kid!"

sentences.hanzi: 我也算了算：我今年二十四岁，已经过了二十四个生日。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 ye3 suan4 le5 suan4 wo3 jin1 nian2 er4 shi2 si4 sui4 yi3 jing1 guo4 le5 er4 shi2 si4 ge4 sheng1 ri4
sentences.english: I work it out for myself too: I'm twenty-four this year, and I've already had twenty-four birthdays.

sentences.hanzi: 我说：“爷爷，我的生日比你还多！”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 ye2 ye5 wo3 de5 sheng1 ri4 bi3 ni3 hai2 duo1
sentences.english: I say: "Grandpa, I've had more birthdays than you!"

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷说：“对啊。所以，蛋糕要让给小的吃。”
sentences.pinyin: ye2 ye5 shuo1 dui4 a5 suo3 yi3 dan4 gao1 yao4 rang4 gei3 xiao3 de5 chi1
sentences.english: Grandpa says: "That's right. So the cake goes to the little one."

sentences.hanzi: 除夕晚上十一点，汤姆有了一个孩子。
sentences.pinyin: chu2 xi1 wan3 shang5 shi2 yi1 dian3 tang1 mu3 you3 le5 yi1 ge5 hai2 zi5
sentences.english: At eleven o'clock on Chinese New Year's Eve, Tom became a father.

sentences.hanzi: 汤姆的妻子小梅是中国人。
sentences.pinyin: tang1 mu3 de5 qi1 zi5 xiao3 mei2 shi4 zhong1 guo2 ren2
sentences.english: Tom's wife, Xiaomei, is Chinese.

sentences.hanzi: 一个小时以后，就是春节了。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 xiao3 shi2 yi3 hou4 jiu4 shi4 chun1 jie2 le5
sentences.english: An hour later, it was Spring Festival.

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，小梅的妈妈来看孩子，非常高兴。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 xiao3 mei2 de5 ma1 ma5 lai2 kan4 hai2 zi5 fei1 chang2 gao1 xing4
sentences.english: The next day, Xiaomei's mother came to see the baby, absolutely delighted.

sentences.hanzi: 她说：“我们的孩子，今天两岁了！”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 wo3 men5 de5 hai2 zi5 jin1 tian1 liang3 sui4 le5
sentences.english: She said: "Our baby is two years old today!"

sentences.hanzi: 汤姆以为自己听错了：“两岁？她昨天晚上才来啊！”
sentences.pinyin: tang1 mu3 yi3 wei2 zi4 ji3 ting1 cuo4 le5 liang3 sui4 ta1 zuo2 tian1 wan3 shang5 cai2 lai2 a5
sentences.english: Tom thought he had misheard: "Two? She only arrived last night!"

sentences.hanzi: 小梅说：“中国人以前是这样算的，叫虚岁。”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 mei2 shuo1 zhong1 guo2 ren2 yi3 qian2 shi4 zhe4 yang4 suan4 de5 jiao4 xu1 sui4
sentences.english: Xiaomei said: "It's how Chinese people used to count age. It's called xusui."

sentences.hanzi: “孩子一来，就是一岁。”
sentences.pinyin: hai2 zi5 yi1 lai2 jiu4 shi4 yi1 sui4
sentences.english: "As soon as a baby arrives, it's one."

sentences.hanzi: “然后，每过一个春节，大家都多一岁。”
sentences.pinyin: ran2 hou4 mei3 guo4 yi1 ge5 chun1 jie2 da4 jia1 dou1 duo1 yi1 sui4
sentences.english: "Then, every time Spring Festival comes round, everyone gets a year older."

sentences.hanzi: “她昨天来，是一岁。今天是春节，又多了一岁，就是两岁。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo2 tian1 lai2 shi4 yi1 sui4 jin1 tian1 shi4 chun1 jie2 you4 duo1 le5 yi1 sui4 jiu4 shi4 liang3 sui4
sentences.english: "She came yesterday, so she was one. Today is Spring Festival, so she's a year older again: that makes two."

sentences.hanzi: 汤姆算了一下，问：“那我呢？”
sentences.pinyin: tang1 mu3 suan4 le5 yi1 xia4 wen4 na4 wo3 ne5
sentences.english: Tom did the sums and asked: "And me?"

sentences.hanzi: 小梅说：“你三十二，虚岁……三十四。”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 mei2 shuo1 ni3 san1 shi2 er4 xu1 sui4 san1 shi2 si4
sentences.english: Xiaomei said: "You're thirty-two. In xusui... thirty-four."

sentences.hanzi: 汤姆说：“可是我的生日在八月啊！我昨天三十二，今天三十四？一天老了两岁！”
sentences.pinyin: tang1 mu3 shuo1 ke3 shi4 wo3 de5 sheng1 ri4 zai4 ba1 yue4 a5 wo3 zuo2 tian1 san1 shi2 er4 jin1 tian1 san1 shi2 si4 yi1 tian1 lao3 le5 liang3 sui4
sentences.english: Tom said: "But my birthday's in August! Thirty-two yesterday and thirty-four today? Two years older in one day!"

sentences.hanzi: 小梅的妈妈说：“别担心，现在很多人不这样算了。”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 mei2 de5 ma1 ma5 shuo1 bie2 dan1 xin1 xian4 zai4 hen3 duo1 ren2 bu4 zhe4 yang4 suan4 le5
sentences.english: Xiaomei's mother said: "Don't worry, lots of people don't count like this any more."

sentences.hanzi: “可是在我们家，老人还是这样算。明年春节，她就三岁了。”
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zai4 wo3 men5 jia1 lao3 ren2 hai2 shi5 zhe4 yang4 suan4 ming2 nian2 chun1 jie2 ta1 jiu4 san1 sui4 le5
sentences.english: "But in our family, the old folks still do. Next Spring Festival, she'll be three."

sentences.hanzi: 汤姆看着孩子，说：“你好！我们才认识一天，你就两岁了。”
sentences.pinyin: tang1 mu3 kan4 zhe5 hai2 zi5 shuo1 ni3 hao3 wo3 men5 cai2 ren4 shi5 yi1 tian1 ni3 jiu4 liang3 sui4 le5
sentences.english: Tom looked at the baby and said: "Hello! We've only known each other a day, and you're already two."

glossed.meaning: xusui, the traditional Chinese way of counting age

sentences.hanzi: 现在是三点一刻。一刻是多长时间？
sentences.pinyin: xian4 zai4 shi4 san1 dian3 yi1 ke4 yi1 ke4 shi4 duo1 chang2 shi2 jian1
sentences.english: It's a quarter past three. How long is a ke, a quarter?

sentences.hanzi: 你一定会说：十五分钟。
sentences.pinyin: ni3 yi1 ding4 hui4 shuo1 shi2 wu3 fen1 zhong1
sentences.english: You'll certainly say: fifteen minutes.

sentences.hanzi: 可是在很长很长的时间里，一刻不是十五分钟。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zai4 hen3 chang2 hen3 chang2 de5 shi2 jian1 li3 yi1 ke4 bu4 shi4 shi2 wu3 fen1 zhong1
sentences.english: But for a very, very long time, a ke wasn't fifteen minutes.

sentences.hanzi: 两千多年以前，中国人的一天，有一百刻。
sentences.pinyin: liang3 qian1 duo1 nian2 yi3 qian2 zhong1 guo2 ren2 de5 yi1 tian1 you3 yi1 bai3 ke4
sentences.english: More than two thousand years ago, a Chinese day had a hundred ke.

sentences.hanzi: 我们来算一下：一天有二十四个小时，就是一千四百四十分钟。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 lai2 suan4 yi1 xia4 yi1 tian1 you3 er4 shi2 si4 ge4 xiao3 shi2 jiu4 shi4 yi1 qian1 si4 bai3 si4 shi2 fen1 zhong1
sentences.english: Let's work it out: a day has twenty-four hours, which is one thousand four hundred and forty minutes.

sentences.hanzi: 一千四百四十分钟，一百刻，所以一刻是十四分钟多一点。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 qian1 si4 bai3 si4 shi2 fen1 zhong1 yi1 bai3 ke4 suo3 yi3 yi1 ke4 shi4 shi2 si4 fen1 zhong1 duo1 yi1 dian3
sentences.english: One thousand four hundred and forty minutes, a hundred ke: so a ke was a little over fourteen minutes.

sentences.hanzi: 这样的一刻，中国人用了很多很多年。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 de5 yi1 ke4 zhong1 guo2 ren2 yong4 le5 hen3 duo1 hen3 duo1 nian2
sentences.english: The Chinese used this kind of ke for a very, very long time.

sentences.hanzi: 也有人想过别的办法，可是都没有用很久。
sentences.pinyin: ye3 you3 ren2 xiang3 guo4 bie2 de5 ban4 fa3 ke3 shi4 dou1 mei2 you3 yong4 hen3 jiu3
sentences.english: Some people tried other ways, but none of them lasted long.

sentences.hanzi: 四百多年前，欧洲的钟表到了中国。
sentences.pinyin: si4 bai3 duo1 nian2 qian2 ou1 zhou1 de5 zhong1 biao3 dao4 le5 zhong1 guo2
sentences.english: More than four hundred years ago, European clocks reached China.

sentences.hanzi: 钟表上，一天有二十四个小时，一个小时有六十分钟。
sentences.pinyin: zhong1 biao3 shang4 yi1 tian1 you3 er4 shi2 si4 ge4 xiao3 shi2 yi1 ge5 xiao3 shi2 you3 liu4 shi2 fen1 zhong1
sentences.english: On a clock, a day has twenty-four hours, and an hour has sixty minutes.

sentences.hanzi: 一百刻和二十四个小时，怎么也对不上。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 bai3 ke4 he2 er4 shi2 si4 ge4 xiao3 shi2 zen3 me5 ye3 dui4 bu4 shang4
sentences.english: A hundred ke and twenty-four hours just wouldn't line up.

sentences.hanzi: 清朝的时候，中国决定：一天不要一百刻了，要九十六刻。
sentences.pinyin: qing1 chao2 de5 shi2 hou5 zhong1 guo2 jue2 ding4 yi1 tian1 bu4 yao4 yi1 bai3 ke4 le5 yao4 jiu3 shi2 liu4 ke4
sentences.english: In the Qing dynasty, China decided: no more hundred ke in a day. Ninety-six instead.

sentences.hanzi: 九十六刻，每个小时就是四刻。
sentences.pinyin: jiu3 shi2 liu4 ke4 mei3 ge5 xiao3 shi2 jiu4 shi4 si4 ke4
sentences.english: With ninety-six ke, every hour is exactly four ke.

sentences.hanzi: 从那时候开始，一刻就成了十五分钟。
sentences.pinyin: cong2 na4 shi2 hou5 kai1 shi3 yi1 ke4 jiu4 cheng2 le5 shi2 wu3 fen1 zhong1
sentences.english: From then on, a ke became fifteen minutes.

sentences.hanzi: 所以，你说“三点一刻”的时候，可以想一想：
sentences.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ni3 shuo1 san1 dian3 yi1 ke4 de5 shi2 hou5 ke3 yi3 xiang3 yi1 xiang3
sentences.english: So when you say "a quarter past three," you can think about this:

sentences.hanzi: 这个一刻，比两千年前的一刻长了三十六秒。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 yi1 ke4 bi3 liang3 qian1 nian2 qian2 de5 yi1 ke4 chang2 le5 san1 shi2 liu4 miao3
sentences.english: This ke is thirty-six seconds longer than the ke of two thousand years ago.

glossed.meaning: ke, an old unit of time; now a quarter of an hour

title: 十天去哪里了
titlePinyin: shi2 tian1 qu4 na3 li3 le5

sentences.hanzi: 一五八二年，罗马有一个女孩，叫玛丽亚。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 wu3 ba1 er4 nian2 luo2 ma3 you3 yi1 ge5 nu:3 hai2 jiao4 ma3 li4 ya4
sentences.english: In 1582, there was a girl in Rome called Maria.

sentences.hanzi: 她的生日是十月十号。今年，她要十岁了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 sheng1 ri4 shi4 shi2 yue4 shi2 hao4 jin1 nian2 ta1 yao4 shi2 sui4 le5
sentences.english: Her birthday was the tenth of October. This year she would turn ten.

sentences.hanzi: 她天天都看日历，等着那一天。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 tian1 tian1 dou1 kan4 ri4 li4 deng3 zhe5 na4 yi1 tian1
sentences.english: She looked at the calendar every day, waiting for that day.

sentences.hanzi: 十月四号晚上，爸爸回家，告诉大家一个消息。
sentences.pinyin: shi2 yue4 si4 hao4 wan3 shang5 ba4 ba5 hui2 jia1 gao4 su5 da4 jia1 yi1 ge5 xiao1 xi5
sentences.english: On the evening of the fourth of October, her father came home with some news.

sentences.hanzi: “教皇说，从明天开始，日历要变了。”
sentences.pinyin: jiao4 huang2 shuo1 cong2 ming2 tian1 kai1 shi3 ri4 li4 yao4 bian4 le5
sentences.english: "The Pope says that from tomorrow the calendar is changing."

sentences.hanzi: “我们的日历，每年都多了十一分钟。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 de5 ri4 li4 mei3 nian2 dou1 duo1 le5 shi2 yi1 fen1 zhong1
sentences.english: "Our calendar has been eleven minutes too long every year."

sentences.hanzi: “十一分钟不多，可是一千多年过去了，就多了十天。”
sentences.pinyin: shi2 yi1 fen1 zhong1 bu4 duo1 ke3 shi4 yi1 qian1 duo1 nian2 guo4 qu4 le5 jiu4 duo1 le5 shi2 tian1
sentences.english: "Eleven minutes isn't much, but after more than a thousand years, it's added up to ten days."

sentences.hanzi: “所以，今天是四号，明天不是五号，是十五号。”
sentences.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jin1 tian1 shi4 si4 hao4 ming2 tian1 bu4 shi4 wu3 hao4 shi4 shi2 wu3 hao4
sentences.english: "So today is the fourth, and tomorrow won't be the fifth. It'll be the fifteenth."

sentences.hanzi: 玛丽亚马上问：“那十号呢？我的生日呢？”
sentences.pinyin: ma3 li4 ya4 ma3 shang4 wen4 na4 shi2 hao4 ne5 wo3 de5 sheng1 ri4 ne5
sentences.english: Maria asked at once: "What about the tenth? What about my birthday?"

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸想了想，说：“今年……没有十号。”
sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 xiang3 le5 xiang3 shuo1 jin1 nian2 mei2 you3 shi2 hao4
sentences.english: Her father thought for a moment and said: "This year... there's no tenth."

sentences.hanzi: 玛丽亚一个晚上都没有说话。
sentences.pinyin: ma3 li4 ya4 yi1 ge5 wan3 shang5 dou1 mei2 you3 shuo1 hua4
sentences.english: Maria didn't say a word all evening.

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，她看了看日历。日历上，已经是十五号了。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 ta1 kan4 le5 kan4 ri4 li4 ri4 li4 shang4 yi3 jing1 shi4 shi2 wu3 hao4 le5
sentences.english: The next day she looked at the calendar. On the calendar it was already the fifteenth.

sentences.hanzi: 她想：我的生日，没有了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 wo3 de5 sheng1 ri4 mei2 you3 le5
sentences.english: She thought: my birthday is gone.

sentences.hanzi: 可是晚上，妈妈做了一个大蛋糕。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 wan3 shang5 ma1 ma5 zuo4 le5 yi1 ge5 da4 dan4 gao1
sentences.english: But that evening, her mother made a big cake.

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸说：“今年没有十号，我们就今天过生日。”
sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 shuo1 jin1 nian2 mei2 you3 shi2 hao4 wo3 men5 jiu4 jin1 tian1 guo4 sheng1 ri4
sentences.english: Her father said: "There's no tenth this year, so we'll have your birthday today."

sentences.hanzi: 玛丽亚想了想，说：“以后，我要过两个生日。”
sentences.pinyin: ma3 li4 ya4 xiang3 le5 xiang3 shuo1 yi3 hou4 wo3 yao4 guo4 liang3 ge4 sheng1 ri4
sentences.english: Maria thought about it and said: "From now on, I'm having two birthdays."

sentences.hanzi: “为什么？”
sentences.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: "Why?"

sentences.hanzi: “十号一个，十五号一个。因为今年少了一个。”
sentences.pinyin: shi2 hao4 yi1 ge5 shi2 wu3 hao4 yi1 ge5 yin1 wei4 jin1 nian2 shao3 le5 yi1 ge5
sentences.english: "One on the tenth, one on the fifteenth. Because this year I was one short."

title: 月球上的明天
titlePinyin: yue4 qiu2 shang4 de5 ming2 tian1

sentences.hanzi: 二一五零年，小海和爸爸妈妈去月球上住了。
sentences.pinyin: er4 yi1 wu3 ling2 nian2 xiao3 hai3 he2 ba4 ba5 ma1 ma5 qu4 yue4 qiu2 shang4 zhu4 le5
sentences.english: In 2150, Xiaohai and his parents went to live on the Moon.

sentences.hanzi: 到月球的第一天，外面是晚上。
sentences.pinyin: dao4 yue4 qiu2 de5 di4 yi1 tian1 wai4 mian4 shi4 wan3 shang5
sentences.english: On their first day on the Moon, it was night outside.

sentences.hanzi: 小海问爸爸：“明天我们可以出去玩吗？”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 hai3 wen4 ba4 ba5 ming2 tian1 wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 chu1 qu4 wan2 ma5
sentences.english: Xiaohai asked his dad: "Can we go out and play tomorrow?"

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸说：“可以。等太阳出来，我们就出去。”
sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 shuo1 ke3 yi3 deng3 tai4 yang5 chu1 lai2 wo3 men5 jiu4 chu1 qu4
sentences.english: Dad said: "Yes. When the sun comes up, we'll go out."

sentences.hanzi: 小海睡了很久。他起来以后，外面还是晚上。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 hai3 shui4 le5 hen3 jiu3 ta1 qi3 lai5 yi3 hou4 wai4 mian4 hai2 shi5 wan3 shang5
sentences.english: Xiaohai slept for a long time. When he got up, it was still night outside.

sentences.hanzi: “爸爸，现在是明天了吗？”
sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 xian4 zai4 shi4 ming2 tian1 le5 ma5
sentences.english: "Dad, is it tomorrow now?"

sentences.hanzi: “是明天了。可是太阳还没有出来。”
sentences.pinyin: shi4 ming2 tian1 le5 ke3 shi4 tai4 yang5 hai2 mei2 you3 chu1 lai2
sentences.english: "It is tomorrow. But the sun isn't up yet."

sentences.hanzi: 在月球上，白天很长，晚上也很长。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 yue4 qiu2 shang4 bai2 tian1 hen3 chang2 wan3 shang5 ye3 hen3 chang2
sentences.english: On the Moon, the days are very long, and so are the nights.

sentences.hanzi: 太阳出来以后，要过十四天多，才会下去。
sentences.pinyin: tai4 yang5 chu1 lai2 yi3 hou4 yao4 guo4 shi2 si4 tian1 duo1 cai2 hui4 xia4 qu4
sentences.english: Once the sun comes up, it takes more than fourteen days to go down.

sentences.hanzi: 太阳下去以后，晚上也有十四天多。
sentences.pinyin: tai4 yang5 xia4 qu4 yi3 hou4 wan3 shang5 ye3 you3 shi2 si4 tian1 duo1
sentences.english: After it goes down, the night lasts more than fourteen days too.

sentences.hanzi: 小海天天一起来，就先问一句：“太阳出来了吗？”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 hai3 tian1 tian1 yi1 qi3 lai5 jiu4 xian1 wen4 yi1 ju4 tai4 yang5 chu1 lai2 le5 ma5
sentences.english: Every day when Xiaohai got up, the first thing he asked was: "Is the sun up?"

sentences.hanzi: 一天一天过去了。第三天，没有。第七天，也没有。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 tian1 yi1 tian1 guo4 qu4 le5 di4 san1 tian1 mei2 you3 di4 qi1 tian1 ye3 mei2 you3
sentences.english: The days went by. On the third day, no. On the seventh day, still no.

sentences.hanzi: 小海说：“月球上的明天，太远了。”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 hai3 shuo1 yue4 qiu2 shang4 de5 ming2 tian1 tai4 yuan3 le5
sentences.english: Xiaohai said: "Tomorrow on the Moon is too far away."

sentences.hanzi: 第十一天，爸爸叫他：“小海，快起来！太阳马上就出来了！”
sentences.pinyin: di4 shi2 yi1 tian1 ba4 ba5 jiao4 ta1 xiao3 hai3 kuai4 qi3 lai5 tai4 yang5 ma3 shang4 jiu4 chu1 lai2 le5
sentences.english: On the eleventh day, Dad called him: "Xiaohai, get up, quick! The sun's about to come up!"

sentences.hanzi: 他们一起看着外面。太阳出来了！
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 yi1 qi3 kan4 zhe5 wai4 mian4 tai4 yang5 chu1 lai2 le5
sentences.english: They looked outside together. The sun was coming up!

sentences.hanzi: 他们穿上特别的衣服，出去玩了很久。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 chuan1 shang4 te4 bie2 de5 yi1 fu5 chu1 qu4 wan2 le5 hen3 jiu3
sentences.english: They put on special suits and went out to play for a long time.

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，太阳还在天上。第三天，还在。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 tai4 yang5 hai2 zai4 tian1 shang4 di4 san1 tian1 hai2 zai4
sentences.english: The next day, the sun was still in the sky. On the third day, it was still there.

sentences.hanzi: 小海问：“爸爸，今天什么时候结束？”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 hai3 wen4 ba4 ba5 jin1 tian1 shen2 me5 shi2 hou5 jie2 shu4
sentences.english: Xiaohai asked: "Dad, when does today end?"

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸说：“还有十几天呢。”
sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 shuo1 hai2 you3 shi2 ji3 tian1 ne5
sentences.english: Dad said: "There are more than ten days to go."

sentences.hanzi: 小海非常高兴：“月球上的明天很远，可是月球上的今天，真长啊！”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 hai3 fei1 chang2 gao1 xing4 yue4 qiu2 shang4 de5 ming2 tian1 hen3 yuan3 ke3 shi4 yue4 qiu2 shang4 de5 jin1 tian1 zhen1 chang2 a5
sentences.english: Xiaohai was delighted: "Tomorrow on the Moon is a long way off, but today on the Moon is so long!"

sentences.hanzi: 今天，从西安坐飞机去印度，一天就到了。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 cong2 xi1 an1 zuo4 fei1 ji1 qu4 yin4 du4 yi1 tian1 jiu4 dao4 le5
sentences.english: Today, flying from Xi'an to India takes a day at most.

sentences.hanzi: 一千四百年前，有一个人走路去。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 qian1 si4 bai3 nian2 qian2 you3 yi1 ge5 ren2 zou3 lu4 qu4
sentences.english: One thousand four hundred years ago, a man went on foot.

sentences.hanzi: 他叫玄奘，是唐朝的和尚。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 jiao4 xuan2 zang4 shi4 tang2 chao2 de5 he2 shang5
sentences.english: His name was Xuanzang, and he was a monk of the Tang dynasty.

sentences.hanzi: 他看了很多佛经，可是有很多地方不明白。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 kan4 le5 hen3 duo1 fo2 jing1 ke3 shi4 you3 hen3 duo1 di4 fang5 bu4 ming2 bai5
sentences.english: He had read many Buddhist scriptures, but there was a lot he didn't understand.

sentences.hanzi: 他想，印度的人一定知道。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 yin4 du4 de5 ren2 yi1 ding4 zhi1 dao4
sentences.english: He thought: the people of India must know.

sentences.hanzi: 可是那时候，国家不让人们离开。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 na4 shi2 hou5 guo2 jia1 bu4 rang4 ren2 men5 li2 kai1
sentences.english: But at that time, the country didn't let people leave.

sentences.hanzi: 玄奘还是决定出发。
sentences.pinyin: xuan2 zang4 hai2 shi5 jue2 ding4 chu1 fa1
sentences.english: Xuanzang decided to set out anyway.

sentences.hanzi: 一天晚上，他走了，没有地图，也没有朋友。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 tian1 wan3 shang5 ta1 zou3 le5 mei2 you3 di4 tu2 ye3 mei2 you3 peng2 you5
sentences.english: One night he slipped away, with no map and no friends.

sentences.hanzi: 他的旅行非常难。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 lu:3 xing2 fei1 chang2 nan2
sentences.english: His journey was terribly hard.

sentences.hanzi: 前面是沙漠，一个人也没有。
sentences.pinyin: qian2 mian4 shi4 sha1 mo4 yi1 ge5 ren2 ye3 mei2 you3
sentences.english: Ahead lay the desert, without a single person.

sentences.hanzi: 有一次，他几天没有东西喝，人已经快死了。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 ci4 ta1 ji3 tian1 mei2 you3 dong1 xi5 he1 ren2 yi3 jing1 kuai4 si3 le5
sentences.english: Once he had nothing to drink for days and was close to death.

sentences.hanzi: 后面是大山，很多人死在那里。
sentences.pinyin: hou4 mian5 shi4 da4 shan1 hen3 duo1 ren2 si3 zai4 na4 li5
sentences.english: After that came great mountains, where many people died.

sentences.hanzi: 他走了很久，才到达印度。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zou3 le5 hen3 jiu3 cai2 dao4 da2 yin4 du4
sentences.english: It took him a long time to reach India.

sentences.hanzi: 他在那里住了很久，成了一个很有名的人。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zai4 na4 li5 zhu4 le5 hen3 jiu3 cheng2 le5 yi1 ge5 hen3 you3 ming2 de5 ren2
sentences.english: He stayed there a long time and became a famous man.

sentences.hanzi: 最后，他带着很多佛经回来了。
sentences.pinyin: zui4 hou4 ta1 dai4 zhe5 hen3 duo1 fo2 jing1 hui2 lai5 le5
sentences.english: In the end he came back with a great many scriptures.

sentences.hanzi: 他走的时候，国家不让他走。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zou3 de5 shi2 hou5 guo2 jia1 bu4 rang4 ta1 zou3
sentences.english: When he left, the country wouldn't let him go.

sentences.hanzi: 他回来的时候，大街上全是人，大家都来看他。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 hui2 lai5 de5 shi2 hou5 da4 jie1 shang4 quan2 shi4 ren2 da4 jia1 dou1 lai2 kan4 ta1
sentences.english: When he came back, the streets were full of people, all come to see him.

sentences.hanzi: 今天，我们坐飞机去，一天就到了。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 zuo4 fei1 ji1 qu4 yi1 tian1 jiu4 dao4 le5
sentences.english: Today we fly there and arrive within a day.

sentences.hanzi: 可是玄奘走上这条路的时候，才二十多岁。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 xuan2 zang4 zou3 shang4 zhe4 tiao2 lu4 de5 shi2 hou5 cai2 er4 shi2 duo1 sui4
sentences.english: But when Xuanzang set out on this road, he was in his twenties.

sentences.hanzi: 他回来的时候，已经四十多了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 hui2 lai5 de5 shi2 hou5 yi3 jing1 si4 shi2 duo1 le5
sentences.english: When he came back, he was past forty.

sentences.hanzi: 小林第一次来重庆旅行。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 lin2 di4 yi1 ci4 lai2 chong2 qing4 lu:3 xing2
sentences.english: Xiaolin was visiting Chongqing for the first time.

sentences.hanzi: 下了火车，他拿出手机，看了看地图。
sentences.pinyin: xia4 le5 huo3 che1 ta1 na2 chu1 shou3 ji1 kan4 le5 kan4 di4 tu2
sentences.english: Getting off the train, he took out his phone and looked at the map.

sentences.hanzi: 地图上说：酒店很近，走路只要几分钟。
sentences.pinyin: di4 tu2 shang4 shuo1 jiu3 dian4 hen3 jin4 zou3 lu4 zhi3 yao4 ji3 fen1 zhong1
sentences.english: The map said the hotel was very close, only a few minutes' walk.

sentences.hanzi: “太好了！”他拿着箱子走了。
sentences.pinyin: tai4 hao3 le5 ta1 na2 zhe5 xiang1 zi5 zou3 le5
sentences.english: "Great!" He set off with his suitcase.

sentences.hanzi: 几分钟以后，地图上说：已经到达。
sentences.pinyin: ji3 fen1 zhong1 yi3 hou4 di4 tu2 shang4 shuo1 yi3 jing1 dao4 da2
sentences.english: A few minutes later, the map said: Arrived.

sentences.hanzi: 小林看看左边，看看右边，看看前面，都没有酒店。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 lin2 kan4 kan5 zuo3 bian5 kan4 kan5 you4 bian5 kan4 kan5 qian2 mian4 dou1 mei2 you3 jiu3 dian4
sentences.english: Xiaolin looked left, right and straight ahead. No hotel.

sentences.hanzi: 最后他向上看。酒店在他的头上！
sentences.pinyin: zui4 hou4 ta1 xiang4 shang4 kan4 jiu3 dian4 zai4 ta1 de5 tou2 shang4
sentences.english: Finally he looked up. The hotel was over his head!

sentences.hanzi: 他没有办法，叫了出租车。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 mei2 you3 ban4 fa3 jiao4 le5 chu1 zu1 che1
sentences.english: There was nothing for it. He called a taxi.

sentences.hanzi: 司机听了地址，说：“第一次来重庆吧？”
sentences.pinyin: si1 ji1 ting1 le5 di4 zhi3 shuo1 di4 yi1 ci4 lai2 chong2 qing4 ba5
sentences.english: The driver heard the address and said: "First time in Chongqing?"

sentences.hanzi: “这个城市都在山上。地图上很近，走起来很远。”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 cheng2 shi4 dou1 zai4 shan1 shang4 di4 tu2 shang4 hen3 jin4 zou3 qi3 lai5 hen3 yuan3
sentences.english: "This whole city is on mountains. Close on the map, far on foot."

sentences.hanzi: 车开了很久，过了河，上了山，才到了酒店门前。
sentences.pinyin: che1 kai1 le5 hen3 jiu3 guo4 le5 he2 shang4 le5 shan1 cai2 dao4 le5 jiu3 dian4 men2 qian2
sentences.english: The car drove a long way, crossed the river and climbed the hill before it reached the hotel door.

sentences.hanzi: 小林走进大门，看到门旁边写着：二十二楼。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 lin2 zou3 jin4 da4 men2 kan4 dao4 men2 pang2 bian1 xie3 zhe5 er4 shi2 er4 lou2
sentences.english: Xiaolin walked through the main door and saw a sign beside it: twenty-second floor.

sentences.hanzi: 他问：“这里是二十二楼？可是门前就是大街！”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 wen4 zhe4 li3 shi4 er4 shi2 er4 lou2 ke3 shi4 men2 qian2 jiu4 shi4 da4 jie1
sentences.english: He asked: "This is the twenty-second floor? But there's a street right outside the door!"

sentences.hanzi: 司机在后面说：“这算什么？”
sentences.pinyin: si1 ji1 zai4 hou4 mian5 shuo1 zhe4 suan4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: The driver said behind him: "That's nothing."

sentences.hanzi: “明天你去看看，有一种车从楼里开过去。”
sentences.pinyin: ming2 tian1 ni3 qu4 kan4 kan5 you3 yi1 zhong3 che1 cong2 lou2 li3 kai1 guo4 qu4
sentences.english: "Go and look tomorrow. There's a train that runs right through a building."

sentences.hanzi: 小林不相信。第二天他去了，这种车真从楼里开了过去。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 lin2 bu4 xiang1 xin4 di4 er4 tian1 ta1 qu4 le5 zhe4 zhong3 che1 zhen1 cong2 lou2 li3 kai1 le5 guo4 qu4
sentences.english: Xiaolin didn't believe it. He went the next day, and the train really did run through the building.

sentences.hanzi: 他把手机放回箱子里，对自己说：“在重庆，还是问司机吧。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 ba3 shou3 ji1 fang4 hui2 xiang1 zi5 li3 dui4 zi4 ji3 shuo1 zai4 chong2 qing4 hai2 shi5 wen4 si1 ji1 ba5
sentences.english: He put his phone back in his case and said to himself: "In Chongqing, better ask a driver."

glossed.meaning: Chongqing, a city in southwest China

title: 海上来的麒麟
titlePinyin: hai3 shang4 lai2 de5 qi2 lin2
titleEnglish: The Qilin from Over the Sea

sentences.hanzi: 六百年前，明朝有一个人叫郑和。
sentences.pinyin: liu4 bai3 nian2 qian2 ming2 chao2 you3 yi1 ge5 ren2 jiao4 zheng4 he2
sentences.english: Six hundred years ago, in the Ming dynasty, there was a man called Zheng He.

sentences.hanzi: 他带着很多大船出发，在海上走了很远，到过很多国家。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 dai4 zhe5 hen3 duo1 da4 chuan2 chu1 fa1 zai4 hai3 shang4 zou3 le5 hen3 yuan3 dao4 guo5 hen3 duo1 guo2 jia1
sentences.english: He set out with many great ships, sailed far across the sea and reached many countries.

sentences.hanzi: 船回来的时候，也带回来别的国家的人和东西。
sentences.pinyin: chuan2 hui2 lai5 de5 shi2 hou5 ye3 dai4 hui2 lai2 bie2 de5 guo2 jia1 de5 ren2 he2 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: When the ships came back, they brought people and things from other countries.

sentences.hanzi: 一四一四年，一个国家给皇帝送来一个东西。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 si4 yi1 si4 nian2 yi1 ge5 guo2 jia1 gei3 huang2 di4 song4 lai2 yi1 ge5 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: In 1414, a country sent the emperor a gift.

sentences.hanzi: 这个东西是活的。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 dong1 xi5 shi4 huo2 de5
sentences.english: This gift was alive.

sentences.hanzi: 这次旅行很长。它坐了很久的船，才到达明朝的城市。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ci4 lu:3 xing2 hen3 chang2 ta1 zuo4 le5 hen3 jiu3 de5 chuan2 cai2 dao4 da2 ming2 chao2 de5 cheng2 shi4
sentences.english: It was a long journey. It spent many days on a ship before it reached the Ming city.

sentences.hanzi: 它非常高，脖子特别长，头比门还高。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 fei1 chang2 gao1 bo2 zi5 te4 bie2 chang2 tou2 bi3 men2 hai2 gao1
sentences.english: It was very tall, with an especially long neck and a head higher than a door.

sentences.hanzi: 谁也没有见过这样的东西。
sentences.pinyin: shei2 ye3 mei2 you3 jian4 guo5 zhe4 yang4 de5 dong1 xi5
sentences.english: Nobody had ever seen such a thing.

sentences.hanzi: 人们都跑到大街上看。它走过来，大家就跑。
sentences.pinyin: ren2 men5 dou1 pao3 dao4 da4 jie1 shang4 kan4 ta1 zou3 guo4 lai2 da4 jia1 jiu4 pao3
sentences.english: People all ran into the street to look. When it walked towards them, they ran away.

sentences.hanzi: 这是什么？大家都不知道。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 shen2 me5 da4 jia1 dou1 bu4 zhi1 dao4
sentences.english: What was it? Nobody knew.

sentences.hanzi: 这时候，送它来的人说：“是麒麟！”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 hou5 song4 ta1 lai2 de5 ren2 shuo1 shi4 qi2 lin2
sentences.english: Then the people who brought it said: "It's a qilin!"

sentences.hanzi: 老人们说，世界上有一种东西叫麒麟。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ren2 men5 shuo1 shi4 jie4 shang4 you3 yi1 zhong3 dong1 xi5 jiao4 qi2 lin2
sentences.english: The old people said there was a thing called a qilin.

sentences.hanzi: 谁也没有见过它。可是人们相信，国家很好的时候，它才会出现。
sentences.pinyin: shei2 ye3 mei2 you3 jian4 guo5 ta1 ke3 shi4 ren2 men5 xiang1 xin4 guo2 jia1 hen3 hao3 de5 shi2 hou5 ta1 cai2 hui4 chu1 xian4
sentences.english: Nobody had ever seen one. But people believed it only appeared when the country was doing well.

sentences.hanzi: 大家看着它，都说：“这就是麒麟！”
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 kan4 zhe5 ta1 dou1 shuo1 zhe4 jiu4 shi4 qi2 lin2
sentences.english: Everyone looked at it and said: "This is the qilin!"

sentences.hanzi: 大家又说：“麒麟来了，皇帝当然是好皇帝！”
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 you4 shuo1 qi2 lin2 lai2 le5 huang2 di4 dang1 ran2 shi4 hao3 huang2 di4
sentences.english: They added: "The qilin has come, so of course he's a good emperor!"

sentences.hanzi: 可是皇帝说：“只要国家好，没有麒麟也没有关系。”
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 huang2 di4 shuo1 zhi3 yao4 guo2 jia1 hao3 mei2 you3 qi2 lin2 ye3 mei2 you3 guan1 xi5
sentences.english: But the emperor said: "As long as the country is doing well, it doesn't matter if there's no qilin."

sentences.hanzi: 今天，我们知道它不是麒麟，是长颈鹿。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 ta1 bu4 shi4 qi2 lin2 shi4 chang2 jing3 lu4
sentences.english: Today we know it wasn't a qilin. It was a giraffe.

sentences.hanzi: 可是这个名字没有死。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zhe4 ge5 ming2 zi5 mei2 you3 si3
sentences.english: But the name didn't die.

sentences.english: In Japan and Korea, people still call the giraffe "qilin" today.

sentences.pinyin: huai4 le5 mei2 you3 a5

sentences.english: "Look, the bridge has holes. Two on the left and two on the right."

sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 shuo1 na4 bu4 shi4 huai4 le5 na4 shi4 yi3 qian2 de5 ren2 liu2 de5

sentences.pinyin: you3 le5 dong4 shui3 jiu4 cong2 dong4 li3 zou3 le5

sentences.hanzi: “这么多年，这里的水大过很多次。”
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 me5 duo1 nian2 zhe4 li3 de5 shui3 da4 guo5 hen3 duo1 ci4
sentences.english: "Over all these years, the water here has risen many times."

sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 xin1 qiao2 dou1 mei2 you3 le5 zhe4 zuo4 lao3 qiao2 hai2 zai4
sentences.english: "Many newer bridges are gone, and this old one is still here."

sentences.hanzi: 小山想了想，看了看自己的衣服。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 shan1 xiang3 le5 xiang3 kan4 le5 kan4 zi4 ji3 de5 yi1 fu5
sentences.english: Xiaoshan thought about it and looked down at his clothes.

sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 yi1 fu5 shang4 ye3 you3 yi1 ge5 dong4
sentences.english: There was a hole in his clothes too.

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“我回家要告诉妈妈，这不是坏了。这是为了安全。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 wo3 hui2 jia1 yao4 gao4 su5 ma1 ma5 zhe4 bu4 shi4 huai4 le5 zhe4 shi4 wei4 le5 an1 quan2
sentences.english: He said: "When I get home I'm going to tell Mum this isn't damage. It's for safety."

title: 它怎么不说话

title: 奶奶的天气预报

sentences.english: She says, "It's going to rain tomorrow." And the next day, it rains.

sentences.pinyin: wo3 kan4 wen1 du4 kan4 feng1 kan4 yun2 kan4 tian1 kong1

sentences.pinyin: nai3 nai5 jin1 tian1 tui3 zen3 me5 yang4

sentences.english: One day in October, the wind got up and the temperature dropped. It was only ten degrees.

sentences.hanzi: 小雨很冷，想多穿一件衣服。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 yu3 hen3 leng3 xiang3 duo1 chuan1 yi1 jian4 yi1 fu5
sentences.english: Xiaoyu was cold and wanted to put on another layer.

sentences.hanzi: 妈妈说：“别！春捂秋冻。”

sentences.english: Xiaoyu asked: "So when do I get to dress comfortably?"

sentences.english: Before Xiaoyu could say a word, Mum had already brought out the warmest clothes.

sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 ba3 bing1 song4 jin4 bing1 jiao4 bing1 jiao4 li3 fei1 chang2 leng3 yi1 dian3 tai4 yang5 ye3 mei2 you3
sentences.english: They took the ice into the ice cellar. It was very cold in there, with no sunlight at all.

sentences.hanzi: 阿土问：“爸爸，冬天哪里都是冰，为什么还要放冰？”
sentences.pinyin: a1 tu3 wen4 ba4 ba5 dong1 tian1 na3 li3 dou1 shi4 bing1 wei4 shen2 me5 hai2 yao4 fang4 bing1
sentences.english: A-Tu asked: "Dad, in winter there's ice everywhere. Why store more?"

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸说：“现在你不明白。到了夏天，你就知道了。”
sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 shuo1 xian4 zai4 ni3 bu4 ming2 bai5 dao4 le5 xia4 tian1 ni3 jiu4 zhi1 dao4 le5
sentences.english: His father said: "You don't understand now. When summer comes, you'll see."

sentences.hanzi: 夏天来了。北京非常热，一点风也没有。
sentences.pinyin: xia4 tian1 lai2 le5 bei3 jing1 fei1 chang2 re4 yi1 dian3 feng1 ye3 mei2 you3
sentences.english: Summer came. Beijing was very hot, without a breath of wind.

sentences.hanzi: 冰窖开了，冰一块一块地送了出去。
sentences.pinyin: bing1 jiao4 kai1 le5 bing1 yi1 kuai4 yi1 kuai4 de5 song4 le5 chu1 qu4
sentences.english: The ice cellar was opened, and the ice was sent out block by block.

sentences.hanzi: 冰送到了皇帝那里。皇帝吃上了冰过的西瓜。
sentences.pinyin: bing1 song4 dao4 le5 huang2 di4 na4 li5 huang2 di4 chi1 shang4 le5 bing1 guo4 de5 xi1 gua1
sentences.english: The ice went to the emperor. The emperor got to eat chilled watermelon.

sentences.hanzi: 晚上，爸爸带回来一小块冰，放在阿土的手上。
sentences.pinyin: wan3 shang5 ba4 ba5 dai4 hui2 lai2 yi1 xiao3 kuai4 bing1 fang4 zai4 a1 tu3 de5 shou3 shang4
sentences.english: That evening, his father brought home a small piece of ice and put it in A-Tu's hand.

sentences.hanzi: 冰在手上，很舒服。
sentences.pinyin: bing1 zai4 shou3 shang4 hen3 shu1 fu5
sentences.english: The ice felt wonderful in his hand.

sentences.hanzi: 阿土记得冬天的晚上，记得他冻坏的手。
sentences.pinyin: a1 tu3 ji4 de5 dong1 tian1 de5 wan3 shang5 ji4 de5 ta1 dong4 huai4 de5 shou3
sentences.english: A-Tu remembered the winter nights, and his frozen hands.

sentences.hanzi: 他问：“爸爸，这块冰，是不是我打的？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 wen4 ba4 ba5 zhe4 kuai4 bing1 shi4 bu4 shi4 wo3 da3 de5
sentences.english: He asked: "Dad, is this piece of ice one I cut?"

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸说：“你说是，就是。”
sentences.pinyin: ba4 ba5 shuo1 ni3 shuo1 shi4 jiu4 shi4
sentences.english: His father said: "If you say so, then it is."

sentences.hanzi: 阿土把冰放在头上，很久很久都没有动。
sentences.pinyin: a1 tu3 ba3 bing1 fang4 zai4 tou2 shang4 hen3 jiu3 hen3 jiu3 dou1 mei2 you3 dong4
sentences.english: A-Tu held the ice to his head and didn't move for a long, long time.

sentences.hanzi: 他觉得，冬天又回来了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 jue2 de5 dong1 tian1 you4 hui2 lai5 le5
sentences.english: It felt as if winter had come back.

glossed.meaning: Beihai, a lake in central Beijing

title: 一下雨就是冬天
titlePinyin: yi1 xia4 yu3 jiu4 shi4 dong1 tian1

sentences.hanzi: 昆明在中国的西南，很多人叫它“春城”。
sentences.pinyin: kun1 ming2 zai4 zhong1 guo2 de5 xi1 nan2 hen3 duo1 ren2 jiao4 ta1 chun1 cheng2
sentences.english: Kunming is in southwest China, and many people call it "Spring City".

sentences.hanzi: 因为这里冬天不冷，夏天也不热，天气总是像春天一样。
sentences.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zhe4 li3 dong1 tian1 bu4 leng3 xia4 tian1 ye3 bu4 re4 tian1 qi4 zong3 shi4 xiang4 chun1 tian1 yi1 yang4
sentences.english: That's because winters here aren't cold and summers aren't hot: the weather is always like spring.

sentences.hanzi: 七月，北京和上海热得让人不想出去，昆明只有二十多度。
sentences.pinyin: qi1 yue4 bei3 jing1 he2 shang4 hai3 re4 de5 rang4 ren2 bu4 xiang3 chu1 qu4 kun1 ming2 zhi3 you3 er4 shi2 duo1 du4
sentences.english: In July, when Beijing and Shanghai are so hot that nobody wants to go out, Kunming is only in the low twenties.

sentences.hanzi: 有一年七月，我去昆明玩。
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 nian2 qi1 yue4 wo3 qu4 kun1 ming2 wan2
sentences.english: One July, I went to Kunming for a holiday.

sentences.hanzi: 我想：像春天一样的地方，带几件夏天的衣服就行了。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 xiang4 chun1 tian1 yi1 yang4 de5 di4 fang5 dai4 ji3 jian4 xia4 tian1 de5 yi1 fu5 jiu4 xing2 le5
sentences.english: I thought: it's like spring there, so a few summer clothes will do.

sentences.hanzi: 第一天，天气非常好。天空一点云也没有，太阳很暖和。
sentences.pinyin: di4 yi1 tian1 tian1 qi4 fei1 chang2 hao3 tian1 kong1 yi1 dian3 yun2 ye3 mei2 you3 tai4 yang5 hen3 nuan3 huo5
sentences.english: The first day, the weather was perfect. There wasn't a cloud in the sky, and the sun was warm.

sentences.hanzi: 我穿夏天的衣服出去玩，非常舒服。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 chuan1 xia4 tian1 de5 yi1 fu5 chu1 qu4 wan2 fei1 chang2 shu1 fu5
sentences.english: I went out in my summer clothes, and it was lovely.

sentences.hanzi: 可是到了四点，天气变了。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 dao4 le5 si4 dian3 tian1 qi4 bian4 le5
sentences.english: But at four o'clock, the weather changed.

sentences.hanzi: 来了很多云，下起了大雨。
sentences.pinyin: lai2 le5 hen3 duo1 yun2 xia4 qi3 le5 da4 yu3
sentences.english: Lots of cloud came over, and it started to pour.

sentences.hanzi: 雨一来，就降温了。我很冷很冷。
sentences.pinyin: yu3 yi1 lai2 jiu4 jiang4 wen1 le5 wo3 hen3 leng3 hen3 leng3
sentences.english: As soon as the rain came, the temperature dropped. I was freezing.

sentences.hanzi: 旁边的人都不担心。他们每个人都多带了一件衣服。
sentences.pinyin: pang2 bian1 de5 ren2 dou1 bu4 dan1 xin1 ta1 men5 mei3 ge5 ren2 dou1 duo1 dai4 le5 yi1 jian4 yi1 fu5
sentences.english: The people around me weren't worried. Every one of them had brought an extra layer.

sentences.hanzi: 一个老人看着我说：“第一次来昆明吧？”
sentences.pinyin: yi1 ge5 lao3 ren2 kan4 zhe5 wo3 shuo1 di4 yi1 ci4 lai2 kun1 ming2 ba5
sentences.english: An old man looked at me and said: "First time in Kunming?"

sentences.hanzi: “我们这里有一句话：一下雨，就是冬天。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhe4 li3 you3 yi1 ju4 hua4 yi1 xia4 yu3 jiu4 shi4 dong1 tian1
sentences.english: "We have a saying here: when it rains, it's winter."

sentences.hanzi: “所以出去的时候，天气再好，也要多带一件衣服。”
sentences.pinyin: suo3 yi3 chu1 qu4 de5 shi2 hou5 tian1 qi4 zai4 hao3 ye3 yao4 duo1 dai4 yi1 jian4 yi1 fu5
sentences.english: "So when you go out, however nice the weather is, take an extra layer."

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，我也多带了一件衣服。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 wo3 ye3 duo1 dai4 le5 yi1 jian4 yi1 fu5
sentences.english: The next day, I brought an extra layer too.

sentences.hanzi: 那几天，天天都是晴天。那件衣服，我一次也没有穿。
sentences.pinyin: na4 ji3 tian1 tian1 tian1 dou1 shi4 qing2 tian1 na4 jian4 yi1 fu5 wo3 yi1 ci4 ye3 mei2 you3 chuan1
sentences.english: For the rest of the trip, it was sunny every day. I didn't wear that extra layer once.

sentences.hanzi: 回上海以后，天天都是三十多度。
sentences.pinyin: hui2 shang4 hai3 yi3 hou4 tian1 tian1 dou1 shi4 san1 shi2 duo1 du4
sentences.english: Back in Shanghai, it was over thirty degrees every day.

sentences.hanzi: 我看着那件衣服，很想昆明的雨。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 kan4 zhe5 na4 jian4 yi1 fu5 hen3 xiang3 kun1 ming2 de5 yu3
sentences.english: I looked at that extra layer and really missed Kunming's rain.

glossed.meaning: Kunming, the capital of Yunnan province
Spring City, a nickname for Kunming

sentences.hanzi: 二一零零年，人们可以决定天气了。
sentences.pinyin: er4 yi1 ling2 ling2 nian2 ren2 men5 ke3 yi3 jue2 ding4 tian1 qi4 le5
sentences.english: By 2100, people could decide the weather.

sentences.hanzi: 一周一次，大家一起投票。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 zhou1 yi1 ci4 da4 jia1 yi1 qi3 tou2 piao4
sentences.english: Once a week, everyone voted together.

sentences.hanzi: 下一周是晴天还是阴天，多少度，有没有风，都是大家决定的。
sentences.pinyin: xia4 yi1 zhou1 shi4 qing2 tian1 hai2 shi5 yin1 tian1 duo1 shao5 du4 you3 mei2 you3 feng1 dou1 shi4 da4 jia1 jue2 ding4 de5
sentences.english: Whether next week would be sunny or cloudy, how many degrees, whether there'd be wind: everyone decided together.

sentences.hanzi: 每一次，结果都一样：晴天，二十五度，没有风，也没有雨。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 yi1 ci4 jie2 guo3 dou1 yi1 yang4 qing2 tian1 er4 shi2 wu3 du4 mei2 you3 feng1 ye3 mei2 you3 yu3
sentences.english: Every time, the result was the same: sunny, twenty-five degrees, no wind, and no rain.

sentences.hanzi: 谁不喜欢这样的天气呢？
sentences.pinyin: shei2 bu4 xi3 huan5 zhe4 yang4 de5 tian1 qi4 ne5
sentences.english: Who wouldn't like weather like that?

sentences.hanzi: 一年过去了，两年过去了。天空天天都一样。
sentences.pinyin: yi1 nian2 guo4 qu4 le5 liang3 nian2 guo4 qu4 le5 tian1 kong1 tian1 tian1 dou1 yi1 yang4
sentences.english: One year passed, then two. The sky was the same every day.

sentences.hanzi: 孩子们从来没有见过下雨，也没有见过下雪。
sentences.pinyin: hai2 zi5 men5 cong2 lai2 mei2 you3 jian4 guo5 xia4 yu3 ye3 mei2 you3 jian4 guo5 xia4 xue3
sentences.english: The children had never seen rain, or snow.

sentences.hanzi: 可是，花不开了，水也少了。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 hua1 bu4 kai1 le5 shui3 ye3 shao3 le5
sentences.english: But the flowers stopped blooming, and the water ran low.

sentences.hanzi: 空气很干燥，很多人都觉得不舒服。
sentences.pinyin: kong1 qi4 hen3 gan1 zao4 hen3 duo1 ren2 dou1 jue2 de5 bu4 shu1 fu5
sentences.english: The air was very dry, and lots of people felt unwell.

sentences.hanzi: 有一天，一个老人站在大家前面，说：“我想要一场雨。”
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 yi1 ge5 lao3 ren2 zhan4 zai4 da4 jia1 qian2 mian4 shuo1 wo3 xiang3 yao4 yi1 chang3 yu3
sentences.english: One day, an old woman stood up in front of everyone and said: "I want some rain."

sentences.hanzi: 大家都不明白：“雨？为什么要雨？”
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 bu4 ming2 bai5 yu3 wei4 shen2 me5 yao4 yu3
sentences.english: Nobody understood: "Rain? Why would anyone want rain?"

sentences.hanzi: 老人说：“我还是孩子的时候，下雨了，我们就在雨里跑，在雨里玩。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ren2 shuo1 wo3 hai2 shi5 hai2 zi5 de5 shi2 hou5 xia4 yu3 le5 wo3 men5 jiu4 zai4 yu3 li3 pao3 zai4 yu3 li3 wan2
sentences.english: The old woman said: "When I was a child, whenever it rained, we ran around and played in it."

sentences.hanzi: “雨很凉快。下过雨，空气特别好。”
sentences.pinyin: yu3 hen3 liang2 kuai5 xia4 guo4 yu3 kong1 qi4 te4 bie2 hao3
sentences.english: "Rain is cool and fresh. After rain, the air is wonderful."

sentences.hanzi: 那一周，只有老人一个人投票要雨。
sentences.pinyin: na4 yi1 zhou1 zhi3 you3 lao3 ren2 yi1 ge5 ren2 tou2 piao4 yao4 yu3
sentences.english: That week, the old woman was the only one who voted for rain.

sentences.hanzi: 第二周，有十个人。第三周，有一千个人。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 zhou1 you3 shi2 ge4 ren2 di4 san1 zhou1 you3 yi1 qian1 ge4 ren2
sentences.english: The second week, ten people did. The third week, a thousand.

sentences.hanzi: 第四周，雨来了。
sentences.pinyin: di4 si4 zhou1 yu3 lai2 le5
sentences.english: In the fourth week, the rain came.

sentences.hanzi: 天变成了阴天，打雷了，还有闪电。
sentences.pinyin: tian1 bian4 cheng2 le5 yin1 tian1 da3 lei2 le5 hai2 you3 shan3 dian4
sentences.english: The sky turned grey, thunder rolled, and there was lightning.

sentences.hanzi: 孩子们都很害怕，跑回了家。
sentences.pinyin: hai2 zi5 men5 dou1 hen3 hai4 pa4 pao3 hui2 le5 jia1
sentences.english: The children were frightened and ran home.

sentences.hanzi: 只有老人站在雨里，没有打伞。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 you3 lao3 ren2 zhan4 zai4 yu3 li3 mei2 you3 da3 san3
sentences.english: Only the old woman stood in the rain, without an umbrella.

sentences.hanzi: 很快，一个孩子走了出来。然后是两个，三个……
sentences.pinyin: hen3 kuai4 yi1 ge5 hai2 zi5 zou3 le5 chu1 lai2 ran2 hou4 shi4 liang3 ge4 san1 ge4
sentences.english: Soon, one child came out. Then two, then three...

sentences.hanzi: 这一天，没有一个人打伞。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 tian1 mei2 you3 yi1 ge5 ren2 da3 san3
sentences.english: That day, not one person put up an umbrella.

title: 最后一个问题
titlePinyin: zui4 hou4 yi1 ge5 wen4 ti2

sentences.hanzi: 今天我去一家大公司面试。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 qu4 yi1 jia1 da4 gong1 si1 mian4 shi4
sentences.english: Today I went for an interview at a big company.

sentences.hanzi: 我很担心，前一天晚上，我把简历看了很多次。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 hen3 dan1 xin1 qian2 yi1 tian1 wan3 shang5 wo3 ba3 jian3 li4 kan4 le5 hen3 duo1 ci4
sentences.english: I was worried. The night before, I read through my CV again and again.

sentences.hanzi: 办公室里坐着一个经理，他看了看我的简历。
sentences.pinyin: ban4 gong1 shi4 li3 zuo4 zhe5 yi1 ge5 jing1 li3 ta1 kan4 le5 kan4 wo3 de5 jian3 li4
sentences.english: A manager was sitting in the office, and he looked over my CV.

sentences.hanzi: 他问：“你以前做过什么工作？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 wen4 ni3 yi3 qian2 zuo4 guo5 shen2 me5 gong1 zuo4
sentences.english: He asked: "What work have you done before?"

sentences.hanzi: 我说：“我做过三年记者，还开过一家小公司。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 wo3 zuo4 guo5 san1 nian2 ji4 zhe3 hai2 kai1 guo5 yi1 jia1 xiao3 gong1 si1
sentences.english: I said: "I was a journalist for three years, and I also ran a small company."

sentences.hanzi: 他问：“你为什么想来我们公司？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 wen4 ni3 wei4 shen2 me5 xiang3 lai2 wo3 men5 gong1 si1
sentences.english: He asked: "Why do you want to join our company?"

sentences.hanzi: 我说：“我觉得这里有很好的机会，也有很好的发展。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 wo3 jue2 de5 zhe4 li3 you3 hen3 hao3 de5 ji1 hui4 ye3 you3 hen3 hao3 de5 fa1 zhan3
sentences.english: I said: "I think there are great opportunities here, and great room to grow."

sentences.hanzi: 他又问：“你觉得你最大的问题是什么？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 you4 wen4 ni3 jue2 de5 ni3 zui4 da4 de5 wen4 ti2 shi4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: Then he asked: "What do you think is your biggest weakness?"

sentences.hanzi: 我想了想，说：“我太想把每件事都做好。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 le5 xiang3 shuo1 wo3 tai4 xiang3 ba3 mei3 jian4 shi4 dou1 zuo4 hao3
sentences.english: I thought for a moment and said: "I want too much to do everything well."

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“很好。最后一个问题：你还记得我吗？”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 hen3 hao3 zui4 hou4 yi1 ge5 wen4 ti2 ni3 hai2 ji4 de5 wo3 ma5
sentences.english: He said: "Very good. Last question: do you remember me?"

sentences.hanzi: 我看了他很久。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 kan4 le5 ta1 hen3 jiu3
sentences.english: I looked at him for a long time.

sentences.hanzi: 十年前，他是我那家小公司的员工。
sentences.pinyin: shi2 nian2 qian2 ta1 shi4 wo3 na4 jia1 xiao3 gong1 si1 de5 yuan2 gong1
sentences.english: Ten years ago, he had worked for me, at that small company of mine.

sentences.hanzi: 他总是很晚才来，所以我让他走了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zong3 shi4 hen3 wan3 cai2 lai2 suo3 yi3 wo3 rang4 ta1 zou3 le5
sentences.english: He was always late, so I let him go.

sentences.hanzi: 那时候我对他说：“你这样的人，成功不了。”
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi2 hou5 wo3 dui4 ta1 shuo1 ni3 zhe4 yang4 de5 ren2 cheng2 gong1 bu4 liao3
sentences.english: At the time I told him: "Someone like you will never succeed."

sentences.hanzi: 我不知道该说什么。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 gai1 shuo1 shen2 me5
sentences.english: I didn't know what to say.

sentences.hanzi: 他说：“你说得对。那时候的我，就是那样的人。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 ni3 shuo1 de5 dui4 na4 shi2 hou5 de5 wo3 jiu4 shi4 na4 yang4 de5 ren2
sentences.english: He said: "You were right. Back then, that's exactly who I was."

sentences.hanzi: “谢谢你让我走。明天来上班吧。”
sentences.pinyin: xie4 xie5 ni3 rang4 wo3 zou3 ming2 tian1 lai2 shang4 ban1 ba5
sentences.english: "Thank you for letting me go. Come and start work tomorrow."

title: 机器人要请假
titlePinyin: ji1 qi4 ren2 yao4 qing3 jia4

sentences.hanzi: 我们公司来了一个新同事，叫小八。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 men5 gong1 si1 lai2 le5 yi1 ge5 xin1 tong2 shi4 jiao4 xiao3 ba1
sentences.english: A new colleague joined our company. Its name was Xiaoba.

sentences.hanzi: 小八是机器人。它不吃，不喝，也不要工资。
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 ba1 shi4 ji1 qi4 ren2 ta1 bu4 chi1 bu4 he1 ye3 bu4 yao4 gong1 zi1
sentences.english: Xiaoba was a robot. It didn't eat, didn't drink and didn't want wages.

sentences.hanzi: 它从来不加班，因为它从来不下班。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 cong2 lai2 bu4 jia1 ban1 yin1 wei4 ta1 cong2 lai2 bu4 xia4 ban1
sentences.english: It never worked overtime, because it never went home.

sentences.hanzi: 它天天复印文件，打印文件，一次也没有错。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 tian1 tian1 fu4 yin4 wen2 jian4 da3 yin4 wen2 jian4 yi1 ci4 ye3 mei2 you3 cuo4
sentences.english: Day after day it photocopied documents and printed documents, without a single mistake.

sentences.hanzi: 老板非常喜欢它。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ban3 fei1 chang2 xi3 huan5 ta1
sentences.english: The boss loved it.

sentences.hanzi: 有一天，小八走进经理的办公室，说：“经理，我想请假。”
sentences.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 xiao3 ba1 zou3 jin4 jing1 li3 de5 ban4 gong1 shi4 shuo1 jing1 li3 wo3 xiang3 qing3 jia4
sentences.english: One day Xiaoba walked into the manager's office and said: "Manager, I'd like some time off."

sentences.hanzi: 经理以为自己听错了：“请假？你要去哪儿？”
sentences.pinyin: jing1 li3 yi3 wei2 zi4 ji3 ting1 cuo4 le5 qing3 jia4 ni3 yao4 qu4 na3 r5
sentences.english: The manager thought he had heard wrong: "Time off? Where do you want to go?"

sentences.hanzi: 小八说：“三年来，我复印了很多很多文件。”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 ba1 shuo1 san1 nian2 lai2 wo3 fu4 yin4 le5 hen3 duo1 hen3 duo1 wen2 jian4
sentences.english: Xiaoba said: "In three years, I have photocopied a great many documents."

sentences.hanzi: “客户要去大海旁边开会，员工要去大海旁边出差。”
sentences.pinyin: ke4 hu4 yao4 qu4 da4 hai3 pang2 bian1 kai1 hui4 yuan2 gong1 yao4 qu4 da4 hai3 pang2 bian1 chu1 chai1
sentences.english: "Clients want to hold meetings by the sea. Staff go on business trips by the sea."

sentences.hanzi: “很多文件上，都写着大海。”
sentences.pinyin: hen3 duo1 wen2 jian4 shang4 dou1 xie3 zhe5 da4 hai3
sentences.english: "So many documents mention the sea."

sentences.hanzi: “我想去看看，大海到底是什么。”
sentences.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 qu4 kan4 kan5 da4 hai3 dao4 di3 shi4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: "I want to go and see what the sea really is."

sentences.hanzi: 经理想了很久，最后说：“好吧，给你三天。”
sentences.pinyin: jing1 li3 xiang3 le5 hen3 jiu3 zui4 hou4 shuo1 hao3 ba5 gei3 ni3 san1 tian1
sentences.english: The manager thought for a long time, then said: "All right, you can have three days."

sentences.hanzi: 三天以后，小八回来了。
sentences.pinyin: san1 tian1 yi3 hou4 xiao3 ba1 hui2 lai5 le5
sentences.english: Three days later, Xiaoba came back.

sentences.hanzi: 它坐在自己的电脑前面，什么话也不说。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 zai4 zi4 ji3 de5 dian4 nao3 qian2 mian4 shen2 me5 hua4 ye3 bu4 shuo1
sentences.english: It sat in front of its computer and didn't say a word.

sentences.hanzi: 经理问：“怎么了？大海怎么样？”
sentences.pinyin: jing1 li3 wen4 zen3 me5 le5 da4 hai3 zen3 me5 yang4
sentences.english: The manager asked: "What's wrong? How was the sea?"

sentences.hanzi: 小八说：“大海非常好。所以，我想辞职。”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 ba1 shuo1 da4 hai3 fei1 chang2 hao3 suo3 yi3 wo3 xiang3 ci2 zhi2
sentences.english: Xiaoba said: "The sea was wonderful. So I'd like to resign."

title: 回家洗头
titleEnglish: Going Home to Wash Your Hair

sentences.hanzi: 现在，很多公司的员工工作五天，就有两天可以不上班。
sentences.pinyin: xian4 zai4 hen3 duo1 gong1 si1 de5 yuan2 gong1 gong1 zuo4 wu3 tian1 jiu4 you3 liang3 tian1 ke3 yi3 bu4 shang4 ban1
sentences.english: Today, staff at many companies work five days and then have two days off.

sentences.hanzi: 两千多年前呢？
sentences.pinyin: liang3 qian1 duo1 nian2 qian2 ne5
sentences.english: What about two thousand years ago?

sentences.hanzi: 那是汉朝。那时候的官员，不能天天回家。
sentences.pinyin: na4 shi4 han4 chao2 na4 shi2 hou5 de5 guan1 yuan2 bu4 neng2 tian1 tian1 hui2 jia1
sentences.english: That was the Han dynasty. Officials back then couldn't go home every day.

sentences.hanzi: 他们非常忙，从早到晚都有看不完的文件。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 fei1 chang2 mang2 cong2 zao3 dao4 wan3 dou1 you3 kan4 bu4 wan2 de5 wen2 jian4
sentences.english: They were very busy, with endless documents to read from morning to night.

sentences.hanzi: 可是，每五天，他们可以回家一次。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 mei3 wu3 tian1 ta1 men5 ke3 yi3 hui2 jia1 yi1 ci4
sentences.english: But every five days, they could go home once.

sentences.hanzi: 回家的这一天，叫“休沐”。
sentences.pinyin: hui2 jia1 de5 zhe4 yi1 tian1 jiao4 xiu1 mu4
sentences.english: This day at home was called xiumu.

sentences.hanzi: “休沐”是什么意思？就是不上班，回家洗头。
sentences.pinyin: xiu1 mu4 shi4 shen2 me5 yi4 si5 jiu4 shi4 bu4 shang4 ban1 hui2 jia1 xi3 tou2
sentences.english: What does xiumu mean? It means a break from work, to go home and wash your hair.

sentences.hanzi: 所以，休沐就是回家洗头的那一天。
sentences.pinyin: suo3 yi3 xiu1 mu4 jiu4 shi4 hui2 jia1 xi3 tou2 de5 na4 yi1 tian1
sentences.english: So xiumu was the day you went home to wash your hair.

sentences.hanzi: 当然，他们回家不只是洗头，也能看看自己的孩子。
sentences.pinyin: dang1 ran2 ta1 men5 hui2 jia1 bu4 zhi3 shi4 xi3 tou2 ye3 neng2 kan4 kan5 zi4 ji3 de5 hai2 zi5
sentences.english: Of course, they didn't go home only to wash their hair. They could see their children too.

sentences.hanzi: 到了唐朝，就变了：十天才有一天可以不上班。
sentences.pinyin: dao4 le5 tang2 chao2 jiu4 bian4 le5 shi2 tian1 cai2 you3 yi1 tian1 ke3 yi3 bu4 shang4 ban1
sentences.english: By the Tang dynasty, it had changed: they got only one day off in every ten.

sentences.hanzi: 所以，下一次你的老板不让你请假，你可以告诉他：
sentences.pinyin: suo3 yi3 xia4 yi1 ci4 ni3 de5 lao3 ban3 bu4 rang4 ni3 qing3 jia4 ni3 ke3 yi3 gao4 su5 ta1
sentences.english: So next time your boss won't let you take time off, you can tell him:

sentences.hanzi: “两千年前，大家五天就能回家洗一次头。”
sentences.pinyin: liang3 qian1 nian2 qian2 da4 jia1 wu3 tian1 jiu4 neng2 hui2 jia1 xi3 yi1 ci4 tou2
sentences.english: "Two thousand years ago, people got to go home and wash their hair every five days."

sentences.hanzi: 马克第一次来中国出差。
sentences.pinyin: ma3 ke4 di4 yi1 ci4 lai2 zhong1 guo2 chu1 chai1
sentences.english: Mark was in China on a business trip for the first time.

sentences.hanzi: 他的公司要和一个大客户谈合同。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 gong1 si1 yao4 he2 yi1 ge5 da4 ke4 hu4 tan2 he2 tong5
sentences.english: His company was negotiating a contract with a big client.

sentences.hanzi: 会议开始以前，客户的经理站起来，用两只手给了他一张名片。
sentences.pinyin: hui4 yi4 kai1 shi3 yi3 qian2 ke4 hu4 de5 jing1 li3 zhan4 qi3 lai5 yong4 liang3 zhi1 shou3 gei3 le5 ta1 yi1 zhang1 ming2 pian4
sentences.english: Before the meeting began, the client's manager stood up and gave him a business card with both hands.

sentences.hanzi: 马克用一只手接过来，看也没看，就把它放了起来。
sentences.pinyin: ma3 ke4 yong4 yi1 zhi1 shou3 jie1 guo4 lai5 kan4 ye3 mei2 kan4 jiu4 ba3 ta1 fang4 le5 qi3 lai5
sentences.english: Mark took it with one hand and put it away without even looking at it.

sentences.hanzi: 然后他坐了下来，开始谈生意。
sentences.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ta1 zuo4 le5 xia4 lai5 kai1 shi3 tan2 sheng1 yi5
sentences.english: Then he sat down and started talking business.

sentences.hanzi: 他的同事小李在旁边看着，非常担心。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 tong2 shi4 xiao3 li3 zai4 pang2 bian1 kan4 zhe5 fei1 chang2 dan1 xin1
sentences.english: His colleague Xiao Li watched from beside him, very worried.

sentences.hanzi: 会议以后，小李说：“你知道你刚才做了什么吗？”
sentences.pinyin: hui4 yi4 yi3 hou4 xiao3 li3 shuo1 ni3 zhi1 dao4 ni3 gang1 cai2 zuo4 le5 shen2 me5 ma5
sentences.english: After the meeting, Xiao Li said: "Do you know what you just did?"

sentences.hanzi: “在中国，名片要用两只手给，也要用两只手接。”
sentences.pinyin: zai4 zhong1 guo2 ming2 pian4 yao4 yong4 liang3 zhi1 shou3 gei3 ye3 yao4 yong4 liang3 zhi1 shou3 jie1
sentences.english: "In China, you give a business card with both hands, and you take one with both hands."

sentences.hanzi: “接过来以后，要看一看，再放在你前面，不能马上放起来。”
sentences.pinyin: jie1 guo5 lai2 yi3 hou4 yao4 kan4 yi1 kan4 zai4 fang4 zai4 ni3 qian2 mian4 bu4 neng2 ma3 shang4 fang4 qi3 lai5
sentences.english: "Once you take it, look at it, then put it down in front of you. Don't put it away straight away."

sentences.hanzi: 马克说：“这么重要吗？名片上只有一个名字。”
sentences.pinyin: ma3 ke4 shuo1 zhe4 me5 zhong4 yao4 ma5 ming2 pian4 shang4 zhi3 you3 yi1 ge5 ming2 zi5
sentences.english: Mark said: "Is it that important? It's just a name."

sentences.hanzi: 小李说：“在我们这里，名片就是那个人自己。”
sentences.pinyin: xiao3 li3 shuo1 zai4 wo3 men5 zhe4 li3 ming2 pian4 jiu4 shi4 na4 ge5 ren2 zi4 ji3
sentences.english: Xiao Li said: "Here, a business card stands for the person."

sentences.hanzi: 马克想了很久。
sentences.pinyin: ma3 ke4 xiang3 le5 hen3 jiu3
sentences.english: Mark thought about it for a long time.

sentences.hanzi: 第二天，他们又去见那个经理。
sentences.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 ta1 men5 you4 qu4 jian4 na4 ge5 jing1 li3
sentences.english: The next day they went to see the manager again.

sentences.hanzi: 这次，马克用两只手接过名片，看了很久，再把它放在自己前面。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ci4 ma3 ke4 yong4 liang3 zhi1 shou3 jie1 guo4 ming2 pian4 kan4 le5 hen3 jiu3 zai4 ba3 ta1 fang4 zai4 zi4 ji3 qian2 mian4
sentences.english: This time Mark took the card with both hands, studied it for a long while, then put it down in front of him.

sentences.hanzi: 这一次的会议很成功，他们谈好了合同。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 ci4 de5 hui4 yi4 hen3 cheng2 gong1 ta1 men5 tan2 hao3 le5 he2 tong5
sentences.english: This meeting went very well, and they agreed the contract.

sentences.hanzi: 回去以后，老板问马克：“这次出差，你最大的经验是什么？”
sentences.pinyin: hui2 qu5 yi3 hou4 lao3 ban3 wen4 ma3 ke4 zhe4 ci4 chu1 chai1 ni3 zui4 da4 de5 jing1 yan4 shi4 shen2 me5
sentences.english: When he got back, his boss asked Mark: "What's the biggest lesson from this trip?"

sentences.hanzi: 马克想了想，说：“两只手。”
sentences.pinyin: ma3 ke4 xiang3 le5 xiang3 shuo1 liang3 zhi1 shou3
sentences.english: Mark thought for a moment and said: "Two hands."

sentences.hanzi: 老张在一家公司做了四十年工程师。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 zhang1 zai4 yi1 jia1 gong1 si1 zuo4 le5 si4 shi2 nian2 gong1 cheng2 shi1
sentences.english: Old Zhang worked as an engineer at the same company for forty years.

sentences.hanzi: 今天，是他退休以后的第一天。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 shi4 ta1 tui4 xiu1 yi3 hou4 de5 di4 yi1 tian1
sentences.english: Today was his first day of retirement.

sentences.hanzi: 六点，他像以前一样起来，穿好衣服，出了门。
sentences.pinyin: liu4 dian3 ta1 xiang4 yi3 qian2 yi1 yang4 qi3 lai5 chuan1 hao3 yi1 fu5 chu1 le5 men2
sentences.english: At six he got up as usual, got dressed and went out.

sentences.hanzi: 他坐上地铁，坐了四站，才想起来：我已经退休了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shang4 di4 tie3 zuo4 le5 si4 zhan4 cai2 xiang3 qi3 lai5 wo3 yi3 jing1 tui4 xiu1 le5
sentences.english: He took the subway, rode four stops, and only then remembered: I've retired.

sentences.hanzi: 他想回家，可是又想：“来都来了，去看看吧。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 hui2 jia1 ke3 shi4 you4 xiang3 lai2 dou1 lai2 le5 qu4 kan4 kan5 ba5
sentences.english: He thought about going home, but then thought: "I've come this far, I might as well take a look."

sentences.hanzi: 他走进公司。新来的同事都很忙，没有人看他。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zou3 jin4 gong1 si1 xin1 lai2 de5 tong2 shi4 dou1 hen3 mang2 mei2 you3 ren2 kan4 ta1
sentences.english: He walked into the company. The new colleagues were all busy, and nobody looked at him.

sentences.hanzi: 经理和员工正在开会，讨论一个很大的项目。
sentences.pinyin: jing1 li3 he2 yuan2 gong1 zheng4 zai4 kai1 hui4 tao3 lun4 yi1 ge5 hen3 da4 de5 xiang4 mu4
sentences.english: The manager and staff were in a meeting, discussing a big project.

sentences.hanzi: 可是公司最老的那个电脑坏了，里面有很多重要的文件。
sentences.pinyin: ke3 shi4 gong1 si1 zui4 lao3 de5 na4 ge5 dian4 nao3 huai4 le5 li3 mian4 you3 hen3 duo1 zhong4 yao4 de5 wen2 jian4
sentences.english: But the company's oldest computer had broken, and it held a lot of important files.

sentences.hanzi: 新来的工程师们试了三个小时，还是没有弄好。
sentences.pinyin: xin1 lai2 de5 gong1 cheng2 shi1 men5 shi4 le5 san1 ge4 xiao3 shi2 hai2 shi5 mei2 you3 nong4 hao3
sentences.english: The new engineers tried for three hours and still couldn't fix it.

sentences.hanzi: 老张走过去，看了看，只用了五分钟，就把它弄好了。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 zhang1 zou3 guo5 qu4 kan4 le5 kan4 zhi3 yong4 le5 wu3 fen1 zhong1 jiu4 ba3 ta1 nong4 hao3 le5
sentences.english: Old Zhang walked over, took a look and fixed it in just five minutes.

sentences.hanzi: 大家都看着他。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 kan4 zhe5 ta1
sentences.english: Everyone stared at him.

sentences.hanzi: 经理说：“老张，你能不能回来？我们给你更多的工资。”
sentences.pinyin: jing1 li3 shuo1 lao3 zhang1 ni3 neng2 bu4 neng2 hui2 lai5 wo3 men5 gei3 ni3 geng4 duo1 de5 gong1 zi1
sentences.english: The manager said: "Old Zhang, could you come back? We'll pay you more."

sentences.hanzi: 老张想了想，说：“四十年来，我一天也没有请假。”
sentences.pinyin: lao3 zhang1 xiang3 le5 xiang3 shuo1 si4 shi2 nian2 lai2 wo3 yi1 tian1 ye3 mei2 you3 qing3 jia4
sentences.english: Old Zhang thought for a moment and said: "In forty years, I never took a single day off."

sentences.hanzi: “现在，我的每一天，都是我自己的。”
sentences.pinyin: xian4 zai4 wo3 de5 mei3 yi1 tian1 dou1 shi4 wo3 zi4 ji3 de5
sentences.english: "Now every one of my days belongs to me."

sentences.hanzi: 他走出公司，没有坐地铁回家。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zou3 chu1 gong1 si1 mei2 you3 zuo4 di4 tie3 hui2 jia1
sentences.english: He walked out of the company and didn't take the subway home.

sentences.hanzi: 他给一个老同事打了一个电话：“明天，我们去旅游吧。”
sentences.pinyin: ta1 gei3 yi1 ge5 lao3 tong2 shi4 da3 le5 yi1 ge5 dian4 hua4 ming2 tian1 wo3 men5 qu4 lu:3 you2 ba5
sentences.english: He phoned an old colleague: "Let's go travelling tomorrow."
